jobs.description:
OverviewDecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support standardized endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks an Endpoint Engineer to develop, maintain, deploy, and support standardized endpoint capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This position supports endpoint images, application packaging, device provisioning, software deployment, patching, configuration baselines, and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.

The Endpoint Engineer supports physical and virtual endpoints throughout their lifecycle, including testing, deployment, configuration, patching, troubleshooting, refresh, recovery, and retirement. The engineer works with the Senior Endpoint Engineer and other technical teams to deliver secure, consistent, and supportable endpoint services across USMEPCOM Headquarters, MEPS, Remote Processing Substations, COOP locations, and remote-user environments.

This role maintains a clear division of responsibility with Task 6 cybersecurity personnel. Task 6 identifies, prioritizes, and validates security findings. The Endpoint Engineer evaluates assigned findings, tests the approved correction, implements the operational change through established change-control procedures, and provides deployment evidence for cybersecurity validation.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Occasional after-hours maintenance, incident response, on-site support, or travel may be required.

 Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Endpoint Engineer will:

- Develop, test, maintain, and document standardized endpoint images.

- Maintain image components, operating-system settings, drivers, firmware dependencies, security baselines, required software, and deployment configurations.

- Support image versioning, testing, approval, release, rollback, and retirement processes.

- Validate endpoint images for functionality, compatibility, security, performance, and operational readiness.

- Develop and maintain automated device-deployment task sequences, provisioning workflows, enrollment processes, and configuration profiles.

- Support endpoint deployment using approved Microsoft and Government management platforms.

- Administer approved endpoint-management capabilities involving Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager, Windows Autopilot, or comparable technologies.

- Develop, test, maintain, and deploy application packages.

- Package commercial, Government, and internally developed software using approved formats and standards.

- Develop installation, detection, dependency, requirement, upgrade, repair, and removal logic.

- Test application packages for silent installation, accurate detection, compatibility, security, and clean removal.

- Troubleshoot package failures, dependency problems, application conflicts, detection errors, and deployment issues.

- Develop approved scripts and automation for provisioning, packaging, configuration, deployment, validation, and remediation.

- Maintain endpoint-management scripts and configurations in approved documentation and version-control repositories.

- Support patching of endpoint operating systems, applications, drivers, firmware, and management components.

- Configure and maintain pilot groups, deployment rings, production waves, maintenance windows, deadlines, and exception processes.

- Test operating-system updates, security patches, vendor patches, and application updates before production deployment.

- Monitor patch and deployment progress, failure rates, compliance status, endpoint health, and approved exceptions.

- Investigate failed patches and coordinate corrective actions, redeployment, rollback, or exception documentation.

- Engineer and support Virtual Desktop Infrastructure capabilities.

- Develop and maintain VDI base images, desktop pools, application delivery, user-profile configurations, and endpoint-access policies.

- Troubleshoot VDI login, profile, application, display, performance, peripheral, and connectivity problems.

- Support VDI refreshes, upgrades, capacity activities, deployment, testing, and optimization.

- Coordinate VDI dependencies with virtualization, storage, network, identity, application, and cybersecurity teams.

- Support endpoint deployment and refresh projects across geographically dispersed USMEPCOM locations.

- Assist with device provisioning, enrollment, configuration, testing, deployment, replacement, recovery, and retirement.

- Support operating-system upgrades, application migrations, technology refreshes, and endpoint-management transitions.

- Provide advanced engineering support for complex endpoint, image, application-packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI incidents.

- Analyze endpoint logs, deployment status, policy results, management-platform data, and other technical evidence.

- Support root-cause analysis and implement approved corrective actions for recurring endpoint incidents.

- Assist with major incidents and outages involving endpoint management, software deployments, VDI, or widespread device failures.

- Implement approved workarounds and restoration actions during endpoint-related incidents.

- Coordinate with the Service Desk and field-support teams to improve troubleshooting, escalation, and knowledge content.

- Develop technical guidance for common endpoint, packaging, deployment, patching, and VDI problems.

- Review cybersecurity findings assigned to endpoint operations by Task 6.

- Assess operational impact, dependencies, testing requirements, deployment approach, and rollback requirements.

- Test and implement approved endpoint security changes through established change and release procedures.

- Execute assigned remediation involving endpoint images, software versions, patches, configurations, policies, or management settings.

- Track the affected endpoint population, deployment status, failures, exceptions, and completion results.

- Provide remediation and completion evidence to Task 6 for validation.

- Coordinate unresolved remediation issues with cybersecurity personnel, vendors, system owners, and Government stakeholders.

- Apply approved endpoint-security baselines and DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides.

- Support endpoint compliance reporting, configuration validation, vulnerability remediation, and audit-evidence collection.

- Maintain endpoint inventories, deployment records, image documentation, software-package records, patch status, VDI records, and configuration baselines.

- Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, packaging instructions, test plans, deployment plans, rollback procedures, and recovery documentation.

- Follow approved incident, problem, change, release, configuration, asset, security, and quality-management processes.

- Provide endpoint health, deployment, patching, compliance, risk, and issue information for program reporting.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

- Active Secret clearance or higher.

- Bachelor’s degree in information technology, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience where permitted by the applicable labor category.

- Minimum of six years of relevant experience in endpoint engineering, systems engineering, device management, desktop engineering, VDI engineering, or a related technical discipline.

- Experience developing or maintaining enterprise endpoint images.

- Experience developing, testing, and deploying application packages.

- Experience supporting endpoint provisioning, deployment, patching, configuration, and lifecycle management.

- Experience engineering or supporting Virtual Desktop Infrastructure.

- Experience implementing assigned endpoint-security or vulnerability-remediation changes.

- Experience troubleshooting complex endpoint, packaging, deployment, patching, or VDI issues.

- Knowledge of controlled testing, pilot deployment, phased implementation, validation, rollback, and change-management practices.

- Ability to maintain image documentation, software-package records, test plans, deployment plans, rollback procedures, and completion evidence.

- Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate certification when relevant to the assigned Microsoft 365 or Intune environment.

- Ability to support after-hours maintenance, deployment windows, critical incidents, and endpoint recovery when required.

- Strong written, verbal, analytical, and technical problem-solving skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

- Experience with Microsoft Intune or Microsoft Endpoint Manager.

- Experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager or System Center Configuration Manager.

- Experience with Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning.

- Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

- Experience with Microsoft Entra ID and hybrid endpoint management.

- Experience with PowerShell, Microsoft Graph, or comparable endpoint-automation technologies.

- Experience packaging applications using MSI, MSIX, Win32, App-V, or comparable formats.

- Experience with VMware Horizon, Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or another enterprise VDI platform.

- Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense endpoint environments.

- Experience applying DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides to Windows endpoints.

- Experience supporting Risk Management Framework controls, vulnerability remediation, or authorization evidence.

- Experience with endpoint analytics, compliance, configuration-management, or digital employee-experience tools.

- Experience supporting large-scale operating-system migrations, device refreshes, or endpoint-management modernization.

- CompTIA Security+ or another relevant security certification.

- ITIL v4 Foundation certification.

- Relevant Microsoft, VMware, Citrix, cloud, automation, or endpoint-management certification.

Skills and Competencies

- Enterprise endpoint engineering and support.

- Image development and automated deployment.

- Application packaging and software distribution.

- Operating-system and application patch management.

- Endpoint security-baseline implementation.

- VDI configuration, deployment, and troubleshooting.

- PowerShell and endpoint-management automation.

- Complex troubleshooting and root-cause analysis.

- Controlled testing, phased deployment, and rollback execution.

- Cybersecurity remediation and evidence development.

- Technical documentation and configuration management.

- Cross-functional engineering coordination.

- Strong attention to detail and change discipline.

Position Purpose: The Endpoint Security Engineering Manager is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery execution, workforce management, and capability advancement of the organization's endpoint security capabilities.

 Position Purpose: The Endpoint Security Engineering Manager is responsible for the operational leadership, delivery execution, workforce management, and capability advancement of the organization's endpoint security capabilities.

This leader ensures the enterprise endpoint security platform remains effective, scalable, measurable, and aligned to business risk reduction objectives. The role manages the engineering team responsible for endpoint protection technologies, endpoint security policy implementation, platform health, operational readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.

The Manager is accountable for delivery and team performance, while partnering closely with senior engineers and capability stewards for technical leadership and architectural direction. The role calls for a thoughtful, people-centered leader who listens well, considers different perspectives, and applies sound judgment to complex technical and organizational decisions.

Candidates should bring direct engineering experience with enterprise endpoint security, endpoint management, or security enforcement platforms, including hands-on experience with at least some of the following core technologies: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike, Trend Micro Cloud One, Microsoft Intune, Tanium Enforce, and Absolute. Additional experience with Armis, Nexthink, Dynatrace, or Microsoft Entra is preferred. This technical foundation is important for providing engineering leadership, participating in complex technical discussions and incident troubleshooting, assessing architecture and configuration decisions, and providing meaningful technical guidance to the endpoint security engineering team.

 Key Details: Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship and future sponsorship are not available for this opportunity, including employment-based visa types H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, F-1, J -1, OPT, or CPT.

Team Leadership:

- Lead a team of endpoint security engineers.

- Establish priorities, sprint objectives, and operational work plans.

- Conduct performance evaluations, career development, coaching, and mentoring.

- Develop succession plans and reduce key-person dependency risks.

- Build a sustainable operating model that distributes ownership across the team.

- Foster a respectful, inclusive team environment by understanding individual perspectives, responding constructively to challenges, and making well-reasoned decisions.

Operational Accountability:

- Ensure reliable operation of endpoint security platforms and services.

- Maintain operational readiness, support models, escalation paths, and runbooks.

- Manage engineering backlogs and technical debt initiatives.

- Monitor service health, platform coverage, policy effectiveness, and operational metrics.

- Drive consistent execution of security engineering processes.

Capability Management:

- Advance endpoint security capabilities across prevention, detection, visibility, and control enforcement.

- Partner with Capability Stewards to develop multi-year capability roadmaps.

- Prioritize initiatives based on risk reduction, operational efficiency, and business value.

- Ensure new capabilities transition successfully into production operations.

Security Platform Ownership:

Provide operational leadership for technologies and capabilities including:

- Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR).

- Malware Prevention and Anti-Virus.

- Attack Surface Reduction (ASR).

- Endpoint Security Policy Management.

- Endpoint Security Telemetry.

- Device Compliance and Coverage Reporting.

- Security Tool Health Monitoring.

- Endpoint Security Feature Adoption.

Program and Project Execution:

- Manage execution of endpoint security projects and strategic initiatives.

- Coordinate resources, timelines, dependencies, and stakeholder communication.

- Partner with infrastructure, workplace technology, architecture, and security operations teams.

- Ensure projects achieve measurable business and security outcomes.

Governance and Risk Management:

- Track operational risks and control effectiveness.

- Escalate issues requiring risk acceptance or executive decisions.

- Support audit, compliance, and control validation activities.

- Maintain documented standards, procedures, and engineering practices.

Vendor and Service Provider Management:

- Manage relationships with endpoint security vendors and service providers.

- Hold vendors accountable to contracted deliverables and service levels.

- Review performance metrics, roadmaps, and support effectiveness.

- Drive continuous improvement through vendor partnerships.

- Performs other duties as assigned.

- Complies with all policies and standards.

 Education/Experience: Requires a Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of related experience.

Or equivalent experience acquired through accomplishments of applicable knowledge, duties, scope and skill reflective of the level of this position.

Required Leadership Competencies:

- Strong people leadership and team development skills.

- Execution-focused management approach.

- Ability to balance operational support and strategic improvements.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

- Experience managing multiple concurrent security initiatives.

- Risk-based decision-making capability.

- Ability to translate technical issues into business impact discussions.

- Prior people-management experience, with a record of strengthening team effectiveness, engagement, and development.

- Demonstrated success improving the reliability, maturity, or effectiveness of the technologies and services supported by their teams.

- Endpoint Security engineering or operations experience preferred.

Soft Skills:

- Ability to lead/manage others.

- Collaboration and team building skills.

- Effectively coaches and delivers constructive feedback.

- Instills commitment to organizational goals.

- Ability to communicate and make recommendations to upper management.

- Effective conflict management skills.

- Develops and delivers effective presentations.

- Demonstrated negotiation skills.

Pay Range: $102,900.00 - $190,500.00 per year

 At Centene, we connect people to the care they need to live healthier lives — and the work you do here makes that impact real every day. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that directly support individuals, families, and communities, building your skills while making healthcare more accessible and effective. It’s work with a purpose you can see, backed by a team committed to improving lives well beyond the workday.

Centene offers a comprehensive benefits package including: competitive pay, health insurance, 401K and stock purchase plans, tuition reimbursement, paid time off plus holidays, and a flexible approach to work with remote, hybrid, field or office work schedules. Actual pay will be adjusted based on an individual's skills, experience, education, and other job-related factors permitted by law, including full-time or part-time status. Total compensation may also include additional forms of incentives. Benefits may be subject to program eligibility.

Centene is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity, and values the ways in which we are different. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristic protected by applicable law.

jobs.description:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

Our Desktop Systems Engineering team is the front line of support for all users across the firm. We work with a wide range of the best technology available - - and we get to test, configure and deploy it all in an environment that continually challenges us and demands that we learn new things daily. The team is also responsible for driving innovation for technologies that impact users daily. The pace is fast but we also obsess about leaving no stone unturned when there is a problem to be solved. We believe in healthy debate, creative and collaborative problem solving and active knowledge sharing. Strong technical aptitude and a passion for technology are critical for success in the Systems Engineer role but initiative, strong analytics and drive are equally important.

 What you’ll be doing:

- Providing end-user support to employees in the Chicago corporate office and exchange floors

- Building, configuring, and upgrading workstations, laptops, and mobile devices

- Troubleshooting, maintenance, and upgrades of desktop managed servers

- User provisioning (user accounts, mobile devices, VPN, directory permissions)

- Providing support for conference room technologies

- Automation of repetitive system administration tasks

- Evaluating and recommending new hardware and software technologies or solutions

  What we’re looking for in this role:

- 2+ years of MEMCM/SCCM administration experience or similar

- Knowledge of application packaging and management

- Strong experience supporting and configuring Windows 10

- Strong knowledge of Group Policy management

- Powershell experience

- Passionate about technology

- Highly motivated, self-starter who is eager to grow within our organization

- Ability to manage projects independently

- Previous mobile device management experience

  Nice to have:

- Intune management experience

- Previous macOS or Linux support experience

- Previous Windows Server and Active Directory support experience

- Scripting or low-level programming experience

The annual base salary range for this position is $85,000 to $125,000 depending on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and relevant skill set. The position is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition, DRW offers a comprehensive suite of employee benefits including group medical, pharmacy, dental and vision insurance, 401k (with discretionary employer match), short and long-term disability, life and AD&D insurance, health savings accounts, and flexible spending accounts.

 For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice .

  California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice .

Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?

IFF is a global leader in Flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences, we deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.

Digital Technology Solutions: Accelerating innovation through data, technology and digital transformation, building intelligent solutions that enhance experiences and power smarter decisions.

The role is based in Chennai, India. Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.

 Where You’ll Make a Difference

- Engineer and support M365 environments, ensuring optimal performance, security, and compliance.

- Lead the deployment, configuration, and lifecycle management of our M365 Environment in collaboration with Senior Engineer.

- Develop, maintain, and enhance PowerShell scripts to automate M365 management and operational tasks.

- Strong hands-on experience with Citrix technologies and Windows virtualization, including deployment, administration, and troubleshooting.

- Advanced PowerShell automation skills combined with a solid understanding of Zero Trust, endpoint security, and compliance best practices.

jobs.description:
Kunden begleiten. Lösungen umsetzen. Verantwortung übernehmen.

Du willst die IT deiner Kunden nicht nur am Laufen halten, sondern verstehen, weiterentwickeln und verantworten? Bei Dukers betreust du eigene Kundenumgebungen von A bis Z – mit einem Team im Rücken, das sein Wissen teilt und bei kniffligen Fragen zusammensteht.

Über Dukers

Dukers ist ein Spin-off der Swisscom mit Sitz in St. Gallen. Wir planen, implementieren und betreiben die IT von Organisationen, die ihre Informatik in verlässliche Hände geben wollen.

Unsere Kunden erhalten eine Lösung aus einer Hand: Arbeitsplätze, Netzwerk, Server, Cloud-Dienste und Kommunikation werden von uns aufgebaut, laufend überwacht, aktuell gehalten und abgesichert. Die Verantwortung für den Betrieb liegt bei uns – mit festen Ansprechpersonen, die die Umgebung ihrer Kunden kennen.

Besondere Tiefe haben wir in Cloud-Infrastrukturen und UCC, gestützt auf starke Partnerschaften mit Swisscom und Microsoft. Unser Team besteht aus Spezialisten mit langjähriger Erfahrung – mit den Standards eines grossen Anbieters und der Verbindlichkeit eines Partners, der seine Kunden persönlich kennt.

Deine Rolle

Du bist die technische Ansprechperson für deine Kunden. Du kennst ihre Umgebungen, betreibst sie zuverlässig und setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um – von der Konfiguration über die Inbetriebnahme bis zur Dokumentation. Bei Migrationen und grösseren Projekten arbeitest du mit unseren Spezialisten für Netzwerk, Security und Cloud zusammen.

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgaben und entscheidest im Alltag selbst. Bei anspruchsvollen Fragen steht das Team hinter dir.

Deine Aufgaben

-
Du betreust die IT-Umgebungen deiner Kunden, kennst ihre Anforderungen und bist ihre verlässliche technische Ansprechperson.

-
Du administrierst Microsoft-365-Tenants: Entra ID, Intune, Microsoft Defender, Exchange Online.

-
Du betreibst Clients, Netzwerke und Serversysteme, analysierst Störungen und behebst ihre Ursachen nachhaltig.

-
Du setzt Anpassungen, Installationen und Rollouts selbstständig um und arbeitest bei Migrationen und Projekten mit.

-
Du erkennst, wo eine Umgebung sicherer oder stabiler werden kann, und bringst konkrete Vorschläge ein.

-
Du dokumentierst deine Arbeit sauber, damit jede Umgebung für das ganze Team nachvollziehbar bleibt.

Womit du arbeitest

-
 Microsoft 365 und Cloud: Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Exchange Online, Azure

-
 Virtualisierung: VMware Cloud Director, Hyper-V, Proxmox

-
 Netzwerk: Ubiquiti UniFi, Cisco, HPE Aruba

-
 Security: Fortinet, Versa, Cisco

-
 Rechenzentrum: Eigene Infrastruktur in einem der sichersten und nachhaltigsten Rechenzentren der Schweiz, auf der wir unsere Lösungen und die unserer Kunden betreiben

-
 Betrieb: Backup, Monitoring und Ticketing mit Tools, die wir selbst entwickeln und weiterentwickeln

Netzwerk und Security betreiben wir als Managed Services – als Value Added Reseller der Swisscom für unsere gemeinsamen Kunden. Wer hier Tiefe aufbauen will, findet bei uns das Umfeld dafür.

Das bringst du mit

-
Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, beispielsweise als Informatiker/in EFZ, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

-
Erfahrung in der Administration von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen – idealerweise mit Entra ID, Intune und Defender

-
Solide Netzwerkkenntnisse: IP-Adressierung, VLANs, DNS und DHCP sind dir vertraut, Routing und Firewall-Regelwerke kein Fremdwort

-
Freude am direkten Kundenkontakt und die Fähigkeit, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären

-
Selbstständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

-
Lernbereitschaft und Interesse, dein Wissen im Team einzubringen

-
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

-
Führerausweis Kategorie B

Idealerweise hast du bereits Kundenumgebungen eigenständig betreut. Stehst du noch am Anfang deiner Laufbahn, bringst aber die fachlichen Grundlagen und den Willen mit, dich einzuarbeiten, möchten wir dich ebenfalls kennenlernen. Deine Aufgaben und deine Verantwortung wachsen mit deinem Können – das Onboarding ist darauf ausgelegt.

Dein Arbeitsort und deine Einsätze

Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet Einsätze bei Kunden in der Ostschweiz und im Raum Zürich mit Arbeit und Austausch in unserem Büro in der Stadt St. Gallen. Wir suchen dich in St. Gallen und Umgebung.

Das Büro liegt verkehrsgünstig: Die Autobahnein- und -ausfahrt Kreuzbleiche ist drei Minuten entfernt, Winkeln fünf. Die Bushaltestelle Schönenwegen liegt eine Minute vor der Tür. Parkplätze sind kostenlos. Dazu kommen ein eigener kleiner Park, ein Balkon direkt am Büro mit Grill – und der Blick auf die Geissli nebenan.

Was dich bei Dukers erwartet

-
 Einarbeitung, die den Namen verdient: Du startest mit einem intensiven Training und arbeitest in den ersten Wochen im Tandem mit einer erfahrenen Kollegin oder einem erfahrenen Kollegen, bis du deine Umgebungen selbst verantwortest.

-
 Fünf Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr: Bezahlt und für Zertifizierungen, Kurse oder Herstellertrainings nutzbar – wir fördern deine fachliche Entwicklung aktiv.

-
 Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg: Dukers wächst, und wer diesen Erfolg mit erarbeitet, soll daran teilhaben. Deshalb beteiligen wir unser Team jedes Jahr am Unternehmenserfolg – zusätzlich zum Lohn.

-
 Fünf Wochen Ferien, bei Bedarf mehr: Bis zu zwei zusätzliche Ferienwochen pro Jahr kannst du unkompliziert dazukaufen.

-
 Arbeit, die zu deinem Leben passt: Familie, Weiterbildung, Sport oder ein Projekt, das Zeit braucht: Wir richten die Anstellung nach deiner Lebenssituation aus – mit einem Pensum von 80 % oder 100 %, Gleitzeit und Remote Work nach Absprache. Und wenn sich dein Leben verändert, verändern wir das Modell mit.

-
 E-Firmenfahrzeug mit Privatnutzung: Ohne Zusatzkosten für dich, inklusive Ladepauschale. Und wenn du zu Hause laden willst, beteiligen wir uns an deiner eigenen Ladestation.

-
 Geschäftshandy mit Mobilabo: Gehört zur Ausstattung.

Bei uns entscheidest du mit. Wer eine Umgebung betreut, kennt sie am besten – also liegt die Entscheidung dort, wo das Wissen ist. Siehst du eine bessere Lösung, bringst du sie ein, und wir setzen sie gemeinsam um.

Lernen wir uns kennen

 Stellenantritt: per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung. Und wenn du vor deiner Entscheidung einen Tag mit dem Team verbringen möchtest – gerne.

 Deine Ansprechpersonen:

-
Livia Julia Tanner, Leitung Personal, nimmt deine Bewerbung entgegen und beantwortet Fragen zur Stelle und zu den Anstellungsbedingungen.

-
Aaron Herceg, Gründer und Governance Manager, leitet das Engineering-Team, mit dem du arbeitest, und beantwortet deine technischen Fragen.

Schreib uns an ----- mit Lebenslauf und ein paar Sätzen dazu, warum diese Stelle zu dir passt.

 Dukers GmbH | St. Gallen

jobs.description:
About Integrated Specialty CoveragesIntegrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.

About Integrated Specialty Coverages

 Integrated Specialty Coverages, LLC (ISC) is a growth stage technology and data-driven commercial MGA and insurance wholesaler leading innovation in the market.

Backed by one of the leading private equity firms, Onex Partners, and led by a forward-thinking management team, ISC is combining the worlds of insurance and technology to create an Insurtech powerhouse. As a leading online distributor of insurance products for a range of industries and “Main Street USA”, we are looking for the right people to help us in our mission of achieving exponential growth. We strive to be the number one place to go for brokers and agents to source insurance. To accomplish this, we’re building a digitally focused team that deeply understands the intersection between user experience, data, and AI/ML to optimize the way we engage with our customers and partners.

Job Summary

The System Administrator is a hands-on, technical role that owns the day-to-day administration, security, performance, and reliability of our Microsoft Azure environment, with a heavy emphasis on Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD) and FS
Logix profile management. They must have an excellent understanding of IT infrastructure (both cloud and on-premise) and a demonstrated willingness to learn and apply new technology. They must possess superior technical aptitude, written and oral communications skills and the ability to deal effectively with people in a wide variety of situations. They must also be forward thinking with a high degree of customer focus and they must possess strong analytical skills with demonstrated problem-solving ability. They must also have a proven ability to handle multiple priorities with limited supervision and possess a high level of discipline while remaining flexible.

As we transition away from a Managed Service Provider (MSP) model in order to manage our Azure environment internally, this role is central to that transition and will be responsible for our Azure environment once operations are brought in-house — leading knowledge transfer from the MSP, documenting and standing up internal processes and runbooks, and then operating and continuously improving the environment as its primary administrator.

Position Responsibilities

- Serve as the primary administrator and technical owner of our Microsoft Azure environment, including subscriptions, resource groups, RBAC/IAM, tagging and governance, cost management, and capacity planning

- Lead the transition of Azure operations from our Managed Service Provider to internal management, including knowledge transfer, tenant and administrative access handoff, documentation, runbooks, and establishing internal operational processes

- Design, deploy, and administer Azure Virtual Desktop, including host pools, session hosts, application groups, workspaces, FS
Logix profile containers, golden image lifecycle, and autoscale/scaling plans

- Administer and tune FS
Logix profile and Office containers, including container storage on Azure Files/Azure NetApp Files, permissions, redirections and exclusions, and remediation of container corruption, bloat, and profile performance issues

- Administer Azure infrastructure services: virtual machines, storage accounts, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN/ExpressRoute, DNS), backup and disaster recovery, and monitoring/alerting via Azure Monitor and Log Analytics

- Windows Active Directory/Entra ID (Azure Active Directory) administration, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access, MFA, group policy, and Intune/endpoint policy

- O365/email administration

- Manage patching, updates, and image maintenance across servers, endpoints, and AVD session hosts

- Automate recurring administrative tasks and deployments using PowerShell and Azure-native tooling

- Maintain accurate documentation, diagrams, and configuration baselines for the Azure environment

- Provide senior-level escalation support for helpdesk tickets and end-user issues across multiple locations and remote users

- Establish/enhance IT Operations policies and standards

- Manage hardware inventory

- Assist with IT functionality of facilities management.

- Manage technical service agreements as well as third party vendors.

- Manage website hosting for external facing sites

- Provide IT support for cyber security

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or applicable certifications in IT related field; Microsoft Azure certifications (AZ-104, AZ-140) strongly preferred

- 5+ years of experience in IT Infrastructure/Operations or systems administration

- 3+ years of hands-on Microsoft Azure administration in a production environment

- Extensive hands-on Azure Virtual Desktop experience, including host pool and session host design and troubleshooting, image management (Azure Compute Gallery), application delivery, user session management, and scaling

- Demonstrated FS
Logix expertise, including profile and Office container configuration, container storage design and permissions, redirections/exclusions, and diagnosing profile load, corruption, and performance problems

- Experience insourcing an environment from a Managed Service Provider, or comparable experience taking operational ownership of a previously outsourced environment, is a strong plus

- Expertise in the following specialized areas: Microsoft Administration (server and desktop), Active Directory and Entra ID administration, O365 administration

- PowerShell scripting and automation experience; familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Bicep/ARM/Terraform) a plus

- Advanced Troubleshooting skills in a multi-user environment

- Understanding and hands on experience with networking, TCP/IP protocols, firewall and switch configurations

- Ability to remotely manage and provide IT support for multiple locations and remote users

- Experience in setting up and configuring helpdesk ticketing systems

- Experience with Computer Facilities maintenance/ Data Cabling / Server Rooms

- Experience communicating verbally and in writing with peers, management, and vendors

- Experience with documentation and asset inventory management

- Experience with cyber/information security

- Proven ability to work successfully with limited supervision

The starting annual pay scale for this position is listed below. Actual starting pay will be based on factors such as skills, qualifications, training, and experience. In addition, the company offers comprehensive benefits including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) plan with match, paid time off, and other benefits.

ISC's salary ranges are determined by role and level. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations and could be higher or lower based on a multitude of factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

National Pay Range

$95,251—$119,064 USD

Benefits of Working at ISC

- Employee Ownership Program - every eligible employee shares in the financial rewards that grow when the company grows

- Professional development opportunities

- Owner Referral Program

- Work from home reimbursement for remote/hybrid roles

- Canary emergency financial assistance program

- Comprehensive medical, dental, vision

- Life/AD&D Insurance

- Confidential, Employee Assistance Program

- Health Savings Account, includes company contribution

- Short-term disability

- Voluntary benefits - supplemental accident, critical illness, hospital insurance

- Employee discounts

- 401(k) Plan with company match contribution

- Addition Wealth Financial Wellness Program

- Various Time Off Programs

- 11 company paid holidays

 Applicants may contact the ISC HR department via e-mail or phone to request and arrange for an accommodation that will allow the applicant to successfully complete the application process. Applicants needing assistance may request accommodation at any time. Please contact ISC at or 760-599-7242.

 ISC believes in creating long-term relationships by being responsive and relevant and by consistently delivering value to our community of customers. Specifically, we focus on attracting, developing, and retaining the best talent for our business, challenging our people, demonstrating a “can-do” attitude, and fostering a collaborative and mutually supportive environment.

 Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, genetic information, mental or physical disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by local, state, or Federal law.

 **Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.**

 **ISC participates in the Federal E-Verify program**

jobs.description:
ABOUT SUNO

We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world.

Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible.

Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Los Angeles office is home to Suno's largest concentration of musicians, producers, and music-industry partners, and the technology they depend on is different from a typical office: studios, DAWs, audio interfaces, monitoring, high-resolution playback, and the networks and storage that move large sessions around. As Staff IT Engineer, you'll own the audio and studio technology domain for Suno company-wide — designing, building, and supporting the production environments our Music team works in — while also serving as the senior IT presence on the ground in LA.

You'll report to the Senior Manager, IT Operations and work alongside IT Engineers in Cambridge, NYC, and San Francisco, who manage identity, endpoint, SaaS, and office-infrastructure. You'll work with the rest of the team to manage our Corporate IT systems stack, but you'll be our audio and A/V expert.

Listen to the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/ldMCcRAh5ln0LgNA

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Run IT for the LA office — identity and onboarding, endpoint management, SaaS Administration, wired/wireless networking, zero-trust VPN, and A/V and videoconferencing.

 - Own audio and studio systems as a domain — set the standard for how Suno builds and supports production spaces across offices: studio and listening-room design in partnership with acousticians and integrators, DAW and plugin management, audio interfaces and I/O, monitoring and calibration, and the storage and networking that production work needs.

 - Support the Music team at a professional bar — keep sessions running; manage DAW environments (Pro Tools, Logic, Ableton, and others), licensing, plugin fleets, and audio drivers across a Mac fleet; troubleshoot latency, clocking, and routing problems the rest of IT can't.

 - Partner on the product — work with Engineering and the Suno Studio team to make sure internal creators have the hardware, routing, and environments they need to use and test our tools the way professional producers do.

 - Design for the next space — specify audio, A/V, and network requirements for LA buildouts and expansions and for studio spaces in other offices; manage integrators and vendors to a result.

 - Scale support — write runbooks and knowledge articles that let office managers and AI-powered self-service handle the routine, and automate what you've done twice.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

MUST-HAVES

 - 10+ years of IT engineering experience, including significant time supporting professional audio production environments — studios, post-production, broadcast, live, or music-technology companies.

 - Deep professional-audio competence — signal flow, digital audio (sample rates, clocking, word clock, Dante or AVB), DAW administration, audio interfaces and converters, monitoring and room calibration — and the ability to diagnose problems producers describe by ear.

 - Demonstrated breadth across the IT stack — identity, endpoint, SaaS administration, networking, and office IT — with the depth to operate independently as the only IT engineer in an office.

 - Experience owning a technical domain end to end — you've set the standard others follow, not just executed it.

 - Strong written and verbal communication — you can work comfortably with producers, engineers, executives, and vendors, and translate between them.

 - Learning agility — you pick up new platforms quickly, you're comfortable being the first person at the company to figure something out, and you aren't afraid to ask for help.

NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Studio design and buildout experience — acoustic treatment, room tuning, patchbay and infrastructure design, working with acousticians and AV integrators.

 - Hands-on experience with a modern IdP (Okta or equivalent), modern Apple MDM (Iru, Jamf, Jumpcloud), and endpoint security (CrowdStrike or similar).

 - Networking depth — AV-over-IP, multicast, QoS for audio networks, and managed switching.

 - Experience supporting creative or music teams at a technology company, or IT at a label, studio, or music-tech company.

 - Comfort with at least one scripting language (Python, TypeScript, or Bash) and config-as-code approaches.

 - Working knowledge of music production — you've made or recorded music yourself.

WORK LOCATION POLICY

This role is expected to work from the designated Suno office 5 days a week, per Suno's company policy. Full-time employees will receive competitive equity packages, and comprehensive benefits. The actual base salary offered may vary depending on location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Additional Notes

Applicants must be eligible to work in the US.

Willingness to travel (up to 20%) to collaborate with team members and support studio spaces across Suno office locations.

PERKS & BENEFITS FOR FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES

 - Company Equity Package

 - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k)

 - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options)

 - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time

 - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave

 - Creative Education Stipend

 - Generous Commuter Allowance

 - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week)

COMPENSATION:

 - The annual salary range for this role is $160K-$217K + target equity + benefits (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k)

Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the Massachusetts Fair Chance in Employment Act, NYC Fair Chance Act, LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

jobs.description:
Sie sorgen dafür, dass unsere IT zuverlässig läuft, und sind erste Ansprechperson für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei allen IT-Anliegen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of IT übernehmen Sie mittelfristig die Verantwortung für den IT-Betrieb.

Aufgaben

- 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support für unsere Mitarbeitenden – vor Ort und remote, inkl. Ticketbearbeitung

- Administration von Microsoft 365, Entra ID und Intune (Benutzer, Berechtigungen, MFA, Geräteverwaltung)

- Client-Management: Beschaffung, Einrichtung, Rollout und Lebenszyklus von Notebooks, Mobilgeräten und Druckern

- Betreuung von Server-, Netzwerk- und Backup-Infrastruktur in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Dienstleistern

- Anwendersupport für unser ERP-System (Comarch) und weitere Fachapplikationen: Benutzer- und Rechteverwaltung, Erstanalyse, Eskalation an Hersteller und Partner

- IT-Sicherheit: Einführung, Umsetzung und laufende Überwachung von IT-Sicherheitsstandards (z. B. Zugriffs- und Passwortrichtlinien, MFA, Patch- und Schwachstellenmanagement, Backup- und Wiederherstellungstests)

- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Sicherheitsvorgaben (Gruppe, Cyberversicherung), Unterstützung bei Audits sowie Sensibilisierung der Mitarbeitenden (Security Awareness)

- Design und Implementierung On- und Offboarding, IT-Dokumentation sowie Schulung der Mitarbeitenden

- Mitarbeit in IT-Projekten (z. B. Migrationen, Hardware-Erneuerungen)

Qualifikation

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatiker/in EFZ (Plattformentwicklung oder Systemtechnik) oder vergleichbar; Weiterbildung (z. B. ICT-System- und Netzwerktechniker/in FA) von Vorteil

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im IT-Support und in der Systemadministration, idealerweise in einem KMU

- Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Windows Client/Server und Active Directory

- Gute Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerk, Firewall und VPN

- Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von IT-Sicherheitsmassnahmen; Kenntnisse gängiger Standards (z. B. CIS Controls, ISO 27001, IKT-Minimalstandard) von Vorteil

- Von Vorteil: Erfahrung im ERP-Anwendersupport, PowerShell

- Serviceorientiert, selbständig und strukturiert – mit Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Stellvertretungen sicherzustellen

- Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse, gutes Englisch; Französisch von Vorteil

Was wir anbieten

- Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem kleinen IT-Team

- Kurze Entscheidungswege und Open-Door-Politik

- Gezielte Aus- und Weiterbildung

- Technisch hochstehendes Produktsortiment

- Fortschrittliche Anstellungsbedingungen

- Home-Office-Möglichkeit

- Sehr gute Anbindung an ÖV und Autobahn

Möchten Sie sich uns anschliessen?

Dann lassen Sie uns einander kennenlernen! Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen über die Stellenausschreibung.

jobs.description:
Company Overview At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents.

Company Overview

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Be part of a team that makes a real difference.

Job Description

 This is a full-time remote position that can be located anywhere in the U.S

We are hiring a Senior Information Systems Engineer to build and support engineering and automation of our End User Computing (EUC) platform. You will manage Windows endpoints through Microsoft Intune, deliver virtual desktops on Amazon Workspaces, and automate the work end to end with scripting, the Microsoft Graph API and Ansible.

This is a hands-on senior role. You will resolve escalated L2/L3 issues, replace manual processes with code, and mentor L1 support staff.

Key responsibilities

Endpoint management (Microsoft Intune)

- Design, build and maintain Intune configuration profiles, compliance policies, app deployments and update rings for Windows devices.

- Automate device, app and policy management through the Microsoft Graph API, including bulk changes, reporting and audit exports.

- Manage Windows Autopilot enrolment and zero-touch provisioning for new and refreshed devices.

- Integrate Intune with Entra ID (Azure AD) Conditional Access, groups and identity lifecycle processes.

Virtual desktops (Amazon Workspaces)

- Build and maintain Amazon Workspaces bundles, custom images and directory integration.

- Automate Workspaces provisioning, patching, rebuilding and decommissioning through the AWS CLI, SDKs or APIs.

- Monitor Workspaces performance, cost and utilization, and right-size running modes and bundles.

- Apply AWS security controls such as IAM, security groups, IP access control groups and encryption.

Automation and configuration management

- Write and maintain scripts in PowerShell, Python and Bash to automate repeatable EUC tasks.

- Develop Ansible playbooks and roles for endpoint and virtual desktop configuration, patching and compliance.

- Store code in Git, follow peer review, and run automation through CI/CD pipelines where suitable.

Operations and support

- Act as the L2/L3 escalation point for complex endpoint, application and virtual desktop incidents.

- Run root-cause analysis on recurring issues and deliver permanent fixes.

- Produce and maintain technical documentation, runbooks and knowledge base articles.

- Mentor L1 engineers and service desk staff and contribute to EUC standards and roadmap.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- 5+ years in IT systems engineering, with at least 3 years focused on End User Computing.

-
 Scripting: strong PowerShell skills, plus working knowledge of Python and/or Bash for automation and API integration.

-
 Microsoft Intune with API: hands-on Intune administration at scale, and proven automation through the Microsoft Graph API (authentication via app registrations, REST calls, paging and throttling).

-
 Ansible Nice to have: experience writing playbooks, roles and inventories to manage Windows

-
 Amazon Workspaces: experience deploying and operating Workspaces, including bundles, custom images, directory services and lifecycle automation.

- Solid grounding in Windows 10/11 and Entra ID / Active Directory, Group Policy and core networking (DNS, DHCP, VPN).

- Experience with Git version control and ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or Jira Service Management.

Preferred qualifications

- Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.

- Exposure to other VDI/DaaS platforms such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365 or Citrix.

- Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and endpoint security baselines (CIS, Microsoft Security Baselines).

- Packaging experience with Win32 apps, MSIX or PSAppDeployToolkit.

- Relevant certifications, for example: Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102), AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or SysOps Administrator – Associate, and Red Hat Certified Specialist in Ansible Automation (Nice to Have)

Skills and attributes

- An automation-first mindset: you script a task the second time you do it.

- Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical users.

- Structured troubleshooting and calm ownership of high-impact incidents.

- Comfortable working independently and setting technical direction for a small team.

Benefits

We’re committed to supporting your ultimate well-being through our total compensation package offerings that support your health, wealth and self. These offerings include Medical, Dental, Vision, Health Savings Accounts / Flexible Spending Accounts, Life and AD&D Insurance, 401(k), Tuition Reimbursement, and an array of resources that encourage a lifetime of healthier living. Benefits eligibility may differ depending on full-time or part-time status. Compensation depends on the applicable US geographic market. The expected base pay for this position ranges from $91,000 - $110,000 annually, and will be based on a number of additional factors including skills, experience, and education.

 The Company is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. We are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.description:
Position Overview:

We are looking for a dedicated Endpoint Engineer to join our client's technology team as an embedded, full-time engineering resource. This role was created to relieve an endpoint team operating at full capacity and to drive platform optimization, automation, and documentation modernization across the organization.

Key Responsibilities:

* Endpoint Architecture \& Platform Engineering Focus : **Endpoint Architecture is a critical component of this role and extends beyond day-to-day endpoint administration and troubleshooting.** The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, standardizing, and optimizing the organization's endpoint management ecosystem, ensuring scalability, security, automation, and operational efficiency across both Microsoft and Apple environments
* Endpoint Device Management: Administer and optimize Intune (Microsoft) and Kandji (Apple) across the full device fleet
* Microsoft 365 Optimization: Manage and optimize the M365 environment including licensing, policies, and platform governance
* Collaboration Platform Administration: Administer Box, Slack, and Zoom environments
* Automation \& Tooling: Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation initiatives to reduce manual workload
* Documentation: Create and maintain runbooks, standard operating procedures, and architecture documentation; close gaps left by legacy Managed Service Provider environments
* Platform Governance: Mature operational processes and platform governance
* After-Hours Support: Participate in after-hours, weekend, and holiday coverage rotation to reduce burden on internal engineers
* Onboarding \& Standards: Establish and enforce endpoint build standards and configuration baselines

Required Skills and Qualifications:

* Minimum 7 years of practical, hands-on experience supporting and administering enterprise endpoints, including endpoint management, desktop engineering, technical support, device provisioning, software deployment, patch management, and workplace technology services
* Proven hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and -preferably- Kandji MDM platforms
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft 365 administration and optimization
* Working knowledge in Cisco Meraki and foundational networking concepts
* Experience with collaboration tools: Box, Slack, Zoom, Jira
* Proficiency in PowerShell scripting and automation
* Experience creating technical documentation and runbooks
* Ability to work independently as an embedded team member
* Strong communication skills in English (written and verbal)
* Ability to travel to the United States approximately 10% of the time
* Knowledge of AI capabilities and practical business applications is a plus

jobs.description:
Das erwartet Sie als ICT System Engineer bei der Bell Food Group

Du brennst für IT, denkst in Prozessen und möchtest Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann gestalte unseren Identity & Access Management Service aktiv mit! Wir sind ein engagiertes IT-Team, das zentrale IT-Services zuverlässig betreibt und kontinuierlich weiterentwickelt. Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung für unseren Identity & Access Management (IAM) Service auf Basis des One Identity Manager übernimmt und dessen Weiterentwicklung aktiv vorantreibt. Dabei bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen IT, Fachbereichen, externen Partnern und technischen Spezialisten. Neben deinem IAM-Schwerpunkt bringst du dich gerne auch in weitere spannende Themen unserer vielseitigen IT-Landschaft ein.

Deine Aufgaben

-
Verantwortung für den IAM-Service: Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb unseres Identity & Access Management sicher und steuerst die Weiterentwicklung des One Identity Manager sowie die Umsetzung neuer Anforderungen

-
Prozessmanagement und Automatisierung: Du gestaltest und optimierst IAM-Prozesse, insbesondere den Identity Lifecycle (Joiner, Mover, Leaver), das Rollen- und Berechtigungsmanagement sowie die Automatisierung bestehender Abläufe

-
Schnittstellen- und Partnermanagement: Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für interne Fachbereiche, angebundene Systeme und externe IAM-Berater. Du koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit und stellst die Qualität der Ergebnisse sicher

-
Service Management und Governance: Du sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten, nachvollziehbare Prozesse und eine saubere Dokumentation. Zudem koordinierst du Incidents, Changes und technische Abhängigkeiten mit den zuständigen Spezialisten

-
Mitarbeit an weiteren IT-Services: Du bringst dich je nach Interesse und Bedarf auch in weitere Themen unseres Teams ein, beispielsweise Client Management, Softwarepaketierung und -verteilung, Omnissa VDI, Citrix, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Monitoring, SharePoint oder SQL-Management

-
Pikettdienst: Du übernimmst gelegentlich Pikettdienste und bist bei Bedarf auch für Wochenendeinsätze bereit

jobs.description:
About Steadfast SolutionsSteadfast Solutions is an Australian Managed IT Services Provider (MSP) with over two decades supporting small and medium businesses — including regional Victorian mining and resources operations.

 About Steadfast Solutions

 Steadfast Solutions is an Australian Managed IT Services Provider (MSP) with over two decades supporting small and medium businesses — including regional Victorian mining and resources operations. We’re ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, Microsoft-centred and automation-led, and we deliver to documented standards rather than one-off builds. We’re a genuinely single-accountable provider: from Microsoft 365 and security through to Cisco Meraki networking and telephony on our own voice platform.

 The opportunity

We’re growing our engineering team and looking for a Senior Systems Engineer to support and mature client environments — including semi-remote regional sites where reliable connectivity is safety-critical, not just a convenience. This is a remote-first role for someone based in regional Victoria: you’ll work primarily from home, with regular travel to client sites across regional Victoria (a company vehicle is provided for business use), plus the option to use our office when it suits. You’ll bring strong hands-on/onsite instincts to a role that’s delivered mostly remotely and by automation.

You’ll be the kind of engineer who owns complex issues end to end, documents as they go, and lifts the standard of every environment they touch.

Requirements

 What you’ll work across

- Microsoft 365 & identity — Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, OneDrive; Microsoft Entra (Conditional Access, MFA, SSO, joiner/mover/leaver).

- Endpoint & SOE — Microsoft Intune device provisioning, compliance and patch/lifecycle management across dispersed, multi-client fleets.

- Networking — Cisco Meraki cloud-managed networking, WiFi authentication to Entra, staff/contractor segmentation.

- Connectivity & resilience — SD-WAN / SASE-aligned edge with diverse paths and automatic failover (e.g. Starlink + cellular) for semi-remote sites.

- Security — Microsoft Defender EDR, managed firewall and web filtering, VPN, and alignment to the ACSC Essential Eight; 24/7 monitoring and alerting.

- Telephony & collaboration — Microsoft Teams and Teams telephony on our own carrier-grade voice platform.

- Backup & recovery — managed backup across infrastructure and Microsoft 365, with tested recovery.

 Our toolset

Autotask (PSA / ticketing & time), N-able N-central (RMM), IT Glue (documentation), CIPP (M365 management), Microsoft Intune & Entra, Cisco Meraki dashboard. Everything is documented, standardised and auditable.

 What you’ll bring

- 5+ years in an MSP environment, at a senior / Level 2–3 standard.

- Deep, hands-on Microsoft 365, Entra and Intune administration.

- Strong networking and connectivity troubleshooting (Meraki, SD-WAN/VPN, DNS/DHCP, wireless, multi-site).

- A methodical, documentation-first approach and calm ownership of complex escalations.

- Excellent communication — you can explain technical issues clearly to non-technical users.

- Comfortable working remotely and self-directed, with the flexibility to attend client sites or the office when needed.

- Current Australian driver’s licence and full Australian working rights.

• Based in regional Victoria.

 Nice to have

- Experience supporting mining, resources or other regional/industrial sites (semi-remote environments, site connectivity).

- Microsoft certifications (e.g. MS-102, AZ-900, SC-900) and/or Cisco Meraki accreditation.

- Firewall experience with Fortinet / FortiGate.

- Exposure to SASE/SD-WAN, Starlink/cellular failover, Essential Eight uplift, or SOC/MDR.

- Backup/DR and quarterly restore-testing experience.

Benefits

 Why Steadfast Solutions

- Genuinely remote-first — built for a dispersed team, with the regional lifestyle that comes with it.

- Company vehicle provided for business use — you’ll get out to client sites across regional Victoria.

- Modern, standardised Microsoft + Meraki stack — no legacy sprawl, no undocumented “tribal knowledge.”

- ISO-certified, process-driven delivery, and a supported certification pathway to grow your Microsoft and security credentials.

- Meaningful work on environments where getting it right genuinely matters.

 The details

 Type: Full-time, permanent

 Location: Remote-first, based in regional Victoria — with regular travel to client sites

 Salary: $125,000 – $145,000 + superannuation

 Vehicle: Company vehicle provided for business use

jobs.description:
Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era.

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl , we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

We are seeking a talented and experienced Sr Information Systems Engineer to join Cribl 's IT Engineering team. In this role, you will be the technical owner of the core systems that power how Cribl operates every day — from identity and access to endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and the automations that tie it all together. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role on a team that treats reliability, security, and employee experience as equally important outcomes.

You'll partner closely with Security, Enterprise Applications, and People teams to design and run the services Cribl depends on at scale: Okta, AWS, ServiceNow, MDM, and a growing stack of SaaS integrations and AI-powered workflows. Whether you're building joiner/mover/leaver automations, hardening endpoint baselines, or governing the next generation of MCP-connected AI tools, your work will be foundational to how a fast-moving, remote-first company stays secure and operational.

This role reports to IT Engineering leadership and will serve as a senior peer and escalation point across the IT & Security organization.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

As the Sr Information Systems Engineer, you will be the technical owner of Cribl 's core corporate systems — keeping identity, endpoints, cloud infrastructure, and IT automation healthy, secure, and scalable. Your key responsibilities will include:

-
 Identity, Access & Lifecycle: Own administration of our primary identity provider (Okta or equivalent) and design joiner/mover/leaver automations (e.g., Workday → Okta → SaaS) with a focus on least privilege, auditability, and contractor and elevated-access workflows.

-
 AWS, Cloud & Core Infrastructure: Administer AWS accounts used for corporate IT, VPN, and supporting infrastructure, including secure networking patterns, logging, monitoring, and alerting across IT-owned cloud resources.

-
 Endpoint Management & MDM: Own endpoint management for macOS and Windows via MDM (e.g., Jamf, Intune), including zero-touch provisioning, patch management, security baselines, and compliance reporting for the fleet.

-
 ServiceNow & IT Service Management: Serve as primary ServiceNow administrator for IT & Security — core data model, catalog, workflows, SLAs, and integrations — and partner with Security, Finance, and Compliance to support ITGC, SOX/IT controls, access reviews, and change management.

-
 Automation, Integrations & Tooling: Design and maintain automation workflows across IT systems (e.g., Okta Workflows, Serval, Zapier, PowerShell/Python, APIs) and serve as SME for SaaS integrations across Okta, ServiceNow, Google Workspace, Slack, and Azure/AWS.

-
 AI Tools & MCP Governance: Evaluate, configure, and govern AI tools and MCP-based agent frameworks in partnership with IT and Security, ensuring safe usage patterns, appropriate access controls, and clear documentation and runbooks.

-
 Operations, Support & On-Call: Serve as Tier 3 escalation for complex incidents across identity, MDM, ServiceNow, and core platforms; participate in the IT on-call rotation; and contribute to IT metrics, fleet reporting, and knowledge base content.

We are a remote-first company and work happens across many time-zones - you may be required to occasionally perform duties outside your standard working hours.

If You’ve Got It - We Want It

-
 Corporate IT Systems Experience: 5+ years in corporate IT roles with significant responsibility for systems administration across identity, SaaS, and/or infrastructure in a cloud-first environment, with a proven track record balancing project work and operational/on-call responsibilities.

-
 AWS Administration (Required): Hands-on, production experience with AWS (IAM, VPCs, EC2/ECS or similar, basic networking, tagging/governance) supporting internal IT or SaaS platforms.

-
 ServiceNow Administration: Hands-on administration of ServiceNow or a similar enterprise ITSM platform, including workflow configuration, catalog items, change/incident processes, and basic reporting.

-
 Enterprise Identity Provider Experience: Direct, production experience with at least one enterprise identity provider — Okta strongly preferred; Azure AD/Entra ID or similar acceptable — including SSO, lifecycle management, and access policies.

-
 Endpoint Management Ownership: Demonstrated ownership of macOS and/or Windows endpoint management in a mid-to-large fleet, including baseline configs, software distribution, and patch management.

-
 Scripting & Automation: Experience with at least one scripting language (Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar) and comfort working with REST APIs and JSON.

-
 Remote-First Operator: Comfortable working autonomously in a fast-moving, distributed environment — you manage your own priorities, communicate proactively, and know when to escalate.

-
 Preferred Qualifications

  - Experience with Jamf (macOS), Intune (Windows/mobile), and/or device posture tooling such as Kolide or similar.

  - Experience managing core SaaS tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, Zoom, Atlassian, or Glean.

  - Background designing or maintaining automations with tools like Serval, Zapier, or equivalent orchestration platforms.

  - Experience evaluating, configuring, and governing AI tools and agents (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Glean) and MCP-based agent frameworks in an enterprise environment.

  - Working knowledge of Azure (subscriptions, RBAC, group-based access) and/or other major cloud providers alongside AWS.

  - Prior experience supporting a rapidly scaling, distributed engineering organization.

The salary for this role is dependent on geographic location and will be based on the individual candidate's job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range

$99,000—$156,000 USD

 Bring Your Whole Self
Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
