jobs.description:
About KadenceAs a fast-paced, early-stage, venture capital-backed B2B SaaS company, we’re looking for a Workplace Solutions Engineer in United States.

 About Kadence

As a fast-paced, early-stage, venture capital-backed B2B SaaS company, we’re looking for a Workplace Solutions Engineer in United States. Kadence is the AI-powered Workplace Operations Platform - one unified system that orchestrates people, space, and time. Leaders get a real-time command center for their two largest costs: people and real estate. Employees get a bottom-up daily guide that helps them navigate every workday.

We work with agile, multi-site enterprises across financial services, healthcare, government, manufacturing, professional services, and technology. Hybrid coordination got us into some of the best companies in the world. Those same customers are now pulling us further upmarket - asking us to solve for operations, planning, scenarios, ROI, and portfolio management. We're building the category-defining company for the future of work, and this role sits at the center of how we make that shift real for enterprise customers.

 Why this role exists

As our customers have moved upmarket and our platform has grown from booking into a full operations layer: SpaceOps, WorkOps Pro, VMS, Sense, Kadence Agent, Insights Plus, Move Manager, and Kadence AI. The technical bar for our deployments has changed. IT teams at our largest customers now want to talk about SSO/SCIM architecture, Zscaler exceptions, Intune policies, calendar service accounts, sensor hardware, multi-instance strategies, and compliance frameworks, often on the first call.

The Workplace Solutions Engineer is the person who meets them there. You are the deep technical brain the customer experience team leans on when a deployment is complex, an integration is contested, a launch has to land on a specific date, or an enterprise workflow needs to be engineered, not just configured. You partner with CSMs, sales engineers, and directly with our product and engineering leadership to make sure every Kadence implementation lands cleanly and unlocks the outcomes we sold.

 What you'll do

 Own the technical implementation across our most complex enterprise deployments. Design and deliver the technical rollout for named enterprise accounts - SSO (Entra ID, Okta, OIDC), SCIM provisioning, calendar integration (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace service accounts), Kadence Agent deployment via Intune/MDM, public-IP configuration for automated check-in, Zscaler/proxy/VPN exceptions, HRIS syncs (Azure AD, Workday feeds), and hardware setup (Neat devices, iPad kiosks, room displays). You are the person who unblocks the deployment when it hits the customer's IT reality.

 Engineer Kadence for real-world workplace complexity. Configure the platform to model how each customer actually operates - overlapping neighborhoods, priority-based booking, hoteling vs. reverse hoteling vs. assigned seating, contractor vs. staff instances, phased multi-country global rollouts, custom roles, VMS operator workflows, badge printing, and floor plan strategies (Archilogic, bulk upload, phased builds). You translate messy customer requirements into elegant Kadence configurations, and you know when to push back and when to escalate to product.

 Lead launch planning and go-live orchestration. Own the launch plan for each customer - sequence of events, dependency chain, and cutover playbook. Coordinate calendar integration before floor plan work, SSO before user sync, and welcome-email suppression before bulk imports. Design phased rollouts by site and by region, ambassador-led soft openings, pilot cohort selection, and licensing-pool sizing. Sequence announcement and launch communications with the customer champion (including CPO/CHRO-signed emails where required), manage go-live-day risk in real time, and orchestrate agent deployment, Teams/Slack app rollout, and global announcement send. Nothing slips because you kept every dependency visible.

 Build and deliver customer enablement. Design and run the training curriculum for each customer - Global Admin, Team Manager, Booking Scheduler, and VMS Operator sessions; end-user rollout training; new-hire onboarding modules (short-form video, agent-login walkthroughs, starring/check-in flows); site manager enablement kits (comms templates, dashboards, anchor-day guidance); Workplace Champions and ambassador programs; and lunch-and-learn formats for large sites. You create the assets - one-pagers, videos, admin guides - and you deliver them live when it matters. Every customer leaves onboarding with a team that can run Kadence without you.

 Coach customers on workplace operations best practices. You bring the pattern-matching from hundreds of deployments to every conversation. Advise customers on adoption strategy, agent enablement, anchor days, neighborhood design, priority booking, hoteling models, data-privacy settings that keep leadership trust intact, and how to sequence a rollout from pilot through global launch. Coach champions and admins on middle-manager engagement, sustaining early wins, and building the internal narrative that drives adoption. When a customer's CFO or CHRO needs to see value, you're in the room shaping that story.

 Stay in the account through moments that matter in the full lifecycle, not just at kickoff. Own post-launch optimization, edge cases, new-feature enablement ( Kadence Agent updates, AI, Slack, Move Manager), and net-new site rollouts as customers expand.

 Navigate enterprise security, compliance, and change management. Own the technical narrative through Architecture Review Boards, security reviews, legal and procurement reviews, and compliance conversations (CMMC, HIPAA-adjacent workflows, GDPR, data-residency). Advise customers on how to structure admin permissions and privacy settings so leadership trusts the system.

 Close the loop with Product and Engineering. Because you're closest to the customer's technical reality, you are the highest-signal input for what needs to be built next. Compile structured feedback, file high-priority bug reports, and work directly with product managers and engineering on custom features and platform improvements. You are a reason the roadmap reflects what enterprise customers actually need.

 Raise the bar for how we deploy Kadence . Document repeatable technical playbooks, launch templates, and enablement curricula - integration guides, network requirements, phased-rollout templates, admin training decks, comms templates. Every deployment should make the next one faster and cleaner. Partner with CX leadership on continuous improvement of our onboarding and implementation methodology as we scale into larger and more complex accounts.

 What success looks like

-
Enterprise deployments launched on time and on scope, with SSO/SCIM/calendar/agent live and working from day one.

-
Launch plans that hit their target dates because dependencies were sequenced correctly and stakeholders were prepared.

-
Admins, managers, and end users who can run Kadence confidently after your enablement - measurable in early-adoption metrics.

-
Zero net-new churn attributable to technical implementation or launch gaps.

-
Time-to-first-value shortened across your portfolio, quarter over quarter.

-
Customer technical stakeholders - IT, security, workplace ops - trust Kadence enough to become internal champions.

-
Renewals and expansions land because the technical foundation is solid, opening the door to new sites, new modules, and increased user seats.

-
Product and Engineering ship improvements sourced from your customer feedba ck.

 Who you are

-
 5+ years in a technical customer-facing role - solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical account management, implementation architecture, or enterprise IT delivery - ideally in SaaS serving mid-market and enterprise customers.

-
 You have real IT depth. You can configure SSO in Entra ID or Okta without a tutorial, explain the difference between OIDC and SAML to a customer's security team, and troubleshoot a SCIM provisioning failure. You have been in the room for calendar integration debates, proxy/Zscaler exceptions, MDM/Intune rollouts, and network/IP architecture conversations.

-
 You've owned launches, not just configurations. You've run go-live plans with dependency chains, comms sequences, pilot cohorts, and cutover risk and delivered them on the date you committed.

-
You are a natural coach and trainer. You can design a curriculum, build assets, and deliver live to a mixed audience of IT admins, workplace leaders, and end users and leave each audience confident.

-
 You are excellent with enterprise IT and security stakeholders. You can hold your own with a CISO, a network architect, and a workplace director in the same call and you make each of them feel heard.

-
 You know workplace, real estate, or IWMS-adjacent domains - or you are deeply curious about them. Experience with tools like Envoy, Robin, OfficeSpace, iOFFICE/Eptura, Condeco, Archibus, or FM Systems is a plus. Experience with visitor management, occupancy sensors, or badge/access systems is a plus.

-
 You are structurally organized. You can hold 8–15 concurrent enterprise deployments in your head, know exactly what is blocked on what, and never let a customer wait on you.

-
 You communicate cleanly under pressure. You translate "the SSO consent flow requires an Entra global admin to approve the enterprise app manifest" into something a non-technical champion can understand and act on.

-
 You have a builder's instinct. When you see the same problem three times, you turn it into a template, a playbook, or a product feature request, not another ticket.

-
 You partner well. Y ou will work daily with CSMs, sales, product, engineering, and directly with our CTO. You give and take feedback like a professional and treat customers' problems as your own.

 Nice to have

-
Direct experience with adjacent workplace tools (Envoy, Robin, OfficeSpace, iOFFICE/Eptura, Condeco, Archibus, FM Systems, SwipedOn).

-
Familiarity with Archilogic, AutoCAD, or CAD/DWG-sourced floor plans.

-
Hardware deployment experience — Neat, Poly, Logitech, iPad kiosks, occupancy sensors.

-
Scripting or query skills (SQL, basic Python, PowerShell) for data validation and bulk operations.

-
Prior experience deploying to CMMC, FedRAMP-adjacent, or heavily regulated customers.

-
Prior experience building customer training programs, certification tracks, or workplace-champion / ambassador networks.

 The team you'll join

You will join our Customer Experience organization - a tight, hands-on team that owns the customer journey from signature through renewal and expansion. You will work alongside our Customer Success Managers and Support team, and you will have a direct line to our engineering and product leadership. This role reports to the VP of Customer Success.

 Location & work model

-
Remote — work from home with the ability to travel to a hub office for collaboration, training, and events occasionally.

-
Occasional travel to customer sites for major enterprise launches and on-site workshops (roughly 10–25%, depending on portfolio).

 What we offer

-
Competitive salary calibrated to a technical customer-facing role.

-
Meaningful equity stock options.

-
Health insurance and 401(k).

-
A front-row seat to Kadence 's expansion from category challenger to category-defining Workplace Operations Platform.

-
Real influence on the product, the playbook, and the shape of the CX organization as we scale.

 By joining Kadence as a Workplace Solutions Engineer, you are not just implementing software, you are engineering how thousands of employees at some of the world's most demanding organizations experience the workplace every day. If that sounds like the room you want to be in, we'd love to talk.

jobs.description:
What Makes a Honda, is Who makes a Honda
Honda has a clear vision for the future, and it’s a joyful one. We are looking for individuals with the skills, courage, persistence, and dreams that will help us reach our future-focused goals. At our core is innovation. Honda is constantly innovating and developing solutions to drive our business with record success. We strive to be a company that serves as a source of “power” that supports people around the world who are trying to do things based on their own initiative and that helps people expand their own potential. To this end, Honda strives to realize “the joy and freedom of mobility” by developing new technologies and an innovative approach to achieve a “zero environmental footprint.”

We are looking for qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences, continuous improvement values, and a strong work ethic to join our team.

If your goals and values align with Honda’s, we want you to join our team to Bring the Future!

Job Purpose
The senior North America (NA) Digital Workplace Client Engineer is responsible for engineering, implementing, and managing the full spectrum of North America's modern workplace endpoint platforms. Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The role also encompasses Microsoft Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join strategies for identity-based endpoint access.The senior Client Engineer serves as the North America subject matter expert (SME) and Level 4 escalation authority for client endpoint technologies, defining technical standards, multi-year roadmaps, and architecture that position NA as the global model for modern endpoint engineering. This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services. The North America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.Key Accountabilities
• Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration.
• Define endpoint architecture, standards, and multi-year technology roadmaps for Intune, Microsoft Entra ID Join, Hybrid Entra ID Join, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and mobile device management solutions.
• Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues, leading root cause analysis, problem management, and long-term remediation while providing technical guidance to support teams.
• Lead the transition from SCCM and Group Policy-based management to cloud-native endpoint management through Intune, including migration planning, deployment strategy, and adoption of zero-touch provisioning technologies.
• Partner with Microsoft, Apple, and other technology providers to evaluate emerging solutions, conduct proof-of-concept initiatives, influence product direction, and recommend technology investments.
• Collaborate with security, identity, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure endpoint services align with compliance, governance, security, and digital workplace objectives.
• Develop and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.

Qualifications, Experience, and Skills
Minimum education:

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology (IT) / Networking / Electronics or a related STEM field of study, or equivalent relevant professional experience in the industry along with industry standard certifications.Required Qualifications:
• At least 8 or more years of enterprise endpoint engineering, modern desktop administration, or endpoint management experience.
• 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune administration and engineering experience supporting Windows and mobile platforms.
• 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join implementations.
• 2+ years of enterprise iOS/iPadOS device management experience using Intune and Apple Business Manager.

Other required technical skills:
• Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows management, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application packaging and deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management.
• Experience migrating SCCM and Group Policy-managed environments to cloud-native Intune management.
• Knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), and enterprise iOS deployment practices.
• Experience with Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, endpoint security baselines, compliance reporting, and governance requirements.
• Proficiency in PowerShell automation, Microsoft Graph, reporting, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
• Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, technical documentation, vendor engagement, roadmap planning, and stakeholder communication.

Highly desirables:
• Experience with Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Power BI, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft endpoint management certifications.

jobs.description:
About Ditto:

Ditto is redefining how data moves at the edge. Our mission is to make it seamless for developers to build resilient, real-time applications, regardless of network conditions. Whether you're in a stadium, airplane, or remote military base, Ditto's peer-to-peer sync engine ensures devices stay connected and data stays consistent, even without internet. With more than $145 million in funding and trusted by organizations like Chick-fil-A, Delta Airlines, and the U.S. military, Ditto powers mission-critical experiences across aviation, retail, travel, hospitality, defense, and more. As a globally distributed, fast-growing startup, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that reflects the wide range of perspectives needed to solve the world’s hardest connectivity problems.

About the PositionThe Senior IT Systems Engineer will be focused on increasing automation across Ditto’s IT operations. They will be responsible for building infrastructure as code, monitoring and managing core IT services.

This role will require approximately 30% of their time in help desk support, but the goal is to automate that away. Ditto is a highly technical and sophisticated work force capable of self helping if given the systems to do so. One of the main goals of this role is to build the automations to enable this.

While this is a remote position, it is only for the Atlanta area. There will be an expectation to make trips to the office for special projects or troubleshooting, but there is no expectation for regularly working out of the office.

Key ResponsibilitiesOwn converting the configuration management for key services to infrastructure as code. This will mean understanding the business needs and processes around the service, required approvers and approval workflows and how to capture these requirements in technical controls.

One of the first big projects will be converting a GitHub instance to use Enterprise Managed Users with a Terraform driven configuration workflow.

Triaging and prioritizing automation projects based on statistics gathered through our ITSM.

Working with the security team to implement new security controls, apply system hardening and monitoring.

Documenting system run books and inventory.

What You'll Need6+ years of relevant experience

US Citizenship and the ability to get clearance

An eye for quality, correctness, scale and consistency

Interested in the process and procedures on how things get done, not just getting it done

Strong experience in Terraform with the ability to implement new workflows and train others

Experience with FleetDM and building policies and reports to detect and prevent issues

Experience in macOS and Linux desktop support and troubleshooting

A history of defining and automating manual IT processes

Strong understanding of identity management including SAML, OIDC, and SCIM

Nice to HavesExperience in Okta administration

Strong scripting skills in at least one common programming language such as Python

Experience working in government or defense under CMMC, FedRAMP or similar regulatory environments

Datadog experience and the ability to build dashboards and alerts

Background in managing AWS, GCP or similar cloud provider

Experience in Nix

Experience with Tracecat or an equivalent SOAR

The Benefits of Building with UsWe offer competitive salaries and meaningful equity. We believe everyone on the team should have a stake in what we’re building. Benefits vary by region to make sure you're covered in the ways that matter most. In the US, that includes health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus a 401(k) and flexible spending accounts.

Regardless of where you live, everyone at Ditto can utilize flexible time off. And while we work remotely, our Atlanta office is always open if you ever want a place to work or meet up with teammates.

Apply AnywayAt Ditto, we know game-changers don’t always come wrapped in a “perfect” resume. Years of experience? Every single bullet point checked? Meh. That’s not what drives us.

What does matter?

Grit.

Curiosity.

Adaptability.

And a genuine spark for what we’re building.

So if you’re fired up about our mission but not sure you tick every box - hit that apply button anyway. Use your application to show us how you’ll make an impact here.

We’re always on the lookout for exceptional humans who want to grow, stretch, and build something meaningful with us.

Equal Opportunity EmployerDitto is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Ditto is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let us know.

jobs.description:
This role is four days on-site at our Seneca One Buffalo, NY location, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week

Overview
M&T Bank is seeking a skilled Desktop Engineer to join our Endpoint Engineering team, with a primary focus on Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Windows endpoint management, and enterprise device deployment. This role will play a key part in supporting and expanding the Bank's ATM/TCR imaging and endpoint management initiatives while partnering closely with the ATM Engineering team.
The ideal candidate will possess a strong desktop engineering background, advanced troubleshooting skills, and hands-on experience managing Windows operating systems at enterprise scale. Experience supporting ATM/TCR platforms is beneficial but not required. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to learn the ATM/TCR environment while leveraging their endpoint engineering expertise to drive operational efficiency, stability, and innovation.

Primary Responsibilities
SCCM / Endpoint Management
Administer and support Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including operating system deployment, software distribution, patch management, compliance reporting, and application lifecycle management.
Design, build, and maintain Windows device images and deployment methodologies for enterprise endpoints and ATM/TCR platforms.
Develop and maintain endpoint standards, configurations, and deployment processes to ensure secure, reliable, and consistent device experiences.

ATM Imaging & Platform Support
Partner with the ATM/TCR Engineering team to build, maintain, and support ATM/TCR imaging solutions.
Assist with operating system upgrades, software deployments, hardware refresh initiatives, and endpoint management activities within the ATM/TCR environment.
Participate in testing, validation, and rollout activities for ATM/TCR hardware and software changes.

Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution
Serve as a senior technical resource for complex endpoint issues involving operating systems, applications, deployment systems, drivers, networking, and hardware.
Perform root cause analysis and drive resolution of recurring technical problems.
Collaborate with support teams and vendors to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve enterprise endpoint and ATM/TCR-related issues.

Automation & Process Improvement
Utilize PowerShell and other automation tools to improve operational efficiency, deployment processes, and reporting capabilities.
Identify opportunities to streamline engineering and support processes through automation and tooling enhancements.

Collaboration & Documentation
Work closely with Desktop Engineering, Security Engineering, Infrastructure, ATM/TCR Engineering, and Service Desk teams.
Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.
Participate in project planning, implementation, testing, and support activities across endpoint technology initiatives.

Education and Experience Required:
Combined minimum of 6 years’ higher education and/or work experience in systems design, management and/or architecture
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including:
Operating System Deployment (OSD)
Software Packaging and Deployment
Patch Management
Task Sequences
Device Compliance and Reporting

Deep knowledge of Windows desktop operating systems and endpoint lifecycle management.
Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across operating systems, applications, hardware, drivers, networking, and deployment technologies.
Experience creating and supporting enterprise device images.
Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.
Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across multiple technology teams.
Experience managing incidents, problem investigations, and root cause analysis efforts.

Education and Experience Preferred:
5+ years of experience in Desktop Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, or Systems Engineering in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.
Experience supporting ATM/TCR platforms, kiosk devices, retail technology, or other specialized endpoint systems.
Experience with Microsoft Intune and modern device management technologies.
Familiarity with endpoint security controls and enterprise device compliance requirements.
Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar IT service management platforms.
Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, Active Directory, Group Policy, and endpoint security practices.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

Key Focus Areas (in priority order)
SCCM / MECM Administration & Engineering
Windows Imaging & Operating System Deployment
Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis
ATM/TCR Imaging and Platform Support
PowerShell Automation & Process Improvement

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $97,100.00 - $161,800.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation.

Location
Buffalo, New York, United States of America

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Procurement team makes working with the world easy, fast, and safe. We connect supplier readiness, purchasing, invoicing, and payment so teams can move with confidence as OpenAI scales. Accounts Payable and Supplier Master Data Operations provide the trusted data, dependable execution, and financial discipline behind that experience.

About the Role

The Senior Manager, Supplier MDM Operations will own the end-to-end supplier operation that makes data accurate, verified, and ready for purchasing and payment. Reporting to the Supplier MDM Lead, you will set operating priorities, lead delivery, and be accountable for service, data quality, sensitive-change controls, and capacity. You will build an operation that scales across procurement and financial systems while creating protected capacity for the lead’s governance and transformation work.

We’re looking for a hands-on senior leader who turns ambiguous problems into clear decisions, develops people, and delivers lasting improvements. You will balance supplier readiness, risk, and capacity; resolve complex escalations; and use practical automation to help teams move faster with reliable data.

Location: San Francisco, CA. This role follows a hybrid work model, with three days per week in the office (Monday–Wednesday). Recruiting to confirm relocation and travel requirements.

In this role, you will:

 - Own supplier onboarding and maintenance across identity, legal entities, sites, tax documentation, authorized contacts, payment methods, and banking information; set service standards and take accountability for results.

 - Set the operating and capacity plan across demand, handling effort, backlog, and coverage. Prioritize work, quantify tradeoffs, and assign qualified owners and backups based on skills, access, confidentiality, and independent verification responsibilities.

 - Own operational execution of sensitive-change controls, including independent identity and authority verification, documented evidence, qualified employee review, and backup coverage. Maintain segregation of duties across preparation, approval, implementation, invoice processing, and payment approval.

 - Lead and develop the operating team and eligible service partners through clear goals, coaching, performance management, cross-training, and quality review. Use contractors for surge capacity and match assignments to approved access and scope.

 - Lead resolution of complex supplier-data and synchronization failures with AP, Procurement Operations, Tax, Treasury, Security, and Finance Systems. Establish the accountable owner, verify the fix across systems, and remove recurring causes.

 - Direct supplier-data remediation, including hierarchies, entity/site relationships, duplicates, holds, inactivation, and reactivation. Reconcile open obligations and validate downstream effects before changes take effect.

 - Own the operating scorecard for first-pass readiness, critical-field completeness, queue aging, supplier wait time, rework, control evidence, and change-related payment exceptions. Use trends to set priorities and demonstrate sustained improvement.

 - Establish an operating cadence and decision framework with the Supplier MDM Lead that protects transformation time, maintains reliable coverage, and turns recurring operational issues into prioritized improvement requirements.

 - Deliver measured improvements through AI and automation for validation, duplicate detection, queue monitoring, and evidence preparation. Define quality thresholds, access boundaries, human approvals, monitoring, and fallback procedures; count capacity gains after they are demonstrated.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Bring substantial supplier master data, P2P, or finance operations experience, with a track record of independently leading a complex operation and developing people or managing service delivery at scale.

 - Apply deep knowledge of supplier identity, legal entities, sites, tax and payment data to improve purchasing and payment outcomes across systems.

 - Have owned operating controls in an audited environment, including segregation of duties, independent verification, evidence quality, and remediation of control gaps.

 - Make sound decisions under ambiguity and time pressure, translate business needs into practical options, and resolve escalations across teams with clear accountability.

 - Have worked deeply with ERP and procurement workflows and can trace data across systems; Oracle and Zip experience is helpful.

 - Build capacity plans and service measures, coach teams through performance issues, and show sustained improvements in throughput, quality, backlog, and resilience.

 - Bring practical AI fluency and experience improving workflows with automation, with measurable benefits and authorized human ownership of sensitive decisions.

 - Influence senior stakeholders and build trust across Procurement, AP, Tax, Treasury, Security, and technology teams through clear recommendations, tradeoffs, and follow-through.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.summary: CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators,...
jobs.description:
CHAOS Industries is redefining modern defense with a multi-product portfolio that gives the ultimate advantage—domain dominance. The company's products are powered by Coherent Distributed Networks (CDN™), empowering warfighters, commercial air operators, and border protection teams to act faster, adapt rapidly, and stay ahead of evolving threats.

CHAOS Industries was founded in 2022 and has raised a total of $1 billion in funding from leading investors, including 8VC, Accel, and Valor Equity Partners. The company is headquartered in Los Angeles, with offices in Washington, D.C., San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, and London. For more information, please visit www.chaosinc.com.

**Role Overview:**

CHAOS Industries is looking for a Senior IT Systems Administrator to design, build, secure, and operate the Windows and Azure cloud infrastructure our teams rely on every day. You will keep servers, identity services, and cloud workloads healthy, patched, and compliant in a defense environment where uptime and data protection are both non-negotiable. As a senior member of the IT organization, you will act as a technical lead for systems engineering: setting standards, owning the hardest problems, and mentoring teammates, while partnering with cybersecurity, service desk, engineering, and program teams.

- Team mandate: keep the core platforms running reliably, securely, and predictably, and automate the repetitive work so the team can spend its time on improvements. You will be the escalation point for complex systems issues and a trusted advisor on infrastructure decisions.
- Ownership: technical ownership of the Windows Server and Azure environments, including architecture, patching, monitoring, backup and recovery, and hardening, plus leadership of infrastructure projects such as server and cloud migrations, new site standups, and environment consolidations as the company grows.

**Responsibilities:**

- Architect, administer, and maintain Windows Server environments (physical and virtual), including provisioning, configuration, patching, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
- Design, deploy, and manage Azure cloud resources, including virtual machines, networking, storage, identity, and monitoring, in commercial and government cloud environments, using templates and infrastructure as code.
- Administer and improve Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and certificate services, including identity lifecycle, privileged access, MFA, and conditional access policies.
- Serve as technical lead and final escalation point for complex incidents; perform root-cause analysis and drive permanent fixes.
- Mentor and coach junior systems administrators and service desk staff, and set technical standards, best practices, and peer review for the team.
- Lead infrastructure projects from planning through delivery, including site buildouts, server and cloud migrations, and the integration of newly acquired environments.
- Design and maintain automation with PowerShell and other scripting tools to streamline provisioning, patching, reporting, and routine administration.
- Own backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity design, including regular restore testing and recovery objectives.
- Apply and maintain security baselines (such as DISA STIG and CIS benchmarks), remediate vulnerabilities, and partner with cybersecurity to close findings.
- Support compliance requirements (such as CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, and FedRAMP) by maintaining configuration documentation, logs, and access reviews, and providing evidence for audits.
- Review technical designs and changes, follow the change control process, and communicate maintenance windows and impacts to stakeholders.
- Evaluate and recommend tools and technologies, and contribute to the infrastructure roadmap, capacity planning, and budget inputs.
- Support Microsoft 365 and endpoint management services, including device compliance and configuration policies, in partnership with the service desk.
- Create and maintain system documentation, runbooks, and architecture diagrams.
- Participate in an on-call rotation and occasional after-hours maintenance windows for critical systems.
- Travel: minimal, up to roughly 10% (occasional trips to company offices and new sites).
- Physical demands: primarily sedentary work at a computer; occasional lifting of equipment up to 25 lbs and work in server or network rooms.

**Minimum Requirements:**

- Minimum education:
  - Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or another related field or equivalent work experience
- 7+ years of progressive experience administering enterprise Windows Server and Microsoft Azure environments.
- Deep expertise with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP, and with Microsoft Entra ID identity and access management, including MFA and conditional access.
- Experience designing and implementing Azure solutions, including virtual machines, virtual networking, storage, role-based access control, and hybrid connectivity.
- Advanced PowerShell scripting to automate administration, patching, and reporting at scale.
- Experience owning patch management, monitoring, and backup and disaster recovery, including testing restores and meeting recovery objectives.
- Experience hardening systems and remediating vulnerabilities in a regulated environment (such as NIST SP 800-171 or CMMC).
- Track record of leading infrastructure projects and mentoring other engineers, with strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.
- U.S. person status, as required for access to CUI and export-controlled data (ITAR/EAR).

**Preferred Requirements:**

- Experience with Azure Government or Microsoft GCC High environments, and with other cloud platforms such as AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM) in multi-cloud or hybrid environments.
- Experience with Okta for single sign-on, MFA, and identity lifecycle management, including integrating Okta with Entra ID and cloud applications.
- Cloud or Microsoft certification such as Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or AWS Solutions Architect; security certification such as Security+ or CISSP.
- Experience with infrastructure as code or configuration management (Bicep, Terraform, ARM templates, or Ansible) across cloud platforms.
- Experience supporting CMMC, NIST 800-171, or FedRAMP assessments, and an active U.S. government security clearance or the ability to obtain one.

**Why CHAOS?**

- **Health Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision benefits 100% paid for by the company
- **Additional benefits**: 401k (+ 50% company match up to 6% of pay), FSA, HSA, life insurance, and more
- **Our Perks:** Free daily lunch while you're working onsite, fully-stocked kitchen, unlimited PTO, casual dress code
- **Compensation Components:** Competitive base salaries, generous pre-IPO stock option grants, relocation assistance, and (coming soon!) annual bonuses
- **Team Growth:** 500+ employees and counting across 5 global offices

**Salary Range: $140,000 - $200,000**

_The stated compensation range reflects only the targeted base compensation range and excludes additional earnings such as bonus, equity, and benefits. If your compensation requirements fall outside of the range, we still encourage you to apply. The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations._

* * *

#### Recruiting Agencies: CHAOS Industries does not accept unsolicited resumes or outreach. Unsolicited submissions will not be reviewed or compensated.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

 ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an Junior Systems Administrator to provide hands-on IT and systems support within secure enterprise environments. This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who is looking to grow their systems administration experience while supporting Windows and Linux workstations, end users, hardware, applications, and basic network connectivity.

You will work alongside experienced Systems Administrators and Engineers to troubleshoot issues, maintain systems, support specialized applications, and ensure work is performed in accordance with established technical and security requirements.

 WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Provide Tier 1 technical support for workstation, hardware, application, authentication, and connectivity issues.

- Install, configure, troubleshoot, and maintain Windows and Linux workstations and associated peripherals.

- Perform basic systems administration using established procedures and approved configuration baselines.

- Troubleshoot common network connectivity issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and physical connections.

- Install and support approved business and engineering applications.

- Diagnose hardware, software, network, and authentication issues and escalate complex problems when appropriate.

- Support workstation provisioning, deployments, upgrades, and maintenance activities.

- Create and maintain clear SOPs, troubleshooting documentation, and technical work instructions.

- Accurately document work performed and resolutions within ticketing and documentation systems.

- Maintain accountability of systems, hardware, and equipment within assigned environments.

- Follow established security procedures, access controls, configuration requirements, and change-management processes.

- Partner with Systems Administrators, Engineers, Cybersecurity, and other technical teams to resolve issues and support the environment.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Active TS/SCI security clearance.

- Active CompTIA Security+ certification or higher DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

- Foundational knowledge of Windows desktop operating systems and troubleshooting.

- Basic Linux command-line and troubleshooting experience.

- Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, and basic network troubleshooting.

- Experience troubleshooting computer hardware, peripherals, and software.

- Familiarity with command-line troubleshooting tools and/or basic PowerShell or Bash.

- Understanding of enterprise authentication and domain-connected systems.

- Ability to follow technical documentation and established procedures while recognizing when escalation is appropriate.

- Strong troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and customer-service skills.

- Ability to work effectively in a controlled, security-focused technical environment.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- CompTIA A+, Network+, or other relevant technical certifications.

- Exposure to Active Directory or similar centralized identity-management technologies.

- Exposure to virtualization technologies such as VMware or Hyper-V.

- Experience supporting engineering or specialized technical applications such as MATLAB, Sentris, or similar tools.

- Previous experience in a DoD, government, classified, or other regulated computing environment.

US Salary Range

 $95,000 - $125,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Senior Systems Administrator to independently administer, troubleshoot, maintain, and secure enterprise Windows and Linux systems in classified environments. Senior Systems Administrators are expected to perform nearly all routine and advanced administration with little to no assistance, serve as a technical escalation point, mentor other administrators, and lead operational work. Assistance should generally be limited to unfamiliar technologies, high-risk changes, architecture decisions, or issues requiring specialized engineering expertise.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Independently administer and troubleshoot Windows Server/desktop and Linux systems, Active Directory, enterprise authentication, permissions, services, applications, and domain-connected systems.

- Administer and troubleshoot enterprise Windows services including Group Policy (GPO), WSUS/patch management, DNS, DHCP, file services, certificates/PKI dependencies, and related system components.

- Create, modify, test, validate, and troubleshoot GPOs, including inheritance, precedence, OU targeting, security filtering, gpresult, and Resultant Set of Policy (RSoP).

- Administer WSUS or equivalent patching solutions, including synchronization, targeting, approvals, deployment status, failed updates, reporting, and patch-compliance remediation.

- Interpret DISA STIG requirements; use applicable STIG tools/checklists; implement and validate remediations, including GPO-based security configurations; document findings; and troubleshoot operational impacts.

- Independently administer and troubleshoot existing VMware, Hyper-V, or similar virtualization environments and virtual machines.

- Troubleshoot complex issues across operating systems, identity, applications, virtualization, storage, certificates, and network dependencies using logs and diagnostic tooling.

- Use PowerShell, Bash, and other scripting/automation methods for administration, bulk changes, data collection, troubleshooting, and repeatable tasks.

- Research and resolve unfamiliar issues using vendor documentation, technical references, logs, DISA guidance, and available tooling before requiring escalation.

- Plan and lead system changes, maintenance, upgrades, and migrations with implementation, validation, rollback, documentation, and change-control considerations.

- Serve as an escalation point and mentor for Junior Systems Administrators and Systems Administrators; provide peer review and technical guidance.

- Identify recurring problems, technical debt, security/configuration gaps, and process deficiencies and lead practical improvements within established architecture.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Active TS/SCI security clearance.

- Active CompTIA Security+ certification or higher DoD 8140/8570-aligned certification.

- Strong hands-on Windows and Linux systems administration experience with demonstrated ability to work independently.

- Hands-on experience with Active Directory, GPO administration/troubleshooting, enterprise patch management/WSUS, and domain-connected systems.

- Experience interpreting and remediating DISA STIG findings within secure or regulated environments.

- Working knowledge of VMware, Hyper-V, or comparable virtualization technologies.

- Strong understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, IP addressing, subnetting, and network troubleshooting.

- Experience with PowerShell, Bash, or similar administrative scripting.

- Demonstrated ability to independently research and resolve complex technical problems, lead technical work, mentor others, and produce effective documentation.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Advanced Microsoft, Linux, VMware, networking, or cybersecurity certifications.

- Experience supporting engineering, manufacturing, or specialized technical applications.

- Experience leading infrastructure upgrades, migrations, maintenance events, or cross-functional technical efforts.

Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. jobs.description:
**About Us**

Machines will make decisions, move value, and coordinate on behalf of organizations, instantly, autonomously, and at unprecedented scale. But the systems that govern today’s economy weren’t designed for that world. Turnkey is building the infrastructure for this future: programmable guardrails that enable autonomy without sacrificing control.

Founded by the team who scaled Coinbase Custody to $100M+ ARR and secured over $100B in crypto assets, we know how to move at pace without ever compromising on security.

Our mission is to help the world operate an economy on autopilot, safely. We're low-ego, high-agency, and deeply technical. Our team consists of experts in cryptography, security, and systems who believe great infrastructure is invisible. We're building the trustless, programmable foundation for the autonomous economy, and we're hiring people who understand what that requires.

### **Your role**

You’ll join a small platform team that works with nearly every engineering team at Turnkey. Your job is to help the whole org build faster, scale more confidently, and make better decisions, through the tooling you build, the practices you establish, and the systemic problems you find and fix before they become incidents.

You’ll work independently across product and infrastructure teams on scaling and performance, gathering requirements and constraints from each team and turning them into shared solutions. This is a role for someone who has lived through what breaks between 1 and 10, and who gets energy from stepping outside their own domain to solve problems wherever they sit.

- Build tooling for performance analysis and observability so teams can see how their systems behave and decide from data rather than intuition
- Partner with product, infrastructure, and security teams to understand their requirements and constraints, translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders, and build shared understanding of priorities to develop solutions that work across team boundaries
- Identify systemic issues across infrastructure and product, and drive them to resolution
- Anticipate scaling bottlenecks and take systems from X to Y scale (e.g., [throughput / latency / tenant count targets]) before they become incidents
- Level up other teams by introducing better tooling and practices and helping them build habits around measurement, SLOs, and data-driven decisions
- Translate technical tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders and build shared understanding of priorities
- Raise the technical bar through design reviews, documentation, and mentorship

### **What we’re looking for**

- 5+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure, or SRE, with substantial distributed systems experience
- Experience designing, building, scaling, and operating robust, reliable distributed systems in production
- Working experience with Golang, AWS, Postgres, and Kubernetes.
- Experience building tooling for performance and observability (metrics, tracing, profiling, logging, alerting, or similar)
- A data-driven approach: you define the metrics, instrument the system, and can tell the story of how a system or team moved from X to Y
- A record of leveling up teams beyond your own, through tooling, practices, or decision-making habits
- Clear communication and collaboration with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Intellectual curiosity and a willingness to step outside your own domain to understand how other teams work and what they need

### **Style points**

- Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform or similar)
- Experience in security-sensitive or high-assurance environments (TEE’s, secure enclaves, key management, regulated infrastructure).
- Fluency in Go
- Experience with incident management and post-incident learning programs
- Open source contributions or public technical writing

### **What We Offer**

- Full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA/FSA, 401(k)
- Paid parental leave
- Unlimited PTO
- $3,000/yr learning and development budget to attend industry conferences
- Multiple team offsites per year
- Lunch stipend

Please note that while the team is remote, we are only considering candidates who are physically based in the United States and Canada at the current time.

_Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply._

Compensation range

$180,000—$250,000 USD

jobs.description:
Looking for a career where hard work is valued, and your ideas and feedback are part of the way we operate daily? Want to bring your skills to a company that encourages teamwork and champions continued education and process improvement?

Atlas Tech, a veteran-owned IT company serving multiple DoD customers in support of America's warfighters, s looking for a senior, hands-on Cloud Engineer who thinks like an enterprise architect. You'll help our customer transition and compute critical data workloads from traditional 3-tier virtual machines to an automated, resilient, and secure Infrastructure-As-Code system hosted on AWS GovCloud. You'll own the solutions in production and clearly communicate your plans and designs to developers, cybersecurity, and senior leaders using diagrams, presentations, and documentation. This role expects a wide range of technical expertise. Besides the general cloud service expertise, you'll need to understand the fundamental compute and networking concepts that those cloud services rely on. You'll be able to build and test ideas and concepts in the console, but real deployments will be code-first. Strong CLI and scripting skills will be expected, able to select and work with the best tool for a given task, including PowerShell, Bash, Python, and/or TypeScript.

Strong candidates will have extensive experience across many IT domains, working as a Systems Admin, Engineer, and Technical Architects.

You Will:

 Design cloud infrastructure to support compute, network, and data services on AWS GovCloud, focusing on security, cost, availability, and operability.
 Build your designs using code-first and DevSecOps principles. Write and review infrastructure-as-code, automation, and CI/CD pipelines (Primarily CloudFormation).
 Administer and automate within the cloud-hosted compute platforms (Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Containers, a few standalone Windows instances) to ensure performant application delivery.
 Prototype and validate approaches in code before recommending them.
 Take technical lead during difficult (tier 4+) outages and incidents, troubleshooting from application behavior down through app logs, CloudWatch, DNS, TLS, routing, and packet captures.
 Work with enterprise services, including cross-cloud services to ensure that your designs meet enterprise requirements.
 Produce actionable architecture artifacts: engineering diagrams, DoDAF views, and cybersecurity documentation.
 Brief senior leaders on technical options, risks, and recommendations in plain language. Support your designs by contributing to roadmaps and business cases for major technology shifts.
 Partner with cybersecurity and accreditation teams to build security and RMF/ATO requirements into designs from the start.
 Review existing environments and develop dashboards that will allow data and metrics to drive improvements in reliability, security, cost, and automation.
 Mentor engineers and help set technical standards for the team.

You Have:

 An active Secret clearance or eligibility.
 Deep, hands-on experience building and operating production infrastructure on AWS or Azure. We care more about how well you understand the underlying systems than which cloud you learned on, and we expect strong engineers to move between platforms.
 A strong command of IT fundamentals:

   TCP/IP and the OSI model
   Common network services such as HTTP, LDAP, and DNS
   TLS/PKI and certificate management
   Load balancing and reverse proxies
   Linux (and some limited Windows) system administration, networking, and engineering
   Backup, high availability, and disaster recovery
   Multifactor authentication, OIDC, Oauth2, and related services

 The ability to explain the why behind your decisions, as well as "how" the solution works.
 Comfort writing code in Python, PowerShell, Bash, or CDK/TypeScript, alongside infrastructure-as-code.
 Experience integrating enterprise capabilities from multiple vendors:

   Virtualization
   Software-defined networking
   VDI and VPN
   Security monitoring
   Server and desktop OS management

 Clear written and verbal communication, at every level from an engineer's ticket to a leadership decision brief.
 The judgment to work independently and prioritize by mission impact.
Education/Experience

 10+ years of hands-on infrastructure, systems, or virtual datacenter engineering experience, or a bachelor's degree in a technical field plus 6+ years.
 DoD 8140 qualification (Security+ CE required, CISSP preferred), or the ability to obtain it within 6 months of hire.
 A professional-level relevant certification (AWS Solutions Architect - Professional, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, RHCE), or demonstrated equivalent experience.
 Experience with AWS GovCloud or Azure Government is preferred.
 DoD experience is a plus, including classified networks, DDIL, or SATCOM environments.
 Familiarity with enterprise architecture such as DoDAF or TOGAF, and experience delivering artifacts to EA and cybersecurity audiences.
 Experience with DevOps toolchains such as Git, CodePipeline, Ansible, Jenkins, Artifactory, Harbor, and Selenium.

Company Overview

Nova Biomedical is a global leader in advanced analytical and diagnostic technologies supporting healthcare, biotechnology, and life sciences organizations worldwide. Nova relies on secure, reliable, and scalable technology capabilities to support employees, manufacturing operations, research and development, commercial teams, and corporate functions across a global environment.

Position Summary

The Digital Workplace Experience Engineer is a senior individual contributor responsible for engineering the workflows, platform integrations, automation patterns, and experience capabilities that reduce employee technology friction and remove repetitive human work from service operations.

This is not a senior help desk or escalation role. The position is accountable for redesigning how employee technology services are delivered across identity, endpoint, collaboration, onboarding, device lifecycle, software fulfillment, and workplace services. Complex exceptions may be handled when engineering judgment is required, but the expected result is a reusable pattern, automated workflow, platform correction, or control improvement rather than a single resolved case.

The role supports Project Aurora by engineering the Service Desk & End User Experience function into an orchestration layer within Platform Engineering. It supports Project Catalyst by converting validated recurring signals into durable remediation, process redesign, standardization, and automation. It advances Project Zero by increasing zero-touch fulfillment, automation-led resolution, proactive remediation, and human-by-exception operations.

Role Mission

Engineer scalable employee technology services that prevent avoidable demand, automate repeatable work, orchestrate cross-platform workflows, improve experience by design, and allow Nova to grow without proportional increases in manual service effort.

Work Architecture View

This role is designed around capability ownership and measurable business outcomes rather than individual service requests. It connects employee technology services across systems, teams, providers, approvals, controls, and lifecycle events.

The role redesigns work so employees and service teams can focus on complex exceptions, experience improvement, and engineering decisions while automation and intelligent tools support fulfillment, routing, remediation, validation, evidence collection, and recurring operational tasks.

jobs.description:
Posting Details

Position Information

Job Title Endpoint Management Administrator Position Number 199381 Hiring Location Code Harrison County Campus Job Description

The Endpoint Management Administrator is responsible for managing and maintaining the organization's fleet of laptops, desktops, and tablets through Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Endpoint Manager. This role ensures that all endpoint devices remain compliant, secure, and up to date with the latest operating system patches, software updates, and configuration policies. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise in device management, patching, compliance, and automation, along with a proactive approach to endpoint health and user experience. In addition, the role includes maintaining an accurate and current inventory of all endpoint devices, coordinating the surplus and disposal of unused or outdated equipment, and supporting lifecycle management to ensure optimal utilization of IT assets.

The administrator oversees PC procurement, maintains an accurate inventory of devices, and ensures all new equipment is properly configured, enrolled, and deployed to end users. This role manages the surplus and decommissioning process for unused or outdated machines, ensuring responsible disposal and recordkeeping.

Job Duties

Endpoint and Update Management:

Administer and maintain Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager for all corporate devices (Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android).

Ensure all laptops, desktops, and tablets receive timely Windows Updates, security patches, and application updates.

Create, deploy, and manage device configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines.

Monitor device health, compliance, and update status using Intune reports, Defender for Endpoint, and Azure AD insights.

Creates and monitors diagnostic reports and dashboards to track metrics.

Enforce device encryption, antivirus, and endpoint protection standards.

Package, deploy, and update applications using Intune and automation tools (e.g., PowerShell, Win32 apps).

Troubleshoot Intune enrollment, policy application, and update issues across devices.

Support the rollout of new device management initiatives and operating system upgrades.

Document Intune configurations, update processes, and endpoint management procedures.

Provide user support for endpoint issues related to Intune policies or updates.

Configure new devices to meet college specifications, including:

OS installation and initial setup

Enrollment into Microsoft Intune and college domain

Application deployment and compliance configuration

Verification of hardware and software functionality prior to deployment

Continuously evaluate and implement improvements for endpoint lifecycle management and compliance.

PC Reporting & Analytics:

Develop, maintain, and automate diagnostic and management reports using Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Microsoft Entra ID, and other endpoint management tools to provide insights into device compliance, usage, software deployment, update status, hardware inventory, and endpoint health.Monitor and analyze PC utilization, hardware health, software inventory, and endpoint performance to identify trends, optimize device lifecycle planning, and support operational decision-making.PC Software & Application Management

Develop and maintain a standardized catalog of approved PC software, including version control, licensing information, deployment methods, and support documentation.Administer the review and approval process for new PC software requests by evaluating business justification, security risks, licensing requirements, technical compatibility, and supportability.Coordinate software evaluations with Data Security, application owners, and business units to ensure requested software meets organizational security and compliance requirements.Document software approval decisions and maintain records of approved, denied, and retired software applications.PC Lifecycle Management

Procurement:

Coordinate and place PC orders in alignment with college purchasing policies and approved standards.

Maintain vendor relationships and ensure timely delivery and warranty support for hardware purchases.

Coordinate and oversee the quote and procurement process for computer equipment, peripherals, software, and related technology resources for the College.

Ensure all technology purchases comply with applicable State of Mississippi Information Technology Services (ITS) guidelines, procurement regulations, and approved Express Procurement Option (EPO) requirements.

Inventory, Asset Tagging, and Deployment:

Generate asset tags for new technology assets and coordinate deployment schedules with college stakeholders and the Technical Support & Desktop Services team.

Maintain accurate and current asset records within the Asset Panda Inventory Management System.

Manage the inventory of all college-owned laptops, desktops, tablets, and other endpoint devices, ensuring data accuracy and completeness.

Surplus of Old Technology:

Coordinate the surplus process for unused, obsolete, or non-functional equipment in accordance with college policies and sustainability standards.

Perform periodic audits to verify asset records and ensure physical inventory matches system documentation.

Work with procurement and leadership to plan equipment refresh cycles and replacement schedules.

Perform periodic inventory audits and reconcile discrepancies to ensure compliance with institutional asset management policies.

Documentation and Support

Maintain clear documentation of Intune configurations, inventory procedures, and update management processes.Provide technical support and guidance to administrators, faculty, staff and students regarding device configuration and compliance issues.Participate in project-work related to device lifecycle management, modernization, and automation.Mandatory Qualifications

(M1) Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

(M2) Minimum 2 years of experience in IT systems or endpoint administration.

(M3) At least one year managing devices through Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager.

(M4) Excellent oral and written communication skills in both technical and non-technical environments.

(M5) Proficiency with Microsoft Intune, Azure AD, and Windows Update for Business.

Desirable Qualifications

(D1) Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field (or equivalent experience).

(D2) Minimum 3 years of experience in IT systems or endpoint administration.

(D3) At least 2 years managing devices through Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager.

(D4) Experience with hardware procurement and device lifecycle management.

(D5) Strong understanding of Windows and macOS setup, configuration, and deployment.

jobs.description:
This role is four days on-site at our Seneca One Buffalo, NY location, with the flexibility to work from home one day per week

Overview

M&T Bank is seeking a skilled Desktop Engineer to join our Endpoint Engineering team, with a primary focus on Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Windows endpoint management, and enterprise device deployment. This role will play a key part in supporting and expanding the Bank's ATM/TCR imaging and endpoint management initiatives while partnering closely with the ATM Engineering team.

The ideal candidate will possess a strong desktop engineering background, advanced troubleshooting skills, and hands-on experience managing Windows operating systems at enterprise scale. Experience supporting ATM/TCR platforms is beneficial but not required. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to learn the ATM/TCR environment while leveraging their endpoint engineering expertise to drive operational efficiency, stability, and innovation.

Primary Responsibilities

SCCM / Endpoint Management

Administer and support Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including operating system deployment, software distribution, patch management, compliance reporting, and application lifecycle management.

Design, build, and maintain Windows device images and deployment methodologies for enterprise endpoints and ATM/TCR platforms.

Develop and maintain endpoint standards, configurations, and deployment processes to ensure secure, reliable, and consistent device experiences.

ATM Imaging & Platform Support

Partner with the ATM/TCR Engineering team to build, maintain, and support ATM/TCR imaging solutions.

Assist with operating system upgrades, software deployments, hardware refresh initiatives, and endpoint management activities within the ATM/TCR environment.

Participate in testing, validation, and rollout activities for ATM/TCR hardware and software changes.

Troubleshooting & Problem Resolution

Serve as a senior technical resource for complex endpoint issues involving operating systems, applications, deployment systems, drivers, networking, and hardware.

Perform root cause analysis and drive resolution of recurring technical problems.

Collaborate with support teams and vendors to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve enterprise endpoint and ATM/TCR-related issues.

Automation & Process Improvement

Utilize PowerShell and other automation tools to improve operational efficiency, deployment processes, and reporting capabilities.

Identify opportunities to streamline engineering and support processes through automation and tooling enhancements.

Collaboration & Documentation

Work closely with Desktop Engineering, Security Engineering, Infrastructure, ATM/TCR Engineering, and Service Desk teams.

Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, knowledge articles, and operational procedures.

Participate in project planning, implementation, testing, and support activities across endpoint technology initiatives.

Education and Experience Required:

Combined minimum of 6 years’ higher education and/or work experience in systems design, management and/or architecture

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), including:

Operating System Deployment (OSD)

Software Packaging and Deployment

Patch Management

Task Sequences

Device Compliance and Reporting

Deep knowledge of Windows desktop operating systems and endpoint lifecycle management.

Advanced troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across operating systems, applications, hardware, drivers, networking, and deployment technologies.

Experience creating and supporting enterprise device images.

Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation.

Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work across multiple technology teams.

Experience managing incidents, problem investigations, and root cause analysis efforts.

Education and Experience Preferred:

5+ years of experience in Desktop Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, or Systems Engineering in a medium-to-large enterprise environment.

Experience supporting ATM/TCR platforms, kiosk devices, retail technology, or other specialized endpoint systems.

Experience with Microsoft Intune and modern device management technologies.

Familiarity with endpoint security controls and enterprise device compliance requirements.

Experience with ServiceNow, Jira, or similar IT service management platforms.

Working knowledge of networking fundamentals, Active Directory, Group Policy, and endpoint security practices.

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to play a significant role in modernizing and supporting M&T Bank's endpoint and ATM/TCR deployment environment. You'll work on highly visible initiatives, solve complex technical challenges, and help deliver secure and reliable technology solutions across the enterprise.

Key Focus Areas (in priority order)

SCCM / MECM Administration & Engineering

Windows Imaging & Operating System Deployment

Advanced Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis

ATM/TCR Imaging and Platform Support

PowerShell Automation & Process Improvement

M&T Bank is committed to fair, competitive, and market-informed pay for our employees. The pay range for this position is $97,100.00 - $161,800.00 Annual (USD). The successful candidate’s particular combination of knowledge, skills, and experience will inform their specific compensation.

Location

Buffalo, New York, United States of America

You’ll support and analyze data anomalies for source data originating in multiple environments including but not limited to Data Warehouse, ODS, Data Replication/ETL and other Data Management initiatives. You will also be responsible for assisting in the initial setup and on-going documentation/configuration related to Data Governance and Master Data Management solutions. You have a passion for data, along with good SQL, analytical and communication skills.

Profile source data and measure data quality (completeness, uniqueness, validity and consistency)

Strong hands-on experience with Enterprise Master Data Management (MDM) platforms.15+ years in data analysis with strong expertise in MDM or data quality

Experience with an MDM platform (Ab Initio preferred)

Ability to work in a team-oriented, fast-paced agile environment managing multiple priorities
