Job Overview

The Endpoint Administrator will manage and support the organization's endpoint computing environment. This role is responsible for the administration, security, deployment, and lifecycle management of Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android devices across branch, corporate, and remote locations. The Endpoint Administrator will play a key role in delivering a secure and modern digital workplace through technologies such as Microsoft Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, mobile device management (MDM), endpoint security, automation, and application deployment. The successful candidate will work closely with Infrastructure, IT Security, Service Support Desk, and business stakeholders to ensure endpoint services meet operational, security, and regulatory requirements.

Role

Endpoint Management

Administer and support enterprise Windows 11 and macOS devices.Manage and maintain corporate iPhone, iPad, and Android devices.Oversee the full endpoint lifecycle, including procurement, provisioning, deployment, upgrades, refreshes, and decommissioning.Develop and maintain standard operating system images and endpoint configuration standards.

Microsoft Endpoint Ecosystem

Administer Microsoft Intune for device management, application deployment, compliance, and configuration management.Design and maintain Windows Autopilot processes for zero-touch device deployment.Manage Microsoft Entra ID device registration and compliance integration.Implement and support Conditional Access and device-based security controls.

Application Deployment & Automation

Package, test, deploy, and support enterprise applications using Intune and related management platforms.Develop and maintain PowerShell and scripting solutions to automate operational tasks and improve service delivery.Maintain software inventories and ensure application currency across the enterprise.Troubleshoot application deployment and compatibility issues.

Active Directory & Policy Management

Create, manage, and troubleshoot Group Policy Objects (GPOs).Support Active Directory administration related to endpoints and user computing.Implement endpoint configuration standards and security baselines.

Security & Compliance

Maintain endpoint security controls including Microsoft Defender, BitLocker, FileVault, antivirus, and device compliance policies.Support regulatory, audit, and cybersecurity initiatives including ISO 27001 and financial industry security requirements.Investigate and remediate endpoint security vulnerabilities and compliance issues.Participate in security incident response activities involving endpoint devices.

Operational Support

Act as a senior escalation point for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.Monitor endpoint health, patch compliance, and service performance metrics.Collaborate with Infrastructure, IT Security, and Service Support Desk teams on projects and operational initiatives.Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and knowledge articles.

Required Skills

College diploma or university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related discipline.Minimum of five (5+) years of experience supporting enterprise endpoint environments.Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate is considered an asset

This role is hybrid in Stoney Creek, ON.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Microsoft 365, Identity & Endpoint Administrator

  Job Type: Full-time, Exempt

  Location: Minneapolis, MN (Hybrid)

  Own Identify, Support People, Secure the Environment
 Plus Relocation is looking for a hands-on Microsoft administrator with deep Active Directory and Group Policy experience who enjoys solving technical problems, helping colleagues locally and around the world, and making technology work better. This is more than a help desk role: you will own the full identity lifecycle across Active Directory and Entra ID, manage our Windows endpoints, and help us improve automation, security and the employee experience.

  What You Will Do

  Own the full identity lifecycle across on-prem Active Directory and Entra ID: set up new-hire accounts ahead of start dates and keep them disabled until Day 1, process internal transfers by removing old access as well as adding new, and fully deprovision departing employees within 24 hours
  Design and maintain role-based access using security groups and the AGDLP model, applying least privilege to file shares, applications, and admin roles
  Administer Group Policy, OU structure, and delegation of control
  Run regular access reviews and cleanup of stale and orphaned accounts, unowned groups, nested-group sprawl, and privileged role membership, and produce audit-ready evidence
  Administer Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint) and manage Windows endpoints through Intune, Autopilot, configuration policies, updates, and application deployment
  Provide excellent hands-on support for local employees, and remote support for US and global employees as needed, across devices, Microsoft 365, and business applications
  Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automations that run under dedicated service accounts, gMSAs, or app registrations, with documented permissions, ownership, and change control
  Partner with Security and Compliance on MFA, Conditional Access, data deletion, audits, and the responsible use of approved AI tools

  What You Bring

  3+ years of hands-on Active Directory administration in a production domain: users, groups, OUs, delegation, DNS, and replication basics
  Demonstrated Group Policy experience: authoring, precedence and inheritance, security and WMI filtering, and troubleshooting with gpresult and RSOP
  Hybrid identity experience with Entra Connect or Cloud Sync, including sync scope, source of authority, and the difference between disabling a user on-prem and in the cloud
  Practical knowledge of role-based access and least privilege, including Entra admin roles, the tiered admin model, and separate admin accounts for privileged work
  Working PowerShell skills (ActiveDirectory module and Microsoft Graph PowerShell) for bulk and scheduled identity tasks
  The ability to walk us through a complete offboarding from start to finish: disabling the account and resetting the password, revoking sessions and MFA methods, removing groups and licenses, handling the mailbox and OneDrive, removing device access, and capturing evidence of each step
  Experience with NTFS and share permissions on Windows file servers
  Hands-on Microsoft 365 administration, confident Windows troubleshooting, and solid networking fundamentals
  Clear communication, strong service instincts, sound security judgment, and ownership

  Nice to Have

  Intune and Autopilot, Microsoft Defender, Purview, Conditional Access, SaaS administration, and compliance or audit experience
  Certifications such as AZ-802 (Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate), SC-300 (Identity and Access Administrator), or MD-102 (Endpoint Administrator). Demonstrated, practical experience matters more to us than certifications.

  Room to Grow
 We envision a progression from identity, Microsoft administration, and endpoint ownership in Year 1, to automation and technical project leadership in Year 2, with a potential Senior Systems and Automation Engineer path in Year 3. Progression depends on demonstrated capability and business needs.

  Compensation and Benefits Summary
 This role offers an annual base salary range of $84,000 - $105,000, depending on qualifications. This is a hybrid role based in Minneapolis, MN.

 In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for:

  Annual discretionary profit-sharing bonus
  Paid floating holiday
  401(k) retirement contributions

 Salary Range Note: This is a good faith estimate based on current benchmarks. Final compensation will be based on skills, experience, and internal equity.

  General Benefits

  Multiple medical plan options with a significant portion of premiums paid by the company
  Dental and vision coverage
  Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions
  Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid volunteer hours
  Company-paid life, AD&D, short- and long-term disability insurance
  Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  Wellness incentives and strengths-based development culture
  Hybrid work arrangement

  Why Plus Relocation?
 Our mission is simple: Deliver Delight. That starts with how we treat our own team. At Plus, you'll join a values-driven group of people who believe in the power of team, hold themselves to a standard of no excuses accountability, and genuinely care about doing right by our clients and each other. We invest in your growth, recognize your contributions, and support you with benefits that go beyond the basics.

 Ready to join us? Apply today or reach out to learn more.

  Plus Relocation is an equal opportunity employer. This is a hybrid position based in Minneapolis, MN. In accordance with applicable state pay transparency laws, the full salary range for this role is disclosed above.

jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Arctiq is a global, intelligence-driven technology services company delivering professional and managed services across Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, Networking & Connected Experiences, Cybersecurity, Data & AI, Autonomous Operations & Intelligence, and Enterprise Service Management. We help organizations operate, secure, and modernize complex environments by unifying infrastructure, networking, data, security, automation, and observability under a single, integrated operating model. Our work focuses on helping customers reduce operational friction, improve resilience, and make better, faster decisions as their environments evolve. Arctiq builds on decades of industry expertise and a customer-centric ethos to deliver exceptional value to clients across diverse industries.

Position Overview:

We are seeking an experienced End User Computing (EUC) Engineer to provide dedicated, full-time support. This role will serve as the primary resource responsible for the administration, support, optimization, and security of the organization's end-user computing environment.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across modern endpoint management technologies and a proven track record of managing enterprise desktop environments, mobile devices, and endpoint security initiative.

This is a remote contract opportunity with one of Arctiq's clients.

Qualifications:

Administer and maintain enterprise endpoint management platforms, including SCCM/MECM and Microsoft Intune.
Configure, deploy, and support Windows Autopilot for streamlined device provisioning and onboarding.
Manage and support endpoint infrastructure through Windows Administration Center and related management tools.
Package, deploy, and maintain end-user applications across the enterprise environment.
Oversee operating system lifecycle management, including upgrades, migrations, and refresh initiatives.
Manage endpoint patching and update compliance to ensure systems remain current and secure.
Support and maintain endpoint backup and recovery solutions.
Identify, prioritize, and remediate endpoint vulnerabilities in partnership with security teams.
Administer software licensing and hardware asset management processes and reporting.
Monitor and improve the overall digital employee experience, focusing on endpoint performance and user satisfaction.
Implement and maintain endpoint security baselines, hardening standards, and compliance controls.
Support and troubleshoot enterprise print services and printing infrastructure.
Manage deployment and support of mobile applications across iOS and Android devices.
Provide support for Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) programs and policies.
Monitor endpoint health and performance through proactive monitoring and alerting solutions.
Serve as the dedicated EUC resource, partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure reliable and high-quality end-user support.

Requirements:

7+ years of experience in End User Computing, Desktop Engineering, or Endpoint Management roles.
Hands-on experience administering Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) and Microsoft Intune in an enterprise environment.
Strong experience with Windows Autopilot, endpoint provisioning, and device lifecycle management.
Experience supporting enterprise Windows desktop environments and modern workplace technologies.
Knowledge of endpoint security best practices, vulnerability management, and system hardening.
Experience with application packaging, deployment, and patch management processes.
Familiarity with mobile device management (MDM) solutions and mobile application deployment.
Experience supporting BYOD environments and modern workplace initiatives.
Strong troubleshooting, communication, and customer service skills.
Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment while supporting a dedicated client account.
Experience with enterprise monitoring and endpoint analytics platforms.
Relevant Microsoft certifications related to endpoint management or modern workplace technologies.
Experience working in managed services or dedicated client support environments.
Familiarity with ITIL processes and service management best practices.

Arctiq is an equal opportunity employer. If you need any accommodations or adjustments throughout the interview process and beyond, please let us know. We celebrate our inclusive work environment and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

We thank you for your interest in joining the Arctiq team! While we welcome all applicants, only those who are selected for an interview will be contacted.

Description

 The NASA IT portfolio within the Digital sector at Leidos currently has an opening for a Junior Mobile Device Management Engineer. This is primarily a telework position, but the ideal candidate will reside within reasonable commute distance from a NASA operating center and have flexibility to go on-site when needed for specific activities. This is an exciting opportunity to use your experience helping the NASA End-User Services and Technologies (NEST) mission. In this mission, we serve as an agile, trusted partner to transform, integrate, simplify, modernize, and safeguard NASA IT systems and data. And, above all else, continuously enhance the end-user experience.

Note:

This position is remote; however, candidates must reside within 50 miles of a NASA facility or within a reasonable commuting distance, as the customer may require onsite support at any time based on program needs.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

The primary responsibilities of this role lie with the management, deployment and support of mobile device management tools and mobile device applications.

Use Microsoft Intune to create, maintain, and deploy configuration profiles, compliance policies, app protection policies, app configuration policies, and role-based access controls.Manage users, apps, devices, resellers and MDM servers within Apple Business Manager.Manage apps within Managed Google Play.Monitor and maintain healthy connections between Intune and Apple Business Manager, Managed Google Play, and Samsung Knox Mobile Enrollment.Create user-facing documentation and knowledge articles for mobile device support topics.Create IT technician-facing documentation and knowledge articles for mobile device support topics.Develop and execute test plans for changes to the mobile device management environment and operations.Participate in project teams to implement new services and service enhancements on the NEST innovation roadmap.Resolve incidents and fulfill requests in alignment with established program processes and in a timeframe that meets or exceeds SLA requirements for incident handling, request fulfillment and service availability (uptime).Prepare process documentation and provide process training to NEST technicians and other relevant audiences.Work with vendors to resolve technical issues, monitor product roadmaps, and implement product changes.Provide support for core and built-in app functionality of the following operating systems: iOS, iPadOS, Android, Windows Holographic
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

Bachelor’s degree and 1-2 years’ experience in a computer or mobile device support role.1-2 years’ experiencing supporting and deploying mobile devices in an enterprise environment.1-2 years’ experience enrolling mobile devices in a mobile device management solution.Ability to work efficiently and effectively in a telework environment while maintaining healthy communication with peers, leadership, customers, vendors, and project stakeholders.Reliable internet connection for telework.Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present technical subjects in an effective way to audiences with a differing levels technical expertise.Suitable workspace that is conducive for focusing on complex work assignments and participating in online video meetings.Ability to work evenings, weekends, and nights as needed for maintenance or issue resolution that cannot be performed during standard working hours.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

A current certification in a relevant field or technology.2+ years’ experience administering Microsoft Intune in support of mobile device management
Experience administering Microsoft Intune in support of PC management.Understanding of all mobile device enrollment methods, including automated device enrollment, device enrollment, user enrollment, corporate owned work profile, work profile, and corporate owned dedicated.
CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

U.S. Citizenship is required.Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

Please be advised that if you are moved to the interview stage, during the interview you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes if an offer letter is extended to you.

jobs.description:
Asana for Client Management is a new product for Agencies to manage every client, every project, and every conversation in one place. We are looking for a collaborative Engineering Manager to lead one of the teams bringing this vision to life. In this role, you will build and empower a talented team of engineers, partner cross-functionally to shape the product roadmap, establish technical foundations, and deliver a superlative user experience.

This role is based in our Warsaw office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

 What you’ll achieve

- Hire and support a talented team of engineers to build a new product from the ground up.

- Partner cross-functionally with Product Management, Design, and Data Science to define roadmap priorities and deliver intuitive product capabilities.

- Guide architectural and technical decisions to ensure system reliability, performance, and long-term scalability.

- Drive operational excellence and continuous delivery processes, enabling the team to iterate quickly and ship value continuously.

- Champion accountability for key outcomes, linking your team's everyday work to Asana's broader strategic goals.

 About you

- Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

- Experience guiding and developing software engineering teams in building scalable web applications, ideally with experience leading 0-1 product development.

- Solid technical background with a deep understanding of software engineering fundamentals and modern architecture.

- Proven track record of collaborating effectively with product managers and designers to balance technical health with user velocity.

- Clear communicator and empathetic leader who thrives in a collaborative environment.

At Asana, we're committed to building teams that include a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, as this is critical to helping us achieve our mission. If you're interested in this role and don't meet every listed requirement, we still encourage you to apply.

 What we’ll offer

Our comprehensive compensation package plays a big part in how we recognize you for the impact you have on our path to achieving our mission. We believe that compensation should be reflective of the value you create relative to the market value of your role. To ensure pay is fair and not impacted by biases, we're committed to looking at market value which is why we check ourselves and conduct a yearly pay equity audit.

For this role, the estimated base salary range is between 34,300 - 39,000 PLN gross. The actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.

In addition to base salary, your compensation package may include additional components such as equity, sales incentive pay (for most sales roles), and benefits. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

We strive to provide equitable and competitive benefits packages that support our employees worldwide and include:

- Mental health, wellness & fitness benefits

- Career coaching & support

- Inclusive family building benefits

- Long-term savings or retirement plans

- In-office culinary options to cater to your dietary preferences

These are just some of the benefits we offer, and benefits may vary based on role, country, and local regulations. If you're interviewing for this role, speak with your recruiter to learn more about the total compensation and benefits for this role.

Living our values everyday results in our team-first culture and enables us to innovate, grow, and thrive while enjoying the journey together. We celebrate diversity and foster an inclusive environment, empowering our employees to be their authentic selves.

The Desktop Systems Administrator II serves as an advanced Tier II escalation point, responsible for deploying, maintaining, and supporting enterprise endpoint hardware, operating systems, and core productivity applications. This role partners closely with Service Desk and Infrastructure teams to ensure high availability, streamline standard operating procedures, and deliver white-glove technical support to on-site, remote, and executive personnel. This position requires being in the office 5 days per week at our Dallas, TX location.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Support & VIP Services

- Tier II Incident Resolution: Act as an escalation point for complex incidents and service requests from the Service Desk, troubleshooting hardware, software, VPN, mobile devices, peripherals, and network connectivity across Windows and macOS environments.
- Executive & VIP Support: Deliver high-touch, urgent technical support for senior leadership and administrative staff with minimal business disruption.
- Incident & Outage Management: Monitor, prioritize, and resolve ticketing queues within established SLAs; participate in an on-call rotation to resolve critical after-hours incidents and outages.
- Event & AV Support: Configure, test, and facilitate audio/video conferencing solutions (e.g., Zoom Rooms, Microsoft Teams, etc.) for executive presentations and company-wide meetings.
- Working with IT Engineering teams, act as “smart hands and eyes” for in-office infrastructure including networking equipment and servers

Endpoint & Systems Administration

- Endpoint Provisioning & Deployment: Deploy, configure, and maintain laptops, desktops, and mobile devices using enterprise management tooling (e.g., Intune, Jamf, SCCM).
- Identity & Access Management: Administer user accounts, groups, and device policies within Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
- Task Automation: Familiarity with technologies to automate repetitive administrative workflows and system maintenance tasks through scripting or AI.
- Infrastructure Relocations: Coordinate and execute IT workspace setups, office reconfigurations, and moves/adds/changes.

IT Asset Lifecycle Management (ITAM)

- Hardware Lifecycle Operations: Maintain the end-to-end hardware lifecycle, including procurement staging, bench testing, provisioning, secure data sanitization/wiping, and e-waste disposal.
- Inventory Control: Monitor and maintain stock levels for hardware, peripherals, and accessories across local depots in alignment with organizational standards.

Process Improvement & Knowledge Management

- SOP Development: Document standardize operating procedures, knowledge base articles, and end-user self-service guides to increase First Contact Resolution (FCR) rates.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Infrastructure, Security, and Desktop Engineering teams to identify operational gaps, rollout technology updates, and enforce IT standards.

Qualifications & Requirements

Required Experience & Education

- Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience with 5+ years of progressive end-user computing / desktop support experience.
- Executive Support: Minimum 2 years of experience providing dedicated VIP / executive-level technical support.
- Operating Systems & Software: Deep administration knowledge of Windows and macOS, along with enterprise suites (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Adobe Creative Cloud, Slack, Zoom).
- Endpoint Management: Comprehensive knowledge administering devices via MDM/UEM platforms (e.g., Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, Jamf Pro, or SCCM).
- Identity & Directory Services: Practical experience managing users, access permissions, and device compliance in Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
- Networking Fundamentals: Strong comprehension of enterprise network protocols and services (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, Wi-Fi 802.1x).
- Communication & Professionalism: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
- Physical Requirement: Ability to physically lift, rack, move, and deploy hardware weighing up to 50 lbs.

Preferred Additional Qualifications

- Certifications: CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or Jamf Certified Associate.
- Scripting Skills: Working knowledge of PowerShell, Bash, or Python for desktop administration and deployment automation.
- AI fundamentals of Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or other AI platforms.
- ITIL Familiarity: Understanding of ITIL framework and ticketing workflows (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira Service Management).

Work Location: This role is hybrid. 3 days a week (T, W, TH) in our Dallas office is required.

* * *

As part of our continued commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion, Five9 supports pay transparency during the entire recruitment process. Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate including, but not limited to: skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the job across the United States. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation package during your hiring process.

Additionally, the total compensation package for this position may also include an annual performance bonus, stock, and/or other applicable incentive compensation plans.

Our total reward package also includes:

- Health, dental, and vision coverage, beginning on the first day of employment. Five9 covers 100% of the employee portion of the health, dental and vision coverage and shares a high portion of the dependent cost. We also offer Short & Long-Term Disability, Basic Life Insurance, and a 401k saving plan with employer matching.
- Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.
- Generous employee stock purchase plan.
- Paid Time Off, Company paid holidays, paid volunteer hours and 12 weeks paid parental leave.

All compensation and benefits are subject to the requirements and restrictions set forth in the applicable plan documents and any written agreements between the parties.

The US base salary range for this role is below.

$72,100—$200,200 USD

Five9 embraces diversity and is committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. The more inclusive we are, the better we are. Five9 is an equal opportunity employer.

Five9 is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@five9.com to request an accommodation. Requests will be handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable law.

* * *

View our privacy policy, including our privacy notice to California residents here: [https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal](https://www.five9.com/pt-pt/legal).

Note: Five9 will never request that an applicant send money as a prerequisite for commencing employment with Five9.

jobs.description:
About the RoleWe are seeking an experienced Senior Microsoft Engineer (Level 3) to serve as a technical authority within a high-performing operations team, supporting complex Microsoft cloud environments across multiple commercial customers.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Microsoft Engineer (Level 3) to serve as a technical authority within a high-performing operations team, supporting complex Microsoft cloud environments across multiple commercial customers.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role focused on resolving complex technical escalations, strengthening security standards, driving technology modernisation, and improving operational efficiency. You will leverage your expertise across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Azure to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions.

Beyond reactive support, you will proactively identify opportunities to optimise customer environments, enhance security, improve licensing efficiency, and reduce operational complexity. You will also play a key role in mentoring engineers, establishing technical standards, and driving continuous improvement across the wider technical team.

About the Client

You will be working with an established technology services provider that delivers managed IT services and Microsoft cloud solutions to commercial customers. The organisation prioritises security, operational excellence, and proactive technology management, empowering its technical teams to deliver reliable solutions while continuously improving customer environments.

Ideal Profile

Professional Experience

-

At least 7 years of experience in systems engineering, cloud engineering, or managed IT services, including significant experience in senior technical support or Level 3 engineering.

-

Proven experience working within a Managed Service Provider (MSP), supporting multiple commercial customer environments.

-

Strong understanding of managed services operations, incident management, problem management, and change management.

-

Demonstrated ability to own complex technical issues, conduct root-cause analysis, and deliver sustainable solutions.

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Management

-

Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and Microsoft Endpoint Manager.

-

Strong knowledge of Windows Autopilot, device enrolment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, application deployment, and Windows 10/11 administration.

-

Experience with endpoint security, device lifecycle management, update management, and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration.

Microsoft 365

-

Advanced administration and troubleshooting experience across Microsoft 365, including Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business, and Microsoft Teams.

-

Knowledge of Microsoft 365 licensing, including Business Premium, E3, and E5, and their associated security and compliance capabilities.

-

Understanding of Microsoft Purview, including Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies and sensitivity labels.

Microsoft Entra ID & Identity Security

-

Deep expertise in identity and access management, authentication, identity protection, and access governance.

-

Advanced experience implementing and troubleshooting Conditional Access, multifactor authentication (MFA), and Single Sign-On (SSO).

-

Knowledge of hybrid identity, Entra Connect, directory synchronisation, authentication protocols, role-based access control, and least-privilege security models.

-

Familiarity with Granular Delegated Admin Privileges (GDAP) and delegated administration across multiple customer tenants.

Microsoft Defender & Cybersecurity

-

Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and the broader Microsoft Defender security ecosystem.

-

Experience implementing endpoint protection, attack surface reduction, vulnerability management, and security policies.

-

Knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Defender XDR, Zero Trust principles, and Microsoft security best practices.

-

Ability to review Microsoft Secure Score and implement recommendations to strengthen security posture.

Microsoft Azure

-

Strong experience administering and troubleshooting Azure environments, including virtual machines, networking, storage, backup, monitoring, and resource management.

-

Knowledge of Azure role-based access control, Azure Policy, security configuration, governance, and cost management.

-

Familiarity with Azure Lighthouse and multi-tenant Azure administration.

Scripting & Automation

-

Advanced PowerShell scripting skills for automating Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Azure administration.

-

Strong experience with Microsoft Graph API for automation, reporting, and configuration management.

-

Ability to develop, troubleshoot, and maintain secure, reusable, and well-documented scripts and automated processes.

Security Frameworks & Additional Technical Knowledge

-

Familiarity with the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) Essential Eight framework and its application to commercial environments.

-

Experience implementing Microsoft security controls to support Essential Eight maturity improvements.

-

Exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Log Analytics, advanced security monitoring, and broader Microsoft Purview compliance capabilities.

-

Familiarity with multi-tenant management platforms, including Microsoft 365 Lighthouse, Azure Lighthouse, and PSA/RMM tools such as ConnectWise, HaloPSA, Autotask, NinjaOne, or Datto RMM.

-

Experience contributing to customer technology roadmaps, security improvement plans, and Microsoft licensing reviews.

-

Understanding of ITIL-aligned service management practices.

Preferred Certifications

-

Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102).

-

Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102).

-

Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104).

Additional certifications in identity and access management, such as SC-300, and Azure security, such as SC-500, are advantageous. Equivalent practical experience and technical knowledge are also valued.

Key Competencies

-

-

Ownership & Accountability: Takes responsibility for issues from investigation through resolution and addresses recurring problems at their source.

-

Proactive Thinking: Identifies opportunities to modernise environments, improve security, and prevent recurring incidents.

-

Analytical Problem-Solving: Uses structured troubleshooting and evidence-based analysis to develop sustainable solutions.

-

Security-Focused Mindset: Maintains secure, consistent, and well-governed Microsoft environments.

-

Communication & Collaboration: Communicates technical concepts, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

-

Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing: Supports the development of junior engineers and contributes to a collaborative technical culture.

-

Documentation & Continuous Improvement: Maintains high-quality documentation and continually improves technical standards, processes, and automation.

Responsibilities

1. Level 3 Technical Escalation & Problem Management

-

-

-

2. Microsoft Security & Configuration Standards

-

-

-

-

3. Proactive Technology Modernisation & Optimisation

-

-

-

-

-

-

4. Multi-Tenant Microsoft Environment Management

-

-

-

Identify opportunities to improve the scalability, consistency, and efficiency of multi-tenant operations.

5. Automation & Operational Efficiency

-

-

Identify repetitive tasks across Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, and Azure that can be streamlined through automation.

-

Build reusable automation for standardised configuration, reporting, monitoring, and remediation.

-

Improve the reliability and efficiency of customer environment management through automation and process standardisation.

-

Document automation solutions to ensure they are secure, maintainable, and accessible to the wider technical team.

6. Technical Leadership & Knowledge Development

-

Mentor Level 1 and Level 2 engineers, strengthening their troubleshooting capabilities and Microsoft platform knowledge.

-

Develop and maintain technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles.

-

jobs.description:
**Company Description** Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

**Job Description** We are looking for an**Endpoint Management Specialist** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.** **Key Responsibilities** **Endpoint Operations \& Support**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and device management issues.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle and perform root cause analysis.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and device provisioning activities.

**Endpoint Management**

* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services.
* Configure and test device policies, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Monitor endpoint compliance and support remediation activities.
* Assist with device lifecycle management and deployment processes.

**Software Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package, test, and deploy software applications and updates.
* Troubleshoot application deployment issues.
* Support application lifecycle management and software maintenance.

**Testing \& Continuous Improvement**

* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments and testing activities.
* Contribute to process improvements, automation, and service optimization initiatives.

**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Document recurring issues and standard solutions.
* Support knowledge sharing within the Endpoint Management team.

**Qualifications**

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Fluent English (C1 or C2)

**Additional Information**

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Cloud & Platform Engineer to design, modernize, secure, and sustain systems and infrastructure supporting classified computing environments. This systems engineering focused role spans government cloud environments, including DoD Impact Level 5 (IL5) and higher where appropriately authorized, classified cloud platforms, and on-premises classified systems. The engineer will develop secure hybrid connectivity, strengthen infrastructure automation, and support mission-critical operations in air-gapped, disconnected, and restricted-connectivity environments.

As a foundational member of the Cloud Networks team, you will assess inherited infrastructure, remediate architectural and operational deficiencies, and establish repeatable engineering and sustainment practices. You will partner with ISSMs, ISSOs, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, and Software Engineering to modernize systems while preserving mission availability and meeting applicable authorization requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Assess, design, modernize, and sustain classified cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure; identify architectural deficiencies, technical debt, security gaps, and opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

- Engineer government cloud infrastructure, including DoD IL5+ environments and appropriately authorized classified cloud platforms; implement secure connectivity, network segmentation, and integration with on-premises systems while respecting classification boundaries.

- Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools; maintain version-controlled infrastructure artifacts, standardized deployments, and repeatable operational workflows suitable for restricted environments.

- Design, deploy, and sustain Windows and Linux systems, virtualization, virtual desktop infrastructure, remote access services, and supporting platform components; integrate automation and internal tooling for provisioning, access management, and support.

- Establish hardened system images, configuration baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation processes, and compliance validation for endpoints, servers, and applicable containerized workloads, including controlled software delivery in air-gapped environments.

- Work directly with ISSMs, ISSOs, and Cybersecurity teams through JSIG or comparable authorization processes, including applicable RMF/DAAPM requirements; implement technical controls, document changes, support assessments, and maintain security evidence and approved baselines.

- Establish engineering and operational standards for change control, configuration management, monitoring, logging, backup and recovery, architectural documentation, and incident response to improve supportability and mission resilience.

- Partner with Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Program Management to deliver secure platform integrations, plan infrastructure migrations, remediate inherited deficiencies, and shape the modernization roadmap while minimizing mission disruption.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI), including any required program-specific access approvals.

- Must possess or obtain and maintain a DoD 8140 compliant cybersecurity workforce qualification appropriate to the assigned role, including DOD 8570 IAT Level II equivalent certification requirements where applicable (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE or an approved equivalent.)

- Hands-on experience engineering or sustaining classified, air-gapped, disconnected, or similarly restricted government information systems.

- Experience working within JSIG or comparable classified system authorization processes, coordinating technical implementation and evidence with ISSMs/ISSOs; familiarity with applicable RMF and DAAPM requirements.

- Strong systems engineering and administration skills across Windows and Linux, enterprise virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure services.

- Hands-on experience engineering government cloud or hybrid infrastructure, including DoD IL5+ environments or appropriately authorized classified cloud services, and secure connectivity to on-premises systems.

- Experience modernizing existing infrastructure, diagnosing systemic technical issues, and delivering remediation with appropriate change control.

- Experience with system hardening, DISA STIG implementation, vulnerability remediation, patch management, configuration baselines, and security control validation.

- Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management, including Terraform and Ansible, version-controlled IaC artifacts, and scripting with PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools.

- Solid networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, segmentation, and secure access.

- Understanding of identity and access management, authentication, authorization, and least-privilege principles.

- Ability to troubleshoot cross-domain infrastructure issues, document technical decisions, and collaborate with cybersecurity and engineering stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) and collateral classified environments, including working with ISSMs/ISSOs and government security stakeholders.

- Experience with AWS GovCloud, DoD IL5+ environments, appropriately authorized classified cloud services, or other government/private cloud platforms.

jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

 - Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

 - Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

 - Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

 - Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

 - Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

 - Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 (or similar) standards, paired with a friendly, end-user-focused attitude.

 - Prior experience in a high-growth or startup environment.

BONUS

 - Experience implement corporate security controls / previous security role experience

 - Strong hands-on experience with VPNs, firewalls, and secure network environments, including modern practices such as Zero Trust networking.

 - Experience with OSquery and Santa

 - Terraform or other infrastructure as code experience.

 - Open source contributions (e.g. a tool you built to automate something).

LOCATION

This role is remote but if you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, Warsaw, New York or San Francisco.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description:
GovCIO is seeking an experienced Virtual Desktop Engineer to engineer, administer, and optimize virtual desktop infrastructure (VDI) supporting the 616th Operations Center (616 OC) and 616th Air and Space Communications Squadron (616 ACOMS). The ideal candidate is expected to independently own assigned VDI engineering and sustainment activities, serve as an escalation resource for complex virtual desktop issues, identify emerging infrastructure problems, and drive solutions through implementation, validation, automation, and documentation. The position delivers reliable, secure virtual desktops and applications and administers Linux systems supporting virtualization and related mission services. This full-time position is located onsite in San Antonio, Texas. Responsibilities Designs, implements, and maintains virtual desktop infrastructure and supports Windows and Linux systems in accordance with mission requirements. Defining system configurations, integration requirements, and performance standards for virtual desktops, applications, and supporting infrastructure. Develops and maintains desktop images, provisioning processes, user environments, and automation to ensure consistent service delivery. Integrates virtualization platforms with network, storage, authentication, and security services. Implement system hardening, patching, monitoring, and recovery procedures to maintain security and availability. Resolves complex technical issues, maintains system documentation, and evaluates performance with customers to ensure operational requirements are met. * Engineer, deploy, configure, and sustain Omnissa Horizon (formerly VMware Horizon) and its supporting VMware vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, and vSAN infrastructure; evaluate capacity, availability, and performance against mission requirements.
* Create and maintain Windows and Linux golden images and instant-clone desktop pools, including image versioning, snapshot management, Horizon Agent configuration, image publishing and push operations, provisioning configurations, application delivery, and user environment settings; test and validate changes before production deployment.
* Administer Horizon Connection Servers, desktop assignments, user access policies, Omnissa Dynamic Environment Manager (DEM), profile and environment management, and application virtualization capabilities, including App Volumes and ThinApp where deployed.
* Troubleshoot instant-clone and desktop provisioning failures, logon delays, profile issues, application delivery, and session connectivity; diagnose dependencies involving compute, storage, networking, authentication, Horizon Agent, and display protocols.
* Monitor resource utilization and user experience; tune desktop and infrastructure configurations, plan capacity, and implement corrective actions to reduce service interruptions.
* Apply patches, upgrades, Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and Technical Compliance Notification Orders (TCNOs); remediate vulnerabilities and document compliance results.
* Automate provisioning, image maintenance, health checks, and recurring administration through PowerShell, PowerCLI, or other appropriate scripting tools.
* Maintain architecture diagrams, configuration baselines, operating procedures, and recovery instructions; coordinate approved changes, backup and restore validation, and technical support with network, storage, cybersecurity, and service desk personnel.
* Install, configure, patch, and harden Linux servers and desktops, including Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) and other supported distributions, with emphasis on systems supporting VDI and virtualization services.
* Administer Linux accounts, permissions, services, storage, repositories, logging, and host firewalls; troubleshoot operating system and application dependencies using command-line tools.
* Support Red Hat Satellite patching, content and repository management, and subscription administration where deployed; use Ansible, Bash, or Python to automate routine maintenance.
* Monitor Linux system health, support backups and recovery, implement security controls, and maintain configuration and troubleshooting documentation. Qualifications High school diploma with 10 or more years of relevant experience, or commensurate experience. Demonstrated engineering and operational experience with enterprise virtual desktop environments and practical Linux administration capability are required. Required Skills and Experience * Clearance Required: Top Secret clearance with Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI) access eligibility.
* Information Assurance Technical (IAT) Level II certification, such as CompTIA Security+ or equivalent; satisfy applicable contract and assigned work-role qualification requirements.
* At least 10 years of relevant enterprise IT infrastructure, virtualization, systems engineering, or VDI experience, including substantial hands-on experience engineering and administering Omnissa Horizon enterprise VDI environments.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with vSphere, vCenter, ESXi, Horizon Connection Servers, Windows and Linux master images, and instant-clone desktop pools, including image versioning, snapshot management, Horizon Agent integration, image publishing and push operations, provisioning failures, clone lifecycle troubleshooting, application virtualization, and user profile or environment management.
* Working knowledge of Active Directory, Domain Name System (DNS), Network Time Protocol (NTP), TCP/IP, virtual local area networks (VLANs), routing, storage dependencies, and PCoIP and Blast display protocols.
* Ability to administer enterprise Linux systems, perform command-line troubleshooting, apply patches, manage repositories and services, and implement system hardening.
* Experience applying STIGs, managing TCNO compliance, remediating vulnerabilities, and maintaining secure configurations in a controlled production environment.
* Demonstrated PowerShell scripting experience for VDI or Windows infrastructure administration, including the ability to develop, modify, troubleshoot, and maintain production administrative scripts; ability to maintain accurate technical documentation, communicate clearly, independently prioritize mission support requirements, and serve as an escalation resource for complex VDI issues.
Preferred Skills and Experience * Experience supporting Department of Defense networks and mission systems, including infrastructure upgrades, migrations, backup and restore operations, and recovery testing.
* Five or more years of hands-on Horizon engineering or administration experience in enterprise environments; advanced PowerShell and VMware PowerCLI experience automating image lifecycle management, provisioning, health checks, reporting, capacity analysis, or bulk administration; Ansible, Bash, or Python experience; Red Hat Satellite provisioning, content management, and Hammer command-line interface experience.
* Experience creating and sustaining RHEL-based Omnissa Horizon instant-clone pools, including master image preparation, Horizon Agent configuration, Active Directory or SSSD integration, image publishing, and authentication or session troubleshooting; experience with Citrix or comparable virtual desktop platforms, storage area networks, and performance monitoring.
* Working knowledge of the Elastic Stack, including Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana, and Beats, for Linux-hosted service support.
* VMware Certified Professional credentials in desktop virtualization or data center virtualization; Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) or Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE); relevant Microsoft certifications.
* Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field. #NSS #DL #TLM Posted Salary Range USD $140,000.00 - USD $165,000.00 /Yr.

Overview

Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most.
HYBRID: Hybrid Work Arrangement: A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in-office time each month, beginning in late 2027.
HUB LOCATIONS: Bloomington, IL
SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H-1B visa) for this opportunity.

Responsibilities

The Infrastructure, Workplace, and Technology Services (IWTS) Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) Engineering team works across a large breadth of technologies allowing a unique learning opportunity amongst the team. IWTS Engineering teams have the freedom to focus on hands-on prototyping, research efforts, and Proof of Concepts (POCs) without day-to-day support obligations. IWTS Engineering teams are responsible for collaborating with ET product teams to understand and evaluate technical requirements that may result in infrastructure offering modifications. IWTS Engineering teams will work closely with the IWTS Service Delivery teams and a Managed Service Provider (MSP) to evaluate and validate proposed technical solutions and changes. IWTS Engineering teams will work closely with IWTS Area Level Architecture to identify areas of improvement, changes to architectural standards, and future state capability strategies. Additionally, IWTS Engineering teams work with the Project Support Office (PSO) as technical resources in validation of project estimates and requirements or as technical resources on defined projects.
The ideal candidate combines deep Windows Server expertise with a broad understanding of enterprise infrastructure and has demonstrated the ability to lead complex technical modernization initiatives, influence engineering direction, and collaborate across technology disciplines.
 As a member of the IWTS IaaS Engineering team, you will be challenged and empowered to grow professionally. We appreciate your interest in this role.

jobs.summary: Key Responsibilities Cloud Architecture & Engineering: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and operational management of scalable, resilient, and highly available AWS cloud infrastructure, with secondary support for Azure environments. Automation...
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

Cloud Architecture & Engineering: Lead the end-to-end design, implementation, and operational management of scalable, resilient, and highly available AWS cloud infrastructure, with secondary support for Azure environments.

Automation & IaC: Drive Infrastructure as Code (IaC) adoption using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation to automate cloud provisioning, configuration management, patching, and deployments.

Migration & Modernization: Architect and execute enterprise cloud migration, application modernization, and continuous platform optimization strategies.

Platform & Reusability: Design and maintain standardized, reusable cloud platform templates and enterprise landing zones to accelerate secure team onboarding.

Operations & Governance: Establish enterprise cloud security standards, IAM best practices, compliance controls, governance policies, and operational workflows.

Disaster Recovery & Continuity: Design and implement comprehensive backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions across cloud workloads.

Troubleshooting & RCA: Resolve complex cloud networking, infrastructure, and application integration issues; perform root-cause analysis with a high sense of urgency and ownership.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration: Mentor junior cloud engineers, provide technical guidance across projects, and partner closely with DevOps, Security, Networking, and Application teams.

Qualifications

Overall IT Experience: 7+ years of broad IT background spanning systems architecture, infrastructure management, operating systems, databases, enterprise applications, and hybrid networking.

Hands-on Cloud Experience: 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing enterprise cloud infrastructure and applications.

AWS Expertise: Deep knowledge of core AWS services, including EC2, VPC, Route 53, ALB/NLB, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, SSM, RDS, Lambda, and container services (ECS/EKS).

Multi-Cloud Familiarity: Practical working knowledge of Azure services, including Virtual Machines, VNETs, Azure Storage, IAM, and Azure Backup.

Scripting & CI/CD: Strong automation capabilities using PowerShell, Python, or Bash, along with experience managing Git-based source control and CI/CD pipelines.

Networking & Security: Solid understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, VPNs, firewalls, hybrid cloud connectivity, secrets management, and cloud security compliance controls.

Containers & Orchestration: Hands-on experience with containerization technologies and platforms, including Docker and Kubernetes.

Soft Skills: Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills, a self-motivated drive to work independently or in an integrated team environment, and strong problem-solving skills under tight SLAs.

Comp TIA Network+ and A+ certifications are a plus

Microsoft certifications are a plus

Knowledge of advanced computer hardware, including desktops, laptops, smartphones, and end user facing network configurations

Extensive experience with VDI, Active Directory, O365, Windows OS and File shares

Familiar with Windows server OS 2012 and above

Proficient in basic network and security fundamentals

Exceptional written and oral communication skills

Exceptional interpersonal skills, with a focus on rapport-building, listening and questioning skills

Strong documentation skills and a willingness to assist with documentation

Self-Starter with ability to work as part of a team and individually as required by specific project needs

Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize

Possess the traits of having patience, being thorough and innovative

Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

Ability to conduct research into a wide range of computing issues is required

Ability to absorb and retain information quickly

Ability to present ideas in user-friendly, business-friendly, and technical language

Highly self-motivated and directed

Attention to detail

Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment

Exceptional customer service orientation

Must be able to physically to handle and set up technology equipment. Can require lifting to 50lbs.

Job Title

Senior Endpoint Administrator Supervisor

Pay Rate Min to Mid Range

$90,528.00 - $113,160.00

Time Type

Full time

Summary

Under general supervision, is responsible for supporting Bexar County Information Technology team; will support the mission of the County, ensuring successful delivery of IT services as defined in the duties and responsibilities. This position will represent the County in a professional and effective manner and establish and maintain effective working relationships with co-workers, County employees, Elected/Appointed Officials, outside organizations and agencies, vendors and the general public. Flexibility to achieve performance excellence in a telework arrangement.

The Senior Endpoint Administrator (Supervisor) is responsible for maintaining Microsoft Windows Operating Systems, macOS, and Mobile Device Management; including operating system deployment, application packaging and deployment, software updates and patching, policy building, and desktop automation. This role maintains the quality, security, consistency, and availability of all endpoint hardware, software, and services.

Description

Duties and Responsibilities:

Supervise, coach, mentor, and train other professionals on the Configuration Management team.

Lead upgrades, maintenance, and configuration of endpoint management suite to include System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), Apple Business Manager, AutoPilot, and Intune

Install, configure, test, and maintain operating systems, desktop/mobile application software, and system management tools

Research new technology in response to enterprise-scale business requirements, systems configurations, or technology innovations

Develop and maintain relevant documentation for new enterprise-scale technologies

Lead and test system performance for potential bottlenecks and collaborate to drive solutions and implement changes

Monitor and administer the operations of systems and services supporting computing endpoints, including endpoint management, configuration, and security tools

Communicate frequently with management on the performance status of services, projects, and operations.

Manage and support projects supporting endpoint technologies

Ensure deployments maintain software compatibility and ensure deployed images and software do not reach end-of-life

Perform development of scripting, application packaging, and provisioning and deployment of applications and services related to endpoint computing management

Ensure audit and compliance successful outcomes by identifying problems and implementing solutions

Track endpoint usages and assess statistics by producing reports to provide data enabling efficient deployment and utilization of computer resources

Manage support queues and ensure responses are professional, consistent, timely and accurate

Research and recommend new tools and applications for internal use and customer support

Prioritize workload in support of business objectives

Perform other related technology duties and projects as assigned

Minimum Qualifications:

Graduation from an accredited college or university with a relevant degree, 5+ years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Demonstrated knowledge, design experience, administration experience, and use of Microsoft SCCM / Enterprise Configuration Management (ECM), Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Autopilot, Apple Business Manager, and application deployment packaging methodologies and endpoint computing management software tools

Demonstrated knowledge of industry-standard endpoint computing management and technology support organization best practices, help desk and customer service

Ability to manage time effectively and work with minimum supervision

Ability to work with a team in a structured environment, adhering to standardized work practices

Ability to stay abreast of new and emerging technology solutions by participating in technical training and technology briefings / webinars, including self-paced and other staff development activities

Proficient in Windows Desktop Operating Systems and macOS desktop installation and administration

Understanding of Active Directory, Azure Active Directory, and basic networking (TCP/IP, switching, routing)

Strong knowledge of PowerShell scripting language

Excellent verbal and written communication

Ability to handle diverse situations, multiple tasks, and rapidly changing priorities

Ability to recognize basic procedural issues and escalate when appropriate

Highly proficient using Microsoft Office

Must secure and maintain a favorable background investigation and clearance

Must clear a pre-employment physical and a pre-employment drug screen test

Required to be on call 24 hours

May be required to work more than 40 hours during the workweek

May be required to work weekends

This position may need to satisfy the requirement of completing and passing an assessment during the employment process

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with ServiceNow IT Service Management

ITIL certification
