jobs.description:
The Bloomberg Enterprise Application Systems team within the Bloomberg Engineering Department is responsible for the administration, engineering and technical operation of enterprise applications supporting Bloomberg’s internal business functions.

     Our team manages primarily third-party enterprise applications running across both on-premise and cloud environments. These systems support a broad range of Bloomberg business functions, including Accounting, Supply Chain, Workplace Operations and others. We are responsible for the administration, reliability, security and resilience of these platforms, as well as their integration with other Bloomberg systems and external services.

     We work closely with application development, database, Linux, Windows, networking, security and other infrastructure teams to provide secure, highly available and well-engineered enterprise application services.

     The Role

     As a Systems Engineer on the Enterprise Application Systems team, you will take technical ownership of enterprise application platforms throughout their lifecycle.

     A key responsibility of this role is the administration of Bloomberg’s PeopleSoft environment, which supports North American Payroll. We are looking for someone with strong PeopleSoft systems administration expertise who can independently operate and evolve the platform.

     You will own the administration of the PeopleSoft environment, including installation and configuration, upgrades, patching, environment management, monitoring, troubleshooting, security, integrations and production support.

     Reliability and resilience are fundamental parts of the role. You will help design, implement and maintain highly available systems, including redundancy, backup and recovery, disaster recovery capabilities and operational procedures. You will work to identify potential points of failure, improve system recoverability and ensure that critical applications can continue operating through infrastructure and application failures.

     Security is also an important part of owning these platforms. You will monitor vendor and internal security advisories, assess vulnerabilities affecting the software you support and ensure that required patches, upgrades or other remediations are implemented promptly. You will also be responsible for application security components including authentication and access controls, certificates and secrets, network connectivity and secure integration with other systems.

     PeopleSoft will be an important part of the role, but it will represent approximately half of your overall responsibilities. You will cross-train with other members of the team and take ownership of additional third-party enterprise applications, both on-premise and in the cloud, supporting business areas across Bloomberg.

     As the application portfolio evolves, you will be expected to develop expertise in new platforms and apply the same disciplines around administration, security, integration, automation, monitoring, resilience and lifecycle management across the systems you own.

     You will need to have:

      Strong hands-on experience administering PeopleSoft and PeopleTools environments

      * Experience administering core PeopleSoft infrastructure including WebLogic, Tuxedo, Application Server, Process Scheduler and Integration Broker

      * Experience independently managing enterprise application platforms, including installation, configuration, upgrades, patching, monitoring and production support

      * Experience identifying and remediating software vulnerabilities, including evaluating vendor security advisories and applying patches or other mitigations in a timely manner

      * Experience designing and operating highly available and resilient application environments

      * Understanding of redundancy, backup and recovery, disaster recovery and business continuity concepts

      * Strong troubleshooting skills across application, operating system, database, network and integration layers

      * Working knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems, relational databases, networking and application infrastructure

      * Experience supporting application integrations using technologies such as REST APIs, SFTP, S3 and other file-based interfaces

      * Understanding of enterprise application security, including authentication, certificates, secrets and secure connectivity

      * Experience developing scripts or automation for application administration, monitoring, maintenance and operational activities

      * The ability and interest to learn new technologies and take ownership of systems beyond PeopleSoft

      * Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively across application, infrastructure and security teams
     We would love to see:

      Experience with PeopleSoft lifecycle and change-management tools such as PUM, Change Assistant and Phire

      * Experience administering multiple third-party enterprise application platforms

      * Experience supporting applications across both on-premise and cloud environments

      * Experience with public cloud or SaaS enterprise application platforms

      * Experience with Python, PowerShell, shell scripting or other automation technologies

      * Experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, secrets management or identity and access management technologies

      * Experience designing or testing disaster recovery and high-availability architectures

      * Experience working with software vendors on upgrades, security issues, technical support and product lifecycle management

     Salary Range = 155,000 - 175,000 USD Annual + Benefits + Bonus

      The referenced salary range is based on the Company's good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level.

        We offer one of the most comprehensive and generous benefits plans available and offer a range of total rewards that may include merit increases, incentive compensation (exempt roles only), paid holidays, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability benefits, 401(k) +match, life insurance, and various wellness programs, among others. The Company does not provide benefits directly to contingent workers/contractors and interns.

Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. To request an adjustment/accommodation to apply for a job, please email AMER_recruit@bloomberg.net (Americas), EMEA_recruit@bloomberg.net (Europe, the Middle East and Africa), or APAC_recruit@bloomberg.net (Asia-Pacific), based on the region you are submitting an application for. jobs.description:
Classification Title:

End User Computing Spec III

Classification Minimum Requirements:

Associate's degree and four years of appropriate experience; or a high school diploma or equivalent and 6 years of relevant experience. Appropriate college course work or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate of required experience.

Job Description:

**Nature of Work and Responsibility:**

The End User Support Specialist III is a hands-on technical support and systems-support position operating under the direct supervision of the IT Manager. The position does not supervise employees and does not have formal management responsibilities.

The position requires strong working knowledge of SCCM/Intune, JAMF, Active Directory, Microsoft Exchange and identity/access management, together with broad technical knowledge across end-user computing, endpoint management, hardware and software troubleshooting, networking, security, and enterprise technology services.

The employee is expected to independently resolve routine and moderately complex technical problems and provide a higher level of technical support for identity, access, endpoint, and user-computing issues. Unusual, highly complex, security-sensitive, or enterprise-level matters are coordinated with the IT Manager, other College IT personnel, or UFIT.

Success in this position requires strong customer service, technical problem-solving, adaptability, communication, documentation, and collaboration.

**Technology Automation and Deployment**

- Team Lead for endpoint management services, including operating system deployment, imaging, upgrades and migrations, software packaging and distribution, patch and update management, device provisioning and configuration, and endpoint security.
- Responsible for ensuring the reliable deployment, maintenance, security, and lifecycle management of College-managed computing devices while supporting a consistent and compliant user computing environment.
- Assists with development and maintenance of scripts, workflows, automation tools, and other processes that improve Active Directory administration, account management, endpoint management, software deployment, and IT support.
- Manages print infrastructure, including print servers, printer deployment, driver management, and print queue administration.
- Supports replacement, inventory, and retirement of College technology according to established University and College standards.
- Maintains expertise in workstation automation technologies by staying current with emerging industry trends, management platforms, hardware innovations, and software solutions. Evaluates new technologies and best practices to improve device deployment, management, security, and operational efficiency.

**Active Directory, Identity, Endpoint, and Security Support**

- Administers and supports the College’s Active Directory environment, including user and computer account management, organizational units, security groups, Group Policy, authentication services, permissions, and access controls. Ensures secure, reliable, and efficient access to College technology resources in accordance with University and College standards and best practices.
- Administers and supports user provisioning and access management for Active Directory-integrated services, including file services and shared mailboxes. Supports access administration for Exchange mailboxes and groups, Listservs, Lenel access controls, and other College resources. Ensures appropriate access is granted, modified, and removed in accordance with established security standards and business requirements.
- Troubleshoots authentication, authorization, permissions, Group Policy, directory synchronization, and other identity-related issues affecting College users and devices.

**Technical Support and Customer Service**

- Provides responsive technical support to College faculty, staff, researchers, students, and other stakeholders for computer hardware, software, operating systems, applications, peripherals, multimedia technologies, and University technology services.
- Troubleshoots and resolves hardware, software, configuration, authentication, connectivity, permissions, and other end-user technology issues. Identifies recurring problems and works with the IT Manager and other technical personnel to implement appropriate corrective or preventative solutions.
- Assists users with account access, authentication, permissions, software access, equipment configuration, and the effective use of College and University technology resources.
- Supports and administers College technology systems as assigned, including facility access technologies such as Lenel Access Control.
- Maintains accurate support records, technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge resources to support consistent and effective service delivery.

**Project Support, Documentation, and Collaboration**

- Supports IT projects and initiatives under the direction of the IT Manager, including technology requirements, implementation schedules, equipment deployment, testing, documentation, training, and communication.
- Develops and maintains technical documentation, procedures, work plans, training resources, status reports, and other materials associated with IT services and projects.
- Communicates project and service updates to the IT Manager and appropriate stakeholders and identifies issues requiring additional technical expertise, resources, or escalation.

Expected Salary:

$61,000 - $66,000

Required Qualifications:

Associate's degree and four years of appropriate experience; or a high school diploma or equivalent and 6 years of relevant experience. Appropriate college course work or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate of required experience.

Preferred:

- Deep Familiarity with endpoint-management technologies including Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Jamf, and Group Policy.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory, including user and computer objects, security groups, permissions, organizational structures, and Group Policy.
- Knowledge of identity and access management practices, including account provisioning, modification, offboarding, authentication, authorization, and access controls.
- Ability to assist with scripting, automation, and other tools that improve identity management, systems administration, endpoint management, and IT support.
- Knowledge of troubleshooting techniques for hardware, software, operating systems, applications, authentication, permissions, and network connectivity.
- Familiarity with Exchange-related services, file and print servers, listserv, Lenel access control, and other enterprise collaboration services.
- Familiarity with information-security practices, endpoint protection, encryption, software updates, access controls, backup, and recovery.
- Working knowledge of Windows and macOS environments, computer hardware, software, peripherals, and common enterprise technologies.
- Ability to support technology purchasing, equipment evaluation, technical specifications, and RFQ development.
- Ability to understand customer technology needs and assist in identifying and implementing appropriate solutions.
- Ability to manage multiple support needs and shift effectively among technical tasks and priorities.
- Strong customer-service and interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate technical information clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
- Ability to collaborate effectively with the IT Manager, College IT personnel, faculty, staff, researchers, ETC, vendors, and University partners.
- Ability to maintain accurate technical documentation and recognize issues requiring escalation.

Special Instructions to Applicants:

In order to be considered, you must upload your cover letter and resume.

Application must be submitted by 11:55 p.m. (ET) of the posting end date.

This is a time-limited position.

Health Assessment Required:No

### Job Posting Title:

Desktop Engineering System Administrator 1

### Position Type:

Professional / Unclassified

### Department:

LSUAM FA - ITS - SO - UECM - Desktop Engineering (Leland Powers Redmond (00010378))

### Work Location:

0202 Fred C. Frey Computing Services Building

### Pay Grade:

Professional

### Job Description:

The Desktop Engineering System Administrator 1, with a team, assists to help support and maintain the Enterprise Mobile Device Management (MDM) environment for the LSU A&M campus. Responsibilities include managing existing application deployments, thin imaging, department on boarding and driver support for both on-premises and cloud based endpoints.

The position also assists with the operation, configuration, and maintenance of departmental servers, including Active Directory, Group Policy, certificate management, as well as file and print services. An intermediate understanding of Windows Server 2019 and higher is required.

Experience with VMware 8.x, Hyper-V, Veeam, and PowerShell without the assistance of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is preferred.

**Job Responsibilities:**

Utilize Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) to design, build, and maintain custom operating system images for deployment via PXE boot. Collaborate with campus departments to ensure images meet the needs of lab, department, and base system configurations across the university.

Develop and manage application deployments that support LSU academic departments, faculty, and staff, including software used in campus computer labs. (20%)

Responsible for the deployment, configuration, and management of Microsoft Intune and related Mobile Device Management (MDM) technologies such as Apple School Manager. Ensures secure, compliant, and efficient management of enterprise endpoints across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android platforms.

Routinely collaborates with ITS Security, Network and Server Infrastructure, and Desktop Support teams to implement and maintain endpoint standards, enforce security policies, and support overall IT operations to allow for end user productivity. (20%)

Collaborate with technical assets to support the student Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) environment using Windows 365, ensuring 24/7 operational availability. Additionally, this would also include the management of VDI pools, imaging, application deployment, and licensing. (15%)

Responsible for the ongoing management of enterprise print services and related infrastructure with respect to student printing (Pharos). Ensures reliable, secure, and efficient printing operations across the organization through the maintenance of print servers, queues, drivers, and print management solutions. Assisting with the Print Desk and Copier Management when needed. (10%)

Perform routine system maintenance, including but not limited to patching, health checks, operating system and third-party software updates, change management, validation, and enforcement of operational and configuration standards within the LSU A&M environment.

Assist in the maintenance and administration of the enterprise wide infrastructure, and escalate system anomalies to senior staff for analysis and resolution. Collaborate with the ITS Security team to deploy, manage, and maintain enterprise software and tools that support IT risk mitigation strategies. (10%)

Collaborate with staff and management to develop training materials, customer documentation, and deployment management standards. Create and maintain support articles and process documentation. (10%)

Provide Tier 3 support to desktop support analysts, ensuring consistent adoption and compliance with UECM standards across all departments. (10%)

Other duties as assigned. (5%)

**Minimum Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree with 1 year of experience. The ideal candidate will have at least one year of hands on experience with Microsoft System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM) and/or Intune in an enterprise environment. Else, at least three years of an understanding of Windows 11, Windows Server 2019 or higher. Self driven and able to present ideas for optimization to management.optimization to management.

_+LSU values skills, experience, and expertise. Candidates who have relevant experience in key job responsibilities are encouraged to apply -- a degree is not required as long as the candidate meets the required years of experience specified in the job description._

**Preferred Qualifications:**

Bachelor's degree with 3 years of experience. In addition to the minimum qualifications, candidates should have at least three years of experience with SCCM, Intune, including configuration policies, deployments and provisioning. Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server and SQL Server report creation is highly desired. Understanding of PowerShell scripting and automation concepts, as well as working knowledge of Azure Active Directory, Group Policy, and basic networking fundamentals.

Experience supporting macOS, iOS, and Android devices along with knowledge of Windows 365, Hyper-V and Linux (Debian and Red Hat Enterprise) operating systems.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

**Job Description** We are looking for a**Specialist IT Endpoint Management** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Key Responsibilities** **Endpoint Architecture \& Strategy**

* Develop and design a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures, standards, and governance models.
* Ensure that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements are embedded into endpoint architectures and operational processes.
* Evaluate, design, and implement new endpoint technologies and solutions to continuously improve the digital workplace experience.
* Lead endpoint management projects from planning and design through implementation and operational transition.

**Endpoint Operations \& Management**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management services.
* Configure, test, and optimize device policies, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and endpoint security controls.
* Monitor endpoint compliance, coordinate remediation activities, and support device lifecycle management processes.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning, and deployment activities for end users.

**Software Deployment \& Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee software packaging, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management activities for business applications and endpoint platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application deployment and device management issues.
* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments, testing initiatives, automation efforts, and continuous service improvement programs.

**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Manage external service providers and coordinate interfaces between IT Security, Infrastructure, Workplace Services, and Operations teams.
* Act as a technical advisor and escalation point for endpoint-related topics across the organization.
* Support knowledge sharing and technical enablement within the Endpoint Management team.

**Documentation \& Governance**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture standards, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Document recurring issues, standard solutions, and architectural decisions.
* Ensure endpoint management processes and documentation align with security and compliance requirements.

**Qualifications**

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* A high level of English is required (C1)

**Additional Information**

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

We are looking for a Manager, Client Platform Engineering to own MongoDB's endpoint platform worldwide. You'll lead a globally distributed team responsible for macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints, mobile device and application management, zero-touch provisioning, on-time operating system and patch delivery, and the endpoint telemetry that tells us how the fleet is performing for the people using it. You'll partner with InfoSec to harden the endpoint estate, and build and grow a team of passionate, curious experts in this space. This role combines deep hands-on end user computing expertise with the people leadership and judgment to set technical direction and communicate risk and strategy to stakeholders.

#### What You'll Do

- Own the worldwide endpoint architecture and roadmap for macOS, Windows, Linux, and mobile, including management platform strategy, configuration-as-code, application packaging and self-service, and zero-touch provisioning
- Lead the release calendar and deployment ring strategy for every endpoint operating system, delivering major and minor updates on time to a published compliance target, with tested rollback and a clear exception path
- Administer and evolve MongoDB's endpoint management stack across MDM and UEM platforms, including declarative device management (DDM) on macOS and Windows Autopilot and Autopatch on Windows 11
- Own mobile strategy end to end for corporate-owned and BYOD devices across iOS and Android, balancing data protection against an enrollment experience employees will accept MDM where enrollment is appropriate, MAM and app protection policies where it is not
- Build and operate MongoDB's Endpoint Digital Employee Experience program: instrument the fleet, define the DEX metrics and SLOs we hold ourselves to, and drive proactive remediation that resolves issues before employees notice them
- Partner with InfoSec to implement and continuously improve endpoint security controls, including hardening baselines, patch and vulnerability remediation SLAs, disk encryption and key escrow coverage, device trust, and Conditional Access
- Serve as a senior technical escalation point (L3) for complex endpoint issues across the organization
- Build automation to reduce manual endpoint operations work and improve reliability and observability, holding the team to configuration-as-code, peer review, and staged rollout
- Act as a technical advisor for MongoDB's relationships with endpoint management, DEX, and hardware vendors, and own the endpoint tooling and licensing budget
- Hire, coach, and retain a globally distributed team of EUC engineers, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and self-service

#### Responsibilities

- Ensure MongoDB's global endpoint fleet remains reliable, secure, compliant, and scalable across every platform and region as the company grows
- Deliver operating system rollouts on time, every cycle, across macOS, Windows, and Linux endpoints
- Reduce risk and technical debt across endpoint management, patching, and device lifecycle
- Build and maintain a high-performing international team, and develop engineers into recognized experts in this space
- Communicate endpoint strategy, risk, and incidents clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Uphold strong engineering practices across endpoint documentation, automation, and change management
- Balance long-term platform architecture work with day-to-day operational support
- Define, publish, and manage the team against the metrics for the service

#### Minimum Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience
- 8+ years of experience in end user computing, client platform engineering, or endpoint and modern workplace engineering, including 3+ years hiring and leading engineers
- Proven experience owning a fleet of several thousand endpoints across multiple countries and time zones
- Hands-on depth across all three desktop platforms, not oversight of them: macOS managed through a modern MDM (Jamf Pro, Iru/formerly Kandji, Microsoft Intune, or Omnissa Workspace ONE) with Apple Business (formerly Apple Business Manager) and Automated Device Enrollment; Windows 11 managed through Intune, Windows Autopilot, and Windows Autopatch; Linux endpoints managed as code with Ansible, Fleet, or equivalent
- A current understanding of Apple's declarative device management (DDM) model and what its adoption means for software update enforcement, Platform SSO, and configuration and app delivery
- Experience with both mobile management models: MDM for corporate-owned devices and MAM/app protection for BYOD, including Intune App Protection Policies, Android Enterprise work profile, and Apple User Enrollment with Managed Apple Accounts
- A demonstrated record of delivering major OS rollouts on schedule, with a defined ring strategy, compatibility gating, communications plan, exception process, and rollback path
- Experience instrumenting endpoints with a DEX or telemetry platform such as Nexthink, Lakeside SysTrack, ControlUp, 1E, Aternity, Intune Advanced Analytics, or osquery/Fleet, defining a score or SLO from it, and using it to resolve issues proactively
- Scripting skills for endpoint automation using infrastructure as code, with fluency in at least one of Bash, Python, Swift, or PowerShell and comfort with Git-based workflows
- Experience partnering with InfoSec, Identity, IT Service Delivery, and Workplace teams on cross-functional endpoint initiatives
- Experience leading engineers across multiple regions, with a clear approach to coverage, escalation, documentation, and asynchronous decision-making
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to a wide range of audiences
- Experience with endpoint documentation and reporting such as fleet compliance dashboards, configuration baselines, and operational runbooks
- There will be requirements from time to time to work across multiple time zones as required by the business, including travel

#### Preferred Qualifications

- Jamf Certified Expert, Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, or equivalent endpoint management certification
- Visible standing in the endpoint community — MacAdmins Slack, Jamf Nation, Midwest Management Summit, Penn State MacAdmins — or open-source contributions to projects such as Munki, Installomator, Nudge, swift
Dialog, or osquery
- Experience supporting a heavily technical employee population, including software engineers with elevated-privilege, virtualization, and local developer and AI tooling needs
- Experience with cloud identity and device trust platforms such as Okta and Microsoft Entra ID, and with Conditional Access policy design
- Familiarity with ITSM practice, service ownership, and Experience Level Agreements (XLAs) alongside traditional SLAs
- Experience owning endpoint tooling budget, vendor relationships, and licensing at scale
- Experience mentoring other endpoint or systems engineers

#### Success Measures

- In 3 months, you will: Be fully onboarded with a thorough understanding of MongoDB's endpoint estate and policies, have met your team and key partners in every region, and have delivered a written assessment of the worldwide fleet — platform coverage, compliance posture, tooling, gaps, and top risks — with a prioritized plan and any approved roles actively in flight
- In 6 months, you will: Have your team at or above 90% of the approved hiring plan, have published the EUC service metrics and SLOs (OS and patch compliance, zero-touch provisioning rate, mean time to provision, DEX score, self-service resolution rate), have shipped at least one major OS release on schedule under a defined ring strategy, and have closed the highest-priority gaps identified in your assessment
- In 12 months, you will: Be recognized as the senior owner of MongoDB's global endpoint platform, operating a fully staffed, high-performing international team; consistently meeting your published OS and patch compliance targets across macOS, Windows, and Linux; running a measurable proactive remediation program with a demonstrated reduction in endpoint tickets per employee; and owning a twelve-month endpoint roadmap that InfoSec, IT, and Engineering leadership have endorsed

#### Location & Travel:

- This role is based in Palo Alto / San Francisco, CA, and candidates should be located within reasonable commuting distance of our Palo Alto and San Francisco offices
- The team operates with a flexible work arrangement, with in-person collaboration typically occurring 1–2 times per week
- This role involves travel and regular work across time zones to lead a globally distributed team and to support global office and regional IT initiatives

#### About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our [Leadership Commitment,](https://www.mongodb.com/company) guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. [From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy](https://www.mongodb.com/company/blog/culture/employee-benefits-that-make-a-difference-at-mongodb), we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. [Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB](https://www.mongodb.com/blog/channel/culture), and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

jobs.title: Classified Cloud & Platform Engineer
jobs.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the...
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Cloud & Platform Engineer to design, modernize, secure, and sustain systems and infrastructure supporting classified computing environments. This systems engineering focused role spans government cloud environments, including DoD Impact Level 5 (IL5) and higher where appropriately authorized, classified cloud platforms, and on-premises classified systems. The engineer will develop secure hybrid connectivity, strengthen infrastructure automation, and support mission-critical operations in air-gapped, disconnected, and restricted-connectivity environments.

As a foundational member of the Cloud Networks team, you will assess inherited infrastructure, remediate architectural and operational deficiencies, and establish repeatable engineering and sustainment practices. You will partner with ISSMs, ISSOs, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, and Software Engineering to modernize systems while preserving mission availability and meeting applicable authorization requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Assess, design, modernize, and sustain classified cloud, hybrid, and on-premises infrastructure; identify architectural deficiencies, technical debt, security gaps, and opportunities to improve reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency.

- Engineer government cloud infrastructure, including DoD IL5+ environments and appropriately authorized classified cloud platforms; implement secure connectivity, network segmentation, and integration with on-premises systems while respecting classification boundaries.

- Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC), automation, and configuration management using Terraform, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools; maintain version-controlled infrastructure artifacts, standardized deployments, and repeatable operational workflows suitable for restricted environments.

- Design, deploy, and sustain Windows and Linux systems, virtualization, virtual desktop infrastructure, remote access services, and supporting platform components; integrate automation and internal tooling for provisioning, access management, and support.

- Establish hardened system images, configuration baselines, patching and vulnerability remediation processes, and compliance validation for endpoints, servers, and applicable containerized workloads, including controlled software delivery in air-gapped environments.

- Work directly with ISSMs, ISSOs, and Cybersecurity teams through JSIG or comparable authorization processes, including applicable RMF/DAAPM requirements; implement technical controls, document changes, support assessments, and maintain security evidence and approved baselines.

- Establish engineering and operational standards for change control, configuration management, monitoring, logging, backup and recovery, architectural documentation, and incident response to improve supportability and mission resilience.

- Partner with Network Engineering, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Program Management to deliver secure platform integrations, plan infrastructure migrations, remediate inherited deficiencies, and shape the modernization roadmap while minimizing mission disruption.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. Top Secret clearance with access to Sensitive Compartmented Information (TS/SCI), including any required program-specific access approvals.

- Must possess or obtain and maintain a DoD 8140 compliant cybersecurity workforce qualification appropriate to the assigned role, including DOD 8570 IAT Level II equivalent certification requirements where applicable (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE or an approved equivalent.)

- Hands-on experience engineering or sustaining classified, air-gapped, disconnected, or similarly restricted government information systems.

- Experience working within JSIG or comparable classified system authorization processes, coordinating technical implementation and evidence with ISSMs/ISSOs; familiarity with applicable RMF and DAAPM requirements.

- Strong systems engineering and administration skills across Windows and Linux, enterprise virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure services.

- Hands-on experience engineering government cloud or hybrid infrastructure, including DoD IL5+ environments or appropriately authorized classified cloud services, and secure connectivity to on-premises systems.

- Experience modernizing existing infrastructure, diagnosing systemic technical issues, and delivering remediation with appropriate change control.

- Experience with system hardening, DISA STIG implementation, vulnerability remediation, patch management, configuration baselines, and security control validation.

- Hands-on experience with infrastructure automation and configuration management, including Terraform and Ansible, version-controlled IaC artifacts, and scripting with PowerShell, Python, or comparable tools.

- Solid networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, firewalls, segmentation, and secure access.

- Understanding of identity and access management, authentication, authorization, and least-privilege principles.

- Ability to troubleshoot cross-domain infrastructure issues, document technical decisions, and collaborate with cybersecurity and engineering stakeholders.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience supporting Special Access Program (SAP) and collateral classified environments, including working with ISSMs/ISSOs and government security stakeholders.

- Experience with AWS GovCloud, DoD IL5+ environments, appropriately authorized classified cloud services, or other government/private cloud platforms.

- Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure, remote application delivery, brokers, gateways, or related access services.

- Experience with endpoint/image management and automated compliance enforcement in environments without traditional Active Directory or Group Policy.

- Experience with Kubernetes, containers, CI/CD, artifact management, and controlled deployment processes in restricted environments.

- Experience with infrastructure observability, centralized logging, resiliency, disaster recovery, and capacity planning.

- Experience creating scripts, APIs, or internal platform tools; familiarity with Go, Python, or comparable languages.

- Experience establishing technical standards and operating practices for a new or evolving engineering team.

US Salary Range

 $142,000 - $188,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
Job Description:Company Description:

McDonald’s is proud to be one of the most recognized brands in the world, with restaurants in over 100 countries that serve 70 million customers daily. We continue to operate from a position of strength. Our updated growth strategy is focused on staying ahead of what our customers want and realizing further growth potential. Our relentless ambition is why McDonald’s remains one of the world’s leading corporations after almost 70 years. Joining McDonald's means thinking big and preparing for a career that can have influence around the world.

At McDonald’s, we see every day as a chance to create positive impact. We lead through our values centered on inclusivity, service, integrity, community and family. From support of Ronald McDonald House to our Youth Opportunity project and sustainability initiatives, our values keep us dedicated to using our scale for good: good for our customers, people, industry and planet. We also offer a broad range of outstanding benefits including a sabbatical program, tuition assistance and flexible work arrangements.

jobs.description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

We are seeking an Endpoint Security Engineer to join our team to help secure and manage enterprise endpoint protection technologies across a global environment. This role will serve as a key technical resource responsible for administering and enhancing endpoint security platforms including CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, and BeyondTrust Privileged Access Management (PAM).

The Endpoint Security Engineer is responsible for the design, administration, optimization, and support of enterprise endpoint security platforms. This role partners closely with Cyber Operations, Infrastructure, Desktop Engineering, and Identity teams to protect endpoints, improve detection capabilities, automate security processes, and strengthen the organization's overall security posture.

The ideal candidate combines strong operational security experience with modern engineering and automation skills. They have hands-on experience with EDR, firewall management, device control, API management, and endpoint security operations, along with a solid understanding of incident response and threat detection. Comfortable administering CrowdStrike and Microsoft security platforms, they leverage scripting, API integrations, GitHub-based workflows, and emerging AI-driven security technologies to automate processes, improve operational efficiency, and strengthen security outcomes. Curious, proactive, and innovative, they continuously seek opportunities to enhance the organization's cyber security capabilities through automation and continuous improvement.

The internal job title for this is role is Security Engineer Senior Consultant II.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, implement, and optimize endpoint security controls. Evaluate new endpoint security technologies. Develop security baselines and endpoint hardening standards. Provide technical guidance for endpoint-related security projects. Understand system security vulnerabilities and associated threats, and assess the overall security risks to the system Provide assistance to engineers to implement new security tools to feed our DevOps/SecOps processes, ensuring the solvency of computing resources Participate as an active member of Design & Build IT projects, steering configurations and services towards industry-leading security practices within domain expertise Work alongside Senior Security Engineers/Architects, and assist in Proof of Concepts and implementation of the security solution Assist with security and compliance-based projects involving cloud, operating systems, applications, and database and security issues and requirements Understand DevOps ideologies with the ability to drive and communicate change supporting DevOps/SecOps methodology within the organization Understand software installations, systems monitoring and troubleshooting, account management, and overall efforts to minimize system

Essential Skills:

3 years or more of professional experience in cybersecurity, endpoint security, or security engineering. 1 year or more of professional experience administering Anti-Virus/Endpoint Detection Response solutions. Experience investigating security events and supporting incident response activities. 1 year or more of professional experience with PowerShell, Python, or similar scripting languages. (Or Equivalent) Experience working with APIs and automation workflows.

Desirable Skills:

Experience with privileged access management platforms. Familiarity with GitHub and version control best practices. Experience with Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR) platforms. Experience with Microsoft Sentinel or other SIEM platforms. Experience implementing AI-assisted security operations or security copilots.
Experience

3 or more years of experience (Preferred)
Supervisory Responsibilities

This job does not have supervisory duties. #LI-MF1

Skills

Access Management, CrowdStrike Falcon, Cybersecurity, Endpoint Security, Incident Response, Information Security Engineering, IT Security Operations, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Risk Management, Scripting, Security Operations, Security Platforms, Security Technologies, Security Tools, SIEM Tools, Stakeholder Engagement, Threat Detection

Compensation offered for this role is 90,700.00 - 153,925.00 annually and is based on experience and qualifications.

The candidate(s) offered this position will be required to submit to a background investigation.

jobs.description:
*Position Title:

Deskside Technician – End User Computing

*JOB DESCRIPTION

(CONTRACT JOB: Renewable once in every 3 months)

The position of Deskside Technician – End User Computing performs troubleshooting, repair, and preventative maintenance of end user computing equipment and peripheral equipment at corporate locations.

The candidate works on assignments of a diverse scope where analysis of data and hardware requires evaluation of identifiable factors. The candidate exercises judgment with supervision within the generally defined practices and policies in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions and acts as a liaison between customers, departments, and within the organization to lead problem resolution.

Any incumbent in this position is expected to perform all the duties of this job description at a minimum level of satisfaction as determined by this position's ADSL managers and/or the ADSL client(s) this position may be assigned to support. If the incumbent is given a separate job description or a different protocol/guideline or expectation by an ADSL client, the incumbent will immediately notify this position’s immediate manager at ADSL so that the ADSL manager can ensure the ADSL and client job descriptions are compatible and aligned. The incumbent in this position understands that the "at will" employment relationship which ADSL has with all of its employees also applies to the assignment of the incumbent to an ADSL client. Therefore, the incumbent understands that an ADSL client may end the incumbent's assignment with the client at any time and at the ADSL client's sole discretion. In such cases, ADSL's continued employment of the incumbent in this position will be evaluated on a case-by-case basis and be further subject to ADSL's business needs and the terms of the "at-will" relationship which ADSL has with all of its employees.

Required Skills and abilities (For any questions, please contact INF_Leadership.)

· Managing work queues in Service Now.

· Attend daily Team meetings.

· Assist in coverage support for PTO and sick days.

· Prioritize tickets accordingly (P1’s, P2s, Break/Fix, VIP, escalated and expedited incidents and tasks).

· Good working knowledge of MS Windows versions 10 and 11 and experience troubleshooting the same.

· Experience troubleshooting network printers.

· Resolving hardware issues for desktops and laptops including Break / Fix.

· Support of Desktops, Laptops and mobile devices including Windows, Apple, and Android.

· Troubleshooting and diagnosing various technical issues.

· Installing and maintaining the company’s software and equipment using tools such as SCCM.

· Re-imaging devices when necessary.

· Troubleshooting various technology issues.

· Helping new employees to set up their workstation.

· Preventative maintenance tasks on machines with low health scores in Systrack.

· Assisting other teams with gathering information such as rack space, cabling, or pictures as needed.

· Creating and updating Knowledge base articles (KB’s) and Standard operation processes (SOP’s).

· Excellent English and communication skills

· Assessing and understanding user needs and issues.

· Answering general questions presented by our customers.

· All other tasks as assigned.

· Daily duty details

CUSTOMER SERVICE

· One of the most important responsibilities that deskside support technicians have is providing personal support services. They must build rapport and obtain problem details from help desk customers. They politely take incoming requests for help from end users through the Service Now ticketing system.

PROBLEM-SOLVING

· Deskside support technicians take initiative and ownership of reported end-user problems. They use diagnostic tools to identify root problems. Once the issue is identified, deskside support technicians process these incidents through an incident management process.

DELIVER HARDWARE AND APPLICATION SUPPORT

· When end users need technical support with desktops, laptops, tablets, workstation devices, mobile devices, printers, and software, they turn to deskside support. These technicians then diagnose and solve unique one-time problems. To complete this, they reimage systems and engage in computer networking. Deskside support technicians also work with purchasing staff to buy replacement hardware and software as needed.

ASSIST OTHER TEAMS

· Deskside technicians are occasionally called up to lend support to other technical towers. This may require going into server rooms, network closets or other locations to assist.

INSTALL SOFTWARE UPGRADES

· Deskside support workers complete hands-on fixes for desktops and laptops that include software installations and upgrades. They perform file backups and configure new systems and applications. After completing installations, deskside support workers test new computers according to established guidelines.

CREATE AND MAINTAIN DOCUMENTATION

· Documentation is a major requirement for deskside support. They record, track, and write notes for the help desk problem-solving process, including decision outcomes, actions taken, and final resolutions. Deskside support technicians are often required to submit accurate call logs itemizing customer interactions.

APPLICATION MIGRATION & REPACKAGING

· Inventory SCCM-deployed applications by exporting the list of applications, versions, and deployment types

· Identify Intune-compatible formats, flagging MSI, EXE, and script-based installers that need conversion to Intune

· Repackage applications using the Microsoft Win32 Content Prep Tool to create Intune files, and validate silent install/uninstall commands

· Test application deployments in pilot groups, validating install success, detection rules, and rollback

· Document application metadata, including publisher, version, install command, detection method, and related details

ENROLLMENT & POLICY TESTING

· Enroll test devices via Autopilot or manual enrollment, validating device join type (Azure AD joined vs. hybrid)

· Apply pilot configuration profiles and test compliance policies, device restrictions, and security settings

· Verify Conditional Access behavior to ensure policies trigger correctly based on device state

· Log and report enrollment errors, capturing screenshots and logs for troubleshooting

· Perform device imaging and OS updates for desktops and laptops following customer standard procedures

END USER COORDINATION

· Schedule pilot user testing sessions, coordinating with selected users to validate app access, device behavior, and policy enforcement

· Create user-friendly, step-by-step guides for enrollment, app access, and common issues

· Collect feedback from pilot users using forms or Teams surveys to gather usability and performance insights

· Provide Tier 1 onsite support to Authorized Users during migration, assisting with enrollment issues, app failures, and basic troubleshooting, and to meet specified SLAs

· Utilize existing customer Knowledge Base to resolve incidents and tasks associated with EUC equipment

· Remote support tooling including BeyondTrust; Bomgar; TeamViewer, etc

SECURITY & COMPLIANCE CHECKS

· Verify BitLocker and Defender status post-enrollment

· Ensure FIPS and TPM settings align with compliance policies

· Confirm device tagging and group membership in Intune

· Security responsibilities including Defender; MDM enrollment; BitLocker handling; Phishing response

REPORTING & DOCUMENTATION

· Update the migration tracker, logging completed repackaging, test results, and deployment status

· Maintain an issue/resolution log, tracking recurring problems and fixes for future reference

· Assist with the Power BI dashboard

· Utilize customer provided ITSM ticketing systems with regular updates and proper hygiene applied to all tickets

· Update CMDB with asset allocation and de-allocation details following customer standard procedures

· Provide regular, accurate, and timely feedback regarding customer requirements and maintain timely communication with operations and project personnel

· Excellent written communication and customer service skills with ability to communicate technical information to both technical and non-technical team and customers

· Intune migration support and other duties as required

*JOB REQUIREMENTS/QUALIFICATIONS

Experience:

· Requires 3+ years of related work experience

· Knowledge of imaging tools (SCCM, MDT)

· Knowledge of data backup and recovery tools

· Installing, upgrading, and migrating to Windows 10/11

· Deploying Windows 10/11 in large enterprises

· Configuring hardware and applications

· Configuring network connectivity

· Configuring access to resources

· Configuring mobile computing

· Monitoring and maintaining systems that run Windows 10/11

· Configuring backup and recovery options

Certifications:

· A+ Certification a plus

Pay: $26.00 - $27.00 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

In this role, you will help scale and automate HRT’s global Windows endpoint fleet, with a focus on improving platform reliability, reducing operational overhead, and delivering new endpoint capabilities. You will also contribute to the management and automation of our Windows server and Azure infrastructure.

Strong communication and collaboration skills, as well as a positive attitude towards team members and internal customers, are crucial to success within this role.

Build and evolve HRT’s endpoint management platform, including device configuration, software deployment, policy enforcement, compliance, and lifecycle automation across our global Windows fleet
Automate the provisioning, configuration, and management of on-premises and cloud-hosted VDI environments, including HRT’s Citrix remote access platform Leverage automation to identify and remediate technical inefficiencies across Windows endpoints, Windows infrastructure, and Microsoft Azure resources

 Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for a**Specialist IT Endpoint Management** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Architecture \& Strategy**

* Develop and design a highly secure endpoint management environment with clear target architectures, standards, and governance models.
* Ensure that security, compliance, and regulatory requirements are embedded into endpoint architectures and operational processes.
* Evaluate, design, and implement new endpoint technologies and solutions to continuously improve the digital workplace experience.
* Lead endpoint management projects from planning and design through implementation and operational transition.

**Endpoint Operations \& Management**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for complex endpoint-related incidents, service requests, and problem management activities.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle, perform root cause analysis, and drive permanent resolution of recurring issues.
* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 endpoint management services.
* Configure, test, and optimize device policies, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and endpoint security controls.
* Monitor endpoint compliance, coordinate remediation activities, and support device lifecycle management processes.
* Support onboarding, offboarding, device provisioning, and deployment activities for end users.

**Software Deployment \& Continuous Improvement**

* Oversee software packaging, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management activities for business applications and endpoint platforms.
* Troubleshoot and resolve application deployment and device management issues.
* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments, testing initiatives, automation efforts, and continuous service improvement programs.

**Stakeholder \& Vendor Management**

* Manage external service providers and coordinate interfaces between IT Security, Infrastructure, Workplace Services, and Operations teams.
* Act as a technical advisor and escalation point for endpoint-related topics across the organization.
* Support knowledge sharing and technical enablement within the Endpoint Management team.

**Documentation \& Governance**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture standards, operational procedures, and knowledge base articles.
* Document recurring issues, standard solutions, and architectural decisions.
* Ensure endpoint management processes and documentation align with security and compliance requirements.

Qualifications
- -------------

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* A high level of **English**is required (C1)

Additional Information
- ---------------------

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses
