jobs.description:
At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It's a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

*LifeStance Health Values*

* Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.
* Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.
* Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.
* One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

**Benefits** As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD\&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

**Role Overview** The **Senior MDM Data Steward** serves as the authoritative steward for patient and provider domains for master data across the Enterprise Data Platform, providing leadership for the operational governance, quality, and integrity of enterprise identity data. This role owns the stewardship framework supporting patient and provider master records and is accountable for ensuring that Enterprise Master Patient Index (EMPI) patient global identifiers and MDM provider global identifiers within the Silver (conformed canonical) layer remain accurate, complete, traceable, and trusted for analytics, reporting, regulatory compliance, operational decision-making, and AI-driven use cases.

Operating with a high degree of independence, the Senior MDM Data Steward leads identity resolution activities, establishes and maintains stewardship standards, and exercises judgment in the review and disposition of complex match, merge, and identity exception scenarios. The steward proactively identifies data quality risks, drives remediation efforts across source systems, oversees survivorship rule execution, and serves as the primary escalation point for patient and provider identity-related issues. In partnership with Business Data Owners, Data Governance leaders, and source-system stakeholders, this role influences stewardship practices, promotes data quality accountability, and drives continuous improvement of master data management processes.

The Senior MDM Data Steward also owns the maintenance and ongoing governance of patient and provider business glossary terms, data quality rules and definitions, lineage context, stewardship procedures, issue records, and related governance artifacts within Snowflake Horizon Catalog. Through active monitoring, analysis, and stewardship leadership, the role ensures critical business and technical metadata remains current, actionable, and aligned with enterprise data governance standards and strategic data management objectives.

Consistent with LifeStance's values, every member of the LifeStance team is expected to support each other and the mission, which may mean participating in projects and initiatives and performing functions and responsibilities not specifically outlined in this job description.

**COMPENSATIO** N: $109,000 - $130,000/annually in addition to a competitive bonus plan

**KEY RESPONSIBILITES**

**Identity Resolution, Match Stewardship, and Operational Leadership (approximately 40%)**

* Lead enterprise MDM stewardship operations by directing work queue activities, adjudicating complex identity resolution scenarios, resolving potential matches and duplicates, correcting improperly merged identities, and establishing consistent record governance practices for manually reviewed records.
* Serve as the senior escalation point for patient identity management issues, investigating overlays, duplicates, and cross-system identity conflicts originating from athena
One, AdvancedMD, and other source systems; determine root causes, drive corrective actions, and recommend process improvements to reduce recurrence.
* Own the governance and integrity of the provider master data domain, establishing and enforcing standards for the reconciliation of NPI, taxonomy, licensure, credentialing status, payer enrollment, practice location, employment status, and related attributes across enterprise source systems.
* Provide leadership for provider data quality and governance initiatives, ensuring the accuracy, consistency, and usability of provider practice, location, and organizational affiliation data supporting operational, analytical, credentialing, reimbursement, and regulatory reporting needs.
* Partner with Data Architecture to evaluate and tune Verato match thresholds, referential matching configuration, survivorship, and attribute precedence rules; measure the effect on auto-match, potential-match, unmatched, and false-positive rates before changes are promoted.
* Ownership over establishing and maintaining enterprise standards for data stewardship decisions, ensuring comprehensive documentation of exceptions, adjudication rationale, survivorship outcomes, merge and unmerge activities, and record-resolution actions to support auditability, compliance, and continuous improvement efforts.

**Data Quality, Issue Management \& Silver Layer Validation (approximately 25%)**

* Establish and own the business acceptance standards for patient and provider mastered records, source-to-global ID crosswalks, identity resolution outcomes, and golden-record quality within the Snowflake Silver layer, ensuring alignment with enterprise data governance and operational objectives.
* Provide oversight of EMPI patient and provider global ID integrity within the Snowflake Silver layer by proactively identifying data quality defects, validating adherence to business rules, and directing remediation efforts with Data Engineering and DataOps teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Define, govern, and continuously refine master data quality standards and performance thresholds, including metrics related to unmatched records, duplicate records, orphaned source IDs, stale provider attributes, missing NPI values, invalid affiliations, and incomplete required attributes; communicate performance trends and improvement recommendations to stakeholders.
* Lead the governance and lifecycle management of patient and provider master data issues, prioritizing remediation activities based on business impact, overseeing issue resolution progress, and providing transparent reporting on ownership, remediation status, risk exposure, and closure outcomes.
* Independently lead strategic trend analysis and root-cause investigations to identify systemic defects across registration, scheduling, provider onboarding, credentialing, human resources, interfaces, and source application workflows; recommend and influence corrective actions that improve data quality and operational efficiency.
* Own the maintenance and governance of master data lineage and identifier crosswalks, ensuring accurate traceability between source-system MRNs, provider identifiers, and enterprise global IDs while supporting audit, compliance, and operational reporting requirements.
* Serve as the primary business lead for identity-related incidents and data quality escalations, coordinating cross-functional resolution efforts, driving stakeholder alignment, and ensuring corrective actions are effectively prioritized, tested, and promoted through established release and change-management processes.

**Governance, Metadata \& Policy (approximately 20%)**

* Establish and govern enterprise patient and provider master data standards, defining business terminology, required attributes, permissible values, data ownership, attribute precedence, relationship hierarchies, and merge/unmerge policies to ensure consistent and compliant master data management practices across the organization.
* Own the stewardship framework and metadata management processes for Patient and Provider domains by maintaining business glossary terms, data quality standards, stewardship procedures, issue records, and lineage documentation within the Snowflake Horizon Catalog, ensuring transparency and accessibility for business and technical stakeholders.
* Serve independently as the primary stewardship leader for Patient and Provider domains within the Data Governance Steering Committee, influencing enterprise governance decisions and partnering with Business Data Owners to establish data definitions, quality expectations, usage standards, and remediation priorities.
* Provide governance leadership and strategic recommendations to Business Data Owners, enabling informed decision-making regarding business definitions, quality thresholds, and stewardship policy changes while ensuring alignment with enterprise data management objectives.
* Lead the evaluation and governance of changes impacting master data policies, including data definitions, identity matching criteria, survivorship logic, and quality thresholds; facilitate cross-functional review, stakeholder alignment, risk assessment, and decision-making through established governance processes.
* Independently ensure stewardship operations adhere to HIPAA minimum-necessary requirements, HITRUST controls, and organizational privacy and security policies, establishing robust auditability and oversight for manual merge, split, correction, and identity-resolution activities.
* Partner with Privacy, Compliance, and business stakeholders to assess regulatory and policy impacts on identity management practices, providing stewardship leadership for consent restrictions, sensitive data handling requirements, healthcare regulatory obligations, golden-record usage, and downstream data access controls.
* Drive the development and continuous improvement of master data standards that support regulatory reporting, quality initiatives, reimbursement processes, payer requirements, and broader enterprise business objectives, ensuring data assets remain reliable, compliant, and fit for purpose across the organization.

**Source-System Improvement, Reporting \& Enablement (approximately 15%)**

* Provide leadership and oversight for enterprise master data remediation efforts, directing corrective actions to registration, provider credentialing, human resources, practice operations, and other source-system owners; ensure timely resolution, accountability, and sustainable process improvements that prevent recurring data quality issues within mastered records.
* Partner with operational and business leaders to strengthen upstream data governance and capture processes, identifying opportunities to enhance controls, workflows, and accountability measures that reduce the creation of duplicate, incomplete, and conflicting patient and provider records at the source.
* Develop, own, and present executive-level stewardship performance reporting, delivering monthly scorecards and actionable insights on duplicate rates, unmatched records, match accuracy, exception backlog and aging, source correction effectiveness, provider data completeness, global ID coverage, and recurring root-cause trends to support informed decision-making.
* Serve as the primary stewardship liaison with MDM vendors and implementation partners, providing leadership in troubleshooting match-quality issues, evaluating configuration recommendations, validating platform capabilities, assessing business impacts, and guiding release planning and implementation decisions.

jobs.summary: Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the...
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our classified software team. You will design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.

This is a hands-on role with real technical authority. You will be the first dedicated software engineer on this team, which means you set the architecture, choose the patterns, and establish the engineering standards the rest of the team builds to. As the team grows you will lead it technically, and there is a clear path into formal technical leadership of the software function for someone who wants it.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Act as technical lead for the classified software and platform team: own the architecture of the application portfolio, set the standards the team builds to, and make the tradeoff calls.

- Design and build production web applications in React and Go that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.

- Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.

- Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.

- Own the DevSecOps path to production: containerize and deploy to Kubernetes through GitOps CI/CD pipelines that scan, sign, and produce the evidence our accreditations require.

- Decompose multi-quarter programs into well-scoped work other engineers can deliver independently, and grow the engineers who join the team through design review, code review, and pairing.

- Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.

- Professional experience developing backend services in Go.

- Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.

- Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.

- Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.

- Experience leading technical work: owning a system's architecture, reviewing the designs and code of others, setting direction for a small team, and communicating clearly in design documents, tradeoff analyses, and decision records a peer can pick up and act on.

- Eligible to obtain and maintain a US Top Secret Clearance with customer's approval. May be required to obtain and maintain a DoD 8140/8570 qualifying certification.

 DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure or application and desktop brokering (e.g. Citrix, Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Leostream, Apache Guacamole, Kasm), and with virtualization orchestrated through Kubernetes such as KubeVirt.

- Experience implementing authorization systems (RBAC, ABAC, or relationship-based models), integrating applications against an external policy decision point, and Policy as Code (PaC) tools such as OPA, Oso, Cedar, or Kyverno.

- Experience with S3-compatible object storage APIs, POSIX filesystem semantics, or FUSE.

- Experience building software for air-gapped or network-isolated environments, including dependency vendoring and offline builds.

- Experience with DevSecOps supply-chain security practices including SBOM generation, artifact signing, and provenance attestation.

- Proficiency with core security concepts including encryption, authentication, identity and access management, and Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA), plus an understanding of NIST SP 800-53 controls and their technical implementation.

- Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.

- Experience as a tech lead or founding engineer on a product team, including establishing engineering practices from scratch, onboarding new engineers, and interviewing and hiring software engineers.

US Salary Range

 $167,000 - $222,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) manages the devices Anthropic’s people work on, plus the infrastructure underneath them. We treat the fleet as a distributed platform, not a collection of devices, and configuration ships as code through pull requests, CI, staging, and a canary group. Today the fleet is mostly macOS, with a growing mobile footprint.

Anthropic also works with vendor and business process outsourcing (BPO) partners whose teams need access to Anthropic systems. Those programs are growing, in more countries and with more vendors. Anthropic-owned Chromebooks issued to vendor staff are becoming the default device for vendor teams. This role exists to make ChromeOS a supported platform with a dedicated owner. You will own ChromeOS end to end, from how devices are bought and enrolled to how they are locked down, monitored, and retired, and help bring Android in as a second platform.

The team is deliberately lean and runs with high autonomy. You’ll define what ChromeOS looks like at Anthropic and own the platform decisions that get it there.

Responsibilities

- Own ChromeOS as a platform at Anthropic: device standards, Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise setup, organizational unit design, and policy

- Manage ChromeOS policy as code through the Chrome Policy API, GAM, and Terraform, in the team's config-as-code pipeline, so changes are reviewed, tested, and progressively rolled out like the rest of the fleet

- Build zero touch enrollment through resellers, so a Chromebook arrives enrolled and works the first time in every country our vendor partners work from

- Work with IT Operations and procurement partners on buying and shipping devices internationally, including regions our current partners don’t reach

- Design device models for vendor teams (kiosk, managed guest sessions, shared devices, and assigned devices) and pick the right one for each program

- Lock devices down to what the work needs: copy and paste, downloads, printing, USB, and app and extension controls

- Own the device lifecycle for vendor fleets, from enrollment to wipe, lock, and retrieval when an engagement ends

- Feed ChromeOS device data into our fleet telemetry, tracking which devices are checking in, OS version, and drift between expected and actual state

- Partner with Corporate Security on hardware standards (such as Verified Access attestation and minimum AUE date), device trust signals, and access decisions

- Work with Security on the contractor access model and on keeping Anthropic data off vendor devices

- Run data loss controls through Chrome Enterprise Premium

- Work with Security on the vendor identity model: which accounts vendor staff use and in which tenant

- Support Android as a second platform, working with the corporate mobile program on Android Enterprise and zero-touch enrollment

- Write the runbooks IT Operations and vendor partners use to stand up a new program

You may be a good fit if you

- Have owned ChromeOS as a platform for a fleet of thousands of devices

- Know the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise well: OU design, device and user policy, enrollment, and reporting

- Have automated ChromeOS policy through the Chrome Policy API or GAM

- Have run kiosk, managed guest, or shared device programs for frontline, contact center, or outsourced teams

- Have set up zero touch enrollment with resellers and shipped devices across several countries

- Have worked with Android device management and can hold your own in a mixed fleet

- Excel at ambiguous problems that touch several teams at once

- Communicate technical concepts clearly to any audience, including vendor partners

- View IT Engineering as requiring product engineering rigor

- Write clear documentation as a natural part of your workflow

Strong candidates may also

- Manage device configuration as code (pull requests, CI, staged rollout) instead of clicking in consoles

- Have managed ChromeOS alongside macOS or mobile fleets

- Have used VDI or browser-based access to keep data off the device for outsourced teams

- Have supported BPO or vendor programs through fast growth into new regions

- Have built automated, progressive rollout systems with promotion gated on telemetry

- Have used LLMs to automate operational work, or are excited to make Claude a teammate

Technical Skills

- Python and shell scripting

- ChromeOS management through the Google Admin console and Chrome Enterprise

- Google Admin SDK, Chrome Policy API, and GAM for automating policy and reporting

- Android Enterprise management (working knowledge)

- Querying live device state at fleet scale

- GitOps and CI for configuration management

- Endpoint security fundamentals

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

 $325,000 - $360,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Desktop Engineer - macOS
jobs.summary: Computer World Services Corp (CWS) is seeking a detail-oriented and results-driven Desktop Engineer – macOS who is responsible for engineering, configuring, and maintaining Apple macOS-based desktop environments in an enterprise setting. This role...
jobs.description:
Computer World Services Corp (CWS) is seeking a detail-oriented and results-driven Desktop Engineer – macOS who is responsible for engineering, configuring, and maintaining Apple macOS-based desktop environments in an enterprise setting. This role performs advanced system administration activities, including system configuration, performance optimization, and capacity planning for macOS endpoints.

    The position ensures reliable, secure, and efficient operation of macOS systems, supports enterprise applications, and provides technical expertise to enhance system performance and user experience. The Desktop Engineer serves as a key technical resource supporting end users and IT operations teams.

   Key Tasks & Responsibilities

        System Administration & Engineering

       Perform daily configuration, administration, and operation of macOS-based desktop and client/server systems.
       Engineer, build, and maintain standardized macOS images, configurations, and profiles.
       Optimize system performance, resource utilization, and endpoint stability.
       Conduct system capacity analysis and planning for macOS environments.
       Implement and maintain system configurations in accordance with organizational standards and policies.
       Provide Tier 3 support for complex macOS system issues.
       Troubleshoot advanced hardware, software, operating system, and performance issues.
       Support enterprise applications and integrations within macOS environments.
       Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term solutions for recurring issues.

       Desktop Engineering & Endpoint Management

       Design, deploy, and manage macOS desktop environments using enterprise tools (e.g., JAMF, Intune, or equivalent).
       Develop and maintain deployment workflows, automation scripts, and configuration profiles.
       Manage patching, updates, and compliance baselines for macOS endpoints.
       Ensure endpoint compliance with security policies and organizational standards.
       Support application packaging, testing, and deployment for macOS systems.

       User Support & System Access

       Provide assistance to users in accessing and effectively using business systems on macOS devices.
       Support identity and access management processes (e.g., Active Directory, Azure AD integration).
       Ensure proper configuration of user environments, permissions, and security settings.
       Collaborate with support teams to improve user experience and system usability.

       System Monitoring & Maintenance

       Monitor system performance, logs, and alerts to ensure optimal operation.
       Perform proactive maintenance, including patching, updates, and system health checks.
       Support backup, recovery, and endpoint security measures as required.
       Ensure compliance with IT security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.

       Documentation & Reporting

       Develop and maintain documentation for system configurations, processes, and procedures.
       Document engineering standards, deployment methods, and troubleshooting guides.
       Prepare reports related to system performance, utilization, and capacity planning.
       Ensure adherence to change management and configuration management processes.

       Collaboration & Support

       Work closely with system administrators, network engineers, security teams, and Help Desk staff.
       Support enterprise deployments, upgrades, and infrastructure initiatives.
       Provide technical leadership and guidance to Tier 1 and Tier 2 support personnel.
       Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and technology evaluations.

       Required Skills & Competencies

       Advanced knowledge of macOS operating systems and Apple hardware
       Experience with endpoint management and mobile device management (MDM) tools
       Strong understanding of system administration, configuration management, and automation
       Experience integrating macOS with enterprise services (e.g., Active Directory, Azure AD)
       Ability to optimize system performance and conduct capacity planning
       Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
       Excellent communication and customer service skills

       Preferred Qualifications

       Experience with scripting (e.g., Bash, Python)
       Experience in federal or government IT environments

       Work Environment

       Office and/or customer-site environment
       May require on-call support or after-hours maintenance activities
       May involve physical handling of IT equipment

   Education & Experience

       Education

       Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field
(or equivalent experience)

       Experience

       5+ years of experience in desktop engineering, system administration, or enterprise IT support
       Experience supporting macOS in enterprise environments
       Experience with macOS endpoint management tools (e.g., JAMF, Intune)

   Certifications

       Apple certifications (e.g., Apple Certified Support Professional – ACSP, JAMF certifications)
       ITIL certification preferred.

   Security Clearance

      Applicants must be able to obtain a Public Trust clearance

Job Description As part of our Digital Workplace Product Management Team, you will play a crucial role in the collaboration between our internal Customers and Engineering Teams, along with our Communications Teams. In this role, you will be responsible for planning and executing the lifecycle of Microsoft 365 services, including Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Copilot, Power Platform, and more. You will work with various stakeholders, including technology teams, business analysts and end users to deliver solutions that meet user needs and drive product success. The ideal candidate will have administration as well as product management experience with the Microsoft 365 ecosystem and have excellent written, communication and presentation skills. This role is perfect for someone who thrives in a dynamic and creative team environment. Responsibilities: Collect and analyze information, interview subject matter experts (SME), and use knowledge of business systems and processes to create detailed product requirements. Define product scope and objectives through research and data gathering using a demonstrated understanding of operations, systems and industry requirements. Analyze user feedback and determine opportunities for future phases of product lifecycle. Create and maintain product roadmaps and feature backlogs. Develop and deliver project business/benefits cases. Serve as a liaison between client business units and technical business units by analyzing business and user needs; defining requirements; and representing the user in the design, development, validation and implementation of appropriate technology solutions. Monitor and report on existing projects, timelines and delivery plans. Propose potential solutions to resolve current user pain points and identify areas of opportunity. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including customers, engineering, operations and marketing to deliver high-quality products. Assist in planning and implementing change initiatives. Serve as a functional SME, providing internal consulting services to assigned functional area(s); coordinate activities with other functional areas. Prepare and deliver written and oral presentations to stakeholders. Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends and opportunities. Monitor and report on product performance, making data-driven decisions to optimize and improve. Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders and customers to understand their needs and feedback. Gather and prioritize product and customer requirements to ensure alignment with business goals. Manage the product lifecycle from concept to launch, including post-launch performance analysis and iteration. Engage with business both proactively and reactively to listen and obtain feedback on the product. Performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned. Skills/Previous Experience: Ideally three (3) to five (5) years of experience in the administration and product management of Microsoft 365 services focusing on messaging, collaboration, workflow and content management and AI services is preferred. Raymond James knowledge and/or financial services industry experience preferred. Proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and Power Platform. Deep understanding of the Microsoft 365 ecosystem. Experience in information technology support and technical documentation. Strong skills in interpreting client input, clarifying issues and developing solutions. Knowledge of user acceptance testing principle, with the ability to develop test plans and scripts. Understanding of project management methodologies and the software development lifecycle. Familiarity with cloud technologies and integrations. Experience in change management and enablement support. Strong collaboration, workflow and content management knowledge particularly, OneDrive, SharePoint, Box and Power Platform. Strong messaging knowledge – Exchange/Outlook, Teams. Ability to act as a liaison between product owners and technology implementers – describe business functions to technical audience and translate technical capabilities, issues to business. Licenses/Certifications: None required. Education Bachelor’s: Computer and Information Science, Bachelor’s: Computer Engineering, Bachelor’s: Computer Systems Analysis, High School (HS) (Required) Work Experience General Experience - 13 months to 3 years Certifications Travel Less than 25% Workstyle Hybrid The total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. You’ll want to join Billings Clinic for our outstanding quality of care, exciting environment, interesting cases from a vast geography, advanced technology and educational opportunities. We are in the top 1% of hospitals internationally for receiving Magnet® Recognition consecutively since 2006.

 And you’ll want to stay at Billings Clinic for the amazing teamwork, caring atmosphere, and a culture that values kindness, safety and courage. This is an incredible place to learn and grow. Billings, Montana, is a friendly, college community in the Rocky Mountains with great schools and abundant family activities. Amazing outdoor recreation is just minutes from home. Four seasons of sunshine!

   You can make a difference here.

 About Us

   Billings Clinic is a community-owned, not-for-profit, Physician-led health system based in Billings with more than 4,700 employees, including over 550 physicians and non-physician providers. Our integrated organization consists of a multi-specialty group practice and a 304-bed hospital. Learn more about Billings Clinic (our organization, history, mission, leadership and regional locations) and how we are recognized nationally for our exceptional quality.

Your Benefits

   We provide a comprehensive and competitive benefits package to all full- and part-time employees (minimum of 20 hours/week), including Medical, Dental, Vision, 403(b) Retirement Plan with employer matching, Defined Contribution Pension Plan, Paid Time Off, employee wellness program, and much more.

 Magnet: Commitment to Nursing Excellence

   Billings Clinic is proud to be recognized for nursing excellence as a Magnet®-designated organization, joining only 97 other organizations worldwide that have achieved this honor four times. The re-designation process happens every four years.

  Pre-Employment Requirements

   All new employees must complete several pre-employment requirements prior to starting.

  IT Systems Administrator - Endpoint Management

PMO / OPERATIONS - 100.8732 (BILLINGS CLINIC 2950 10TH AVE N BUILDING)

req12972

Shift: Day

Employment Status: Full-Time (.75 or greater)

Hours per Pay Period: 1.00 = 80 hours every two weeks (Exempt)

Starting Wage DOE: $33.66 - $42.07

   Serves as part of a team that supports the IT infrastructure for the Billings Clinic and Logan Health Organizations. Responsible for providing day-to-day support, maintenance and improvement of existing endpoint management tools and processes as well as participation in guidance, planning and execution of improvements and future strategy in that area. Expected to work within a Service Management Platform, accepting, documenting, and completing tasks that are assigned to their service area(s). In addition to the technical knowledge/skills required to support these services, expectations include good documentation, compliance with change control, and effective task management. Effective coordination, communication and interaction with other teams/departments, vendors and facilities is a must.

   This is a highly dynamic environment requiring members of this team to respond to the often-changing needs of the organization while maintaining a high level of uptime, service quality, and security.

  Essential Job Functions

  Designs, implements and evaluates Information Technology functions to cost effectively improve organizational outcomes throughout Billings Clinic and Logan Health.
  Functions as part of a multi-team environment, including resources from multiple sites, organizations and teams. Excellent communication (written and verbal) and collaboration is essential.
  Develops and recommends strategies for improving the organizational IT service delivery, enhancing management capabilities, automation, and security measures related to systems management toolsets.
  Utilizes documentation, training and mentorship, drives application adoption and skillset growth within IT and other functional areas.
  Provides operational and technical support, maintenance, administration and enhancements for relevant tools to facilitate management of for workstations, servers and mobile devices across the organization, both inside and outside the network as appropriate.
  Professional experience in supporting, implementing, and maintaining a number of the following enterprise technologies:
  Windows network services, especially Active Directory (Local and Azure) and Group Policy
  Microsoft operating system imaging technologies (both cloud and on-premises)
  Microsoft and third party patching automation, compliance and reporting (both cloud and on-premises)
  Mobile device management for multiple platforms utilizing Microsoft Intune
  Scripting languages (Powershell, VBS, etc.)
  Utilizes tools and automation, drives support and implementation efficiency through standardization and refinement/implementation of additional endpoint management capabilities.
  Effectively manages, implements, automates and troubleshoots software package deployments.
  Effectively manages, implements, automates and troubleshoots device operating system imaging, upgrades and deployments.
  Performs, remediates, troubleshoots and reports on Windows and third-party patches/updates in accordance with company policies and cybersecurity guidelines.
  Configures, maintains, and troubleshoots policies in appropriate management platforms (e.g Active Directory Group Policy, Azure, Intune, MECM, etc.).
  Creates and maintains quality documentation.
  Focuses on consistent improvement of management tools and capabilities, driving efficiency and additional functionality for the purpose of providing better IT services.
  Assists in other functional areas, work outside of standard hours and on-call duties may be required.
  Identifies needs and sets goals for own growth and development; meets all mandatory organizational and departmental requirements.
  Supports and models behaviors consistent with Billings Clinic’s mission, vision, values, code of business conduct and service expectations. Meets all mandatory organizational and departmental requirements. Maintains competency in all organizational, departmental and outside agency standards as it relates to the environment, employee, patient safety or job performance.
  Performs all other duties as assigned or as needed to meet the needs of the department/organization.

   Minimum Qualifications

Education

   4 Year / Bachelors Degree in related field and area of study.

 Experience

   2-5 years of successful experience as a System Administrator / Endpoint Management, preferred.
  Successful Information Technology experience in the health care industry, a plus.

Certifications and Licenses

   MT Driver License or the ability to obtain one at hire and the ability to be insured to operate organization's vehicles.
   Relevant technical certifications preferred.
   Able to provide reliable home internet access and have personal cell phone.

  Or an equivalent combination of education and experience relating to the above tasks, knowledge, skills and abilities will be considered

Billings Clinic is Montana’s largest health system serving Montana, Wyoming and the western Dakotas. A not-for-profit organization led by a physician CEO, the health system is governed by a board of community members, nurses and physicians. Billings Clinic includes an integrated multi-specialty group practice, tertiary care hospital and trauma center, based in Billings, Montana. Learn more at www.billingsclinic.com/aboutus

jobs.description:
As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.

End User Computing Engineer

CREATING ESSENTIAL CHEMISTRY THE WORLD NEEDS

At Chemours, our people are redefining how the world thinks of chemistry by approaching everything we do with a commitment to delivering Trusted Chemistry that creates better lives and helps communities thrive. That begins with how we use our science, data, and unmatched technical expertise to develop market-leading products with the highest levels of performance, sustainability, and safety in the industry.

Powered by chemistry, our products are used in applications that make the products we rely on, processes, and new technologies possible. In key sectors such as clean energy, advanced electronics, high-performance computing and AI, climate friendly cooling, and high-quality paints and coatings for homes and industrial infrastructure, sustainable solutions and more modern living depend on Chemours chemistry.

Chemours is seeking an experienced End User Computing Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This position may be based at various Chemours US locations; candidates located within 50 miles of any Chemours US location will enable close collaboration with IT and business teams.

This role will manage and continuously improve Chemours’ enterprise endpoint capabilities. The engineer will deliver secure, reliable, and user-focused computing services across the device lifecycle.

The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:

· Engineer, administer, and continuously improve enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune.

· Design and support co-management and cloud-native endpoint strategies for Windows, iOS, and Android devices, including Microsoft Intune integration with Apple Business Manager and Android zero-touch enrollment.

· Design and support Windows Autopilot provisioning to streamline device deployment and employee onboarding.

· Build, test, deploy, and maintain applications, packages, task sequences, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines.

· Plan and execute operating system feature updates, monthly patching, driver and firmware updates, and endpoint lifecycle activities.

· Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, service delivery, and application teams to remediate vulnerabilities and meet endpoint security and compliance requirements.

jobs.description:
Desde la división de IT \& Cloud de Iwantic estamos buscando un/a M365 Specialist con experiencia avanzada en Microsoft Intune para incorporarse directamente a una importante compañía tecnológica ubicada en Madrid.

Buscamos un perfil con experiencia sólida en la administración integral de una tenant de Microsoft 365 y conocimientos avanzados de Intune, especialmente en la gestión de dispositivos y despliegues masivos de Windows mediante Autopilot.

¿Qué harás?

* Administrar de forma integral una tenant de Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Teams, usuarios, permisos y políticas corporativas.
* Gestionar Microsoft Intune para la administración avanzada de dispositivos, aplicaciones, configuraciones, políticas de cumplimiento y seguridad.
* Diseñar y ejecutar despliegues masivos de dispositivos Windows mediante Windows Autopilot, desde la configuración inicial hasta su puesta en marcha.
* Administrar Microsoft Entra ID y las políticas de identidad y acceso.
* Gestionar sistemas Windows e infraestructura cloud en Microsoft Azure.
* Resolver incidencias técnicas complejas y garantizar la continuidad y seguridad del entorno tecnológico.

¿Qué buscamos?

* Formación en Informática, Sistemas o áreas relacionadas.
* Experiencia sólida en la administración integral de entornos Microsoft 365.
* Experiencia avanzada y práctica con Microsoft Intune, más allá de la configuración básica de dispositivos.
* Experiencia demostrable en despliegues masivos de dispositivos Windows y Windows Autopilot.
* Certificación Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102), imprescindible.
* Autonomía, capacidad de resolución de problemas y buenas habilidades de comunicación.

¿Qué ofrecemos?

* Contrato indefinido directamente con la compañía.
* Ubicación: Madrid.
* Modalidad presencial.
* Entorno tecnológico dinámico y colaborativo.
* Oportunidades de crecimiento y desarrollo profesional.

Si tienes experiencia administrando entornos Microsoft 365 de forma integral, dominas Intune y Windows Autopilot y cuentas con la certificación requerida, ¡inscríbete en la oferta y valoraremos tu candidatura!

jobs.description:
Calling all originals: At Levi Strauss \& Co., you can be yourself --- and be part of something bigger. We're a company of people who like to forge our own path and leave the world better than we found it. Who believe that what makes us different makes us stronger. So add your voice. Make an impact. Find your fit --- and your future

**Introduction** As an Engineer I, Endpoint at Levi Strauss \& Co., you will provide hands-on Microsoft Intune engineering and endpoint security operations. You will package and deploy applications, manage patching and configuration, monitor deployment health and compliance, resolve complex escalations, and automate recurring support work. This role reports to the Director of Engineering, Endpoint

**About The Job**

* Package, test, deploy, maintain, and retire endpoint applications using established engineering, release, and change-management standards.
* Manage operating system and application patching across supported Windows and macOS endpoints and monitor deployment health and failures.
* Maintain Intune enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, endpoint security controls, encryption, and vulnerability remediation activities.
* Troubleshoot complex endpoint, operating system, application, device management, and compliance issues escalated by Service Desk and Deskside teams.
* Document solutions, identify root causes, create PowerShell or remediation scripts, and automate recurring operational work within approved architecture and security guardrails.

**About You**

* 5 years of experience in IT support, including 2 years of hands-on Intune engineering or advanced endpoint administration.
* Bachelor's degree in technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience with application packaging, deployment, operating system and application patching, compliance policies, configuration profiles, and endpoint troubleshooting.
* Strong Windows knowledge, working knowledge of macOS management, and PowerShell or similar scripting experience preferred.
* Demonstrated success improving endpoint compliance, security posture, deployment reliability, device health, root-cause resolution, and technical documentation.
* Solid understanding of agile development practices and CI/CD pipelines.

NTT Data Services Federal Government is currently looking to hire a skilled Microsoft Endpoint Management (MEM) Engineer, specializing in Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM, formerly SCCM) with a secret clearance. The ideal candidate will join a team of engineers responsible for engineering and implementing an enterprise Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) Solution.   Prioritizes work as it relates to the achievement of NTT DATA's short and long- term business goals and objectives.
  Responsible for complex testing and analysis of all elements of the computer systems.
  Provides guidance and direction to junior level systems engineers.
  Regularly assists in orienting, training, assigning and checking the work of lower level engineers.
  Establishes system priorities as they relate to NTT DATA's achievement of short and long term business goals and objectives.
  Analyzes and provides innovative solutions to B1 systems engineering and design projects.
  Represents the organization in front of critical audiences such as clients / vendors / executives.

Minimum 10 years of information technology experience Bachelor's degree in applicable field may be substituted for 5 years of experience. Minimum 1 year experience testing, deploying, and troubleshooting the installation of Microsoft and third-party software updates. Minimum 1 year experience building/deploying application packages in SCCM 2012/MECM Current Branch. Minimum 1 year experience managing a large MECM infrastructure. Minimum 1 year experience managing Windows Servers and Workstations. Minimum 1 year experience working in a DoD classified environment.Security+ or equivalent certification
Active DoD secret clearance

Experience with ServiceNow Acts independently to expose and resolve problems. Familiarity with STIG requirements Familiarity with ITILv4 Familiarity with Agile Scrum methodologies Strong skills with MS Office tools (Excel, Word, Project, Visio) and SharePoint. jobs.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We're looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne's Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our Endpoint Protection product, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (We're currently growing multiple teams and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).

The Platform group teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:

Windows agent's Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,usermode security & agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer & interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance & stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.

What will you do?

As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode & kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals & Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection & Response eco-system.Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance & optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise & government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).You'll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.Working setup: Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.What skills & knowledge should you bring?

Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design & internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling toolsPrevious experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deploymentGreat communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinkingAttention to detail and high coding standardsAn advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysisWhy SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

About the role: The State Corporation Commission (SCC) is seeking an Endpoint Engineer to support enterprise software and patch deployment activities. This role is responsible for reviewing endpoint vulnerability metrics and executing remediation through targeted software and patch deployments. The engineer will troubleshoot deployment failures, patching issues, and configuration problems, providing detailed root cause analysis and corrective actions. Additionally, the position contributes to maintaining a secure, compliant, and reliable endpoint environment across the organization.

  Develop and maintain deployment packages using tools such as Microsoft Intune, Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) or similar endpoint management platforms.

  Troubleshoot deployment failures, patching issues, and endpoint configuration problems, providing root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
  Maintain documentation for packaging standards, deployment procedures, endpoint baselines, and change management activities.
  Implement and enforce endpoint hardening policies, compliance settings, and configuration baselines.
  Partner with infrastructure, security, and service desk teams to ensure high endpoint reliability, security posture, and user satisfaction.
  Continuously evaluate new technologies, updates, and automation opportunities to optimize endpoint management operations.

jobs.summary: ABOUT WATERSHED Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and...
jobs.description:
ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

THE ROLE

As an IT Engineer at Watershed, you’ll own the internal technology and SaaS platforms our teams rely on every day and shape how employees experience IT across our global offices. It’s an exciting time to join: we’ve equipped employees with best-in-class AI tools, and you’ll help define what modern IT looks like when AI is woven into how we work. You’ll support employees directly while designing agent-driven workflows, integrations, and self-service resources that reduce toil and turn repetitive tickets into well-engineered systems that make your colleagues’ lives meaningfully better.

As we grow globally, you’ll have real ownership over the systems you build and a direct hand in shaping where IT goes next, partnering closely with teammates in San Francisco and London. We’re looking for someone with deep experience who finds joy in solving problems for people, thrives in a creative, collaborative environment, and has the judgment to balance quick fixes with long-term engineering. If you’re customer-obsessed, hard-working, proactive, inclusive, and optimistic, you’ll fit right in. This position is based in our San Francisco office, where you’ll work four days per week as part of our in-office culture.

YOU WILL:

 - Design and implement scalable IT solutions that enhance employee productivity and security across our global offices

 - Manage and maintain our core IT systems, including Okta, Kolide, Iru (formerly Kandji), Google Workspace, Notion, and Slack

 - Develop and optimize our global asset management processes for employee devices throughout their lifecycle

 - Build and maintain reliable automations and integrations across our IT systems, reducing repetitive work in onboarding, access management, device operations, and support

 - Own and improve employee onboarding, role change, and offboarding lifecycle processes through reliable provisioning, access controls, automation, and device workflows in partnership with People and Security

 - Partner with Security, People, Workplace, Engineering, and our external IT support provider to deliver reliable services and a thoughtful employee experience

 - Serve as an escalation point for elevated hardware, software, and network-related issues, as well as occasional in-person support within the San Francisco office

 - Maintain a secure, reliable macOS fleet through device provisioning, configuration, patching, endpoint protection, and compliance monitoring

 - Manage and optimize our conference room technology and A/V systems

 - Turn recurring issues into lasting improvements through root-cause analysis, clear run books, employee-facing guidance, and self-service tools; maintain IT policies and procedures that support consistent service delivery

 - Use AI tools to accelerate troubleshooting, scripting, documentation, system architecture design and workflow development

 - Administer and support our AI platforms, including Claude, ChatGPT, Dust.tt, and Notion AI, managing access, configuration, integrations, and secure adoption across the company

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF:

 - You have 3+ years of increasing experience and responsibility in IT at high-growth technology companies

 - You have hands-on experience administering Okta, including SSO, provisioning, and lifecycle workflows, and understand least-privilege access

 - You have hands-on experience using AI to improve your work, can explain where it has helped, and know when to verify its output or use a different approach

 - You’re comfortable building scripts, using APIs, and workflow automation to solve operational problems, and you test, document, and maintain what you build

 - You have experience managing and supporting Mac-based environments

 - You have experience with asset management systems and lifecycle management for employee devices

 - You're knowledgeable about IT security best practices and compliance requirements

 - You have excellent problem-solving abilities and a track record of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

 - You're an effective communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - You have experience supporting a breadth of modern SaaS applications

 - You have experience managing vendor relationships and external service providers

 - You're passionate about creating exceptional user experiences and find fulfillment in helping others succeed

NICE TO HAVE:

 - First-hand experience building custom tools and applications to solve internal business challenges

 - Experience with zero-trust security frameworks

 - Knowledge of corporate networking fundamentals and troubleshooting

 - Familiarity with office setup and infrastructure planning

 - Direct experience with IT compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO)

 - Industry certifications related to our technology stack (e.g., Okta, Google Workspace, Cisco)

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.
