jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Anduril is seeking a Classified Platform Engineer to serve as the technical lead for our classified software team. You will design and build the platform services and user-facing applications that make multi-level classified computing possible: a virtual desktop and application broker, a policy-enforcing storage gateway, and the administrative interfaces for our access control platform. You will own them end to end, from architecture through the DevSecOps pipeline that delivers them into accredited, fully air-gapped environments, working alongside Cybersecurity, Systems Engineering, and Infrastructure Engineering.

This is a hands-on role with real technical authority. You will be the first dedicated software engineer on this team, which means you set the architecture, choose the patterns, and establish the engineering standards the rest of the team builds to. As the team grows you will lead it technically, and there is a clear path into formal technical leadership of the software function for someone who wants it.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Act as technical lead for the classified software and platform team: own the architecture of the application portfolio, set the standards the team builds to, and make the tradeoff calls.

- Design and build production web applications in React and Go that operate fully air-gapped inside accredited classified environments.

- Develop and work with S3 storage APIs and policies.

- Build the administrative and operator interfaces for our access control platform, and design the relational and distributed datastores behind authorization decisions, audit records, and application state.

- Own the DevSecOps path to production: containerize and deploy to Kubernetes through GitOps CI/CD pipelines that scan, sign, and produce the evidence our accreditations require.

- Decompose multi-quarter programs into well-scoped work other engineers can deliver independently, and grow the engineers who join the team through design review, code review, and pairing.

- Partner with Cybersecurity, Program Management, and business line stakeholders to capture requirements and translate them into a technical plan delivered on time and on budget.

 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Professional experience building and shipping production web applications with React, or a comparable modern front-end framework, and TypeScript, including interfaces for complex domains where operator workflow matters.

- Professional experience developing backend services in Go.

- Experience designing and working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or CockroachDB, including schema design, migrations, and query performance.

- Experience with containerization and container orchestration (Podman or Docker, and Kubernetes), and with GitOps and Continuous Integration / Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) pipelines in an Agile development process.

- Knowledge and experience with Linux Operating Systems (OS) such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), Rocky Linux, or Ubuntu.

- Experience leading technical work: owning a system's architecture, reviewing the designs and code of others, setting direction for a small team, and communicating clearly in design documents, tradeoff analyses, and decision records a peer can pick up and act on.

- Eligible to obtain and maintain a US Top Secret Clearance with customer's approval. May be required to obtain and maintain a DoD 8140/8570 qualifying certification.

 DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience with virtual desktop infrastructure or application and desktop brokering (e.g. Citrix, Omnissa/VMware Horizon, Leostream, Apache Guacamole, Kasm), and with virtualization orchestrated through Kubernetes such as KubeVirt.

- Experience implementing authorization systems (RBAC, ABAC, or relationship-based models), integrating applications against an external policy decision point, and Policy as Code (PaC) tools such as OPA, Oso, Cedar, or Kyverno.

- Experience with S3-compatible object storage APIs, POSIX filesystem semantics, or FUSE.

- Experience building software for air-gapped or network-isolated environments, including dependency vendoring and offline builds.

- Experience with DevSecOps supply-chain security practices including SBOM generation, artifact signing, and provenance attestation.

- Proficiency with core security concepts including encryption, authentication, identity and access management, and Zero-Trust Architecture (ZTA), plus an understanding of NIST SP 800-53 controls and their technical implementation.

- Experience with observability tooling: structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing.

- Experience as a tech lead or founding engineer on a product team, including establishing engineering practices from scratch, onboarding new engineers, and interviewing and hiring software engineers.

US Salary Range

 $167,000 - $222,000 USD

 The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

 Benefits

 At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits .

 Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:

-

 No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

- Please always verify communications:

  - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.

  - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com .

-

 Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.

-

 What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com . Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

 Data Privacy

 To view Anduril's candidate data privacy policy, please visit https://anduril.com/applicant-privacy-notice/ .

 By submitting your application, you consent to Anduril Industries using a third-party service provider to conduct pre-employment risk, integrity, and due diligence screening and assessing potential risks as part of your application process. This third-party service provider provides risk-intelligence services that may include analysis of sanctions and watchlists, adverse media, public-record information, and other lawful open-source or commercial data sources. This third-party service provider does not act as a consumer reporting agency. Use of this provider helps to ensure compliance with applicable laws and protect technology, intellectual property, and organizational security.

jobs.description:
### Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

### Responsibilities

- **Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management.** Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment.
- **Make patching predictable and safe.** Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation.
- **Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable.** Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues.
- **Build maintainable automation.** Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate.
- **Advance code-managed endpoint operations.** Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment.
- **Lead cross-functional platform improvements.** Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity.
- **Strengthen the team’s capability.** Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team.

### Requirements

- Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration.
- Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies.
- Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health.
- Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery.
- Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations.
- Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift.
- Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers.
- Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration.

### Preferred Qualifications

- Production experience with **FleetDM on Windows**, including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps.
- Practical **osquery and SQL** experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results.
- Experience with infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration, continuous integration and delivery, and migration or coexistence between endpoint-management platforms.
- Experience with **Automox, Patch My PC, or comparable tools**, and with endpoint privilege management, application control, encryption, or other security controls.
- Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments and contributing reusable automation across Windows, macOS, or Linux.

### Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to _amplify_ human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

- **Awareness:**Understand yourself and others.
- **Judgment:**Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
- **Adaptability:**Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
- **Connection:**Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this [blog post](https://www.dropbox.jobs/en/our-blog/employee-stories/the-era-of-durable-skills-what-the-data-tells-us-about-thriving-in-change/)from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

### Compensation

Canada Pay Range

$125,000—$170,000 CAD

jobs.description:
Full time
R94931

**About Us**
**Wellington Management** offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.

**About the Role**
Our Placement Internship is a year-long programme offering an exceptional introduction to the Investment Management industry. Starting in **June 2027** , the internship spans twelve months and provides opportunities across a variety of departments. You will play an integral role within your team, taking on meaningful responsibilities that contribute to delivering excellence for our clients and positively impacting millions of beneficiaries worldwide. Successful candidates will be based at our London Victoria office.

**WHO CAN APPLY**

This programme is designed for penultimate-year undergraduate students who are eager to explore a career in investment management. We welcome applications from all degree disciplines.

At Wellington Management, you’ll find opportunities across our three core platforms:

+ **Client Platform** – focused on delivering exceptional client experiences
+ **Investment Platform** – driving investment excellence and innovation
+ **Infrastructure** – enabling the firm through technology and operational expertise

There are three job advertisements, one for each platform. This advertisement relates specifically to the Client Platform.

**CLIENT PLATFORM**

**Client Group**

Includes business development, relationship management, client service, and marketing functions across all geographies and channels, including institutions, consultants, intermediaries, and wealth managers.

**Product Management**

Management of investment products across their lifecycle, ensuring they align with client needs and market trends. It acts as a strategic link between investment teams, distribution, and clients to deliver innovative, scalable, and commercially effective solutions.

**Marketing & Communications**

Responsible for the firm's editorial, communications, design, client programs, and external web efforts. The team is collectively charged with creating and implementing marketing and communication strategies that promote the firm's investment capabilities and thought leadership, foster its global brand, and drive client engagement.

**The successful candidates will:**

+ Be an undergraduate student who is eligible for a year-long industrial placement in your penultimate year of study – beginning June 2027
+ Have skills or experiences which demonstrate an interest in a career within investment management.
+ Be a highly motivated self-starter with a high intellectual curiosity.
+ Be proactive and have the humility and willingness to learn from and collaborate with their colleagues.
+ Possess outstanding interpersonal and organisational skills, be resourceful, detail-oriented, and have a strong work ethic.
+ Able to work independently, in a fast-paced and team-oriented environment, where priorities change frequently.
+ Have strong systems skills, in particular familiarity and versatility in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
+ Have foreign language skills but not required.

**HOW TO APPLY**

To be formally considered for the 2027 Placement Internship Programme, please follow the link and submit, together as one document, your CV and a 1-page maximum cover letter. In your cover letter, we’d like to hear why you are interested in the Investment Management industry, and what can you hope to gain from a year on the Placement Internship programme.

**Application Process**

Apply online > Recorded Video Interview > Team Interviews > Offers extended to successful candidates by January 2027.

Please note that we recruit on a rolling basis, so we suggest you apply early. We are only able to respond to successful applicants.

Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? That’s ok. If you believe that you could excel in this role, we encourage you to apply and welcome a chance to review your background. We are dedicated to building and maintaining a diversified workforce and considering a broad array of candidates with a variety of skill, workplace experiences, and backgrounds.

_As an equal opportunity employer, Wellington Management ensures that all qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to_ _r_ _ace, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, religion, creed, national origin, age, ancestry, disability (physical or mental), medical condition, citizenship, marital status, pregnancy, veteran or military status, genetic information or any other characteristic_ _protected by applicable law_ _._ _If you are a candidate with a disability, or are assisting a candidate with a disability, and require an accommodation to apply for one of our jobs, please email us at_ _GMWTalentOperations@wellington.com_ _._

We believe that in person interactions inspire and energize our community and are essential to our culture. In support of this commitment, our employees work from our offices 4 days a week with flexibility to work remotely 1 day a week. We believe that this approach ultimately supports our mission to deliver investment excellence to our clients and their beneficiaries over the long term.

Tracing our history to 1928, Wellington Management is one of the world’s largest independent investment management firms. We serve as a trusted adviser to clients in over 60 countries, visit our website to see our assets under management. Our innovative investment solutions are built on the strength of proprietary, independent research and span nearly all segments of the global capital markets, including equity, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternative strategies. As a private partnership whose sole business is investment management, our long-term views and interests are aligned with those of our clients. We are committed to attracting a talented and diverse workforce, and to fostering an open, collaborative culture of inclusivity because we believe multiple perspectives lead to more informed investment and business decisions. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome people with diverse life experiences, fresh ideas, and specialized subject-matter expertise. We believe that in person interactions inspire and energize our community and are essential to our culture. In support of this commitment, our employees work from our offices 4 days a week with flexibility to work remotely 1 day a week. We believe that this approach ultimately supports our mission to deliver investment excellence to our clients and their beneficiaries over the long term.

For more information, please visit https://www.wellington.com/en/ (https://www.wellington.com/en/about-us)

Job Summary: Guardian is seeking a NY Site and Executive Support Lead to join the Digital Workplace organization. This role serves as the primary technology leader for the New York and Stamford offices while delivering high-touch, white-glove support to senior executives and their administrative teams.

The position combines hands-on executive support with site ownership, ensuring a consistent, high-quality workplace technology experience across locations. The individual will act as a trusted partner to business leadership, owning the end-to-end support experience, driving service performance, and ensuring seamless execution during high-visibility and time-sensitive situations.

This role requires strong technical expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to operate calmly under pressure while maintaining the highest level of professionalism, discretion, and accountability.

Key Responsibilities
Serve as the dedicated technology partner for C-suite executives and their administrative teams, delivering white-glove, high-touch support

Act as the escalation point for complex or high-impact executive issues, driving rapid resolution with clear communication and follow-through

Provide proactive readiness support for executive meetings, including pre-checks, validation, and contingency planning

Support executives both onsite and remotely, including during travel, ensuring secure and reliable access to systems and collaboration tools

Maintain strict confidentiality and professionalism when handling sensitive executive interactions and data

Act as the primary IT point of contact for the New York and Stamford office locations

Own the end-user technology experience across the sites, ensuring alignment with enterprise standards and business expectations

Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, leadership teams, and administrative partners

Partner with Real Estate and Facilities to support workplace initiatives, office improvements, and user experience enhancements

Ensure all technology services at the site operate reliably and meet service expectations

Own ServiceNow reporting, including building dashboards and interpreting data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities

Drive performance against KPIs and SLAs, ensuring service quality meets or exceeds expectations

Perform regular ticket quality audits and hold managed service providers accountable for delivery excellence

Track and drive resolution of recurring issues through structured follow-up and trend analysis

Establish, document, and improve operational processes, standards, and runbooks

Provide advanced troubleshooting across endpoints, including Windows and Apple devices, mobile platforms, and core enterprise applications

Support virtual desktop environments such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, AWS WorkSpaces, and other VDI platforms

Maintain strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, SCCM, and Windows Autopilot

Own executive device lifecycle management, including provisioning, configuration, maintenance, refresh, and retirement

Ensure devices meet security, compliance, and performance standards

Apply a security-first mindset when supporting executives, including privileged access considerations and secure configurations

Partner with Security and Infrastructure teams to ensure executive environments align with enterprise policies

Identify and escalate risks proactively, particularly in high-visibility or sensitive scenarios

Partner with stakeholders to plan and execute workplace technology rollouts, including communications, documentation, and user enablement

Support and drive adoption of modern digital workplace capabilities, including automation and AI-enabled tools

Identify opportunities to improve the executive and end-user experience through standardization and innovation

Stay current on emerging technologies and recommend improvements aligned with business needs

Qualifications
Experience
10+ years of IT experience, with at least 5 years focused on executive support, end-user computing, or digital workplace environments

Proven experience supporting C-suite executives in a white-glove support model

Experience owning or leading technology operations for office locations or site environments

Demonstrated experience operating in high-pressure, high-visibility environments

Technical Skills
Strong experience with Microsoft 365, including endpoint management (Intune, SCCM, Autopilot)

Hands-on experience supporting virtual desktop platforms such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, and AWS WorkSpaces

Broad experience across Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and enterprise collaboration tools

Experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, including reporting and operational metrics

Solid understanding of identity and access management concepts (Active Directory / Entra ID)

Professional Skills
Exceptional customer service skills with the ability to build trust with senior executives and stakeholders

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into plain language

Ability to operate independently and make sound decisions under pressure

Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver consistently high-quality outcomes

High degree of professionalism, discretion, and attention to detail

Preferred
Experience leading or mentoring executive support or deskside teams

Background in service management, KPI tracking, and continuous improvement practices

Familiarity with tools such as Nexthink or digital experience monitoring platforms

ITIL or Lean Six Sigma experience

Reporting Relationship
Reports to the Head of End User Support within Digital Workplace / Workplace Technology.

Salary Range
$82,770.00 - $135,975.00

The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. Title: EUC Design Engineer

Hybrid

locations Minneapolis, Minnesota

time type Full time

About Our Company

We’re a diversified financial services leader with more than $1.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year-end 2024. Our team of 22,000 people across 19 countries, serves more than 3.5 million individual, small business and institutional clients. We are a longstanding leader in financial planning and advice, a global asset manager and an insurer. Our unwavering focus on our clients and strong financial foundation connects each of our unique businesses – Ameriprise Financial, Columbia Threadneedle Investments and RiverSource Insurance and Annuities. Here, we foster meaningful careers, invest in the future, and make a difference for clients, institutions and communities around the world.

Job Description

Ameriprise Financial is looking to add a EUC Design Engineer to the team! The EUC Design Engineer will support complex enterprise architectures by developing and implementing detailed design, configuration and engineering strategies/solutions for one or more technologies within assigned technical area of expertise. Ensure capability, flexibility, scalability, performance and reliability objectives are met or exceeded for a variety of small to mid-size projects. In collaboration with the team and vendor/contractor resources, ensure viable designs, flawless execution, and seamless transition into the production environment.

Job Description Summary

Support complex End User Computing (EUC) environments by developing and implementing detailed designs, configurations, standards, and engineering solutions across endpoint management, browser management, and modern workplace technologies. This role is responsible for the design, implementation, governance, and ongoing support of Windows, macOS, mobile devices, enterprise browser platforms, Microsoft Intune, and AI-enabled workplace technologies, including Microsoft Copilot. The position partners with Security, Architecture, Infrastructure, and Operations teams to deliver secure, scalable, and supportable solutions that enhance user experience, improve operational efficiency, and meet compliance requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Endpoint Engineering & Device Management

    Design, implement, and support endpoint management solutions across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms.
    Develop and maintain Microsoft Intune configurations, compliance policies, security baselines, application deployment standards, and device management strategies.
    Design and implement endpoint policies using modern management technologies and Group Policy where appropriate.
    Evaluate, test, and validate new configurations, technologies, and security controls prior to production deployment.
    Collaborate with application owners to ensure endpoint compatibility and a positive user experience.

Browser Engineering & Management

    Design, implement, and support enterprise browser management solutions for Microsoft Edge and Google Chrome.
    Administer Microsoft Edge Management Service, including policy management, reporting, governance, and operational support.
    Configure and maintain browser security controls, extension governance, authentication settings, and enterprise browser standards.
    Evaluate browser releases, policy changes, and emerging capabilities for enterprise adoption.
    Partner with Security and Architecture teams to ensure browser platforms align with enterprise security and compliance requirements.
    Troubleshoot complex browser policy, authentication, compatibility, and configuration issues.

AI & Modern Workplace Technologies

    Support the implementation, governance, and operational readiness of Microsoft Copilot and other AI-enabled workplace technologies.
    Evaluate emerging workplace technologies and provide recommendations that improve productivity and employee experience.
    Partner with Security, Risk, and Compliance teams to establish appropriate controls and governance for AI-enabled solutions.

Governance, Compliance & Operations

    Create and maintain engineering standards, technical designs, operational documentation, and support procedures.
    Monitor policy compliance and effectiveness through reporting, analytics, and management platforms.
    Participate in governance forums, architecture reviews, and technology planning activities.
    Support Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Vulnerability Management processes.
    Perform root cause analysis and implement long-term corrective actions for recurring issues.
    Support audit and compliance activities through documentation and evidence collection.

Required Qualifications

    Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent work experience.
    5-7 years of relevant engineering experience supporting enterprise endpoint technologies.
    Strong experience supporting Windows endpoint management in a large enterprise environment.
    Strong experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Endpoint Manager, Microsoft Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 technologies.
    Experience designing and implementing endpoint configuration, compliance, and security policies.
    Experience managing enterprise browser platforms, including Microsoft Edge, Google Chrome, browser policy management, extension governance, and browser security controls.
    Experience with Microsoft Edge Management Service or similar enterprise browser management technologies.
    Experience supporting macOS and mobile device management platforms.
    Experience with PowerShell automation and scripting.
    Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
    Experience working within ITIL-based operational processes including Incident, Problem, and Change Management.

Preferred Qualifications

    Experience with Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, AI governance, or enterprise AI adoption initiatives.
    Experience implementing enterprise browser governance, security, and modernization initiatives.
    Experience with Windows Autopilot and modern device provisioning.
    Experience supporting iOS and Android device management.
    Experience implementing endpoint security baselines and compliance controls.
    Experience with endpoint analytics, Digital Employee Experience (DEX) solutions, and operational reporting.
    Experience with Microsoft Defender and endpoint security technologies.
    Microsoft certifications related to Endpoint Management, Microsoft 365, Security, or AI technologies.

In-Office Collaboration

We are a client-centric, relationship-based business. Working together, in-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face-to-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least four (4) days per week, with flexibility to work from home one (1) day per week. Some roles may require additional in-office time or different in-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.

Visa Sponsorship

Applicants must have a valid work authorization that does not now, or in the future, require visa sponsorship for employment in the United States (e.g., H-1B, F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, TN).

Base Pay Salary

The estimated base salary for this role is $107,000 - 147,100. We have a pay-for-performance compensation philosophy. Your initial total compensation may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and geographical work location. In addition, most of our roles are eligible for variable pay in the form of bonus, commissions, and/or long-term incentives depending on the role. We also have a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that supports all aspects of your health and well-being, including but not limited to vacation time, sick time, 401(k), and health, dental and life insurances.

jobs.description:
Purpose and Impact:

Amentum is seeking a Top‑Secret cleared Systems Engineer to join a high‑impact team dedicated to accelerating operations through data innovation and advanced analytical insights. This mission‑driven organization leverages agile practices to deliver enhanced reporting, global search capabilities, and improved task management—supporting national intelligence priorities while ensuring the protection of sensitive data, sources, and methods.

In this role, you will help lead large‑scale data analysis efforts and contribute to the design and delivery of both on‑premises and cloud‑based applications. As a Systems Engineer, you will provide hands‑on support for daily network operations, including evaluating system utilization, monitoring performance, and serving as a primary responder for operational issues and system anomalies.

You will troubleshoot across physical and logical layers of the network—working with measurement hardware, diagnostics tools, communication protocols, and system components to identify, isolate, and resolve issues. This position also performs essential systems management and integration functions, ensuring all systems remain current with approved patches, aligned with security requirements, and optimized for mission success.

Additional responsibilities include supporting certification and accreditation activities, developing SOPs and quick‑reference guides, and advising leadership on technology investments related to processing, storage, data access, and application development. You will also help evaluate the feasibility of future projects, contributing technical insight that shapes long‑term planning and modernization.

This role offers the opportunity to work with advanced technologies, hybrid infrastructures, and mission‑critical data solutions—ideal for engineers who excel in dynamic environments and are motivated by meaningful, national‑level impact.

Work Schedule: Typically, Monday through Friday 8-hour days onsite. Flexibility within a 2-week pay period to reach 80 hours.

Essential Responsibilities:

Supervise, coordinate and/or design, develop and perform additions and changes to network hardware, infrastructure server environments, and operating systems, and attached devices, including investigation, analysis, recommendation, configuration, installation, and testing of new network hardware and software. Provide direct support in the day-to-day operations on network hardware and operating systems including the evaluation of system utilization, monitoring response time and primary support for detection and correction of operational problems. jobs.description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Senior Endpoint Engineer/Administrator (Level 3) responsible for the design, deployment, and advanced support of endpoint management solutions across a large, distributed physical and virtual device estate using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM) and Microsoft Intune in a co-managed environment. Owns application packaging, third-party patch management, security vulnerability remediation, advanced PowerShell automation, and at-scale incident troubleshooting, partnering closely with Information Security, Networking, and Support teams to keep the endpoint fleet secure, compliant, and reliable.

Key Responsibilities

Package, test, and deploy Windows and third-party applications through MECM and Intune (Win32 apps), using PSADT and other silent-install packages with reliable detection logic and dependency handling. MECM/Intune co-management experience: client settings, boundaries and boundary groups, deployment collections, Autopilot profiles, compliance policies, and configuration baselines across the enterprise endpoint estate. Design, write, and maintain advanced PowerShell scripts for automation, remediation, and reporting, including Intune and MECM. Identify, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities across the endpoint fleet in partnership with Information Security – driving CVE/patch-compliance reporting and mitigation timelines for OS and third-party applications. Third-party application patching lifecycle – identifying, packaging, testing, and deploying updates (e.g., via Patch My PC, MECM, application/patch deployment) to minimize vulnerability exposure windows. Networking knowledge (DNS, DHCP, IP addressing/subnetting, VLANs, boundary/content distribution) to resolve connectivity issues affecting client communication, application delivery, and patch distribution. Leverage AI-assisted tools (Claude, Copilot and other scripting assistants) and automation/orchestration to streamline packaging, remediation, and reporting – tracking work in JIRA and version-controlling scripts/configs in GitHub. Partner and collaborate with multiple technical teams (Architecture, Networking, Information Security, Support, etc.) to develop and support endpoint solutions. Triage and resolve escalations from Endpoint Support and Security, acting as a technical escalation point for Level 1/2 teams.
This job profile description is a standardized, non-contractual reference description and global reference tool provided for organizational consistency and talent architecture purposes across Cencora. It does not alter actual job duties, responsibilities, reporting lines, working conditions, grading, compensation, or other essential terms and conditions of employment.

Actual duties and responsibilities may vary based on business needs, local requirements, and operational practices. Where a team member's role is governed by an employment agreement, local terms and conditions, prior job description or collective bargaining agreement, those documents shall prevail in case of any inconsistency. Mandatory local laws shall also prevail.

Experience and Educational Requirements

Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or a related technology field (equivalent experience considered). At least 8 years of IT experience, including 5+ years in infrastructure/endpoint engineering. Advanced, hands-on expertise with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune, including co-management, Autopilot, compliance policies, and Win32 application deployment. Demonstrated experience remediating security vulnerabilities – identifying, prioritizing, and patching OS and third-party application vulnerabilities, including CVE triage and patch-compliance reporting (Microsoft Defender/vulnerability management tooling). Advanced PowerShell scripting ability (functions, modules, error handling, remoting, Graph API/Intune scripting), plus familiarity with VB
Script for legacy support. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex incidents at scale across large, distributed endpoint environments, with strong root-cause analysis skills. Strong application packaging experience (.MSI/.MST, Win32; App-V/MSIX familiarity a plus) using, PSAppDeployToolkit, Advanced Installer, and Orca. Experience managing third-party application patching programs (e.g., Patch My PC, Ivanti, or similar). Solid understanding of Active Directory and Group Policy for managing user/computer objects, including GPO troubleshooting (gpresult, RSoP). Working knowledge of wired/wireless networking fundamentals: DHCP, DNS, IP addressing, subnetting, and VLANs, and how they affect client-server communication and content distribution. Familiarity with Windows 11 Enterprise features, settings, and deployment; BIOS/UEFI configuration; Bitlocker and Microsoft Defender. Experience with virtualization technologies (Citrix, VMware) and thin/zero-client delivery is a plus. Solid track record of delivering thoughtful, effective, and timely solutions to complex business problems that enhance the end-user experience.

Additional / Preferred Skills

AI-assisted automation and Copilot-style tools (Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, Claude) to speed up scripting, triage, and remediation. Service-Now for Incident, request logging. GitHub (or Azure DevOps) for version-controlled scripts and Intune/MECM configuration-as-code, including basic CI/CD pipelines. JIRA (or similar) for ticketing, sprint/backlog tracking, and change management. Working familiarity with Azure AD/Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and Windows Autopatch. Experience mentoring Level 1/2 engineers and producing clear runbooks/knowledge-base documentation. ITIL foundations or equivalent incident/problem/change management experience.

What Cencora offers

We provide compensation, benefits, and resources that enable a highly inclusive culture and support our team members’ ability to live with purpose every day. In addition to traditional offerings like medical, dental, and vision care, we also provide a comprehensive suite of benefits that focus on the physical, emotional, financial, and social aspects of wellness. This encompasses support for working families, which may include backup dependent care, adoption assistance, infertility coverage, family building support, behavioral health solutions, paid parental leave, and paid caregiver leave. To encourage your personal growth, we also offer a variety of training programs, professional development resources, and opportunities to participate in mentorship programs, employee resource groups, volunteer activities, and much more. For details, visit https://www.virtualfairhub.com/cencora

Full time

Overview

CACI seeks an experienced Endpoint Engineer - InTune for a critical role supporting the United States Secret Service (USSS) contract within the Department of Homeland Security. This position strengthens federal IT infrastructure by leading modern endpoint management, cloud integration, and security automation across enterprise systems serving national security missions.You will be part of a dynamic team of Systems and Desktop Engineers and security specialists, driving the administration and evolution of Microsoft Intune, SCCM/MECM, and Azure-based endpoint solutions. As a technical leader, you'll bridge on-premises and cloud environments implementing hybrid identity solutions, automating deployments, and ensuring compliance with federal security standards while maintaining operational excellence.This role combines hands-on technical engineering (Intune policy management, application deployment, device compliance, scripting automation) with strategic leadership (designing cloud-native solutions, mentoring junior engineers, driving adoption of emerging technologies). Utilize Azure Automation and Intune to manage and secure cloud-based and on-premises Windows workstations and servers, ensuring they are patched to correct levels
Develop and maintain Azure-based system templates and images for rapid deployment
Systems Administration & Engineering

Manage and maintain Windows Server 2016/2019/2022 systems and Windows 11 PC images in both Azure and on-premises environments
Identify, analyze, and resolve system problems with both short-term workarounds and long-term cloud-based solutions
Perform expertise in MDT and SCCM including capturing images (.WIM), creating packages, advertisements, task sequences, operating system deployment (OSD), and queries
Support SCCM software packaging and patching across the enterprise
Automation & Scripting

Write advanced PowerShell scripts and leverage Azure Functions to automate systems administration tasks across cloud and on-premises environments
Develop automation solutions to customize configurations and streamline operational tasking

jobs.description:
Шукаємо фахівця/фахівчиню з практичним досвідом підтримки хмарних сервісів Microsoft у корпоративному середовищі.

Шукаємо фахівця/фахівчиню з практичним досвідом підтримки хмарних сервісів Microsoft у корпоративному середовищі. Основні завдання — керування доступами, поштою, пристроями й політиками безпеки, вирішення інцидентів та автоматизація рутинних операцій.

Про нас

 Kyivstar .Tech — українська гібридна ІТ-компанія, резидент Дія.City. Ми є дочірньою компанією Київстар, одного з найбільших українських операторів зв’язку.

Наша місія — змінювати життя в Україні та світі, створюючи технологічні рішення і продукти, що реалізують потенціал компаній і потреби користувачів.

Понад 700 спеціалістів KS.Tech щодня працюють у різних сферах: мобільні та вебрішення, а також проєктування, розробка, підтримка та технічне обслуговування високопродуктивних систем і сервісів.

Ми віримо в інновації, що дійсно приносять якісні зміни, та постійно кидаємо виклик традиційним підходам і рішенням. Кожен із нас є адептом підприємницької культури, яка дозволяє ніколи не зупинятися, розвиватися і створювати нове.

Що ти будеш робити

- Адмініструвати та підтримувати Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive for Business.

- Керувати користувачами, групами, ліцензіями, поштовими скриньками та доступами.

- Налаштовувати Microsoft Intune: керування пристроями, політиками безпеки, відповідності та розгортання застосунків.

- Адмініструвати Microsoft Entra ID: MFA, Conditional Access, ролі та інтеграції застосунків.

- Проєктувати, розгортати з нуля та підтримувати інфраструктуру Microsoft Azure, забезпечуючи безпеку, масштабованість і відмовостійкість.

- Автоматизувати адміністративні процеси та звітність за допомогою PowerShell.

- Діагностувати інциденти L2/L3, забезпечувати моніторинг сервісів, взаємодіяти з Microsoft Support та вести технічну документацію.

Яка кваліфікація та досвід необхідні

- Практичний досвід адміністрування Microsoft 365: Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Groups, shared mailboxes, mail flow, transport rules, connectors та licensing.

- Досвід роботи з Microsoft Intune: enrollment, Configuration Profiles, Compliance Policies, розгортання застосунків і troubleshooting.

- Знання Microsoft Entra ID: Users, Groups, Roles, MFA, Conditional Access, App Registrations, автентифікація, авторизація та Azure RBAC.

- Досвід побудови Azure-інфраструктури з нуля: subscriptions, resource groups, networking, Virtual Machines, Storage, monitoring, backup, security та оптимізація витрат.

- Впевнене володіння PowerShell для адміністрування Microsoft 365 та Azure, автоматизації й масових операцій.

- Досвід підтримки L2/L3, роботи з logs, Message Trace, Service Health та Microsoft Support.

- Навички підготовки технічної документації та інструкцій.

- Англійська мова на рівні B1+/B2 або вище для технічної комунікації.

- Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Azure Automation.

- Windows Autopilot, PIM, Entra Connect, Hybrid Identity.

- Microsoft Defender, Microsoft Purview.

- Active Directory, Hybrid Exchange, AD FS, PKI.

- Azure DevOps, Terraform, Infrastructure as Code (IaC).

- Досвід роботи з великими корпоративними середовищами Microsoft 365.

Що ми пропонуємо

- Офіс або ремоут — вирішувати тобі

- Ремоут онбординг

- Перформанс бонуси для всіх (річні чи квартальні — залежить від ролі)

- Навчаємо працівників: є безліч внутрішніх ресурсів і програм від партнерів, власна бібліотека

- Страхування здоров’я і життя для працівників

- Wellbeing-програма та корпоративний психолог

- Компенсація витрат на мобільний зв’язок Київстар

- Administer and configure Jira Service Management, including workflows, queues, automation rules, permission schemes, and reporting dashboards.

- Maintain desktop engineering standards, including OS imaging, application packaging, patch management, and endpoint lifecycle management.

- Provide Service Desk support as needed, including responding to tickets, triaging incoming requests, and handling first-line troubleshooting for hardware, software, and account access issues.

- Integrate AI agents into service experiences (e.g. employee chatbots, self-service tools).

- Partner with support and platform teams to identify and automate common issues.

- Analyze service data to prioritize automation impact.

- Mentor junior engineers and set standards for automation best practices.

- **Participate in day-to-day IT operations as needed**, including monitoring and actioning items in the ticket queue.

- **Perform hands-on physical tasks** (e.g., workstation setup, AV troubleshooting, hardware swaps, network equipment adjustments) as required to ensure seamless employee support.

Must have Skills & Experience:

- 6+ years of experience in Engineering and Workplace technology

- Experience with administration of Jira

- Experience working with ThousandEyes or similar tools.

- Strong scripting proficiency (Python, Bash).

- Working experience with Slack integrations, or similar tools.

- Comfortable with MDM tools (Iru) and endpoint automation (macOS).

- Solid understanding of networking, and endpoint security.

- Able to independently troubleshoot cross-system issues.

Expectations:

- Solves complex service problems using automation and AI-driven techniques.

- Takes initiative in identifying automation opportunities.

- Begins to influence team direction and standards.

In addition to a competitive base salary, this role is eligible for:

- **Annual Performance Bonus** – tied to individual performance.

- **Comprehensive Benefits Package** – including health, dental, vision, retirement savings with company match, and generous paid time off.

This role is based in London, and we ask that you’re within a commutable distance to this office, so that you’re able to come onsite regularly to collaborate across engineering teams, Monday - Wednesday. We have a hybrid work style and ask that all Engineers be onsite Monday - Wednesday during core hours (9:00am - 3:00pm*).

**About Us**

Bumble Inc. is the parent company of Bumble Date, BFF, and Badoo. The Bumble platform enables people to build healthy and equitable relationships, through Kind Connections. Founded by Whitney Wolfe Herd in 2014, Bumble was one of the first dating apps built with women at the center and connects people across dating (Bumble Date) and friendship (BFF). BFF is a friendship app where people in all stages of life can meet people nearby and create meaningful platonic connections and community based on shared interests. Badoo, which was founded in 2006, is one of the pioneers of web and mobile dating products.

**AI Fluency**

AI is important to us. We’re excited by people who are curious and experimental, and who think thoughtfully about how AI can amplify their impact and outcomes.

We encourage you to use AI responsibly as you prepare your application. Please don’t use it to fabricate experiences or answer questions live in interviews. We care deeply about authenticity and want to understand your real skills, judgment and voice, because building a meaningful, genuine connection with you matters to us.

**Final Compensation**

Will be determined based on factors such as the selected candidate’s qualifications, relevant experience, skill set, and other job-related considerations.

**Inclusion at Bumble Inc.**

Bumble Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and we strongly encourage people of all ages, color, lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, queer and non-binary people, veterans, parents, people with disabilities, and neurodivergent people to apply. We're happy to make any reasonable adjustments that will help you feel more confident throughout the process, please don't hesitate to let us know how we can help.

In your application, please feel free to note which pronouns you use (For example: she/her, he/him, they/them, etc).

**AI in Bumble Inc. Hiring**

At Bumble, we may use AI tools to support parts of our recruitment process — such as helping us record, transcribe, and summarize conversations, and supporting job alignment by comparing resumes and job descriptions to highlight skills and potential roles that may be a good match. These tools help us work more efficiently and stay focused on you during our conversations. Importantly, all hiring decisions are made by people. AI is used only to support our team’s efficiency and improve the candidate experience — not to evaluate or decide on your candidacy. Participation in AI-supported interviews and conversations is completely voluntary and will not impact your candidacy. If you’d prefer to opt out, simply let your recruiter or interviewer know at the start of a call, or anytime during the interview or conversation. Summaries and related data are retained only as long as needed in line with our internal data retention policies. If at any point you’d like a transcription or summary deleted, please contact your recruiter directly.

**Fraudulent Candidate Detection**

Our applicant tracking system analyzes signals relating to device, IP, email, and phone data associated with each application to protect applicants and our hiring process from fraudulent applications. These signals provide indicators for internal review only and do not constitute a definitive determination of identity or intent. No applicant is rejected, advanced, or otherwise affected based solely on this analysis without human review

For further information on how we hold and manage your data, please refer to our [Privacy Policy](https://bumble.com/en/candidate-privacy-policy).

jobs.description:
BKF is a multi-service infrastructure consulting firm providing civil engineering, construction management, environmental, planning, and surveying services across California, the Pacific Northwest, and beyond. With offices throughout California and the Portland area, BKF has served transportation, water resources, land development, government, and federal clients for over 110 years.

At BKF, you’ll find a unique opportunity to grow your career with intention. Our culture values professional autonomy, innovation, and meaningful collaboration across offices. We are proud to be recognized with the Great Place to Work certification for the second year in a row.

The Systems Engineer – M&A Integration executes technical integration activities associated with mergers and acquisitions. The role supports the onboarding of acquired companies into BKF’s technology environment, with a primary focus on Microsoft 365, identity, collaboration services, security controls, and related cloud technologies.

Reporting to the M&A Integration Lead and receiving technical direction from the Senior M&A Technology Integration Engineer, this position performs hands-on migration, configuration, testing, troubleshooting, cutover, and hypercare activities across multiple acquisitions each year.

The ideal candidate is a technical generalist with strong Microsoft cloud and identity experience who can work independently while following established integration architecture, standards, and migration plans.

 Responsibilities

- Execute technical integration activities for acquired companies in accordance with approved architecture, migration plans, and BKF standards.

- Perform migrations into BKF’s standard platforms, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive-to-Box migrations.

- Support migrations from Google Workspace, Microsoft 365 tenants, and other source environments.

- Execute identity and access integration activities involving Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, SSO, MFA, conditional access, provisioning, and account lifecycle management.

- Support the technical dependencies associated with endpoint deployment, including identity, Intune enrollment, application access, security policies, and user authentication.

- Support Azure and related cloud-integration activities when required, including access, permissions, subscriptions, and coordination with Cloud Operations.

- Partner with acquired-company IT teams, internal stakeholders, consultants, and vendors to gather technical information and complete integration work.

- Follow migration runbooks, cutover plans, validation procedures, rollback plans, and hypercare processes.

- Troubleshoot technical issues during migration, cutover, and stabilization.

- Support the integration of security, compliance, endpoint-protection, and IT-management platforms.

- Document source environments, migration activities, configurations, dependencies, risks, and completion status.

- Build and improve reusable integration playbooks, standards, checklists, scripts, and automation.

- Escalate technical risks, blockers, and design decisions to the Senior M&A Technology Integration Engineer.

- Hands-on experience administering and migrating Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint Online, and OneDrive.

- Experience supporting tenant, email, collaboration-platform, or other enterprise IT migrations.

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, identity synchronization, MFA, SSO, and conditional access.

- Experience with Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Configuration Manager, or a comparable endpoint-management platform.

- Experience supporting endpoint readiness, device enrollment, application deployment, and user onboarding.

- Familiarity with Azure administration, access, permissions, subscriptions, networking concepts, and cloud services.

- Ability to troubleshoot across identity, email, collaboration, endpoint, and cloud environments.

- Strong PowerShell, documentation, and technical-procedure skills.

- Ability to support multiple concurrent acquisition projects and planned after-hours or weekend cutovers.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with internal teams, consultants, vendors, and acquired-company personnel.

- Ability to work independently while escalating risks and technical decisions appropriately.

- Experience with Microsoft 365 tenant-to-tenant migrations.

- Experience migrating Google Workspace environments to Microsoft platforms.

- Experience with migration tools such as BitTitan MigrationWiz, Quest, AvePoint, ShareGate, or comparable solutions.

- Experience automating Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, or Azure activities with PowerShell.

- Familiarity with Microsoft Defender, Purview, Sentinel, or related security platforms.

- Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, carve-outs, or enterprise onboarding.

- Experience working with managed service providers, consultants, or integration vendors.

- Familiarity with ITSM, change-management, and technical project-tracking processes.

- Relevant Microsoft certifications.

Physical Demands: Must be able to regularly talk, hear and operate a computer, keyboard and mouse and occasionally lift, pull/push and carry up to 20 pounds with accommodations.

Work Conditions: Exposure to constant or intermittent sounds at a low or moderate level consistent with an office setting. Exposure to high-stress, fast-paced, deadline-oriented environment. Travel to other BKF locations and client sites may be required.

- The typical base salary range for this position is $100,000.00- $135,000.00, annualized depending upon skills, experience, education, and geographical location. This is a salary position paid biweekly.

- Competitive salaries, profit sharing, and 401k.

- Generous paid time off packages.

- 9 Paid Holidays.

- Flexible schedules.

- Education reimbursement, paid annual dues for professional and societal organizations.

- BKF offers competitive and award-winning benefits and perks. To learn more click here.

BKF provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

BKF does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement and a specific solicitation for the position or other approved engagement request for the position with BKF, BKF reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited submittals are done at the risk of the recruiter.

jobs.description:
**Company Description** We are seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused Technical Customer Success Manager (TCSM) to serve as a trusted advisor for our cyber security customers. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic customer engagement, ensuring customers maximize the value of their security investments while achieving their business objectives.

The ideal candidate possesses strong endpoint security knowledge, a startup mentality, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate complex technical challenges into meaningful business outcomes. They are comfortable engaging with stakeholders ranging from security administrators to C-level executives and are passionate about driving customer success.

**Job Description** **Job Description** **Customer Success \& Strategic Advisory**

* Serve as the primary post-sales technical advisor and trusted partner for assigned customers.
* Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including security teams, IT leadership, and executive sponsors.
* Translate technical challenges and security risks into business-focused recommendations and outcomes.
* Drive customer adoption, engagement, and long-term success through strategic account planning.
* Lead customer success reviews, executive business reviews, and ongoing strategic discussions.

**Technical Leadership**

* Provide expertise in endpoint security technologies, cyber security best practices, and security operations.
* Own the customer onboarding experience post-sale, driving structured deployment plans that accelerate time-to-value. Partner with Professional Services and Support to ensure smooth rollouts across diverse endpoint environments, minimizing risk and maximizing early adoption milestones.
* Guide customers through deployments, integrations, configuration optimization, and adoption initiatives.
* Analyze customer environments and provide data-driven recommendations to improve security posture and product utilization.
* Design and deliver enablement programs tailored to customer security teams --- including workshops, product training sessions, and guided best-practice reviews --- ensuring customers build internal competency and maximize platform utilization independently.
* Leverage Check Point's threat intelligence capabilities to provide customers with contextually relevant security guidance --- translating global threat data into actionable recommendations specific to their endpoint environment.

Maintain awareness of product roadmap developments and communicate upcoming capabilities to customers in ways that align with their security strategy and drive continued investment.

* Collaborate with Support, Engineering, Product Management, and Sales to resolve complex customer issues.

**Escalation \& Problem Resolution**

* Own and drive resolution of critical customer escalations from identification through closure.
* Act as the customer advocate internally, ensuring timely communication and accountability across teams.
* Proactively identify risks to customer satisfaction and develop mitigation plans.
* Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills when navigating technical and business challenges.

**Business Partnership**

* Partner closely with Sales teams to support account growth, retention, and customer advocacy.
* Own and report on key customer success metrics including Net Revenue Retention (NRR), product adoption rates, CSAT/NPS scores, and renewal forecasts. Use these signals proactively to identify at-risk accounts and build data-driven action plans that protect and grow the customer base.
* Use customer health metrics, adoption data, and business insights to identify opportunities and risks.
* Maintain executive-level relationships and effectively communicate value realization to business leaders.
* Contribute to customer renewal and expansion strategies through technical and business guidance, including connecting endpoint security posture to broader platform discussions spanning email security, identity, cloud, and SASE.

**Qualifications**

* 5 years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Security Engineering, Professional Services, or related customer-facing cyber security roles.
* Strong hands-on knowledge of endpoint security technologies, including EDR/EPP platforms, antivirus and anti-malware solutions, and endpoint detection and response capabilities. Familiarity with OS-diverse environments (Windows, macOS, Linux), VDI and remote workforce deployments, MDM/UEM integrations, and common endpoint attack scenarios including ransomware and supply chain threats.
* Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.
* Proven ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Experience handling high-priority customer escalations and driving cross-functional resolution.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to analyze data and use customer insights to drive recommendations and business outcomes.
* Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS Controls, and Zero Trust.
* Experience presenting to executive leadership, including CIOs, CISOs, and other C-suite stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in SaaS cyber security organizations.
* Knowledge of endpoint protection, email security, identity security, cloud security, or workspace security solutions.
* Experience supporting customers during active security incidents or coordinating with incident response teams.

**Success Profile** **The Successful Technical Customer Success Manager Is**

* A trusted advisor who earns customer confidence.
* Technically credible and business-minded.
* Data-driven in decision making and customer guidance.
* Proactive, accountable, and customer-obsessed.
* An exceptional communicator who can simplify complex technical concepts.
* Comfortable owning customer outcomes and leading through influence.

jobs.description:
**Role Description** This is a remote contract role for a Senior Data Analyst with strong MicroStrategy and MDM (Reltio) experience, and pharmaceutical industry experience is mandatory. The Senior Data Analyst will design, develop, and maintain MicroStrategy dashboards and reports to support data-driven decision-making across pharmaceutical business functions. This role will manage and optimize Reltio MDM data models, data quality rules, and governance processes to ensure accurate and trusted master data. Day-to-day responsibilities include performing complex data analysis and statistics, building data models, validating data integrity, and translating business requirements into technical specifications. The Senior Data Analyst will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, document analytical findings, and provide clear communication and insights to technical and non-technical audiences.

**Qualifications:**

* Strong analytical skills with demonstrated experience in Data Analytics to interpret complex datasets and support strategic decisions.
* Proficiency in Statistics and Data Modeling to design robust analytical frameworks, build data models, and validate data quality.
* Effective Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams, gather requirements, and present insights clearly to diverse stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience with MicroStrategy (development of dashboards, reports, and visualizations) and Reltio MDM (data modeling, data quality, and governance).
* Mandatory experience in the pharmaceutical industry, with familiarity in regulatory, compliance, and commercial or clinical data domains.
* Experience working with relational databases, SQL, and data integration tools; exposure to cloud data platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, or GCP) is beneficial.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple priorities, and deliver quality outcomes within contract timelines.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.description:
At Jamf, we believe in an open, flexible culture based on respect and trust. Our track record and thriving work environment all stem from the freedom we grant ourselves to get the job done right. We take pride in helping tens of thousands of customers around the globe succeed with Apple.

The secret to our success lies in our connectivity, while operating with a high degree of flexibility. Work-life balance remains our priority while feeling connected is important to maintain our strong culture, achieve our goals, and thrive as #OneJamf.

 What you'll do at Jamf

The Senior Manager, IT Enterprise Applications, Digital Workplace is responsible for how technology works and feels for Jamf employees. This leader connects enterprise systems into a cohesive, scalable foundation that supports productivity and cross-team collaboration. You will own the roadmap, architecture, lifecycle management, and day-to-day operations of Jamf's Service & Knowledge Management and Employee Experience platforms (currently ServiceNow and Atlassian), with the opportunity to take on additional digital workplace platforms over time. You will build and develop a team of platform administrators, developers, and technical architects, and partner with the Senior Director of Enterprise Applications on long-term platform strategy while holding decision-making authority over execution, vendor relationships, and cross-domain escalations.

 What you can expect to do in this role:

- Owns the technical roadmap, governance model, and architecture for Service & Knowledge Management and Employee Experience platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Atlassian), reducing friction and modernizing how employees get work done

- Leads, coaches, and develops a team of platform administrators, developers, and technical architects, including performance management, staffing, and career growth, in alignment with Enterprise Applications goals

- Directs platform delivery, including planning, prioritizing, and releasing new functionality and enhancements across managed systems

- Leads platform governance and steering committees, aligning stakeholders across departments on priorities, changes, and roadmap decisions

- Serves as the technical escalation point for critical service disruptions, resolving cross-domain, vendor, and competing stakeholder issues, and escalating to the Senior Director when an issue carries significant business or budget impact

- Manages vendor relationships, licensing, contracts, and budget for managed domains, tracking utilization, forecasting spend, and communicating ROI to optimize cost and prevent SaaS sprawl

- Partners with IT, Security, and business stakeholders to architect and govern integrations and automated workflows across platforms and workplace systems (e.g., IDP, HRIS, collaboration tooling, AI tooling), and advises departments on platform capabilities for new systems and major process changes

- Leads evaluation and rollout of AI-powered platform capabilities (e.g., ServiceNow Now Assist, Atlassian Rovo, Microsoft Copilot), and uses AI tools to automate manual work and improve team efficiency

 What we are looking for:

- 8+ years of experience delivering and managing enterprise applications and collaboration platforms in a complex, cross-functional IT environment (required)

- 5+ years of experience coordinating work across internal teams and external vendors, including managing SaaS budgets, contracts, and license negotiations with a focus on cost optimization and sprawl prevention (required)

- 3+ years in a formal people-management role, including hiring, performance management, and team development (required)

- Deep platform architecture experience, with hands-on configuration and administration background, in ServiceNow (e.g., ITSM, ITOM, ESM) or Atlassian (e.g., Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence) (required)

- Effective executive communication and stakeholder management skills across technical and business audiences (required)

- Experience architecting and governing complex enterprise IT platforms across more than one vendor ecosystem, with the ability to anticipate how a change in one system affects others (preferred)

- Experience building integrations and automated workflows between enterprise platforms using REST/SOAP APIs and identity providers (Okta/Azure AD) (preferred)

- Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve your own work and your team's efficiency, and evaluating AI-enabled platform features (preferred)

 EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a related field (preferred); a combination of relevant education and experience will be considered

- Relevant ServiceNow or Atlassian certification, such as ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Application Developer (CAD), or Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS), or Atlassian Certified Jira Administrator (preferred)

 What it means to be a Jamf?
 We are a team of free-thinkers, can-doers, and problem-crushers. We value humility and the relentless pursuit of knowledge. Our culture flows from a spirit of selflessness and relentless self-improvement - driving both personal growth and collective progress throughout our company. We unite around common goals while respecting personal approaches, believing that fulfilled individuals create a thriving, vibrant workplace.

Our aim is simple: hire exceptionally good people who are incredibly good at what they do and let them do it. We provide the support and resources to let everyone be their authentic, best selves at work, at rest, and at play. Above it all, waves our banner of #OneJamf – and the knowledge that when we stand together, we accomplish so much more than we could alone. We seek individuals who share this unwavering journey toward growth to join us in our quest for constant improvement.
