jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

 About the Role

As a Technical Program Manager for Corporate Engineering, you will lead programs that build world-class business solutions enabling every Ant to do their best work. In partnership with Anthropic's IT & Security organization, you will drive end-to-end solutions across the company, delivering the right products, tools, platforms, and experiences for all Ants as they work to create a world for safe and powerful AI. In the simplest terms, you build and drive solutions to enable all of Anthropic to be more productive.

You will use your technical and program management expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from start to finish. You will work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, lead execution, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You are equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to leadership as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

This role owns the full spectrum of Corporate Engineering programs: the IT systems Ants depend on daily, first-party and third-party software platforms, endpoint devices, office infrastructure, AV and collaboration equipment, network infrastructure, and the programs that scale our physical office footprint as Anthropic grows.

 Responsibilities

-

 Partner across Corporate Engineering domains to drive alignment and delivery : Work with globally distributed product, engineering, and architecture teams to foster collaboration, help teams adopt enterprise standards, and enable faster delivery with consistent practices across the organization

-

 Define and maintain core architectural foundations : Assist in establishing and maintaining the architectural standards that underpin Corporate Engineering systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security as Anthropic grows

-

 Lead office deployment and scaling programs : Own end-to-end planning and execution for new office buildouts and expansions, coordinating across IT, Facilities, Security, and external vendors to deliver fully operational workspaces on schedule

-

 Own internal systems and infrastructure programs : Drive programs for all internal systems and hardware deployed in Anthropic buildings, including network infrastructure, AV equipment, printing and collaboration hardware, and building technology integrations

-

 Lead endpoint and device management programs : Own global programs for corporate laptops, mobile devices, and endpoint management, ensuring Ants have secure, well-managed devices that enable productivity from day one

-

 Drive IT Operations excellence : Lead programs that improve IT service delivery, support operations, and the overall Ant experience with technology, driving continuous improvement in reliability and responsiveness

-

 Manage enterprise software and platform programs : Lead programs for the 1P and 3P software platforms Ants depend on, including HR systems, productivity tools, and business applications, from evaluation through deployment and ongoing optimization

-

 Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders : Work closely with Security, Facilities, People, Finance, and functional teams across Anthropic to ensure Corporate Engineering programs meet diverse organizational needs

-

 Communicate effectively at all levels : Comfortable communicating across all levels of Anthropic from presenting analyses, recommendations, and program status to leadership, engaging deeply on technical tradeoffs with engineering teams, and communicating broadly to the entire company

 You May Be a Good Fit If You Have

-

8+ years of experience in IT, Corporate Engineering, or Enterprise Technology, with at least 4+ years leading complex, cross-functional programs

-

Technical background in enterprise IT systems, including endpoint management, identity and access management, network infrastructure, and SaaS platforms

-

Experience leading office buildout or infrastructure deployment programs, coordinating across IT, Facilities, and external vendors

-

Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager or similar role in a technology-focused environment, with a track record of leading company-wide programs to successful completion

-

Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for executive audiences and engage credibly with engineers on technical details

-

Ability to manage ambiguity and drive clarity in fast-paced, evolving environments where requirements and priorities shift

-

Strong collaboration skills with proven ability to partner across diverse stakeholders including IT, Security, Facilities, People, Finance, and functional teams

 Strong Candidates May Also Have

-

Experience scaling IT infrastructure in high-growth technology companies

-

Background in IT service management (ITSM) frameworks and continuous improvement methodologies

-

Experience with enterprise software evaluation, procurement, and vendor management

-

Familiarity with modern endpoint management platforms and zero-trust security architectures

-

Experience with AV systems, video conferencing infrastructure, and collaboration technology deployments

-

Prior technical experience as an IT engineer, systems administrator, or network engineer

-

Experience with IT programs in AI/ML research environments or organizations with unique security and compliance requirements

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

 $290,000 - $365,000 USD

 Logistics

 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

 How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description:
**About the role**

We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Professional Services Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will work closely with clients to understand their unique technical requirements, diagnose issues, and provide effective solutions. Your ability to dive into log files, troubleshoot complex problems, and debug issues will be essential in delivering exceptional consulting services. By leveraging your technical expertise and industry knowledge, you will ensure successful implementation, configuration, and integration of our product, while providing training and support to enable clients to maximize the value of our solution.

**What you'll do**

- Take charge of the implementation and configuration process, ensuring the seamless integration and successful deployment of Cyberhaven’s solution within clients’ existing environments.

- Foster close collaboration with clients to gain a deep understanding of their technical requirements, diagnose issues, and create customized dataset and policy solutions.

- Utilize log file analysis, debugging techniques, and advanced troubleshooting to identify underlying causes of complex technical problems and coordinate effective resolutions with our Support, Engineering, and Operations teams.

- Work in close partnership with cross-functional teams, including developers, project managers, and support staff, to deliver high-quality solutions that adhere to timelines.

- Deliver technical training to end users, empowering them with the necessary knowledge and skills to maximize the utilization of Cyberhaven to optimize their workflows and expedite ROI.

- Serve as a trusted advisor to clients, offering strategic guidance, best practices, and insights to help them derive the maximum value from our product.

- Conduct regular progress updates, status meetings, and post-implementation reviews with clients to ensure their satisfaction or identify areas for improvement, serving as the internal and external point of contact for client escalations.

- Collaborate with the development and support teams, promptly escalating and resolving technical issues or system discrepancies to maintain smooth operations for clients.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in our product offerings, continuously enhancing your technical expertise to provide valuable insights and guidance to clients.

**Who you are**

- 3+ years of Solutions Engineer, Delivery Manager, or Professional Services with Endpoint Security experience required in the Cybersecurity and DLP Space:

  - Proven track record of delivering complex technical solutions, preferably in a Professional Services or Consulting role, specifically with endpoint security products.

  - Previous experience with other DLP solutions such as Forcepoint, Symantec, McAfee DLP, Fortra (Digital Guardian), Trend Micro, Check Point, Next DLP, or Proofpoint.

  - Understanding of data classification methodologies and techniques to effectively identify sensitive data types and define appropriate DLP policies.
- Project Management: Ability to manage and deliver against strict timelines, requiring constant prioritization and mitigation strategy-building.

- Deep technical background, with hands-on experience in supporting and troubleshooting SaaS-based security and/or endpoint agent technologies.

  - Software debugging skills

  - Knowledge of web technologies, APIs, and data integration techniques.

  - Solid understanding of system architecture, network protocols, and Google Cloud Platform.

  - Practical knowledge of the MacOS (e.g., MDM, app management, basic terminal skills) and Windows (SCCM, GPO, Intune, registry configuration, understanding PowerShell scripts, etc.) ecosystems.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, allowing one to easily convey technical concepts to diverse stakeholders and build relationships cross-functionally.

- Knowledge of system software design (services, drivers, agents).

- Experience with AI Agent use and creation (Claude Code, Glean, Monday etc)

- Education and Certifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent advanced industry certifications, or 3+ years of experience in a similar role.

- **Candidate location preference:** Central or Eastern timezones

Joining Cyberhaven means joining the team building Data Security for the Agentic Enterprise. Traditional tools fall short. Cyberhaven traces the full lifecycle of your data, adapting protection to changing context, so protection moves with the way people actually work, not against it. AI Changed Work. We Protect It.

Backed by $250M from leading investors like Khosla and Redpoint, our team includes leaders who built industry-defining technologies at CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, Meta, Google, and more. This role lets you shape the future of data security, working alongside people driven to protect workflows, not just data, for customers who cannot afford to slow down to stay safe.

**AI Tools Disclosure:** As part of Cyberhaven's hiring process, we use recruiting tools that include AI-powered features to help with tasks like scheduling, note-taking, workflow automation, and other recruiting activities ("AI Tools"). The AI Tools may process information you provide during the application and interview process. When AI-assisted interview note taking is used, candidates are notified in advance and have the option to opt out of the AI-assisted interview note taking.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status._

Job Description

Make an impact at DTCC

The DTCC IT EDGE Program offers accelerated professional development opportunities for recent university graduates. This 18-month rotational initiative enables Analysts to enhance both technical and leadership capabilities through practical work experience and a comprehensive training curriculum.

Additionally, the program features regular networking sessions that facilitate exposure to senior leaders across the organization. Dedicated managers are available to provide ongoing coaching and support throughout the duration of the program.

At DTCC, we help power the global financial markets by providing critical infrastructure that supports the safe and efficient processing of securities transactions. In this role, you will learn how your business area contributes to that broader mission while building practical skills through meaningful work, coaching, and structured development.

About the EDGE Program

EDGE is DTCC's 18-month early-career development program for recent graduates. The program combines hands-on business experience, structured learning, mentorship, networking, and regular feedback to help analysts build technical, functional, and leadership capabilities.

What you will gain

 A structured onboarding experience, including Welcome Week and program orientation.

 Hands-on experience through meaningful work aligned to business priorities.

 Rotational experiences across relevant teams/functions.

 Monthly learning sessions, business education, professional development, and opportunities to hear from leaders and subject matter experts.

 Regular feedback, including a 90-day feedback and assessment milestone, manager coaching, and program check-ins.

 Mentorship, networking, and opportunities to build relationships across DTCC.

What you will do

Role Responsibilities

 Assist in the engineering, implementation, maintenance, and support of enterprise infrastructure platforms across distributed, mainframe, networking, database, private cloud, and public cloud services.

 Support automation, monitoring, observability, and reliability initiatives that improve platform stability, operational efficiency, scalability, resiliency, and secure delivery.

 Collaborate with infrastructure engineers, application teams, operations teams, architecture, cybersecurity, and other cross-functional stakeholders to troubleshoot issues, validate solutions, and support technology delivery.

The Endpoint Engineer is responsible for managing and supporting enterprise endpoint devices, including desktops, laptops, tablets, and mobile devices. They are the customer-facing, go-to resource for endpoint management, deployment, maintenance, and support at their assigned location. They provide Tier III support for complex technical issues, administer endpoint management platforms, and partner with other IT teams on technology initiatives.  Manage endpoint deployment, configuration, and lifecycle activities using Microsoft Intune and related technologies. Deploy and maintain operating system, application, and security updates across the enterprise. Provide Tier III support for escalated software, hardware, and networking issues. Assist with testing, deployment, and troubleshooting of new hardware and software solutions. Support Cisco conference room technologies and collaboration tools. Maintain accurate hardware inventory and asset records. Support enterprise printer environments, including laser and thermal printers. Create and maintain technical documentation and knowledge base articles. Assist with training and knowledge transfer for Service Desk personnel. Participate in a rotating on-call support schedule.  Education: Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science, related field, or six (6) years of equivalent work experience. Minimum six (6) years of experience supporting Windows desktop operating systems and enterprise endpoint environments. Strong knowledge of Windows OS administration, Active Directory, Group Policy, BitLocker, Microsoft Office, PowerShell, SCCM/MECM, and MDT. Experience managing endpoint deployments, software distribution, patching, and device administration at enterprise scale. Experience with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365 administration, and Azure-based endpoint management. Experience working with RMM platforms and IT service management tools; ServiceNow experience preferred. Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and problem-solving skills. Exceptional customer service, communication, and time management skills. Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information. jobs.description:
The Lead Endpoint Cybersecurity Engineer is a senior technical engineering role responsible for the design, deployment, maintenance, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of enterprise endpoint cybersecurity technologies. The engineer will provide deep technical leadership across endpoint security platforms and their supporting infrastructure, ensuring security applications are stable, performant, effectively integrated, and capable of operating at enterprise scale.

The position builds on the existing internal Endpoint Engineering charter, which describes responsibilities for designing, deploying, maintaining, and optimizing endpoint security solutions across the enterprise. The existing Senior Endpoint Cybersecurity Engineer requirement similarly emphasizes endpoint-security solution design and deployment, EDR and deception technology, detection tuning, technology evaluation, incident-response collaboration, architecture, and mentoring.

This role will have two strategic deployment responsibilities:

Enterprise Deception Framework: Lead the endpoint-engineering activities required to deploy, integrate, validate, operate, and optimize the company's enterprise cyber deception capability. AI Detection and Response (AIDR): Lead endpoint engineering and technical implementation activities associated with evaluating and deploying an endpoint-based AI Detection and Response capability designed to identify and respond to emerging AI and agentic-AI threats.
Key Responsibilities and Duties:

Serve as a technical lead for enterprise endpoint cybersecurity technologies across Windows, macOS, Linux, VDI, and server environments as applicable. Design, configure, deploy, maintain, upgrade, and troubleshoot endpoint cybersecurity applications and agents. Provide senior-level break/fix and problem-management support, including root-cause analysis for application failures, agent health issues, policy conflicts, deployment failures, integration failures, and endpoint instability. Perform application lifecycle activities including upgrades, configuration changes, policy tuning, regression testing, deployment validation, and rollback planning. Develop technical standards, runbooks, operating procedures, implementation documentation, and support documentation. Identify opportunities for automation through scripting, APIs, configuration-management platforms, and other engineering mechanisms. Troubleshoot agent installation, upgrade, communication, policy, interoperability, and stability issues. Coordinate complex incidents with cybersecurity, infrastructure, desktop engineering, vendors, and application owners. Identify conflicts between existing and proposed cybersecurity agents. Perform stability, coexistence, upgrade, rollback, failure-mode, and regression testing. Document findings and provide technical go/no-go recommendations before production deployment. Establish performance monitoring following initial deployment waves. Engineer the endpoint components of the Deception Framework across supported workstation and server populations. Perform proof-of-concept and production-readiness testing. Validate deceptive files, credentials, registry artifacts, sessions, processes and related endpoint lures as appropriate to approved use cases. Test failure conditions and confirm endpoint stability when deception components are unavailable or impaired. Validate integration of Deception telemetry with enterprise security monitoring and response systems. Support deployment waves and troubleshoot installation, communications, configuration, and endpoint-side operational issues. Develop deployment procedures, engineering standards, configuration documentation, troubleshooting guides, and operational runbooks. Assist with tuning and continuous improvement following production deployment. Ensure endpoint implementation adheres to architecture, privacy, security, change-management and production-safety requirements. Validate integration with existing EDR/XDR, SIEM, SOAR, identity and security operational workflows. Conduct controlled performance testing to quantify CPU, memory and other endpoint overhead.

As a customer service–focused organization, we provide centralized services, specialized support, and practical solutions to state agencies, boards, and commissions, as well as local governments across Montana. Our vision is to transform how government services are delivered and accessed, serving state government with effective, efficient, and customer‑driven solutions that benefit all Montanans.

The State Information Technology Services Division's (SITSD) mission is to provide shared IT services to support the needs of the state and citizens of Montana. We offer an innovative and collaborative work environment where employees are valued and supported. In addition, our employees have the opportunity to be involved in some of the most exciting and innovative IT projects and initiatives in development within Montana state government.

What is this career opportunity?

Help make technology work better for the people who serve Montana.

Do you enjoy solving complex technical problems, helping teammates succeed, and improving the technology people rely on? Desktop Services is seeking a collaborative, customer-focused Endpoint Administrator to serve as a technical lead across the State of Montana enterprise. You’ll bring both technical depth and a people-first mindset. You know that behind every ticket or enterprise solution is a person trying to do important work.

In this role, you will solve complex endpoint and desktop-service problems, identify and address recurring issues, guide and mentor support staff, and collaborate with IT teams, vendors, and agency customers. You will help advance enterprise endpoint strategy through planning, implementation, deployment, and modernization initiatives across the State of Montana.

Desktop Services delivers the tools and technology state employees rely on to serve the public each day. As a technical lead, you will help shape the customer experience, strengthen operational reliability and security, and improve the services that support their work.

  Active Directory concepts and services, including domains, organizational units, accounts, groups, Group Policy, authentication, permissions, replication, and access troubleshooting.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

As a Distinguished Engineer for Endpoint Engineering, you will be the chief architect and technical authority for Palo Alto Networks’ access agent platform. You will own the unified architectural vision across our core endpoint clients including GlobalProtect, Prisma Access Agent, ADEM, and many others spanning Windows, macOS, Linux, iOS, and Android.

In this high-visibility role, you will lead the evolution of our endpoint portfolio from distinct product agents into a unified, high-performing platform foundation. By establishing shared networking, IPC, core application logic, and observability layers, you will ensure that every capability and performance optimization built in one agent automatically powers them all. Furthermore, you will define how endpoint software is engineered in an AI-native world embedding automated defect verification, intelligent telemetry analysis, and smart crash triage into our global release pipeline.

This is a high-leverage "build-the-foundation" role with direct executive sponsorship, a clear evidence-backed mandate, and an organization ready to execute under your vision.

About the Role As a SCCM & Intune Migration Engineer, you will make an impact by driving enterprise endpoint modernization initiatives and leading the migration from traditional Microsoft SCCM/MECM environments to Microsoft Intune and cloud-based endpoint management solutions. You will be responsible for assessing current-state infrastructure, designing migration strategies, implementing co‑management and cloud‑native device management, and supporting large-scale device transformation programs. You will collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, Azure, Active Directory/Entra ID, Networking, Service Desk, Desktop Engineering, and Application teams to deliver secure, scalable, and modern endpoint management services.
 In this role, you will Assess existing SCCM/MECM environments, including infrastructure, device management, application deployment, software updates, compliance policies, security controls, and operational processes.

Develop and execute the migration strategy and roadmap for transitioning from SCCM/MECM to Microsoft Intune and cloud-based endpoint management.

Design the target‑state endpoint management architecture leveraging Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Entra ID, Windows Autopilot, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, and related Microsoft cloud technologies.

Configure and manage SCCM‑Intune Co‑management and oversee the transition of endpoint management workloads from SCCM to Intune.

Lead the migration of device configurations, compliance policies, security baselines, applications, scripts, software updates, and endpoint security controls to Intune.

Implement Microsoft Entra ID Join/Hybrid Join and Windows Autopilot solutions to support modern device provisioning and lifecycle management.

Perform application compatibility assessments and develop remediation strategies for applications requiring modernization or repackaging.

Plan and execute pilot deployments, migration waves, and phased device migrations while minimizing business disruption and operational risk.

Establish migration governance, standards, risk management processes, and success metrics to support enterprise migration objectives.

Develop KPI reporting, migration dashboards, and executive‑level status reporting to track migration progress, compliance, risks, and operational readiness.

Create architecture documentation, solution designs, runbooks, SOPs, migration procedures, rollback plans, and operational handover materials.

Collaborate with Infrastructure, Security, Azure, Network, Service Desk, Desktop Engineering, and Application teams throughout the migration lifecycle.

Lead knowledge transfer, post‑migration hypercare, operational stabilization, and transition activities for support teams.

Strong expertise with Microsoft SCCM/MECM, Microsoft Intune, and SCCM‑Intune Co‑management.

Strong PowerShell scripting, automation, and troubleshooting skills.

Experience with application packaging, deployment, software distribution, and patch management.

Strong communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and solution design skills.

 These will help you stand out Experience designing enterprise‑scale endpoint management and Modern Workplace architectures.

Experience with KPI reporting, executive communications, hypercare management, and operational transformation.

jobs.description:
Dunhill Government Solutions is hiring an Intune Engineer to support the Endpoint Engineering Lead in modernizing a federal agency's Microsoft Intune endpoint management platform. This is a hands-on, mid-level engineering role: working to the Lead's direction and established standards, you will build, test and implement the policy, provisioning and application delivery changes that move the organization from an Active Directory-anchored, co-managed estate to a cloud-native, Intune-first one. Hybrid in Washington, DC, two days per week on site.

Responsibilities:

Cloud-native join transition: assist with the migration from Hybrid Entra ID join to Entra-native join, including pilot testing, device object cleanup, cutover steps and identifying on-premises dependencies
Group Policy migration: review the AD GPO estate, translate settings into Intune settings catalog and ADMX-backed policy, test for conflicts and MDM-versus-GPO precedence, and document retired GPOs
Legacy dependency remediation: rework domain-dependent services for cloud-native endpoints (logon scripts, mapped drives, print, local admin passwords, Kerberos-dependent applications and file shares)
Provisioning and packaging: configure Windows Autopilot profiles and Enrollment Status Page settings; convert the SCCM catalog into Intune Win32, winget and Enterprise App Catalog deployments with detection rules, dependencies and supersedence
Update management: deploy Windows quality and feature updates and Microsoft 365 Apps updates, including ring design, channels, deferrals, deadlines, expedited releases and rollback
Policy and security: build configuration, compliance and certificate profiles (SCEP/PKCS, PIV smart card, 802.1X, VPN); apply NIST, CIS and STIG baselines; support Conditional Access, CDM reporting and patch compliance against federal Binding Operational Directives
Automation: author PowerShell for packaging, detection, remediation and reporting; use the Microsoft Graph API for bulk operations and drift detection
Follow Intune releases and Message Center posts, test changes in a pilot ring, maintain runbooks and documentation, and provide escalation support for complex endpoint issues

Required qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
3-5 years in enterprise endpoint management, including at least 2 years of hands-on Microsoft Intune work beyond day-to-day console administration
Familiarity with Hybrid Entra ID join and cloud-native Entra join; working knowledge of Active Directory Group Policy
Building Intune policy with the settings catalog and ADMX-backed profiles; Windows Autopilot configuration and troubleshooting
Application packaging, including Intune Win32 packages with detection and requirement rules
Deploying Windows quality and feature updates; familiarity with Microsoft 365 Apps update channels
Entra ID dynamic and assigned groups, Conditional Access and device identity; working PowerShell scripting
Familiarity with NIST, CIS or STIG hardening frameworks
Able to work a hybrid schedule with two days per week on site in Washington, DC
US citizen (no dual citizenship, per agency requirements)

Preferred: Federal, DoD or similarly regulated environment experience, including GCC High tenants; hands-on Hybrid-to-cloud-native join migration or SCCM-to-Intune catalog conversion; certificate delivery via SCEP or PKCS and PIV smart card authentication; Windows LAPS in Entra ID, Windows Hello for Business cloud Kerberos trust and Universal Print; Group Policy analytics; federal PKI (derived PIV, NDES / Certificate Connector, Microsoft Cloud PKI); Intune Suite and Defender for Endpoint; Recast Software, PSAppDeployToolkit, Patch My PC or similar tooling.

Location: Washington, DC — hybrid (two days per week on site).

US Citizenship and the ability to pass a federal background investigation in order to be granted access to sensitive information.

Compensation: $86,000 - $113,000 per year

jobs.description:
## **Who are we?**

At Finastra, we’re a global leader in financial services software, dedicated to expanding access to financial services and shaping what’s next for the industry. Our technology powers mission‑critical solutions across Lending, Payments and Universal Banking, supporting over 7,000 customers, including 80% of the world’s top 50 banks, in more than 110 countries.

We are seeking a Senior Client Platform Engineer to join our Workplace Technology team. This role will serve as a senior technical engineer and subject matter expert responsible for the engineering, security, automation, and lifecycle management of Finastra's endpoint platforms and services across the organization.

The successful candidate will drive the strategy, modernization, and operational excellence of endpoint technologies supporting Windows, macOS, iOS, and other client platforms. While a significant focus of this role will be on Apple technologies and their continued adoption across the enterprise, the engineer will also support broader endpoint management, security, compliance, and user experience initiatives.

Working closely with Endpoint Security, Security Engineering, Service Management, and Support teams, you will play a key role in shaping the future of endpoint management, device security, workplace automation, and modern end-user computing services.

This role is ideal for an experienced endpoint engineer who combines deep Apple expertise with broad endpoint management, security, and automation capabilities.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Platform Ownership**

- Serve as a senior technical owner for enterprise endpoint platforms, with primary accountability for Apple technologies and support for the broader endpoint ecosystem.
- Define platform standards, engineering best practices, governance models, and technology roadmaps.
- Drive platform modernization initiatives focused on automation, security, operational efficiency, and user experience.
- Evaluate emerging endpoint technologies and provide recommendations for adoption.
- Act as a senior escalation point and subject matter expert for endpoint management technologies and services.

**Endpoint Management & Device Lifecycle**

- Manage the lifecycle of enterprise endpoint devices, including Windows, macOS, iOS, and mobile platforms from enrollment through retirement.
- Design and maintain automated provisioning, deployment, and device management processes.
- Support hardware refresh programs, lifecycle governance, and platform standardization initiatives.
- Ensure a secure, reliable, and consistent user experience across endpoint platforms.

**Endpoint Management Platforms**

- Administer and engineer enterprise endpoint management technologies including Microsoft Intune, IRU (formerly Kandji), Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM), Apple Business Manager, compliance policies, software distribution, and automated device enrollment.
- Develop scalable management frameworks supporting global endpoint deployments.
- Optimize device compliance, reporting, software distribution, and operational workflows.
- Support coexistence and modernization initiatives across endpoint management platforms.

**Operating System & Application Management**

- Plan, test, and deploy operating system updates and major releases across Windows and Apple platforms.
- Package, deploy, and manage enterprise applications.
- Maintain application compatibility and supportability across endpoint environments.
- Develop deployment standards, release management processes, and endpoint configuration baselines.
- Partner with business and technology teams to support application modernization initiatives.

**Security & Compliance**

- Implement and maintain endpoint security baselines and compliance standards.
- Partner with security teams to support vulnerability management, remediation, and endpoint risk reduction initiatives.
- Support deployment and management of enterprise security tools across endpoint devices.
- Assist with regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements while ensuring alignment with corporate security policies and standards.

**Identity & Access Management**

- Support integration between endpoint platforms and enterprise identity services.
- Manage integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access, and device compliance policies.
- Support modern device identity, Zero Trust, and secure access initiatives.

**Automation & Engineering**

- Develop automation solutions using scripting, APIs, and platform-native capabilities.
- Build proactive remediation, self-healing, and operational automation solutions.
- Integrate endpoint management platforms with enterprise systems and workflows.
- Develop reporting and operational dashboards to support platform management and decision-making.

**Operational Excellence & Governance**

- Monitor endpoint health, security, compliance, operational performance, and user experience metrics.
- Drive continuous service improvement, automation, and platform maturity initiatives.
- Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, architecture diagrams, and operational procedures.
- Participate in audits, governance reviews, technology assessments, and platform roadmap planning.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

- 5-7+ years of experience engineering and managing enterprise endpoint platforms.
- 4+ years of hands-on Apple platform administration and engineering experience.
- Experience with Microsoft Intune, Kandji, Jamf, or comparable endpoint management platforms.
- Strong understanding of Windows and Apple device management within enterprise environments.
- Experience managing endpoint security, compliance controls, vulnerability remediation, and device lifecycle services.
- Experience supporting operating system management, software deployment, and endpoint update management.
- Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
- Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity and security services.
- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred**

- Experience with Apple Business Manager and Automated Device Enrollment.
- Experience integrating Apple devices with Entra ID and Conditional Access.
- Experience with Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management practices.
- Experience supporting enterprise security tooling and vulnerability management programs.
- Experience within highly regulated and global enterprise environments.
- Apple, Microsoft, or endpoint management certifications.
- Experience supporting cloud-first workplace and endpoint modernization initiatives

We are proud to offer a range of incentives to our employees worldwide. These benefits are available to everyone, regardless of grade, and reflect the values we stand for:

**Flexibility:** Enjoy unlimited vacation, subject to local regulations and business priorities. Benefit from hybrid working arrangements and inclusive policies such as paid time off for voting, bereavement, and sick leave.

**Well‑being:** Access confidential one‑to‑one support through our Employee Assistance Program, connect with our network of Wellbeing Champions and Gather Groups, and take part in monthly events and initiatives designed to help you thrive—inside and outside of work.

**Career Development:** Access online learning and accredited courses through our Skills & Career Navigator tool.

**Recognition:** Take part in our global recognition program, Finastra Celebrates, and share your voice through regular employee surveys that help shape our culture and ways of working.

*Specific benefits may vary by location.

At Finastra, each individual is unique—bringing their own ideas, perspectives, cultural backgrounds, and experiences. We learn from one another, value what makes us different, and create an environment where everyone feels included, supported, and able to be their authentic selves.

jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

OpenAI’s Client Platform Engineering team builds and operates the platforms that make employee devices secure, reliable, and easy to use. Our work spans device posture and trust, onboarding, application delivery, operating-system updates, fleet telemetry, and employee-facing remediation. We partner with Security, IT, Research, Applied, and specialized engineering teams to reduce friction while protecting OpenAI’s systems and data.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Client Platform Engineer, You will build and own agentic solutions that automate OAI fleet operations and reduce employee friction, with measurable outcomes and reliability. You will develop first-party software, integrate commercial and open-source tools, and own changes from design and testing through deployment and production operations. Your work will improve security, reliability, and the employee experience.

We’re looking for people who are passionate about automation, endpoint security, and building scalable solutions that improve employee experience. You should have deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets at scale, with strong software engineering skills to automate security controls and fleet operations across environments with different compliance requirements. Your problem-solving mindset and attention to detail will be key to success in this role.

In this role, you will:

Build the platforms that help employees do their best work on devices they can trust.

 - Own the design, development, deployment, and operation of secure Linux endpoint management systems across environments with different compliance requirements.

 - Create magical employee experiences by building agentic workflows with OpenAI products and models that use fleet telemetry to anticipate issues, guide remediation, and design friction out of everyday work.

 - Make new hires productive from day one, using OpenAI products to simplify device setup, software delivery, and onboarding support.

 - Build secure, reliable workflows with scoped access, human review for sensitive changes, traceable actions, and tested recovery.

 - Partner with IT, Security, Research, and Engineering to deliver consistent Linux provisioning, updates, and support alongside macOS and Windows.

 - Develop first-party software and integrate commercial and open-source tools for software packaging, deployment, and application management.

 - Manage fleet configuration as code through GitOps, version control, peer review, and automated validation.

 - Build and operate CI/CD pipelines for fleet infrastructure across Azure, AWS, and GCP, with staged deployments and tested rollback.

 - Use fleet telemetry to proactively improve performance and reliability, detect configuration drift, and verify deployment outcomes.

 - Participate in engineering on-call, own incident resolution, and turn operational lessons into lasting improvements that reduce recurring failures and manual work.

YOU MAY BE A FIT FOR THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - Proficiency in Python, Go, or another modern programming language.

 - Deep experience securing and managing Linux fleets with configuration management, MDM, device enrollment, policy enforcement, and cloud identity integration.

 - Demonstrated success with open-source endpoint tools for configuration, device and application management, and telemetry.

 - Experience delivering secure, reliable, scalable systems across different compliance requirements.

 - Deep experience managing infrastructure at scale with IaC and GitOps, using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, and Chef.

 - Experience integrating and operating fleet infrastructure with CI/CD and DevOps workflows.

 - A track record of deploying and operating fleet infrastructure in public cloud environments (Azure, AWS, GCP).

 - Initiative, analytical judgment, and the ability to turn problems into practical improvements.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - Deep experience with open-source fleet management tools and frameworks.

 - Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

 - Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, and NIST.

 - Strong soft skills, including stakeholder communication and cross-functional collaboration.

 - Relevant professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP.

 - A security thought leader with contributions to CPE open-source projects or technical communities.

About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations.

jobs.description:
Join us in delivering a great first living experience to more than 21.000 students

* Xior\*\* is the largest owner \& operator of student accommodation in continental Europe. Our mission is to give as many students as possible a great first living experience. We offer a second home to more than 21.000 students in Belgium, the Netherlands, Germany, Poland, Spain, Portugal, Denmark and Sweden. A place where they can live, study, connect and relax.

We want to do more than just provide infrastructure for our students. We believe we play a fundamental role in students' journey to independence. The right people are essential in this.

Would you like to contribute to this as Operations Assistant in one of our best residences in Madrid (Villaviciosa de Odón).

We are looking for a dynamic, versatile operations assistant, who is eager to join one of our best student residence with more than 540 rooms and the activity this entails. You will be working in an educational environment, with an exclusive package of services and accommodation in an exceptional location.

**Your Responsibilities**

* You are the (first) face of our reception at the student residence
* You take care of our customer service; you help students at the counter, by mail, and over the phone
* You manage reservations and therefore the check-in and check-out process. You provide our students with the necessary keys and cards
* You accompany visitors and future clients during open days, a tour of the facilities, etc.
* You support the administration office
* You monitor the building and take care of coordination between the different departments (cleaning, catering, maintenance \& gardening)
* You apply the necessary protocols in emergencies

**Your Working Conditions**

* Permanent contract - 40h a week
* Rotating morning or afternoon shifts from Monday to Sunday ( bank holidays), with 2 days off per week
* Salary of 1.800€ gross per month
* You will be working in our residence in Campus UEM - Villaviciosa de Odón, Madrid

**Your Skills**

* Studies in relation to Hospitality Industry, Tourism, and Business Administration (formative degrees, diplomas...) will be positively valued
* You speak Spanish, as well as English
* You know how to work with MS Office
* You have some interest and knowledge of costumer service, social networks and new technologies

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to make an impact in a fast-growing, dynamic company that is the leader in the student accommodation sector in continental Europe.
* You will help build the future by working with and for the student generation.
* Opportunities for further development and (international) growth.
* Pleasant workplace in Madrid with a fun, dynamic team
* An attractive, competitive salary complemented by numerous additional benefits

jobs.description:
Founded in Silicon Valley in 2009 by Marc Andreessen and Ben Horowitz, Andreessen Horowitz (aka a16z) is a venture capital firm that backs bold entrepreneurs building the future through technology. We are stage agnostic . We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI , bio + healthcare , consumer , enterprise , fintech , frontier , games , and companies building toward American dynamism . a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

 We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

 The Role

 We’re hiring a Senior IT & AI Platform Engineer to build, deploy, and operate enterprise systems, AI applications, and cloud infrastructure that help teams across a16z execute with speed, confidence, and security. You’ll lead complex technical deployments, serve as a trusted technical escalation point for stakeholders, manage privileged access across critical systems, and reduce friction through reliable automations and self-service workflows.

 This is a hands-on role within the IT Systems team, working closely with Cybersecurity, Engineering, Product, Data, and other business units across the firm. On a typical day, you’ll be orchestrating multiple AI coding agents, managing AWS or GCP infrastructure, and guiding a business unit to deploy a custom vibe-coded application. You’ll be expected to take on complex, often ambiguous or urgent requests, understand what’s needed, and deliver outcomes that are secure, well documented, and easy to support.

 This role requires an in-office presence 3 days a week in either our San Francisco, CA or Menlo Park, CA office.

 To join our team, you should be excited to:

- Take ownership of the firm's toughest IT challenges around AI deployments, making consequential technical decisions and building lasting solutions that teams across a16z depend on

- Co-own the technical implementation of new enterprise systems and emerging AI applications, including evaluating, testing, and deploying new capabilities securely and at scale

- Identify opportunities to reduce manual toil and build automations across the entire IT organization

- Partner with business teams and internal builders to turn ideas into working applications—from early prototypes through deployment, hardening, and ongoing support

- Build and operate AWS and GCP infrastructure

- Partner with Cybersecurity to protect sensitive data and manage privileged access across AI, SaaS, cloud, endpoint, and internal systems

- Work with internal stakeholders to support Databricks and cloud AI services, including workspace configuration, service principals, access controls, and operational monitoring

- Serve as a trusted technical escalation point for cybersecurity, engineering, data, and other business units. Work with stakeholders to untangle complex problems and find a clear path forward

- Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis to restore service and prevent future issues across the firm’s enterprise systems

- Maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and decision records, and share knowledge to help the IT team operate more effectively

 Minimum Qualifications

- 8 years of experience in platform engineering, systems administration, cloud infrastructure, or IT engineering, with responsibility for production systems

- A power user of advanced AI workflows, going beyond such tools as ChatGPT/Codex, Claude Code, Wispr Flow

- Experience transforming IT operations by leveraging AI

- Experience deploying AI applications with enterprise systems and data, including SSO, provisioning, integrations, permissions, administrative controls, and staged rollouts

- Experience shipping internal applications or tools from prototype to production, including authentication, API integrations, deployment, and ongoing support

- Hands-on AWS and GCP experience, including IAM, networking, application hosting, storage, and logging, plus infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Pulumi

- Experience administering or supporting Databricks, including workspaces, service principals, permissions, and monitoring, in partnership with data engineering teams

- Experience administering modern enterprise infrastructure and SaaS ecosystems such as Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, GitHub, Jamf, Intune, and cloud-native environments

- Experience building maintainable automations and API integrations using code and low-code/no-code platforms, with version control, testing, monitoring, and safe deployment practices

- Ability to diagnose complex problems across enterprise systems, infrastructure, identity, and integrations, and weigh security, reliability, cost, and user experience when choosing solutions

- Experience making changes to production systems with adequate testing, monitoring, rollback plans, and responding effectively when things go wrong, and communicating appropriately throughout.

- Low ego, high empathy: you listen to different perspectives, question your assumptions, and use evidence to find the best solutions

- High agency: you take initiative, manage priorities, navigate ambiguity, collaborate effectively, and proactively communicate progress, risks, and blockers

 The anticipated salary range for this role is between $221,000 - $258,000 actual starting pay may vary based on a range of factors which can include experience, skills, and scope.

 This role is eligible to participate in the a16z carry program and various discretionary bonus programs as well as benefit and perquisite plans including health, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, 401K plan, vacation, and sick leave.

  a16z culture

- We do only first class business and only in a first class way

- We take a long view of relationships, because we are in the relationship business

- We believe in the future and bet the firm that way

- We are all different, we recognize that, and we win

- We celebrate the good times

- We do it for the team

- We play to win

 At a16z we are always looking to hire the absolute best talent and recognize that diversity in our experiences and backgrounds is what makes us stronger. We hire candidates of any race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, Veteran status, and any other status. These differences are what enables us to work towards the future we envision for ourselves, our portfolio companies, and the World.

 Our organization participates in E-Verify. Click here to learn about E-Verify.

 Andreessen Horowitz hereby reserves the right to make use of any unsolicited resumes received from outside recruiting agencies and / or individual recruiters without being responsible for payment of any fees asserted from the use of unsolicited resumes.

jobs.description:
**What We Do:**

Cybercrime is growing, and more businesses are getting hit by threats that used to target only the biggest organizations. That pushes defenders like us to operate at the highest level, and it deepens our need for good people who want to make a meaningful impact.

Founded in 2015 by former NSA cyber operators, Huntress is a remote-first team working to make enterprise-grade cybersecurity accessible to businesses of all sizes. We work closely with security teams and service providers protecting complex environments, often without the time or headcount to handle it all. That’s why we build our technology in-house and back it with a 24/7 human-led Security Operations Center (SOC). As a result, our platform is never disconnected from the experts who manage it, ensuring our customers' protection.

Huntress now secures more than 6M endpoints and 16M identities worldwide. Those numbers keep growing because more businesses rely on us to help carry the load and operate with more confidence. Every day, you can see that commitment in how we stand with our customers and how we show up for each other.

**Reports to: Manager, IT Solutions Engineering**

**Location: Remote US**

**Compensation Range: $130,000 to $140,000 base plus bonus and equity**

**What You’ll Do:**

As a Senior IT Automation Engineer on the IT Solutions Engineering team, you will shape how Huntress uses automation and AI to work smarter, move faster, and scale securely. You will own the strategy and operating model for our Automation and Agentic AI Center of Excellence, turning tools such as Claude, Glean, Zapier, and related platforms into practical systems that improve how teams get work done.

You embrace continuous improvement by testing what has the most leverage, learning quickly, and improving the patterns that scale. You find friction before it becomes someone else’s problem and owning the path from idea to adoption. You measure success by the operational impact, security, and value your systems create across Huntress.You’ll work side by side with the rest of the IT Solution Engineering team and automation engineering peers to accomplish your work.

**Responsibilities:**

- Lead cross-functional initiatives that use automation to improve operational scale, employee experience, and business execution.
- Own the enterprise automation and integration stack, including Zapier and connected business systems, while ensuring performance, maintainability, and security alignment.
- Establish and operate the Automation and Agentic AI Center of Excellence, including standards, governance, documentation, intake, and prioritization practices.
- Build reusable frameworks, templates, libraries, and design patterns that help enable self service and deliver reliable solutions faster with more consistency.
- Represent IT with Internal Innovation to collaborate on AI adoption, feature enablement, and governance.
- Design modular, resilient integration patterns and automation pipelines with secure data handling, role-based access control, and least-privilege principles built in.
- Analyze operational inefficiencies, identify high-value opportunities, and deliver data-informed recommendations and roadmaps to leadership.
- Re-engineer meaningful parts of the operational layer with AI, using tools such as Claude and Glean to create reusable workflows that preserve human judgment, security, and measurable outcomes.

**What You Bring To The Team:**

- You have 7+ years of experience in automation engineering, systems integration, or a similar technical leadership role, with experience on or partnering closely with IT teams.
- You have set automation strategy, translated organizational goals into practical roadmaps, and guided initiatives from concept through adoption.
- You have hands-on experience with enterprise workflow platforms, API-based integrations, and Microsoft tooling such as Azure, Entra, and Intune, along with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript scripting and version-controlled delivery practices.
- You understand SaaS security, identity and access management, credential protection, privacy-aware data handling, and the risk assessment of new integrations.
- You can diagnose root causes, weigh automation against manual processes, and make clear decisions about where standardization creates the most value.
- You communicate technical trade-offs clearly with engineers, business partners, and executive stakeholders, and you can guide teams toward maintainable solutions.
- You have re-engineered workflows with AI and can design reusable systems that let tools such as Claude and Glean run meaningful parts of the operational layer while keeping human judgment, security, and measurable outcomes in the loop.

**What We Offer:**

- 100% remote work environment - since our founding in 2015
- Generous paid time off policy, including vacation, sick time, and paid holidays
- 12 weeks of paid parental leave
- Highly competitive and comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits plans
- 401(k) with a 5% contribution regardless of employee contribution
- Life and Disability insurance plans
- Stock options for **all** full-time employees
- One-time $500 reimbursement for building/upgrading home office
- Annual allowance for education and professional development assistance
- $75 USD/month digital reimbursement
- Access to the BetterUp platform for coaching, personal, and professional growth

_Huntress is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where every single member of our team is valued, has a voice, and is empowered to come to work every day just as they are._

_We do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status._

_We do discriminate against hackers who try to exploit businesses of all sizes._

**Accommodations:**

_If you require reasonable accommodation to complete this application, interview, or pre-employment testing or participate in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to_ [_accommodations@huntresslabs.com_](mailto:accommodations@huntresslabs.com) _. Please note that non-accommodation requests to this inbox will not receive a response._

__Huntress uses artificial intelligence tools to assist in reviewing and evaluating job applications, including resume screening, skills assessment, and candidate matching and comparisons. These AI tools support our human recruiters in the initial review process, but do not make final hiring decisions without human involvement. By submitting your application, you acknowledge this use of AI in our recruitment process. Please review our [Candidate Privacy Notice](https://trust.huntress.com/?item
Uid=47f0a941-b86f-4864-a0d0-a224a34cfd57&source=click) for more details on our practices and your data privacy rights.__

jobs.description:
Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart

The Opportunity As a Senior Systems Engineer in our End User Computing division, you will take ownership of our global digital workplace infrastructure, ensuring seamless and secure experiences for our workforce. Your primary technical purpose is to design, implement, and automate advanced endpoint management solutions across macOS, Windows, and Linux environments. You will architect robust device lifecycle processes, integrate cutting-edge AI tools, and solve complex endpoint challenges. By driving zero-touch provisioning and maintaining stringent security postures, you directly empower our teams to operate efficiently and support Nutanix’s broader mission of making hybrid multicloud simple.

About the Team You will be joining the Digital Workplace Experience and Apps team, a specialized engineering sub-group dedicated to evolving how Nutanix employees interact with their technology daily. Our team thrives on a culture of technical mentorship, autonomy, and collaborative problem-solving, moving beyond traditional IT support to function as true platform engineers. We are a tight-knit group that values proactive automation over reactive firefighting, fostering a supportive environment where diverse perspectives drive innovation. We prioritize continuous learning and empower every engineer to own their solutions from end to end.

In this role, you will report directly to Huy Nguyen, Manager of EUC Engineering. Huy is known for a leadership style that emphasizes hands-on mentorship, strategic trust, and career development. He empowers his team to make critical architectural decisions and provides the necessary air cover to focus on deep engineering work rather than administrative overhead. Under his guidance, you will have the autonomy to build impactful automation and the support to grow your technical expertise across complex, enterprise-scale environments.

This position requires 0% travel. Your focus will be entirely on engineering, automating, and maintaining our core endpoint computing platforms from your primary hybrid workspace without the burden of regional travel requirements.

Your Role

- Manage and architect advanced endpoint management platforms, primarily Microsoft Intune and Jamf Pro.

- Drive process automation utilizing API integrations and scripting to enable zero-touch provisioning and automated patching.

- Enforce and manage stringent security compliance standards, including the deployment and oversight of FileVault and BitLocker.

- Administer and integrate workflows within ServiceNow to streamline end-user experiences.

- Serve as the definitive Tier 2/3 escalation point for complex, systemic endpoint challenges.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years of dedicated experience in End User Computing or Systems Engineering.

- Proven expertise in administering and architecting solutions within Microsoft Intune and Jamf Pro.

- Strong proficiency in scripting and API integrations for process automation (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python).

- Demonstrated experience managing OS security features such as FileVault and BitLocker.

- Ability to diagnose and resolve complex, Tier 3 architectural issues across macOS and Windows environments.

Learn More About the Technology: [https://www.nutanixbible.com/](https://www.nutanixbible.com/)

**The pay range for this position at commencement of employment is expected to be between USD $104,000 and USD $208,000 per year.**

Work Arrangement Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Vancouver, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager

--

jobs.description:
Endpoint Administrator - (26142580)

    Why should you keep reading and consider working here?

  As a customer service–focused organization, we provide centralized services, specialized support, and practical solutions to state agencies, boards, and commissions, as well as local governments across Montana. Our vision is to transform how government services are delivered and accessed, serving state government with effective, efficient, and customer‑driven solutions that benefit all Montanans.

  The State Information Technology Services Division's (SITSD) mission is to provide shared IT services to support the needs of the state and citizens of Montana. We offer an innovative and collaborative work environment where employees are valued and supported. In addition, our employees have the opportunity to be involved in some of the most exciting and innovative IT projects and initiatives in development within Montana state government.

   What is this career opportunity?

  Help make technology work better for the people who serve Montana.

  Do you enjoy solving complex technical problems, helping teammates succeed, and improving the technology people rely on? Desktop Services is seeking a collaborative, customer-focused Endpoint Administrator to serve as a technical lead across the State of Montana enterprise. You’ll bring both technical depth and a people-first mindset. You know that behind every ticket or enterprise solution is a person trying to do important work.

  In this role, you will solve complex endpoint and desktop-service problems, identify and address recurring issues, guide and mentor support staff, and collaborate with IT teams, vendors, and agency customers. You will help advance enterprise endpoint strategy through planning, implementation, deployment, and modernization initiatives across the State of Montana.

  Desktop Services delivers the tools and technology state employees rely on to serve the public each day. As a technical lead, you will help shape the customer experience, strengthen operational reliability and security, and improve the services that support their work.

     Qualifications

   What are we looking for?

    Education and Experience:

     Associates Degree in an IT field; AND

     Two years of desktop support applicable experience; OR

     Alternate combinations of education and experience will be considered on a case-by-case basis.

     Competencies:

   Knowledge of:

     Advanced troubleshooting methods for endpoint, desktop, application, hardware, software, connectivity, configuration, deployment, and customer-impacting issues.

     Endpoint management concepts and tools, including device configuration, software deployment, operating system deployment, patching, compliance, and remote support.

     Active Directory concepts and services, including domains, organizational units, accounts, groups, Group Policy, authentication, permissions, replication, and access troubleshooting.

     Desktop virtualization and virtual desktop infrastructure concepts, including virtual desktop and hosted application delivery, user profiles, device access, session performance, remote connectivity, and user support.

     Networking protocols and concepts relevant to endpoint support, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, wired and wireless connections, basic routing, network ports, and tools for diagnosing connectivity issues.

     Network access control concepts and practices, including user and device authentication, permissions, certificate-based access, device compliance, network segmentation, secure remote access, and troubleshooting access restrictions.

   Ability to:

     Install, configure, troubleshoot, maintain, and update desktop hardware, operating systems, software, and peripherals.

     Use endpoint management, remote support, software deployment, and patching tools to support devices across multiple locations.

     Resolve complex desktop, application, and deployment issues using sound judgment, structured troubleshooting, and appropriate escalation.

     Provide technical guidance, coaching, and escalation support to Tier II Desktop Support staff and other IT teams.

     Take initiative, set priorities, and follow complex issues through resolution and documentation.

     Communicate clearly, professionally, and respectfully with customers, IT teams, leaders, and stakeholders at all levels.

     Explain technical concepts, risks, progress, and recommendations in plain language for nontechnical audiences.

     Plan, test, deploy, document, and support enterprise desktop service changes and modernization efforts.

     Foster a culture of strong partnerships, shared accountability, and continuous improvement across Desktop Services and partner teams.

   Please tell us how and why by submitting your resume, cover letter, (Please Note: You do not need to complete the “work experience” or the “education & certifications” portion of the application process in our recruiting system. You only need to upload the requested documentation.)

APPLICANTS MUST BE LOCAL TO PITTSBURGH, PA

No 3rd Parties/Sub Vendos

Location: Hybrid in Pittsburgh., PA (3 days onsite, 2 days remote)

Job Type: 1 year Contract

Work Authorization: U.S. Citizen or Green Card Holders Only

Overview:

The A.C.Coy company has an immediate opening for a Microsoft Windows Client Engineer. Ideal candidates must have 3- 5 years of experience engineering and administering Microsoft Windows endpoints in an enterprise environment. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and SCCM/Configuration Manager including application packaging and deployment is also required.

Responsibilities:

The Windows Client Engineer will manage and modernize the Windows endpoint estate through Microsoft Intune and SCCM (Configuration Manager), with a primary focus on driving down vulnerability risk. This is a hands-on engineering role: partner closely with the security team to review findings from Tenable, translate them into deployable fixes, and build the packages, scripts, and configuration baselines that remediate them at scale.

Review outstanding vulnerabilities identified by Tenable Nessus / Tenable Security Center and own the endpoint-side remediation workflow from finding to closure
Build, test, and deploy remediation packages and solutions using Intune and SCCM — application updates, patches, registry and configuration changes, and scripted fixes
Author and maintain remediation scripts (PowerShell), including detection and remediation logic for Intune proactive remediations and SCCM configuration items
Package and deploy third-party application updates that fall outside standard Microsoft patching (e.g., via Win32 apps in Intune, application deployments in SCCM, or a patching tool like PatchMyPC)
Manage Windows Update policy through Windows Update for Business / WSUS / SCCM software update groups, and ensure patch compliance reporting is accurate
Partner with the security/vulnerability management team to triage findings, validate that deployed fixes actually clear the vulnerability, and provide feedback on false positives
Track remediation progress and report on compliance, patch coverage, and outstanding risk against SLAsMaintain configuration baselines and security hardening (e.g., CIS/DISA STIG alignment) across the Windows client fleet
Support co-management, device onboarding, compliance policies, and conditional access as part of the broader Intune/SCCM environment
Document remediation procedures and contribute to a repeatable, well-tested deployment process to avoid breaking production

Education:

Bachelor's degree - Required

Certifications:

Microsoft MD - 102, SC - 200, or CompTIA Security+ - Preferred

Responsibilities:

Experience engineering and administering Windows endpoints in an enterprise environment - 3-5 years
Hands-on experience with both Microsoft Intune and SCCM/Configuration Manager, including application packaging and deployment
Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation, detection, and remediation
Experience with Windows patch management (Windows Update for Business, WSUS, or SCCM software updates)
Familiarity with vulnerability management concepts and tooling — Tenable experience strongly preferred; comparable tools (Qualys, Rapid7) also relevant
Understanding of CVEs, CVSS scoring, and how vulnerability findings map to real remediation actions
Solid grasp of Windows OS internals, Active Directory, Group Policy, and Entra ID (Azure AD)
Ability to test changes carefully and roll out fixes without disrupting end users
Experience with application packaging tools (PSADT, PatchMyPC) and MSI/MSIX - PreferredExposure to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and its vulnerability management (TVM) integration - PreferredKnowledge of security hardening frameworks (CIS Benchmarks, DISA STIGs) - Preferred
