As we create a colorful, capable and cleaner world through chemistry, we invite you to join our team to harness the power of chemistry to shape markets, redefine industries and improve lives for billions of people around the world.

End User Computing Engineer

CREATING ESSENTIAL CHEMISTRY THE WORLD NEEDS

At Chemours, our people are redefining how the world thinks of chemistry by approaching everything we do with a commitment to delivering Trusted Chemistry that creates better lives and helps communities thrive. That begins with how we use our science, data, and unmatched technical expertise to develop market-leading products with the highest levels of performance, sustainability, and safety in the industry.

Powered by chemistry, our products are used in applications that make the products we rely on, processes, and new technologies possible. In key sectors such as clean energy, advanced electronics, high-performance computing and AI, climate friendly cooling, and high-quality paints and coatings for homes and industrial infrastructure, sustainable solutions and more modern living depend on Chemours chemistry.

Chemours is seeking an experienced End User Computing Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This position may be based at various Chemours US locations; candidates located within 50 miles of any Chemours US location will enable close collaboration with IT and business teams.

This role will manage and continuously improve Chemours' enterprise endpoint capabilities. The engineer will deliver secure, reliable, and user-focused computing services across the device lifecycle.

The responsibilities of the position include, but are not limited to, the following:

• Engineer, administer, and continuously improve enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune.

• Design and support co-management and cloud-native endpoint strategies for Windows, iOS, and Android devices, including Microsoft Intune integration with Apple Business Manager and Android zero-touch enrollment.

• Design and support Windows Autopilot provisioning to streamline device deployment and employee onboarding.

• Build, test, deploy, and maintain applications, packages, task sequences, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and security baselines.

• Plan and execute operating system feature updates, monthly patching, driver and firmware updates, and endpoint lifecycle activities.

• Partner with cybersecurity, infrastructure, service delivery, and application teams to remediate vulnerabilities and meet endpoint security and compliance requirements.

• Monitor platform health, capacity, deployment success, and compliance; analyze data to identify trends and drive continuous improvement.

• Troubleshoot complex endpoint, deployment, policy, application, and device-enrollment issues, and provide technical leadership during escalations.

• Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft endpoint-management roadmaps, recommended architectures, security guidance, and modern engineering practices, and incorporate them into enterprise standards and solutions.

• Develop and maintain engineering standards, technical documentation, operational procedures, and knowledge resources for support teams; serve as an L2/L3 escalation point for complex issues and provide technical leadership through resolution.

The following is required for this role:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

• 3+ years of experience engineering or administering enterprise end user computing and endpoint management services.

• Advanced hands-on experience with Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Intune, including application and package deployment, software updates, collections, reporting, operating system deployment, and client health.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Group Policy, identity-based access controls, endpoint security, and vulnerability remediation.

• Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

The following is preferred for this role:

• Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Endpoint Analytics, Windows Update for Business, and certificate or configuration management.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager, Android zero-touch enrollment, and iOS and Android device enrollment, automated deployment, configuration, compliance policies, application deployment, security controls, and lifecycle management.

• Experience administering and managing enterprise endpoint privilege management and remote support tools, including policy configuration, access governance, operational support, and reporting.

• Experience using PowerShell to automate endpoint administration, reporting, and remediation.

• Experience integrating endpoint tooling with IT service management, asset management, or reporting platforms.

• Microsoft certification aligned to endpoint administration, security, or Azure technologies.

• Experience providing technical leadership for endpoint modernization, tenant migration, or large-scale device transformation initiatives.

Serve as a technical leader and modern solution evangelist, advocating for the practical adoption of AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools across the firm, in partnership with the firm's broader network of technology champions
Lead innovation by identifying and delivering automation solutions that eliminate manual work and unlock employee capacity
Drive business process automation through hands-on consulting, Power Platform development, and self-service enablement

Contributors to your success:

3-5+ years of experience in a similar role, with a demonstrated track record of building automation solutions and driving technology adoption.
Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into automated solutions.
Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), with the ability to champion adoption alongside the wider Digital Workplace Services team.

#### Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

#### Job Description

We are seeking a proficient M365 Engineer with specialized knowledge in Microsoft Intune Autopilot, Mobile Device Management (MDM), and Mobile Application Management (MAM), The ideal candidate will play a key role in Implementing and refining autopilot including creation of deployment profiles, deployment of key applications and the migration of GPOs to compliance policies. Additionally, this role involves providing advanced support for M365 services as they pertain to our end users and devices

This is a hybrid position, based out of our Allen, TX office. You will report to the head of Endpoint Management.

You will have opportunity to:

- Implement and enhance Microsoft Intune and Autopilot solutions for endpoint management and device provisioning.
- Configure device compliance policies and migrate legacy Group Policy settings to modern management controls.
- Deploy, manage, and maintain applications, updates, and endpoint configurations across managed devices.
- Support endpoint security initiatives, including Microsoft Cloud PKI, application control policies, and device compliance standards.
- Monitor device health, inventory, and Microsoft 365 service performance to ensure reliable user experiences.
- Create reports and insights using Microsoft Graph and other Microsoft 365 management tools.
- Develop and maintain automation solutions using Azure Automation, Logic Apps, Functions, and scripting tools.
- Troubleshoot endpoint management, security, and Microsoft 365 issues while supporting security assessments and remediation efforts.

#### Qualifications

- 7+ years of experience in endpoint management and endpoint security.
- Experience administering Microsoft Intune for device management, application deployment, compliance, and security policies.
- Experience implementing and managing Windows Autopilot, including end-to-end zero-touch deployment configurations.
- Experience creating and maintaining automation solutions using Azure Automation Runbooks and Azure Logic Apps.
- Experience using PowerShell or similar scripting languages for automation, configuration, and administration.
- Knowledge of Windows operating systems, endpoint security controls, and security best practices.
- Experience creating technical documentation and operational procedures.
- Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Microsoft 365 Enterprise Administrator Expert certifications preferred.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. jobs.description:
Gracia101 is looking for an **MDM Consultant**on behalf of a global organization based in Barcelona.

This role is responsible for designing and maintaining Master Data Management (MDM) processes within their area, ensuring these processes meet business needs while promoting consistency across the organization. The role holder will ensure MDM processes remain aligned with company policies and the broader operating model, and will act as the key point of contact with IT and MDM Technical Solutions teams to implement and support MDM solutions.

**This opportunity may also be a good fit for professionals interested in working on a freelance basis.**

Key accountabilities:

* Design Master Data Management processes in own area. Ensure processes are compliant to group Policies and DoAs. Ensure MDM processes fulfil the needs of --and are validated by --process stakeholders,
* Ensure all owned processes are documented according to standards. Support audits (ISO certifications, customer audits..),
* Support M\&A and IT projects (such as ERP implementation) by defining adequate Master Data setup and processes,
* May lead work packages for solution implementation projects (including running design workshops)
* Interface with MDM Technical Solutions to implement technical solutions in Informatica,
* Interface with IT to implement technical solutions in backend SAP systems.
* Engage with MDM Services for implementation of process or solution changes.
* Define cleansing rules with data owners for ensuring owned data readiness for transformation projects
* Provide third level support to MDM Services teams (what to do if not in the books)
* Follow-up on MDM continuous improvement initiatives in own area.
* Ensure continuous dialogue with process stakeholders and MDM Services teams to nourish continuous improvement process.
* Keep documentation and data assets (data catalog) up-to-date for own area

Education \& Experience:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT, Engineering or Business administration or equivalent professional experience
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in Master Data Management
* Fluent in English (written and spoken)
* Experience in a multinational company / exposure to diverse cultures

Critical competencies:

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with demonstrated intellectual and analytical rigor
* Strong SAP expertise, in particular regardingmaster data objects in own area
* Proficient in process modeling and design
* Good communication and presentation skills.

**If you are ready to help shape the future of global master data and bring together business processes, SAP and MDM technology, we would love to hear from you.**

* Expert level experience within End Point Protection Engineering.

* Expertise in MECM and Intune.
*
* Expert in patch management including bios and firmware updates, service pack upgrades, and application-based updates.
*
* Basic Database Administration experience, particularly in SQL Server.

**Must Have Skills**

* Azure Virtual Desktop
* Microsoft Azure
* Microsoft Intune
* Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI)
* Windows 11

jobs.description:
#### Company Description

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#LI-Hybrid

#### Job Description

We are looking for an Endpoint Security Engineer to own the security of Nexthink’s corporate endpoint estate: roughly 1,200 devices (550 macOS, 650 Windows) managed through Microsoft Intune and Jamf. You will turn endpoint security from a set of point controls into a measurable, continuously improving program covering what runs on our devices, how quickly we patch them, and how we prove it to auditors.

This is a hands-on role at a pivotal moment, as we build out a dedicated security function. Your first priorities include application baselines and allowlisting, a formal application lifecycle from approval to removal, and stronger vulnerability and compliance posture across both platforms. As a company that sells digital employee experience, we expect security that protects people without getting in their way.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Hardening**

- Define and maintain security baselines for macOS and Windows (CIS or equivalent), delivered through Intune and Jamf.
- Own hardening standards: disk encryption, firewall, local admin removal and privilege management.
- Evaluate endpoint security tooling and steer vendors while keeping internal ownership of design.

**Application Control & Software Governance**

- Design and roll out application allowlisting using MDM-native capabilities and/or tools such as Santa, with developer-friendly exception models for Engineering and Product.
- Build and maintain the software and binary inventory: discover, classify and risk-rate applications, and define baselines from the results.
- Run remediation campaigns for unauthorized or high-risk software, from communication to uninstallation and verification.
- Operate the application lifecycle process end to end: request, security review, deployment, monitoring and retirement.

**Vulnerability & Patch Management**

- Own endpoint vulnerability management: scanning, risk-based prioritization and remediation tracking against SLAs.
- Define patching and update rings for OS and third-party applications with EUC across macOS and Windows.
- Drive remediation of critical and zero-day vulnerabilities and report on exposure and performance to Security leadership.

**Zero Trust & Data Protection**

- Partner with IAM and Security to enforce device compliance and device trust in Conditional Access.
- Support endpoint data protection controls (e.g. Microsoft Purview DLP, USB and removable media controls) and hardware-backed authentication such as passkeys and security keys.

**Compliance & Reporting**

- Document endpoint controls and maintain automated evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and ITGC audits.
- Turn security posture into clear metrics for IT leadership, Security and Finance.

**Automation & Digital Employee Experience**

- Automate security operations with PowerShell, Python, shell scripting, Microsoft Graph and the Jamf and Intune APIs.
- Use Nexthink’s own DEX platform to measure endpoint health and the employee impact of security changes, and build self-service remediation to reduce tickets.

**Primary Metrics**

- Device compliance and security baseline adherence (macOS and Windows)
- Mean time to remediate critical and high vulnerabilities, against SLA
- Patch and OS currency against SLAs
- Application control coverage and share of unclassified binaries
- Unauthorized or high-risk application count, and time to remediate
- Standing local admin count
- Endpoint-related audit findings and evidence automation coverage
- Employee experience impact of security controls (Nexthink DEX score)

#### Qualifications

- 5+ years in endpoint security, security engineering, or end-user computing with a strong security focus.
- Hands-on experience securing macOS and Windows at scale with Microsoft Intune and Jamf (or equivalent).
- Practical experience with vulnerability management tooling, prioritization and remediation workflows.
- Experience with application control and allowlisting (MDM-native controls, Santa, AppLocker, WDAC or similar).
- Strong knowledge of OS security and hardening frameworks (CIS, NIST, Apple platform security).
- Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Zero Trust applied to devices.
- Scripting skills in PowerShell, Python or Bash; familiarity with REST APIs and Microsoft Graph.
- Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2 or ITGC controls and audit evidence.
- Ability to work with Engineering and Product teams and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
- Nice to have: DEX tools experience, Microsoft Purview, or certifications (e.g. MD-102, SC-300, Jamf Certified, GIAC, CISSP, Security+).

**_Please apply with a copy of your CV in English._**

#### Additional Information

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers’ IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees ‘Nexthinkers’ and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

- 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
- 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
- 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR .
- 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work.
- 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
- 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
- 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare & public transportation.
- 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English & Spanish classes.
- 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, and soft drinks in the office.
- 🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
- 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

jobs.description:
### **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

### About the role

Anthropic's Corporate Systems team runs the core collaboration platforms everyone here works in and builds the tooling and automation behind IT. That responsibility extends to the companies we acquire. Their people, devices, and systems have to come into Anthropic securely.

You'll own the IT side of Anthropic's acquisitions: due diligence, integration planning, and integration. Before close, you'll assess a company's IT environment and give the deal team a clear read on risk and effort. You'll define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, what has to be ready on day one, and how each security gap gets closed. After close, you'll carry out that plan and bring the company's people, devices, and systems onto our stack. This is a hands-on engineering role. You'll hold admin, write code, build automation, run the cutovers yourself and bring in other teams when the work calls for their expertise or support. You'll lead this work for IT Engineering and partner with Security, Corporate Development, Legal, People, and Finance at every stage.

M&A will be your primary focus and responsibility, but you'll be a full member of the Corporate Systems team; taking part in planning and reviews, using and contributing to the team’s tooling, and contributing to the roadmap. Early on, M&A will be most of your work, including using Claude to automate the repeatable parts of diligence and integration. As that automation matures, and when M&A load is light, you'll contribute to other parts of the team’s roadmap.

### Responsibilities

- Lead technical IT due diligence: assess a company's identity, applications, endpoints, and infrastructure, and brief the deal team on risk and effort before close
- Find the gaps between an acquired environment and Anthropic's security model, rate them, and build the mitigations into the integration plan
- Define the technical integration plan and its requirements: what moves, where it lands, in what order, and what has to be ready on day one
- Run the integration: take over administration, migrate people, devices, and data, and retire what's no longer needed, with support from other IT Engineering teams as required.
- Work with Business Technology, Client Platform, Corporate Network, IT Operations, and Security on their parts of each integration
- Keep Corporate Development, Legal, People, Finance, and the acquired company's team clear on where IT stands
- Build a repeatable IT M&A playbook and automate as much of it as possible with Claude
- When M&A work is light, contribute to core Corporate Systems projects

### You may be a good fit if you have

- 8+ years as a hands-on engineer in corporate IT. You have designed and shipped systems, carried out migrations or integrations yourself, and owned at least one area end-to-end, with experience supporting other areas: identity, applications, endpoints, or corporate infrastructure
- Experience administering enterprise identity and collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace, Slack, and an SSO provider, and working code in Python or similar against their SaaS APIs
- Working knowledge of endpoint management and security concepts, enough to lead diligence on an unfamiliar fleet
- A proven ability to understand an unfamiliar IT environment quickly and deliver a prioritized view of risk to non-specialists
- A record of leading technical projects that span several teams and run to a fixed date, while doing much of the engineering yourself
- Comfort working autonomously, with ambiguity and confidential information
- Clear communication with executives, legal and corporate development teams, and engineers at acquired companies

### Strong candidates may also have

- Prior M&A, carve-out, or company-to-company migration experience
- Experience across the full stack: endpoints, systems, applications, and infrastructure
- Hands-on experience managing a device fleet or running an MDM
- Experience working in or alongside a security team
- A record of building tooling that replaces manual IT work
- Using Claude or similar tools as a core part of how you work

### Representative projects

- Assess an acquired company's IT environment that nobody here has seen and produce a prioritized integration plan within days
- Design a way to size integration effort and risk for a company of any shape or size
- Automate bringing acquired people and devices onto Anthropic's identity and device management
- Write the IT risk memo for a live deal and present it to Corporate Development and Security leadership

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be received on a rolling basis.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$325,000—$360,000 USD

### **Logistics**

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit [anthropic.com/careers](http://anthropic.com/careers) directly for confirmed position openings.

### **How we're different**

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

### **Come work with us!**

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about [our policy](https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance) for using AI in our application process.

I’m partnering with an established, privately held organization headquartered in Roseville, MN on a permanent Endpoint / Systems Administrator opening.

The company has approximately 600 employees and a small internal IT team, so this is a great opportunity for someone who wants broader ownership and doesn’t want to be siloed into one specific area.

They’re looking for a true mid-level Systems / Endpoint Administrator who has a strong Microsoft foundation and is ready to continue growing. This person will work closely with both a junior and senior team member, help mentor the junior resource, and gradually take on more responsibility over time.

Key technologies / responsibilities:

Microsoft Intune – configuration, compliance, application deployment & troubleshooting
Windows Autopilot – Entra ID joined & hybrid environments
Microsoft 365, Exchange Online & Entra ID
Active Directory & Group PolicyPowerShell scripting & automation
Windows 10/11 endpoint administration
Microsoft Defender, BitLocker & endpoint security
Windows ServerVMware / Nutanix or similar virtualizationVPN, DNS, DHCP & general networkingiOS / Android MDM
Patch management & vulnerability remediation

Ideal background:

Roughly 4–8 years of IT experience2+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune experience
Strong troubleshooting skills
Practical PowerShell experience
Experience across both endpoint and systems administration
Comfortable wearing multiple hats in a smaller IT environment
Strong communication skills and willingness to mentor others/

This would be a great fit for someone who has gained solid experience in a larger environment but is ready for more ownership, broader exposure, and a clear path toward a senior-level role.

Salary: $80K–$100K depending on experience

Type: Permanent / Direct Hire

Location: Roseville, MN

Schedule: Onsite initially, with potential for hybrid flexibility in the future

jobs.description:
Job Summary: The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer will join the Firm's IT implementation and engineering team, which designs, builds, and delivers the Firm's IT systems and services with an emphasis on cloud, automation, and artificial intelligence. This position focuses on building, automating, and optimizing these systems to maximize Firm-wide productivity and minimize disruptions. The engineer will help maintain a culture of superior client service and continuous improvement. Job Functions:

Supports the design, development, implementation, and migration of the Firm's cloud and on-premises IT systems and infrastructure. Builds, configures, and maintains the Firm's IT environments, including cloud resources, cloud applications, and AI systems and agents. Works closely with the Enterprise Architecture Manager to: Assist in delivering and supporting solutions across the full lifecycle, including continuous improvement.

Contribute to the development, implementation, and maintenance of operational and technology strategies, policies, and standards. Support the development and implementation of backup and disaster recovery plans and procedures, including regular reviews and real-world tests.

Collects and analyzes core system metrics and supports Firm-wide efforts to improve IT processes and the security and performance of existing systems. Communicates and collaborates with other departments to report and resolve software, hardware, and operational issues. Researches and evaluates new technologies and helps implement recommended solutions that make operations more efficient.

Participates in a rotating 24/7 on-call schedule to support deployments and systems the team maintains, including handling Tier 3 escalations and problem triage. Provides day-to-day coverage during Eastern Time (ET) business hours.

Qualifications
4+ years of related IT experience with a particular focus on supporting business-critical IT infrastructure in a professional services environment. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field is preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Microsoft, cloud, and networking certifications are preferred. Working knowledge of cloud services, virtualization, and networking.

Experience with deployment, configuration, and management of systems using automation. Working proficiency in Python, PowerShell, or comparable languages, with experience leveraging REST APIs and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. Exposure to deploying and operating AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool/function calling, orchestration, and integration with enterprise systems.

The ideal candidate will also have experience working with several of the technologies currently in use at the Firm, including: Microsoft Azure (incl. Networking, DNS, Virtual Desktop) Microsoft Entra ID (incl.

Enterprise
Applications, Single Sign-On, Conditional Access) AI systems (Claude, Copilot, Legal-specific applications) Data governance (incl.

Microsoft
Purview, Litera CAM) Containerization (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes) Version control and CI/CD pipelines (Git, pipeline automation, DevOps practices) Automation tools (Ansible, Terraform) Server operating systems (Windows, Linux) Databases (Microsoft SQL and PostgreSQL) Certificate management (ACME, DigiCert) Network monitoring and management platforms

Demonstrated analytical capability in solving new and complex problems. Effective in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment. Self-starter who works independently, with the judgment to know when to seek guidance. Ability to set priorities and complete diverse assignments on a timely basis. Strong oral and written communication skills, including the ability to assess systems and produce clear technical documentation.

Work Authorization
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for sponsorship by the Firm (either now or in the future).

Compensation and Total Rewards Package:

Choate offers a comprehensive Total Rewards package to our business professional team members. The Firm also offers comprehensive health and well-being benefits, personal and professional development, career growth opportunities and a collegial and supportive culture. The anticipated pay range for this role is listed below and represents our good faith and reasonable estimate of the salary range for this specific position at the time of posting.

In addition, this role is eligible for a discretionary bonus based on performance. The actual offered rate for this position will be determined based on job-related, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to qualifications and experience, education, external market data and consideration of internal equity.

$125,000 - $165,000

jobs.description:
Deliver simple solutions to complex problems as a Systems Engineer, Senior at GDIT. Here, you’ll tailor cutting-edge solutions to the unique requirements of our clients. With a career in application development, you’ll make the end user’s experience your priority and we’ll make your career growth ours.

At GDIT, people are our differentiator. As a Systems Engineer, Senior, you will help ensure today is safe and tomorrow is smarter. Our work depends on the Systems Engineer, Senior, joining our team to manage and monitor all installed Information Technology Systems and infrastructure, as well as install, configure, test and perform routine maintenance on operating systems, application software, and system management tools to ensure the highest levels of systems and infrastructure availability.

Performs administrative operation and maintenance functions of server hardware and software. Maintains system security and executes common practices and procedures. Monitors usage statistics and logs. Maintains baseline configurations and performs modification of configuration settings—institutes troubleshooting and incident response procedures. Troubleshoots system-related problems. Remains current in operating systems/software analysis and technological developments and applications.

Recommends future direction or projects to management. Provides expertise and direction in the development or modification of software programs and applications to enhance an operating system. Develop and maintain documentation on new and existing systems. See below some of the other responsbilities and duties for this role.

HOW A SYSTEMS ENGINEER SENIOR WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

Function as the Site Lead for all IT professionals at location
Perform management functions at geographically separated location
Has full technical knowledge of all phases of systems engineering
Analyzes complex information and independently takes appropriate actions to resolve problems
Guides system development and implementation planning through assessment or preparation of system engineering management plans and system integration and test plans
Develops technical documentation, system architecture, and system design documentation
Evaluates, develops, and delivers technical input to the systems engineering process
Validates the technical integrity of work performed and deliverables associated with the Systems Engineering area of responsibility
Excellent communication skills; shows tact, effective listening skills and follow through
Detail oriented and organized and must be able to identify and resolve problems or inadequacies of systems engineering
Experience identifying, analyzing, and resolving system problems and must be able to design and deliver solutions
Experience with configuration and deployment technologies such as Ansible
WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED:

Education: BA/BS in Information Technology related field or the equivalent combination of education, technical training, or work/military experience.Required Experience: 10+ years of related experience
Experience with RedHat Linux based server operating systems, and OpenShift technology
Experience with Windows based server operating systems, SQL, SCCM, and Active Directory Experience with configuration and deployment technologies such as AnsibleExperience with SANs, NetApp preferred Certification Requirements: DoD 8570.01 certification required – CompTIA Security+ CE cert. or higher
SECURITY CLEARANCE: Must have fully adjudicated TS/SCI clearance (Required)

LOCATION: Must be able to work on the customer Site in Tampa FL. This is not a remote role.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:

401K with company match
Comprehensive health and wellness packages
Internal mobility team dedicated to helping you own your career
Professional growth opportunities including paid education and certifications
Cutting-edge technology you can learn from and apply to solve real world problems.Rest and recharge with paid vacation and holidays

Job Posting The System Administrator will provide hands-on administration and operational support for Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM)–managed environments in a DoD setting. This role is endpoint-first, with supporting responsibilities across Windows Server systems. The ideal candidate has direct experience owning MECM deployments, patching, imaging, and lifecycle management, and operates comfortably in an enterprise, security-conscious environment using ServiceNow.

This position is not cybersecurity- or RMF-focused; it is an operations-driven system administration role supporting daily endpoint and server reliability.

Core Responsibilities (Primary)
Own day-to-day MECM operations, including: PXE boot imaging Application/package deployment Software updates and patching Collections, task sequences, and reporting Execute IAVA-compliant patching and endpoint lifecycle management. Perform workstation and endpoint configuration, refreshes, and remediation. Support endpoint compliance and operational readiness in classified and unclassified environments. Track and resolve incidents, changes, and requests using ServiceNow.

Supporting Responsibilities (Secondary)
Administer Windows Server 2012+ systems (AD, GPOs, patching, upgrades). Monitor system health and performance; resolve operational issues. Assist with documentation and change control artifacts as needed. Coordinate hardware refreshes and system upgrades.

Requirements
Required Qualifications Hands-on MECM experience (must have direct operational ownership). 2+ years of system administration experience in an enterprise environment.

Experience with patching, imaging, and endpoint lifecycle management. ServiceNow experience. DoD 8140 / 8570 compliant (Security+ CE).

Active
Confidential or higher clearance. Nice to Have (Not Required) Intune or hybrid endpoint management.

Windows
Server administration beyond core operations. Familiarity with DoD clinical or mission systems.

Role

Job Description

HII Mission Technologies has been selected as one of Military.com's "Top 25 Employers for Veterans in 2024" and a Forbes Best Large Employer for 2023.

Are you ready to take your career to the next level? We are seeking a skilled and motivated System Administrator to join our team.

HII: Mission Technoolgies is seeking is seeking a qualified, proactive, and customer-focused IT Specialist (Desktop System Administrator) for The U.S. Army DEVCOM Ground Vehicle Systems Center (GVSC) Information Management Office

In this role, you will deliver journey-level functional application support, customer service desk operations, and hands-on system administration. Responsibilities span mission-specific desktop environments (Windows 11).

You will act as both a Desktop System Administrator, ensuring high availability, system integrity, and robust security posture, and a Customer Advocate within DEVCOM GVSC, resolving complex IT issues, leading conference room audiovisual support, and safeguarding systems in compliance with Department of the Army (DA) and Department of War (DoW) standards.

This role requires on-site work in Warren, MI and cannot be performed remotely.

Come support our work with Ground Vehicle Systems Center and join a high-performing team of engineers!

Details Below!

Essential Job Responsibilities

Install, configure, deploy, test, maintain, and upgrade operating systems and layered software packages for client workstations running Microsoft Windows.Provide direct touch labor for installing, moving, troubleshooting, and repairing desktops, laptops, servers, peripherals, and mission-specific hardware.Maintain desktop configurations strictly in accordance with Computer System Configuration Baseline (CSCB), and established IT operational policies.Monitor and tune workstations to achieve optimal performance; regularly review system, security, and application logs (at least daily) and provide summary reports on findings.Maintain physical security standards within hosting spaces and provide required escort support for non-NOC personnel accessing hosting environments.IAVA Patch Management: Apply Information Assurance Vulnerability Alert (IAVA/IAVM) security patches and operating system updates within mandatory suspense dates; conduct rigorous post-patch functional testing to ensure operational availability without adverse side effects.Perform regular security checklists, apply Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs), and evaluate scan results generated by Security Content Automation Protocol (SCAP) and Assured Compliance Assessment Solution (ACAS).Support RMF lifecycle tasks, certification and accreditation efforts, and policy adherence to protect system confidentiality, integrity, and availability (CIA).Act as the primary IT Customer Advocate within DEVCOM GVSC; handle walk-in, phone, and ticketing system inquiries with prompt, courteous, and effective solutions.Record all incidents, user requests, and troubleshooting milestones in the designated ticketing tool, coordinating tier-to-tier escalation and driving tickets to validated closure.Analyze service request patterns and log data to identify chronic computer problems, formulate root-cause solutions, and develop "lessons learned" to boost customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.Deliver informal on-the-job guidance and technical instruction to end users regarding business processes, application capabilities, and IT best practices. Provide full administrative and technical support for classified and unclassified conference rooms, collaboration spaces, and mobile collaboration assets.Review event requests (schedules, locations, duration, participant roster, POCs, and audiovisual requirements) to stage and test conferencing equipment prior to meetings.Quickly diagnose and resolve hardware, software, network protocol, and connectivity faults affecting video teleconferencing (VTC) and multimedia presentation systems.Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs): Author, maintain, and refine SOPs for routine and contingency operations; submit documentation for peer/technical team review 48 hours prior to implementation.Document every manual intervention and system outage on the day of occurrence; execute formal root-cause analyses detailing corrective measures and preventive strategies.Maintain a comprehensive software/hardware library and baseline configuration tracking system, documenting open/closed ports, protocols, services, and hardware/software changes.Produce weekly ticket status reports, monthly System Architecture health metrics, Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (SCCM/MECM) data, and capacity management reporting for the Government Performance Certifier

Minimum Qualifications

0 years relevant experience with Bachelors in related field; or High School Diploma or equivalent and 4 years relevant experience.Minimum of one to three years of hands-on experience in desktop support, system administration, and customer support within enterprise Windows environment.Security Clearance: Active Secret Clearanceis required at hire and eligibility for DoW IT Level I access (subject to background investigation and DD Form 254 compliance).8140 Cyber Workforce Certification: Active DoW 8140 Technical Support Specialist (Code 411) baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, or CompTIA Network+ CE, or CompTIA Security+ CE), or BS degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or Software Engineering.Operating System Certifications: Current equivalent Modern Desktop Administrator certification on Microsoft Windows 11 Platform.In-depth understanding of operating system internals, TCP/IP networking, DNS, DHCP, Active Directory, group policies (GPOs), and system registry configurations.Working knowledge of DoW cybersecurity policies, vulnerability mitigation workflows, and STIG implementation techniques.Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear instructions for non-technical users and deliver professional briefings to leadership and system owners.Ability to independently evaluate emerging IT products, functional software, and hardware tools against Army acquisition and logistics constraints.

Physical Requirements

Chemours is seeking an experienced End User Computing Engineer to join our Information Technology team. This position may be based at various Chemours US locations; candidates located within 50 miles of any Chemours US location will enable close collaboration with IT and business teams.

 Engineer, administer, and continuously improve enterprise endpoint management services using Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune.  Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. 3+ years of experience engineering or administering enterprise end user computing and endpoint management services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

 Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Endpoint Analytics, Windows Update for Business, and certificate or configuration management. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, including Windows Autopilot, Apple Business Manager, Android zero-touch enrollment, and iOS and Android device enrollment, automated deployment, configuration, compliance policies, application deployment, security controls, and lifecycle management. Experience using PowerShell to automate endpoint administration, reporting, and remediation. jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Nexthink is the leader in digital employee experience management software. The company provides IT leaders with unprecedented insight allowing them to see, diagnose and fix issues at scale impacting employees anywhere, with any application or network, before employees notice the issue. As the first solution to allow IT to progress from reactive problem solving to proactive optimization, Nexthink enables its more than 1,500 customers to provide better digital experiences to more than 25+ million employees. Dual headquartered in Lausanne, Switzerland and Boston, Massachusetts, Nexthink has 9 offices worldwide.

#LI-Hybrid

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for an Endpoint Security Engineer to own the security of Nexthink's corporate endpoint estate: roughly 1,200 devices (550 macOS, 650 Windows) managed through Microsoft Intune and Jamf. You will turn endpoint security from a set of point controls into a measurable, continuously improving program covering what runs on our devices, how quickly we patch them, and how we prove it to auditors.

This is a hands-on role at a pivotal moment, as we build out a dedicated security function. Your first priorities include application baselines and allowlisting, a formal application lifecycle from approval to removal, and stronger vulnerability and compliance posture across both platforms. As a company that sells digital employee experience, we expect security that protects people without getting in their way.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Endpoint Hardening**

* Define and maintain security baselines for macOS and Windows (CIS or equivalent), delivered through Intune and Jamf.
* Own hardening standards: disk encryption, firewall, local admin removal and privilege management.
* Evaluate endpoint security tooling and steer vendors while keeping internal ownership of design.

**Application Control \& Software Governance**

* Design and roll out application allowlisting using MDM-native capabilities and/or tools such as Santa, with developer-friendly exception models for Engineering and Product.
* Build and maintain the software and binary inventory: discover, classify and risk-rate applications, and define baselines from the results.
* Run remediation campaigns for unauthorized or high-risk software, from communication to uninstallation and verification.
* Operate the application lifecycle process end to end: request, security review, deployment, monitoring and retirement.

**Vulnerability \& Patch Management**

* Own endpoint vulnerability management: scanning, risk-based prioritization and remediation tracking against SLAs.
* Define patching and update rings for OS and third-party applications with EUC across macOS and Windows.
* Drive remediation of critical and zero-day vulnerabilities and report on exposure and performance to Security leadership.

**Zero Trust \& Data Protection**

* Partner with IAM and Security to enforce device compliance and device trust in Conditional Access.
* Support endpoint data protection controls (e.g. Microsoft Purview DLP, USB and removable media controls) and hardware-backed authentication such as passkeys and security keys.

**Compliance \& Reporting**

* Document endpoint controls and maintain automated evidence for ISO 27001, SOC 2 and ITGC audits.
* Turn security posture into clear metrics for IT leadership, Security and Finance.

**Automation \& Digital Employee Experience**

* Automate security operations with PowerShell, Python, shell scripting, Microsoft Graph and the Jamf and Intune APIs.
* Use Nexthink's own DEX platform to measure endpoint health and the employee impact of security changes, and build self-service remediation to reduce tickets.

**Primary Metrics**

* Device compliance and security baseline adherence (macOS and Windows)
* Mean time to remediate critical and high vulnerabilities, against SLA
* Patch and OS currency against SLAs
* Application control coverage and share of unclassified binaries
* Unauthorized or high-risk application count, and time to remediate
* Standing local admin count
* Endpoint-related audit findings and evidence automation coverage
* Employee experience impact of security controls (Nexthink DEX score)

Qualifications
- -------------

* 5+ years in endpoint security, security engineering, or end-user computing with a strong security focus.
* Hands-on experience securing macOS and Windows at scale with Microsoft Intune and Jamf (or equivalent).
* Practical experience with vulnerability management tooling, prioritization and remediation workflows.
* Experience with application control and allowlisting (MDM-native controls, Santa, AppLocker, WDAC or similar).
* Strong knowledge of OS security and hardening frameworks (CIS, NIST, Apple platform security).
* Good understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access and Zero Trust applied to devices.
* Scripting skills in PowerShell, Python or Bash; familiarity with REST APIs and Microsoft Graph.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2 or ITGC controls and audit evidence.
* Ability to work with Engineering and Product teams and communicate clearly with senior stakeholders. Fluent English; Spanish is a plus.
* Nice to have: DEX tools experience, Microsoft Purview, or certifications (e.g. MD-102, SC-300, Jamf Certified, GIAC, CISSP, Security+).

***Please apply with a copy of your CV in English.***

Additional Information
- ---------------------

We are the pioneers and trailblazers of a global IT Market Category (DEX) that is shaping the future of how the world works, giving our customers' IT Teams total digital visibility across their enterprise. Our innovative solutions integrate real-time analytics, automation, and employee feedback across all endpoints. This enables our IT teams to solve complex technical challenges, create ever more productive workplaces, and deliver happy, satisfied employees in the digital workplace.

With over 1000 employees across 5 continents, Nexthink operates as One Team, connecting, collaborating and innovating to continuously grow. We call our employees 'Nexthinkers' and our commitment to diversity, inclusion, and equity is second to none. We currently have over 75 nationalities working with us, from all cultures and backgrounds, speaking many different languages.

If you are looking for a change and like a nice atmosphere, lots of challenges, and having fun while working, this is a great opportunity for you! Check what we offer:

* 💼 Permanent Contract and a competitive compensation package.
* 📍 Amazing centrally located offices near the Bernabeu Stadium.
* 🩺 Private Health Insurance (Sanitas) and daily meal vouchers of 11 EUR .
* 🏡 Hybrid work model balancing office and remote work.
* 🏖️ Flexible Hours and unlimited vacation (employees have unlimited paid time off on top of the 23 days of holidays we offer) plus 3 company-paid volunteer days.
* 🤸 Up to 25 EUR per month for a gym subscription.
* 🛴 Flexible compensation plan for childcare \& public transportation.
* 🧑‍🏫 Reimbursement of up to 50% of the cost of English \& Spanish classes.
* 🍉 Fresh fruit, cookies, and soft drinks in the office.
* 🍕 Regular company and team events like Pizza talks, Team Building activities, Christmas parties, hosting Meetups at the office and more!
* 📣 Bonuses for referring successful hires after three months of continuous employment.

jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
 ML Platform powers hundreds of use cases and billions of inferences per day across Discovery, Safety, Economy, and Creation. We build the primitives that let teams train, evaluate, deploy, and operate models quickly and safely—so a new ML idea can reach production in weeks or less. We’re looking for a Principal Platform Engineer who treats platform as a product : someone who can turn complex ML/AI infrastructure into clear, durable APIs, SDKs and easy-to-use CLIs/UIs that our internal developers love.
 This role blends product thinking, developer experience, backend engineering, and infrastructure at scale. Hands‑on ML experience is a plus; a track record of building internal platforms that developers love is a must.
 You Are

 Have 10+ years of professional experience and have a wealth of system design experience upon which to draw to build a scalable, reliable ML platform for all of Roblox.
 A Code Machine; you love not only to design and communicate ideas but also to actually ship product. You obsess about user feedback, and constantly drive towards getting platform features in customers hands.
 Proficient in API design and developer experience—gRPC/REST APIs, SDKs, CLIs, and simple UIs that developers love to use.
 Good to have - experience with the end‑to‑end ML model lifecycle such as model serving, training, model CI/CD, and GPU resources management, and have built ML platform features that are delightful to use.
 You're passionate about infrastructure‑as‑code and automating painful manual processes. You push for platform solutions that don’t leave on-call teams carrying the burden of design choices.
 Passionate about supporting ML engineers to meet and understand their needs, and translating them into clean, durable platform abstractions.
 A clear communicator who excels at both written and verbal communication across differing levels of technical detail.

CDW is a Fortune 500 technology solutions provider that helps businesses, government, education, and healthcare organizations achieve what’s possible through technology. jobs.description:
Role Summary

We’re seeking an IT Systems Engineer to join our growing IT team. You’ll own the architecture and automation behind the systems our employees rely on every day: identity, device management, endpoint security, and the tooling that ties them together. You’ll work closely with IT, Security, Engineering, and People teams to design, build, and scale the platforms that keep a fast-growing company productive and secure. You’ll also be the onsite IT presence in San Francisco, supporting our executive team and running the technology in our new office. You’ll be expected to set technical direction within your domain, lead multi-team initiatives, and make sound decisions without close supervision.

This role is based in San Francisco, with regular onsite presence at our new San Francisco office, which you’ll manage day to day.

What You’ll Do

 - Own and deploy the architecture, reliability, and roadmap for core IT platforms (identity and access, device management, endpoint security, or IT automation)

 - Design and build automation and internal tooling that eliminates manual work: onboarding and offboarding workflows, access lifecycle management, device enrollment and posture enforcement, and self-service for employees. Use AI and LLM-based tools (such as AI agents and MCP integrations) where they make IT work faster, more consistent, and more reliable

 - Lead multi-team technical initiatives end to end, from architecture and design docs through rollout and communication, partnering with Security, Engineering, and People teams

 - Set technical standards and patterns for the IT team, and write clear design documentation and runbooks others can build on

 - Evaluate tools and vendors, weigh build-vs-buy tradeoffs, and make recommendations to IT leadership with clear reasoning on cost, risk, and scale

 - Partner with Security to implement and maintain the technical controls behind our security and compliance requirements

 - Serve as the technical escalation point for the hardest problems, and apply lessons from incidents to fix root causes rather than symptoms

 - Mentor IT Support Specialists and raise the team’s technical bar

 - Own technology for our San Francisco office end to end, including network and internet connectivity, Wi-Fi, A/V, and equipment, and coordinate with ISPs and vendors

 - Design, deploy, and support network-connected video conferencing and meeting room systems (for example Zoom Rooms, Neat, and Cisco Meraki networking), and make sure every meeting space works reliably for in-person and remote participants

 - Provide white-glove support to executives: proactive and responsive with a high bar for reliability before and during important meetings and events

 - Occasional travel to company events and other Temporal locations

What You’ll Bring

 - 8+ years of experience in IT, systems engineering, or a similar role, with a track record of owning platforms rather than only operating them

 - Deep expertise in at least one of: identity and access management (Okta, Entra ID), device management (MDM for macOS and Windows), or endpoint security and zero trust tooling

 - Strong scripting and automation skills (for example Python, TypeScript, Bash, or PowerShell), including working with APIs and integrating SaaS systems, and hands-on experience using AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools to build and ship automation faster

 - Experience leading cross-functional projects to completion, including scoping, stakeholder alignment, and rollout

 - Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executives

 - Hands-on experience with enterprise networking (switching, Wi-Fi, firewalls, ISP circuits) and with conference room and video conferencing systems

 - Comfort supporting senior executives: polished, discreet, and calm under pressure, with the ability to build trust quickly

 - A bias to action and a history of self-education

Nice to Have

 - Experience with identity governance and access lifecycle automation (for example Okta Identity Governance, group rules, access certifications)

 - Experience with zero trust networking (for example Cloudflare Zero Trust) and endpoint detection and response tooling

 - Infrastructure-as-code experience (for example Terraform) applied to IT systems

 - Experience building AI-powered workflows or agents for IT operations (for example MCP servers, or LLM-driven ticket triage and onboarding automation)

 - Experience supporting security and compliance programs from the IT side

 - Experience at a fast-growing, remote-first company, or one that serves developers

 - Experience standing up or opening a new office, including vendor and circuit coordination

About the Role

We’re seeking a sharp, trusted, and highly autonomous Enterprise Solutions Engineer, Channel to help drive NinjaOne’s expansion into the enterprise market. This is a builder role—your chance to shape how we engage complex accounts, scale technical wins, and define what great looks like in enterprise pre-sales. You’ll own the full technical sales cycle—from discovery and architecture through proof-of-concept and implementation—while partnering closely with AEs to influence deal strategy and deliver real-world impact. You won’t just run demos—you’ll build the playbooks, tools, and repeatable processes that help us scale. If you’ve done this before in B2B SaaS, thrive in high-stakes environments, and want your work to directly shape the next chapter of NinjaOne’s growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - *IL, KS, & TX.
 Travel Requirements - ~50%, including strategic customer meetings, industry events, and team collaboration

What You’ll Be Doing

Own the full pre-sales technical experience for Enterprise Partners, Channel, MSPs & Customers. This will include product demonstrations, architecture design, and key customer engagements to drive deal success.Represent NinjaOne at enterprise-facing industry events, conferences, and customer forums.Support the review and alignment of technical content within RFPs and RFIs without owning full proposal management.Partner with Training and Customer Success teams to accelerate time-to-value and ensure long-term adoption success.Serve as a strategic voice between Sales and Product—surfacing feedback, identifying feature gaps, and influencing roadmap direction.Build and maintain reusable technical assets including lab environments, demo flows, battlecards, and scripts to support a scalable AE-to-SE model.Collaborate closely with Account Executives and Sales Leadership to drive growth and align technical value to business goals.Help shape the future of the Enterprise SE function as a founding member of the team, contributing to playbooks, processes, and cross-functional alignment.Other duties as assigned.
  Technical Requirements

· Proficiency in Windows environments (registry, services, performance troubleshooting).

· Familiarity with Linux/macOS systems and basic command-line troubleshooting.

· Strong understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, VPNs, firewalls, and endpoint protections.

· Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms and endpoint lifecycle management.

· Scripting experience in PowerShell, JavaScript, &/or VB
Script is strongly preferred.

· Comfortable navigating complex IT ecosystems and integrating with existing infrastructure.

· Experience with Salesforce, Jira, Highspot, or equivalent systems is required.

About You

5+ years in a pre-sales engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting role supporting enterprise B2B SaaS customers.Brings deep domain knowledge in enterprise IT operations, RMM, endpoint management, and ITSM-adjacent platforms.Evolved from a technical background (e.g., TAM, support, systems engineer), with practical insight into IT operations at scale.Strong communicator with executive presence—able to tailor messaging for admins, architects, and senior business stakeholders.Understands how IT teams evaluate, implement, and scale solutions—along with insight into the limitations of legacy platforms and the shift toward unified, modern alternatives.Known for high emotional intelligence, technical credibility, and a customer-first mindset.Operates well in ambiguity and brings a builder’s mentality to scaling people, processes, and tools.Bachelor’s degree preferred but not required. Technical certifications (e.g., CISSP, Security+, cloud architecture) are a plus.

About Us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries. ​

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. ​ NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community.

We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance.

We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan.

We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO.

We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement.

jobs.description:
Job DescriptionCustomer Success & Strategic Advisory• Serve as the primary post-sales technical advisor and trusted partner for assigned customers.

Job Description

Customer Success & Strategic Advisory

- Serve as the primary post-sales technical advisor and trusted partner for assigned customers.

- Develop strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including security teams, IT leadership, and executive sponsors.

- Translate technical challenges and security risks into business-focused recommendations and outcomes.

- Drive customer adoption, engagement, and long-term success through strategic account planning.

- Lead customer success reviews, executive business reviews, and ongoing strategic discussions.

Technical Leadership

- Provide expertise in endpoint security technologies, cyber security best practices, and security operations.

- Own the customer onboarding experience post-sale, driving structured deployment plans that accelerate time-to-value. Partner with Professional Services and Support to ensure smooth rollouts across diverse endpoint environments, minimizing risk and maximizing early adoption milestones.

- Guide customers through deployments, integrations, configuration optimization, and adoption initiatives.

- Analyze customer environments and provide data-driven recommendations to improve security posture and product utilization.

- Design and deliver enablement programs tailored to customer security teams — including workshops, product training sessions, and guided best-practice reviews — ensuring customers build internal competency and maximize platform utilization independently.

- Leverage Check Point's threat intelligence capabilities to provide customers with contextually relevant security guidance — translating global threat data into actionable recommendations specific to their endpoint environment.

Maintain awareness of product roadmap developments and communicate upcoming capabilities to customers in ways that align with their security strategy and drive continued investment.

- Collaborate with Support, Engineering, Product Management, and Sales to resolve complex customer issues.

Escalation & Problem Resolution

- Own and drive resolution of critical customer escalations from identification through closure.

- Act as the customer advocate internally, ensuring timely communication and accountability across teams.

- Proactively identify risks to customer satisfaction and develop mitigation plans.

- Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills when navigating technical and business challenges.

Business Partnership

- Partner closely with Sales teams to support account growth, retention, and customer advocacy.

- Own and report on key customer success metrics including Net Revenue Retention (NRR), product adoption rates, CSAT/NPS scores, and renewal forecasts. Use these signals proactively to identify at-risk accounts and build data-driven action plans that protect and grow the customer base.

- Use customer health metrics, adoption data, and business insights to identify opportunities and risks.

- Maintain executive-level relationships and effectively communicate value realization to business leaders.

- Contribute to customer renewal and expansion strategies through technical and business guidance, including connecting endpoint security posture to broader platform discussions spanning email security, identity, cloud, and SASE.

- 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, Security Engineering, Professional Services, or related customer-facing cyber security roles.

- Strong hands-on knowledge of endpoint security technologies, including EDR/EPP platforms, antivirus and anti-malware solutions, and endpoint detection and response capabilities. Familiarity with OS-diverse environments (Windows, macOS, Linux), VDI and remote workforce deployments, MDM/UEM integrations, and common endpoint attack scenarios including ransomware and supply chain threats.

- Experience managing enterprise customer relationships.

- Proven ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Experience handling high-priority customer escalations and driving cross-functional resolution.

- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

- Ability to analyze data and use customer insights to drive recommendations and business outcomes.

- Familiarity with security frameworks such as NIST, CIS Controls, and Zero Trust.

- Experience presenting to executive leadership, including CIOs, CISOs, and other C-suite stakeholders.

- Demonstrated ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in SaaS cyber security organizations.

- Knowledge of endpoint protection, email security, identity security, cloud security, or workspace security solutions.

- Experience supporting customers during active security incidents or coordinating with incident response teams.

Success Profile

The successful Technical Customer Success Manager is:

- A trusted advisor who earns customer confidence.

- Technically credible and business-minded.

- Data-driven in decision making and customer guidance.

- Proactive, accountable, and customer-obsessed.

- An exceptional communicator who can simplify complex technical concepts.

- Comfortable owning customer outcomes and leading through influence.

We are seeking a highly motivated and customer-focused Technical Customer Success Manager (TCSM) to serve as a trusted advisor for our cyber security customers. This role combines deep technical expertise with strategic customer engagement, ensuring customers maximize the value of their security investments while achieving their business objectives.

The ideal candidate possesses strong endpoint security knowledge, a startup mentality, exceptional problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate complex technical challenges into meaningful business outcomes. They are comfortable engaging with stakeholders ranging from security administrators to C-level executives and are passionate about driving customer success.
