jobs.description:
Latitude AI ( [lat.ai](http://lat.ai)) is building the future of Ford’s autonomy roadmap to make travel safer, less stressful, and more enjoyable for everyone. Bringing this vision to scale, our fully in-house developed hands-free ADAS platform will debut on the all-new Ford Fathom in 2027.

When you join the Latitude team, you’ll work alongside leading experts across machine learning and robotics, cloud platforms, mapping, sensors and compute systems, test operations, systems and safety engineering – **_all dedicated to redefining the relationship between people and their vehicles for millions of customers._**

As a Ford Motor Company subsidiary, we operate independently to develop automated driving technology at the speed of a technology startup. Latitude is headquartered in Pittsburgh with engineering centers in Dearborn, Mich., and Palo Alto, Calif.

**Meet the Team:**

The Enterprise Cyber Security team is focused on ensuring the resilience of our corporate environment with focus on protection of our corporate systems, IP, and employee data. We are a close-knit team with strong cross-functional roles in the company.

As a Cyber Security Engineer, you will be the hands-on technical lead securing our High Performance Computing (HPC)/Virtualization environments. Your job is to have a deep understanding of this infrastructure, network architecture, and the operations depending on it, including our software/hardware/network engineering, fleet operations requirements, and administrative functions. You will use your knowledge and experience to design, implement, automate, and continuously improve our security posture.

**What you'll do:**

- Identity Management and Device Management design, implementation, and deployment (Entra/Okta, MDM solutions like Intune)
- Network Security design and engineering, applying best practices in software, network, and infrastructure engineering
- Consult and advocate security best practices for DMZ architectures, NAC/NAP, lateral isolation, and multi-site data movement in Network management tooling (like Palo Alto, Fortinet, F5)
- Deliver projects on time, on budget, with excellent quality and security configurations
- Review the existing and new deployments and architecture designs looking for design flaws, security improvements, and advocate for stronger security controls that meet functional and operational needs
- Work hand-in-hand with the Cloud Platform, IT, and Product teams to research, design and develop security solutions and deployments and strategies tailored to Latitude’s business needs
- Engage actively in Data Center and Network Security initiatives to assess existing security access controls, and implementations of supplemental technical solutions to improve overall security.
- Document findings, conduct comparisons, perform threat and risk assessments, and Proof of Concepts aiding the team in making informed decisions about the impact of various design options.
- Develop, Review, and Design the automation and orchestration for security aspects device controls and access to services
- Provide inputs into dashboards and report metrics on the status of the Cyber Security posture
- Plan for, execute, and follow through on projects and engagements independently
- Hands on deployment of solutions, working independently and as part of a team
- Provide mentoring and skill set knowledge transfer to team members and engineering staff
- Moderate and contribute to Supercomputing System Administration that contributes to:

  - Proactive monitoring, analysis, and correcting system security issues
  - Development of scripts to automate, perform security checks, and develop tools to enhance support of the Cloud/Virtualized systems and development environments

- Developing playbooks/runbooks, operational and troubleshooting documentation
- Evaluate and contribute to designs for Network and Infrastructure Solutions with Security and Functionality as pillars of implementation

**What you'll need to succeed:**

- At a minimum, a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Cyber Security or a related field and 4+ years of relevant experience (or Master's degree and 2+ years of relevant experience)
- **Strongly prefer 8+ years related experience or 6 years with a Master’s degree; as an Identity and Device Management Engineer and/or Network Security Architect/Engineer. Actively deploying solutions from scratch to Production**
- 2+ years of related experience in vulnerability management and adjusting the risk rating/severity dependent on internal factors for cloud and other infra.
- Experience with Lustre, Kerberos, and Linux Administration
- Proficiency in scripting languages, including Bash, Python, Go, or Java to create production level services and automation tools that incorporate into CI/CD
- Proficiency and hands-on experience using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to automate the creation of cloud resources, virtualized systems, and review infrastructure deployments. E.g. Terraform, Cloud Formation, Ansible, or others
- Ability to grasp new technologies quickly and prioritize and multitask on multiple responsibilities.
- Hands-on Experience with patching and hardening Linux, MacOS, and Windows Systems (clients and servers), images, and containers.
- Proficient in Network Protocols and Firewall Management, with hands-on experience in configuration and optimization to ensure network security internally and at perimeters.
- Critical thinking and a holistic view of Cyber Security with ability to balance security requirements with mission needs and collaboration across teams
- Exceptional organizational and time management skills demonstrated through adept autonomy, independent work, collaborative teamwork, and a professional demeanor.
- Strong experience with architecting/deploying scalable security services and workloads in cloud native and virtualized environments
- Ability to deploy Device Management solutions to control access to Company Solutions
- Understand engineering design limitations and provide guidance for teams to secure their deployments to achieve desired performance in budget and on time
- An Independent take-charge attitude while being open-minded, creatively thinking, willing to take calculated risks, and make informed decisions
- Strong understanding of Cyber Security Standards (ISO27001, NIST 800-53)
- Experience with Jenkins a plus
- Experience with Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) principles and implementations
- Exposure to data governance, secure data movement, and storage lifecycle management
- Must have demonstrated proficiency and strength in verbal, written, presentation, and communications skills, including technical diagramming
- A sense of comradery, compassion, and unparalleled passion/energy

**What we offer you:**

- Competitive compensation packages
- High-quality individual and family medical, dental, and vision insurance
- Health savings account with available employer match
- Employer-matched 401(k) retirement plan with immediate vesting
- Employer-paid group term life insurance and the option to elect voluntary life insurance
- Paid parental leave and Adoption/Surrogacy support program
- Paid medical leave
- Unlimited vacation and 15 paid holidays
- Daily lunches, snacks, and beverages available in all office locations
- Pre-tax spending accounts for healthcare and dependent care expenses
- Pre-tax commuter benefits
- Monthly wellness stipend
- Backup child and elder care program
- Professional development reimbursement
- Employee assistance program
- Discounted programs that include legal services, identity theft protection, pet insurance, and more
- Company and team bonding outlets: employee resource groups, quarterly team activity stipend, and wellness initiatives

Learn more about Latitude’s team, mission and career opportunities at [lat.ai](https://lat.ai/)!

The expected base salary range for this full-time position in California is $160,000 - $240,000 USD. Actual starting pay will be based on job-related factors, including exact work location, experience, relevant training and education, and skill level. Latitude employees are also eligible to participate in Latitude’s annual bonus programs, equity compensation, and generous Company benefits program, subject to eligibility requirements.

Candidates for positions with Latitude AI must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a permanent basis. Verification of employment eligibility will be required at the time of hire.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status or protected veteran status.

jobs.description:
**Company:** Marsh

**Description:**

**Windows Endpoint Engineer**

We are seeking a Windows Endpoint Engineer to join our team at Marsh. This role will be based in Mexico City. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. As a Windows Endpoint Engineer, you will work across modern device management, Windows deployment and servicing, application delivery, endpoint security and compliance, hardware lifecycle, automation and digital employee experience. You will collaborate with security, identity, network, application, service management and regional support teams to deliver reliable, secure and user-focused solutions.

**We will count on you to**:

* Engineer and maintain the enterprise Windows endpoint platform, including laptops, desktops, virtual endpoints and specialist device configurations.
* Design and support modern provisioning and lifecycle workflows using Microsoft Intune, Entra ID and Windows Autopilot, including Entra-only device scenarios.
* Manage Windows configuration, feature updates, quality updates, servicing rings, drivers, BIOS, firmware, UEFI and supporting hardware standards.
* Engineer and improve application packaging, deployment, update and remediation processes, working with application owners to reduce compatibility and colleague-experience issues.
* Implement and maintain endpoint security and compliance capabilities, including BitLocker, Secure Boot, Defender controls, Windows Hello for Business and security baselines.
* Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and workflow automation to remove manual effort, improve control and integrate endpoint services with platforms such as ServiceNow.
* Use endpoint telemetry and digital employee experience data to identify trends, assess change impact and proactively improve device health, performance and reliability.
* Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis for complex tier III incidents, engaging Microsoft and other technology vendors where required.
* Translate business, colleague, security and operational requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, testing approaches and production acceptance criteria.
* Create and maintain roadmaps, standards, engineering guides, release documentation, support knowledge and operational handover materials.
* Contribute to peer reviews, technical governance, proof-of-concept activity and continual improvement across the global endpoint engineering service.

**What you need to have**:

* 5 + years of experience working in Window Endpoint support.
* Strong experience of engineering and supporting Windows 11 endpoints in a large, distributed enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and cloud-based Windows configuration and compliance.
* Experience with Windows deployment, servicing, recovery and troubleshooting, including feature updates, quality updates, drivers and firmware.
* Strong knowledge of application deployment, update management and compatibility troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 Apps and enterprise Windows applications.
* Practical PowerShell automation skills and experience working with APIs, Microsoft Graph or structured data formats such as JSON, XML and CSV.
* Good understanding of endpoint security, identity, compliance and access controls, including BitLocker, Secure Boot and Windows Hello for Business.
* Ability to analyse complex technical problems, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and produce high-quality engineering documentation.

**Why join our team**:

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

jobs.description:
**Windows Endpoint Engineering**

We are seeking a Windows Endpoint Engineering to join our team at Marsh. This role will be based in Mexico City. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. As a Windows Endpoint Engineering, you will work across modern device management, Windows deployment and servicing, application delivery, endpoint security and compliance, hardware lifecycle, automation and digital employee experience. You will collaborate with security, identity, network, application, service management and regional support teams to deliver reliable, secure and user-focused solutions.

**We will count on you to**:

* Engineer and maintain the enterprise Windows endpoint platform, including laptops, desktops, virtual endpoints and specialist device configurations.
* Design and support modern provisioning and lifecycle workflows using Microsoft Intune, Entra ID and Windows Autopilot, including Entra-only device scenarios.
* Manage Windows configuration, feature updates, quality updates, servicing rings, drivers, BIOS, firmware, UEFI and supporting hardware standards.
* Engineer and improve application packaging, deployment, update and remediation processes, working with application owners to reduce compatibility and colleague-experience issues.
* Implement and maintain endpoint security and compliance capabilities, including BitLocker, Secure Boot, Defender controls, Windows Hello for Business and security baselines.
* Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and workflow automation to remove manual effort, improve control and integrate endpoint services with platforms such as ServiceNow.
* Use endpoint telemetry and digital employee experience data to identify trends, assess change impact and proactively improve device health, performance and reliability.
* Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis for complex tier III incidents, engaging Microsoft and other technology vendors where required.
* Translate business, colleague, security and operational requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, testing approaches and production acceptance criteria.
* Create and maintain roadmaps, standards, engineering guides, release documentation, support knowledge and operational handover materials.
* Contribute to peer reviews, technical governance, proof-of-concept activity and continual improvement across the global endpoint engineering service.

**What you need to have**:

* 5 + years of experience working in Window Endpoint support.
* Strong experience of engineering and supporting Windows 11 endpoints in a large, distributed enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and cloud-based Windows configuration and compliance.
* Experience with Windows deployment, servicing, recovery and troubleshooting, including feature updates, quality updates, drivers and firmware.
* Strong knowledge of application deployment, update management and compatibility troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 Apps and enterprise Windows applications.
* Practical PowerShell automation skills and experience working with APIs, Microsoft Graph or structured data formats such as JSON, XML and CSV.
* Good understanding of endpoint security, identity, compliance and access controls, including BitLocker, Secure Boot and Windows Hello for Business.
* Ability to analyse complex technical problems, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and produce high-quality engineering documentation.

**Why join our team**:

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

jobs.description:
We are seeking a Windows Endpoint Engineering to join our team at Marsh. This role will be based in Mexico City. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office. As a Windows Endpoint Engineering, you will work across modern device management, Windows deployment and servicing, application delivery, endpoint security and compliance, hardware lifecycle, automation and digital employee experience. You will collaborate with security, identity, network, application, service management and regional support teams to deliver reliable, secure and user-focused solutions.

**We will count on you to** :

* Engineer and maintain the enterprise Windows endpoint platform, including laptops, desktops, virtual endpoints and specialist device configurations.
* Design and support modern provisioning and lifecycle workflows using Microsoft Intune, Entra ID and Windows Autopilot, including Entra-only device scenarios.
* Manage Windows configuration, feature updates, quality updates, servicing rings, drivers, BIOS, firmware, UEFI and supporting hardware standards.
* Engineer and improve application packaging, deployment, update and remediation processes, working with application owners to reduce compatibility and colleague-experience issues.
* Implement and maintain endpoint security and compliance capabilities, including BitLocker, Secure Boot, Defender controls, Windows Hello for Business and security baselines.
* Use PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and workflow automation to remove manual effort, improve control and integrate endpoint services with platforms such as ServiceNow.
* Use endpoint telemetry and digital employee experience data to identify trends, assess change impact and proactively improve device health, performance and reliability.
* Lead technical investigation and root-cause analysis for complex tier III incidents, engaging Microsoft and other technology vendors where required.
* Translate business, colleague, security and operational requirements into technical designs, implementation plans, testing approaches and production acceptance criteria.
* Create and maintain roadmaps, standards, engineering guides, release documentation, support knowledge and operational handover materials.
* Contribute to peer reviews, technical governance, proof-of-concept activity and continual improvement across the global endpoint engineering service.

**What you need to have** :

* 5 + years of experience working in Window Endpoint support.
* Strong experience of engineering and supporting Windows 11 endpoints in a large, distributed enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, Windows Autopilot and cloud-based Windows configuration and compliance.
* Experience with Windows deployment, servicing, recovery and troubleshooting, including feature updates, quality updates, drivers and firmware.
* Strong knowledge of application deployment, update management and compatibility troubleshooting for Microsoft 365 Apps and enterprise Windows applications.
* Practical PowerShell automation skills and experience working with APIs, Microsoft Graph or structured data formats such as JSON, XML and CSV.
* Good understanding of endpoint security, identity, compliance and access controls, including BitLocker, Secure Boot and Windows Hello for Business.
* Ability to analyse complex technical problems, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and produce high-quality engineering documentation.

**Why join our team** :

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Marsh is committed to creating a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. Office-based teams will identify at least one "anchor day" per week on which their full team will be together in person.

jobs.description:
Omega Morgan believes that each employee makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this position description is designed to outline primary duties, qualifications, and job scope, but not limit the individual nor the organization to just the work identified. It is our expectation that each employee will offer his/her services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our endeavors.

The Endpoint Administrator owns the operational lifecycle of company endpoints and the technology aspects of employee onboarding and offboarding. This role is responsible for ensuring laptops, desktops, mobile devices, shared workstations, and related peripherals are securely standardized, provisioned, maintained, supported, recovered, and retired. The Endpoint Administrator works closely with Human Resources, hiring managers, IT support, security, and infrastructure teams to deliver a consistent employee technology experience while maintaining accurate asset and access records.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Own the complete lifecycle of company endpoints, including standards, procurement coordination, receiving, staging, deployment, assignment, support, reassignment, refresh, recovery, and secure retirement or disposal.Administer endpoint management, remote monitoring and management, deployment, and mobile device management platforms; maintain device enrollment, configuration profiles, policies, and compliance rules.Provision laptops, desktops, mobile devices, shared workstations, and peripherals using standardized builds, required applications, security controls, and role-based configurations.Coordinate and execute employee onboarding by preparing equipment, accounts, licenses, group memberships, applications, and access in partnership with Human Resources and hiring managers.Coordinate and execute employee offboarding by disabling access, reclaiming equipment and licenses, preserving or transferring business data as authorized, documenting disposition, and securely wiping devices for reuse or disposal.Maintain accurate endpoint and asset records, including assigned user, location, serial number, model, warranty, configuration, status, and planned replacement date.Manage operating system, application, driver, BIOS, and firmware patching; monitor compliance and remediate devices that fall outside established security or maintenance standards.Implement and maintain endpoint security controls, including encryption, endpoint protection, local administrator restrictions, screen-lock standards, and secure configuration baselines.Package, test, deploy, update, and remove business applications while supporting software licensing, standardization, and compatibility requirements.Troubleshoot endpoint, peripheral, profile, performance, connectivity, and application issues; identify root causes and coordinate vendor repair or replacement when necessary.Maintain ready-to-deploy inventory and forecast endpoint refresh, warranty, and accessory needs to support timely onboarding, replacements, and business growth.Create and maintain endpoint standards, onboarding and offboarding checklists, support documentation, knowledge articles, and audit-ready records; report on fleet health, patch compliance, inventory accuracy, and lifecycle status.

Required Skills

Strong endpoint troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, operating systems, applications, user profiles, peripherals, and connectivityAbility to organize and execute time-sensitive onboarding, offboarding, deployment, and device-recovery activities with a high degree of accuracyWorking knowledge of endpoint management, RMM, software deployment, patching, encryption, endpoint security, and remote support technologiesStrong customer service and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information clearly to employees and managersAbility to create and maintain clear procedures, checklists, asset records, and technical documentationStrong attention to detail, ownership, discretion, and sound judgment when handling company devices, employee data, credentials, and access

Required Experience And/or Education

Three or more years of experience in endpoint administration, desktop engineering, IT support, systems administration, or a related roleDemonstrated experience provisioning, managing, troubleshooting, and retiring Windows 10/11 endpoints in a corporate environmentExperience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, and role-based user and device provisioningExperience with endpoint management, RMM, deployment, or mobile device management platforms; Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot experience is preferredExperience with application packaging and deployment, patch management, disk encryption, endpoint protection, and security compliance remediationExperience maintaining hardware inventory, asset assignments, warranties, refresh schedules, and secure device disposition recordsRelevant certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, or equivalent practical experience preferred

About the Role
We are seeking a hands-on Systems Administrator / Desktop Support professional to join a small, collaborative IT team supporting users and technology across the organization.

The right person will be just as comfortable troubleshooting a laptop, setting up a new employee, resolving an Outlook or Microsoft 365 issue, or helping someone with a conference room as they are administering Active Directory, managing endpoints, supporting CrowdStrike, or assisting with infrastructure and security initiatives.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to the users and wants broad exposure across desktop support, systems administration, security, and infrastructure. A strong customer-service mindset is critical. We are looking for someone approachable, responsive, and willing to jump in wherever needed rather than someone who only wants to focus on higher-level engineering work.

Key Responsibilities

Provide hands-on desktop and end-user support, troubleshooting hardware, software, Microsoft 365, connectivity, printing, and other day-to-day technology issues.
Serve as a highly visible IT resource for employees, providing responsive and professional support both in person and remotely.
Set up laptops, workstations, mobile devices, monitors, peripherals, and other equipment for new and existing employees.
Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including account creation, access provisioning, equipment setup, permissions, and device deployment.
Administer and support Microsoft 365, including Outlook/Exchange Online, Teams, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
Manage users, groups, permissions, and access within Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID.
Support identity and access management, including MFA, SSO, and user provisioning.
Manage Windows endpoints and device policies using Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot.
Administer and support CrowdStrike Falcon, including endpoint deployment, policy management, monitoring, and basic incident response.
Assist with SOX-related IT controls, documentation, access reviews, change management, and audit requests.
Troubleshoot basic networking issues involving Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP, and general connectivity.
Support conference rooms, collaboration technology, and other office IT equipment.
Assist with patching, software deployments, upgrades, backups, and routine systems maintenance.
Help maintain accurate IT asset inventory, documentation, SOPs, and user support procedures.
Use PowerShell or other scripting tools to automate repetitive administrative tasks where appropriate.
Partner with other members of IT on infrastructure, security, cloud, and technology improvement initiatives.
Assist with additional IT needs as they arise, regardless of size or complexity.

Required Qualifications

3+ years of experience in desktop support, systems administration, IT support, or a similar hands-on corporate IT role.
Strong experience supporting users in a Windows and Microsoft 365 environment.
Hands-on experience with Active Directory and/or Microsoft Entra ID.
Experience with user provisioning, permissions, group management, and employee onboarding/offboarding.
Experience supporting and managing corporate endpoints.
Familiarity with CrowdStrike Falcon or a comparable endpoint security/EDR platform.
Understanding of SOX controls or working within an audited corporate environment.
Strong troubleshooting skills across laptops, desktops, applications, Microsoft 365, networking, and general end-user technology.
Comfortable working directly with employees at all levels of an organization.
Strong communication skills and a genuine customer-service mentality.
Willingness to handle both basic support requests and more technical systems work.
Ability to work independently and prioritize requests within a small IT team.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot.
Experience with Okta, SSO, and MFA.
Working knowledge of PowerShell.
Exposure to Azure, VMware, Windows Server, or other infrastructure technologies.
Familiarity with Fortinet firewalls, VPNs, and general networking.
Experience supporting backup and recovery platforms such as Veeam or Druva.
Experience within financial services, private equity, venture capital, or another regulated environment.
Basic macOS administration experience.
Exposure to enterprise AI tools such as Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT Enterprise, Gemini, or Claude is a plus.

jobs.description:
Why this role

We are a consulting firm that helps life sciences companies, locally and globally, get their commercial data right, from master data and data platforms to customer engagement programmes. In this role, you'll be the person clients and project teams turn to when the data questions get hard.

We welcome people from two backgrounds: master data management (MDM) or data platforms. You don't need to cover both. We're looking for real depth in one.

What you'll do

* Act as the subject matter expert on MDM or data platform pre-implementation or implementations for life sciences clients, depending on your background
* Tackle the data challenges typical of customer engagement, such as HCP/HCO data quality, CRM master and reference data
* Bring third-party reference data (IQVIA, Veeva) together with client data
* Work with architects, functional consultants and client stakeholders to turn requirements into working data solutions

What you bring

* A proven track record as a subject matter expert in either:

* MDM implementations (e.g. Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM), or

* data platform implementations (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica IDMC)
* A solid understanding of data management and its typical challenges in the customer engagement (CE) domain
* A general understanding of CE processes within CRM, marketing automation, consent management, and event and engagement management
* Good knowledge of the data models of at least one key data provider: IQVIA OneKey, IQVIA sales and prescription data, or Veeva OpenData
* Clear communication, spoken and written
* Excellent English

A plus if you have

* Deep knowledge of one or more CE processes
* A certification in an MDM solution (Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM) or a data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica)
* GAMP 5 training or hands-on experience

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

* Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning
* Execution matters --- we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice
* Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines
* Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

* Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs
* Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance
* Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career
* A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work
* Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results
* The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay---++submit your application in English++ at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy++.++

jobs.description:
**Overview**

As a Solution Engineer -- AI Business Solutions (Cloud Endpoint), you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise customers, helping them modernize their endpoint and virtual desktop environments for secure, cloud-native, AI-enabled work.

You will lead technical engagements across the Cloud Endpoint portfolio, including Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Entra ID, translating customer business and technical requirements into scalable solution architectures. You will drive technical wins through discovery, architectural design, demonstrations, workshops, and proofs of concept, while partnering closely with sales, security, identity, engineering, and partner teams.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead technical discovery and customer conversations to understand business, security, endpoint management, virtualization, and AI-related requirements and translate them into solution strategies.

* Design and present secure, scalable Cloud Endpoint architectures leveraging technologies such as Windows 365, Azure Virtual Desktop, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender, and Microsoft Entra ID.

* Drive technical wins by delivering architectural design sessions, demonstrations, hands-on workshops, Proofs of Concept (POCs), and technical close plans that demonstrate solution value and integration with customer environments.

* Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers modernize legacy VDI and endpoint management environments and adopt cloud-native, identity-first, and Zero Trust approaches.

* Partner with account teams, specialists, Cloud Solution Architects, security and identity teams, partners, and engineering to develop strategic win plans, resolve technical blockers, and accelerate customer adoption.

* Apply competitive, industry, partner, and technical knowledge to position Microsoft solutions effectively, identify competitive opportunities, and provide feedback to product and engineering teams.

* Continuously develop technical expertise across Cloud Endpoint, security, identity, virtualization, and emerging AI technologies while sharing knowledge and best practices with customers, partners, and internal teams.

**Qualifications**

**Required/minimum qualifications**

· Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 3+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND 4+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR 5+ years technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR equivalent experience.

· Professional proficiency in English, with the ability to lead technical discussions, presentations, demonstrations, and architecture conversations with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders in both written and verbal interactions.

**Additional or preferred qualifications**

· 6+ years technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.

· 4+ years experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.

· Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines (e.g., Office 365, Power BI, Azure Architect and Development exams, Cloud Platform Technologies, Information Security, Architecture).

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. 🔐 ¿Qué harás?

* Administrar la consola, tenants, sites, grupos, agentes y políticas de SentinelOne Singularity.
* Monitorear alertas, investigar amenazas y ejecutar acciones de contención, aislamiento, kill, quarantine, remediation y rollback según los procedimientos establecidos.
* Gestionar el despliegue, actualización, salud y cobertura de agentes en Windows, Linux y macOS.
* Analizar exclusiones y falsos positivos, evaluando su impacto y documentando las excepciones.
* Integrar la telemetría de SentinelOne con soluciones SIEM/SOAR.
* Colaborar con equipos de Threat Hunting, Incident Response y Vulnerability Management.
* Generar reportes de cobertura, detecciones, tendencias y cumplimiento operativo.
* Coordinar investigaciones e incidentes con equipos de SOC, infraestructura y soporte.

📍 Condiciones

* Rol: SentinelOne Security Specialist
* Especialidad: Cybersecurity / Endpoint Security / EDR
* Ubicación: Colombia

🌟 **Buscamos un perfil técnico, autónomo y orientado a la respuesta** , capaz de mantener una alta cobertura de endpoints, investigar amenazas y tomar decisiones efectivas frente a incidentes de seguridad.

📩 Si tienes experiencia en **SentinelOne, EDR/XDR y Endpoint Security** , ¡postúlate y sé parte de Accenture!

🔎 ¿Qué buscamos?

* 4 años de experiencia en Endpoint Security, SOC, Incident Response o áreas relacionadas.
* Experiencia hands-on con SentinelOne Singularity o plataformas EDR/XDR equivalentes.
* Conocimientos sólidos de seguridad en Windows y Linux, malware, comportamiento de procesos, persistencia y respuesta a incidentes.
* Experiencia investigando alertas y ejecutando acciones de contención y remediación.
* Capacidad para documentar investigaciones y coordinar incidentes con equipos técnicos.
* Autonomía operativa y buen criterio para escalar incidentes de acuerdo con su criticidad.

⭐ Será un plus

* Certificación SentinelOne o formación específica en la plataforma.
* Experiencia con SIEM/SOAR, scripting, Threat Hunting y MITRE ATT\&CK.
* Experiencia en administración masiva de endpoints.
* Conocimientos de IAM/PAM y Cloud Workload Security.

Leidos is seeking an experienced Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Engineer to support enterprise digital employee experience capabilities. jobs.title: Senior MDM Engineer
jobs.summary: Job Description Who We Are HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next. We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and...
jobs.description:
Job Description

 Who We Are

HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.

We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and high-growth SaaS companies, to modernize operating models and embed data, automation, and AI into the core of how work gets done.

Our clients aren’t just upgrading technology. They are rethinking workflows, activating governed AI, and designing environments where humans and intelligent systems work side by side.

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long-term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

 The Role

HIKE2 is hiring a senior Master Data Management Engineer for its data and integration practice. You will architect and build resolved identity and relationship foundations for financial services clients.

 Own the end-to-end MDM and relationship-graph architecture on an engagement, from data modeling through integration, data quality, and governance. Design and configure match and merge logic, survivorship and trust rules, validation rules, and golden-record management. Build entity resolution, the golden record, and the graph, along with the pipelines that feed them and syndicate trusted master data back to consuming systems. Establish the data-quality baseline and the survivorship and stewardship operating model, including steward workflows and issue queues. Define the identity seam between the client identity platform and the MDM layer, turning an authenticated claim into a resolved party. Set engineering standards, document a repeatable delivery approach, and mentor and grow a small team. Collaborate with data governance, CRM and source-system owners, and business stakeholders, and translate complex MDM concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Requirements

The following is the depth we expect. A strong candidate is hands-on across most of these areas, not familiar with them in theory.

 Identity resolution and matching

 Design and implement deterministic and probabilistic match logic, configuring match rules, thresholds, and trust scoring, and tuning them over time to balance false merges against missed matches. Weight strong identifiers such as tax ID and date of birth above shared attributes like name and address, and handle nicknames, transliteration, and address standardization. Build and maintain crosswalks between each source system's local key and the canonical party identifier.

 Golden record and survivorship

 Design golden, or best, record construction with attribute-level survivorship and trust rules that define which source wins per attribute and why, with full lineage. Implement merge, unmerge, split handling, and manage record consolidation safely in production. Establish validation rules and the golden-record lifecycle: create, update, retire.

 Party and relationship data modeling

 Model the party domain across person, legal entity, household, and account, with relationships, hierarchies, crosswalks, and reference data. Design the relationship graph ontology: households, beneficial ownership (UBO) chains, advisor-to-client, entity-to-account, collateral, and exposure, with effective dating so relationships are time-valid. Define measurable data-quality metrics and the minimum required attributes for each domain.

 Data quality and stewardship

 Build automated data profiling and a measured baseline for completeness, accuracy, consistency, and duplication. Implement data-quality rules, validation logic, and exception handling, and design steward workflows, issue queues, and dashboards that make stewardship efficient. Partner with governance to define master data policies, standards, and the stewardship operating model, and maintain data dictionaries per domain.

 Integration and pipelines

 Design inbound and outbound integration patterns to ingest source data and syndicate trusted master data back to operational, analytical, and reporting systems. Build ingestion and integration jobs, implement change data capture, and stand-up real-time resolve-and-lookup services with acceptable latency. Consume an authenticated claim from the identity platform and translate it to a resolved party identifier through the orchestration and integration layer.

 Cloud data platform

 Build on a modern cloud data stack, Azure preferred, using the medallion or lakehouse pattern across bronze, silver, and gold. Manage multiple environments (development, test, QA, production) with performance tuning, monitoring, and cost awareness.

 Graph engineering

 Implement the relationship graph on a property-graph store (Neo4j with Cypher, or Cosmos DB with Gremlin), keyed strictly on the canonical party identifier. Build graph queries and traversals for multi-hop questions such as UBO chains and advisor-to-borrower authorization, returning explainable, evidenced assertions with effective dates.

 Programming and platforms

 Strong SQL and proficiency in Python, with Java or .Net as needed to extend MDM platforms and build services. Hands-on with at least one enterprise MDM platform (Informatica MDM, Reltio, Semarchy, Ataccama, or Profisee) and the judgment to weigh build-lite on the existing stack against a packaged product. Comfortable with data governance and quality tool (for example Ab Initio or Collibra) and with workflow tooling.

 Security, governance, and regulatory

 Build for audit and regulatory review: full lineage, decision logs, and traceable survivorship. Apply KYC, AML, and beneficial ownership requirements under the Bank Secrecy Act and USA PATRIOT Act, and handle PII, tokenization, and access controls appropriately. Desired ExperienceTen to fifteen years in enterprise data engineering and architecture, with master data management delivered in production, not just designed. Demonstrated ability to both architect and build, having designed the system and then implemented it, not a design-only background. Financial services required, private and commercial banking strongly preferred, where a client is at once a person, an entity, a household member, and a borrower, and where party is a regulated, first-class concept. Proven physical MDM design with a party model, and experience resolving duplicated or unresolved entities upstream in identity. Familiarity with enterprise identity platforms, including Ping, and how digital identity binds to data identity. Experience building for audit in a regulated industry, having survived a real audit or examination. AI-assisted MDM: intelligent match scoring, automated survivorship suggestions, and anomaly flagging, kept governed, auditable, and validated before promotion to master. Experience with the systems common to banking estates: core banking (for example Fiserv), CRM (for example Salesforce), loan origination and servicing (for example Broadridge), and client due diligence (for example Fenergo). A track record of mentoring or leading a small engineering team, and consulting or client-facing delivery experience. Exposure to externalized authorization or relationship-based access control, where the graph supplies context and a decision point applies policy.

 Certifications

Certifications are preferred, not mandatory. We value demonstrated, hands-on delivery above any credential, and a candidate certified on one platform who can clearly reason across others is stronger than one certification alone. A current certification in one or more of the following is a plus.

 MDM platforms

 Informatica: Professional or Practitioner certification in MDM, MDM SaaS or Cloud, or Informatica Data Quality (IDQ), and related Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) credentials. Reltio Certified Professional, for the Reltio Connected Data Platform. Semarchy xDM certification (Discovery or Practitioner). Ataccama ONE certification. Profisee certification, particularly for teams on the Microsoft and Azure stack.

 Cloud, data platform, and graph

 Microsoft Azure: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert, given our Azure-preferred stack. Databricks or Snowflake certification where the client stacks calls for it. Neo4j Certified Professional, or an equivalent graph credential, for the relationship graph work.

 Governance and adjacent

 Data governance or quality credentials such as Collibra Ranger, or the DAMA CDMP (Certified Data Management Professional). A recognized cloud security or privacy certification is a plus given the regulated setting.

The salary range for this position is: $125,000-$175,000+k/annually. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. This range is exclusive of any bonuses or commissions. HIKE2 offers a wide range of benefits for full time employees which may include medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more.

 Don’t meet every requirement? As an innovation consultancy, we recognize that talent is not always related to job history and skills come from valuable experiences that aren’t always shown on a resume. If you are excited to make a positive impact, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for our organization, whether it be this role or another.

At HIKE2, we recognize that conviction records may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship to responsibilities such as accessing sensitive company or customer information, handling proprietary assets, or collaborating closely with team members. We evaluate these factors thoughtfully to establish a secure and trusted workplace for all.

Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Palo Alto Networks is looking for an experienced and motivated solutions engineer with a passion for endpoint security controls that protect the workforce from attacks. This engineer will work closely with our sales team and ultimately be responsible for the technical “win” during the sales cycle. The Domain Consultant – Endpoint must demonstrate value during presentations, articulate technical challenges, pair with Palo Alto Networks solutions, and provide technical knowledge and experience to earn customer trust.

Palo Alto Networks Endpoint Privilege Manager (part of the Idira platform), a critical and foundational endpoint control addresses the underlying weaknesses of endpoint defenses against a privileged attacker and helps enterprises defend against these attacks.

Palo Alto Networks Domain Consultants work with the sales organization and are responsible for establishing the value of Palo Alto Networks products to prospective and current customers through demos, presentations, meetings, and proofs of concepts (POCs). Domain Consultants also help to create successful and happy customers by building relationships and technical trust with customers. The Domain Consultant is seen internally and externally as a technical expert on Palo Alto Networks products, as well as an industry expert in Identity and End Point security.

Responsibilities

Build and deliver product demonstrations and sales presentations to create excitement around Palo Alto Networks technology. Use your knowledge of various workforce operating systems and security concepts to understand and align with customer needs, matching their problems with Palo Alto Networks solutions.Plan and execute POC evaluations of Palo Alto Networks products with prospective customers. Use your sales experience to position Palo Alto Networks value and differentiators to acquire the technical win.Document customer interactions in Salesforce.Collect and deliver constant feedback to Palo Alto Networks product management team to influence product direction and champion the voice of your customers.Earn customer trust by demonstrating expertise in the area of endpoint and user security.Present and evangelize during tradeshows and customer events.

Qualifications

Advanced working knowledge (5+ years) of 2 of 3 primary workstation/server operating systems (Windows, MacOS, Linux).Prior experience working primarily with endpoint/workstation products or solutions in a sales capacity. Hands-on experience with endpoint and identity management technologies such as: Active Directory, Intune, SCCM/MECM, Jamf and endpoint troubleshooting.Strong presentation skills and professional demeanor. Ability to articulate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.An understanding of security concepts and the development of security roles within organizations that meet functional, technical and regulatory requirements.Ability to anticipate risks and devise solutions in the moment; adaptable.Proven ability to run technical discovery, design solutions, deliver demonstrations, answer RFPs and support complex sales opportunities.Travel as needed (Experience navigating enterprise-scale sales cycles preferred.Experience working with restAPIs with scripts or other no code/low code systems

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

Description
WELLTOWER – REIMAGINE REAL ESTATE WITH US

At Welltower, we’re transforming how the world thinks about senior living and wellness-focused real estate. As a global leader in residential wellness and healthcare infrastructure, we create vibrant, purpose-driven communities where housing, healthcare, and hospitality converge. Our culture is fast-paced, collaborative, and endlessly ambitious—guided by our mantra: The only easy day was yesterday.

We’re looking for bold, independent thinkers who thrive on challenge, embrace complexity, and are driven to deliver long-term value. Every team member is empowered to think like an owner, innovate fearlessly, and lead from where they stand. If you're passionate about outcomes and inspired by the opportunity to shape the future of healthcare infrastructure, we want you on our best-in-class team.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Welltower is seeking a Digital Workplace Engineer with deep specialization in Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management. This role supports the design, implementation, governance, and continuous improvement of Welltower’s digital workplace ecosystem, with a primary focus on endpoint management, device security, application delivery, and user experience across Microsoft 365. The engineer will partner closely with Security, Identity, Service Desk, Infrastructure, and business teams to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable workplace technology services.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Engineer and support modern digital workplace capabilities across Microsoft 365 and endpoint services.
Maintain standards, configurations, documentation, and lifecycle practices for workplace technology platforms.
Contribute to digital workplace roadmap execution with a focus on secure, reliable, and user-friendly experiences.

Microsoft Intune & Endpoint Specialization

Lead Microsoft Intune design, implementation, governance, and operational management across Windows, iOS, and Android.
Design and enforce device compliance policies, endpoint security baselines, configuration profiles, and enrollment strategies.
Implement and optimize Windows Autopilot provisioning, device enrollment, zero-touch deployment, and device lifecycle processes.

Application, Patch & Configuration Management

Package, deploy, and maintain Win32, Microsoft Store, and mobile applications through Intune.
Support software update rings, feature update policies, driver/firmware strategies, and patch compliance reporting.
Troubleshoot application deployment failures, policy conflicts, and configuration drift to improve reliability and user adoption.

Endpoint Security, Access & Compliance

Partner with Security and Identity teams to align endpoint posture with Zero Trust principles and Conditional Access requirements.
Support Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration, endpoint security policy deployment, attack surface reduction settings, and device risk remediation.
Manage BYOD strategies including Mobile Application Management, app protection policies, and data protection controls.

Operational Support & Service Excellence

Provide Tier 2/3 escalation support for endpoint, application, compliance, and digital workplace service issues.
Monitor endpoint health, compliance, deployment status, and service performance trends.
Identify recurring issues and lead corrective actions, knowledge documentation, and service improvement initiatives.
Develop automation using PowerShell, Microsoft Graph API, and Intune reporting capabilities.
Create operational reporting for device posture, application deployment, compliance, and remediation progress.
Continuously improve endpoint performance, service reliability, and the employee technology experience.
Collaborate with Security, Identity, Service Desk, Infrastructure, Procurement, and business stakeholders.
Participate in governance processes including change management, standards development, operational readiness, and documentation.
Provide guidance and enablement to support teams for endpoint and digital workplace processes.

OTHER DUTIES

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of this employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

TRAVEL

Minimal travel

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

5+ years of experience in digital workplace, endpoint engineering, systems administration, or Microsoft 365 operations.
Required specialization in Microsoft Intune / Endpoint Manager, including Autopilot, enrollment, compliance, configuration profiles, and endpoint security baselines.
Strong experience with Windows endpoint management, application packaging/deployment, update management, and troubleshooting endpoint policy behavior.

jobs.description:
About the position

The Endpoint Administrator owns the operational lifecycle of company endpoints and the technology aspects of employee onboarding and offboarding. This role is responsible for ensuring laptops, desktops, mobile devices, shared workstations, and related peripherals are securely standardized, provisioned, maintained, supported, recovered, and retired. The Endpoint Administrator works closely with Human Resources, hiring managers, IT support, security, and infrastructure teams to deliver a consistent employee technology experience while maintaining accurate asset and access records.

Responsibilities

Own the complete lifecycle of company endpoints, including standards, procurement coordination, receiving, staging, deployment, assignment, support, reassignment, refresh, recovery, and secure retirement or disposal.Administer endpoint management, remote monitoring and management, deployment, and mobile device management platforms; maintain device enrollment, configuration profiles, policies, and compliance rules.Provision laptops, desktops, mobile devices, shared workstations, and peripherals using standardized builds, required applications, security controls, and role-based configurations.Coordinate and execute employee onboarding by preparing equipment, accounts, licenses, group memberships, applications, and access in partnership with Human Resources and hiring managers.Coordinate and execute employee offboarding by disabling access, reclaiming equipment and licenses, preserving or transferring business data as authorized, documenting disposition, and securely wiping devices for reuse or disposal.Maintain accurate endpoint and asset records, including assigned user, location, serial number, model, warranty, configuration, status, and planned replacement date.Manage operating system, application, driver, BIOS, and firmware patching; monitor compliance and remediate devices that fall outside established security or maintenance standards.Implement and maintain endpoint security controls, including encryption, endpoint protection, local administrator restrictions, screen-lock standards, and secure configuration baselines.Package, test, deploy, update, and remove business applications while supporting software licensing, standardization, and compatibility requirements.Troubleshoot endpoint, peripheral, profile, performance, connectivity, and application issues; identify root causes and coordinate vendor repair or replacement when necessary.Maintain ready-to-deploy inventory and forecast endpoint refresh, warranty, and accessory needs to support timely onboarding, replacements, and business growth.Create and maintain endpoint standards, onboarding and offboarding checklists, support documentation, knowledge articles, and audit-ready records; report on fleet health, patch compliance, inventory accuracy, and lifecycle status.Requirements

Three or more years of experience in endpoint administration, desktop engineering, IT support, systems administration, or a related role
Demonstrated experience provisioning, managing, troubleshooting, and retiring Windows 10/11 endpoints in a corporate environment
Experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Group Policy, and role-based user and device provisioning
Experience with endpoint management, RMM, deployment, or mobile device management platforms
Experience with application packaging and deployment, patch management, disk encryption, endpoint protection, and security compliance remediation
Experience maintaining hardware inventory, asset assignments, warranties, refresh schedules, and secure device disposition records
Strong endpoint troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across hardware, operating systems, applications, user profiles, peripherals, and connectivity
Ability to organize and execute time-sensitive onboarding, offboarding, deployment, and device-recovery activities with a high degree of accuracy
Working knowledge of endpoint management, RMM, software deployment, patching, encryption, endpoint security, and remote support technologies
Strong customer service and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical information clearly to employees and managers
Ability to create and maintain clear procedures, checklists, asset records, and technical documentation
Strong attention to detail, ownership, discretion, and sound judgment when handling company devices, employee data, credentials, and access
Nice-to-haves

Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot experience is preferred
Relevant certifications such as Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate, CompTIA A+, Network+, Security+, or equivalent practical experience preferred

jobs.description:
IT SECURITY ENGINEER

Edinburgh

Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operations platform for in-house teams, and we're growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgment matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We're built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend, and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com http://Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we're building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

Why this role is different

We treat internal IT as a product and our employees as its users, not as tickets. If your answer to a repeated problem is to do it faster by hand, this isn't the seat — and it isn't a back-room coding role either.

You'll be the engineer who builds the platform that provisions, supports and secures every Wordsmith employee, end to end. The goal is for the function to get more automated as we grow, not need more people.

The Role

You'll own onboarding, access, devices and offboarding as one connected system, and build the tooling — including coding agent workflows — that removes the manual steps at every stage. You'll be hands-on with the physical side of the job too, in the Edinburgh office.

What you'll do

 - Build a joiner pipeline that reads a new hire from Humaans, creates their identity in Okta, assigns app access by group rule, and triggers zero-touch laptop enrolment in Jamf — no manual steps

 - Build a Slack assistant, backed by a coding agent, that handles requests like “I need access to X” or “my laptop is slow” and either fixes them or routes them, resolving most without a human

 - Build a hardware vending machine for the Edinburgh office that dispenses chargers, dongles, headsets and loan laptops against an employee's identity, with stock reordered automatically

 - Write scripts and infrastructure as code that configure devices, enforce security baselines, and produce compliance evidence on their own

 - Build an offboarding flow that revokes access everywhere, wipes and reclaims the device, and files the record the moment someone is marked as a leaver

What good looks like in the first year

 - Zero-touch onboarding: within six months, a new hire's accounts, apps and access provision automatically from Humaans through Okta, and their laptop self-enrols — day one setup takes minutes, not hours

 - Self-service by default: within nine months, the top twenty employee IT requests — access, kit, resets, software — are self-served through automation, chat or a vending machine, not a ticket to a person

 - Automated joiner/mover/leaver: within twelve months, role changes and offboarding run automatically from the HRIS, with access removed same-day and hardware recovered

 - Build over buy: you ship internal tooling and coding agent workflows that remove manual steps, so the function scales on automation, not headcount

 - Secure and audit-ready: the fleet stays managed and SOC 2 evidence generates itself, rather than being assembled by hand before an audit

Who you might be

We're not hiring a traditional IT person — we're hiring someone who builds. That might mean you're:

 - a software engineer who likes owning systems end to end and wants a broad, high-ownership remit

 - a DevOps, SRE or platform engineer who automates infrastructure and wants to point that at people and devices

 - a strong IT or systems person who already codes and automates rather than clicking through consoles

 - someone from a smaller company or an MSP who has wired up tools, identity and devices and scripted the boring parts away

What matters is the instinct to automate anything you have to do twice, and to build the tool rather than do the task. We'll teach the IT domain to a strong builder — we won't teach someone to be a builder.

What we're looking for

 - You write real code and automate with APIs and scripts — Python, Bash or TypeScript. This isn't optional.

 - You think in systems: identity, access, data flows and lifecycle

 - You're comfortable using AI coding agents to build and ship tooling fast

 - You care about security and doing things properly, not just quickly

 - You're happy working on-site in Edinburgh and hands-on with real hardware

Bonus:

 - Exposure to identity and device tooling such as Okta, Google Workspace or Jamf

 - Experience with SOC 2 or security compliance

 - Having run or automated onboarding, end

### About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

### **About the role:**

We are looking for an IT Systems Engineer to build and secure the identity and access management (IAM) and mobile device management (MDM) systems for employees who build agents and internal tools every day. You will design access and device policies that let them ship quickly without exposing company data, and automate the work with scripts, API integrations, and AI tooling alongside our IT and Security engineers. This is a hybrid role based in San Francisco, New York City, or Austin, with three days a week in the office.

### **What you’ll do:**

- Configure Okta, including application integrations, single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), groups, access policies, and automated provisioning
- Build onboarding, role-change, and offboarding automation that keeps employee access current
- Configure and maintain MDM for device enrollment, software deployment, patching, encryption, and compliance controls
- Build scripts, API integrations, and automation across Okta, MDM, Google Workspace, Slack, and IT service management systems, using AI to write and troubleshoot code and reviewing its output before it ships
- Partner with Security on least-privilege access that lets employees connect agents and internal tools to company systems safely, along with device security standards and access reviews, and serve as the escalation point for complex identity and device issues

### **What you need:**

- 7+ years of hands-on IT systems engineering experience, with deep expertise in either IAM or MDM and working knowledge of the other
- Administered Okta and integrated applications using Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), OpenID Connect (OIDC), and System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM)
- Configured and operated an MDM platform such as Jamf, Kandji/Iru, or Intune
- Wrote automation in Python or Bash against APIs, and used AI to build and troubleshoot it, reviewing generated code before deploying

### **Bonus if you:**

- Managed Okta or other IT systems as code with Terraform, including version-controlled configurations, code review, and configuration drift management
- Supported AWS identity and access configurations
- Built or hosted a project on Vercel

### **Benefits:**

- Competitive salary and meaningful equity
- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage
- Generous paid time off and parental leave
- Professional development stipend
- Daily lunch and commuter benefits (SF office)

### Compensation & Benefits:

- Competitive compensation package, including equity.

- Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.

- We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $180,000.00 - $288,000.00. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

 IT INFRASTRUCTURE ENGINEER, VIRTUALIZATION & STORAGE

 As an IT Infrastructure Engineer on the infrastructure team, you will collaborate with internal teams to deliver innovative solutions for SpaceX’s growing infrastructure demands. You will ensure quality and reliability of systems across the software lifecycle while scaling and supporting data center infrastructure, virtualization, Kubernetes, and storage environments. You should have strong opinions on designing, testing, and operating virtualization platforms and multi-tier storage (enterprise + HPC) and be ready to build the next generation of SpaceX data center platforms.

 RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Implement and maintain a scalable, robust VMware environment and identify efficiencies supporting critical applications

- Design, implement, and maintain storage infrastructure across high-performance, capacity, archive, backup/recovery, and disaster recovery tiers

- Architect and operate high-throughput, low-latency storage and support exabyte scale file systems (e.g., VAST,) for simulation, telemetry, and high-concurrency workloads

- Administer enterprise storage platforms (NetApp, Pure FlashArray/FlashBlade, Cohesity, Scality) and manage access controls, permissions, and protocols (NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI)

- Perform data center deployments, monitor performance, and troubleshoot production issues across virtualization, storage, transport (RDMA), and protocol layers

- Develop automation/tooling for monitoring, capacity planning, configuration management, and alerting; define standards for deployment and performance tuning

- Collaborate with compute, networking, and application teams to align virtualization and storage strategies with workload requirements

- Participate in on-call rotation, scheduled maintenance, and occasional physical installation support

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems, computer science, engineering or related technical field and 3+ years of engineering experience in an enterprise environment; OR 5+ years of engineering experience in lieu of a degree

- 1+ years of professional experience managing virtualized server environments

- 5+ years of experience in IT storage engineering with enterprise platforms (NetApp, Pure Storage, Scality, Vast or similar)

 PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Experience with full lifecycle management of large-scale VMware environments and supporting container infrastructure with Kubernetes

- Experience with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tools

- Deep knowledge of RDMA, congestion control, lossless Ethernet, RoCEv2, and/or InfiniBand storage fabrics in HPC or latency-sensitive environments

- Experience automating infrastructure with Python, PowerShell, or Ansible

- Familiarity with HPC schedulers (Slurm, LFS) and how storage tiers interact with job scheduling

- Linux and Windows OS system administration experience

- Exceptional analytical and troubleshooting skills; strong written and verbal communication

- Willingness to respond to after-hours triage and operational support

- Strong understanding of storage protocols (NFS, CIFS/SMB, iSCSI) and experience with client/server systems, monitoring tools, enterprise networking, and virtualization

 ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Willingness to work extended hours and weekends as needed

 COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
IT Infrastructure Engineer: $130,000.00-$175,000.00/per year

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock, stock options, or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks.
