About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

The Endpoint team (Client Platform Engineering) treats Anthropic's device fleet as a platform we build and run. We run our own MDM as a production service and manage every piece of device configuration as code. Policies, configuration profiles, queries, remediation scripts, and software all ship through pull requests, CI, a staging environment, and a canary group before they reach the fleet. The fleet is mostly macOS, plus a small number of Linux machines and a growing mobile footprint.

- Support a small number of Linux machines alongside the Mac fleet

- Have 8+ years building secure IT systems in complex environments, including leading projects across multiple teams

- Treat endpoint configuration as code that is version controlled and peer reviewed, rather than clicking in consoles

- Go deep on macOS internals such as launchd, configuration profiles, TCC, and system extensions

- Write design docs and runbooks so teammates can review and support what you build

- Have experience running infrastructure as code in a public cloud

- Have working knowledge of Linux administration (packaging, systems, config management)

- Have used LLMs to automate ops work

jobs.description:
About Thatch

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give every employee a real healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them, and employers get predictable costs they can control.

It's a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology, and we're just getting started. We look for people who like solving complex problems, use good judgment, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here care deeply about our customers, take real responsibility for what gets built, and are driven by doing work that matters.

About The Role

At Thatch, technology is how our teams get their work done, securely and without friction. As our IT Ops/Systems Engineer, you'll own the systems and access infrastructure that keeps the company running: endpoint compliance, identity and access management, and the operational backbone behind our security initiatives. This role goes beyond day-to-day support. You'll be the owner of company-wide compliance, conditional access and privileged access workflows in a Mac-first environment, with the autonomy to build the systems and automation that let us scale securely. If you want real ownership over how a fast-growing technology company manages access and identity, this role is for you.

What you'll do

Own our technology stack including Okta, Iru, Mac, iOS, Android, Rippling MDM/SSO, 1Password, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, Slack, Zoom, Linear, and NotionDrive endpoint fleet compliance to 100% coverage across MDM, EDR, and DLP, and own remediation when devices fall out of complianceAdminister conditional access policies (device trust, managed browser enforcement) and own the exception and escalation process when legitimate access gets blockedOwn the Privileged Access Management (PAM) workflow, including replacing manual quarterly access reviews with automated request, approval, and time-bound removalRun trusted device and MFA enrollment, and lead remediation campaigns for weak or breached passwordsOwn the complete employee lifecycle experience from onboarding through offboarding, managing access control, hardware provisioning, and audit-ready documentationVet and administer new SaaS tooling for SSO/IdP compliance as part of vendor onboarding, expose and remediate shadow ITBuild and maintain a knowledge base that empowers employees to solve common issues independentlyIdentify and build automation for repetitive IT and access-management tasksPartner with the Head of IT and Security to support company-wide initiatives and maintain our security posture

Background we're looking for

4-6 years of hands-on IT support or systems engineering experience in a corporate environment, ideally including some ownership of identity/access infrastructureCertification in Network+, Security+, JAMF, Bettercloud, Okta, or comparable credentialsDeep understanding of SSO, 2FA, passkeys, conditional access, and password management systemsExperience administering or implementing a PAM tool, or a clear grasp of the concepts and willingness to build one from scratchStrong knowledge of security principles and best practices with proven ability to implement them at scaleExcellent follow-through and organizational skills. You never let tasks fall through the cracks

Experience We'd Be Particularly Excited About

Experience driving a fleet from partial to full MDM/EDR/DLP compliance, and building the exception workflow that kept support ticket volume manageableSelf-motivated individuals who can work independently with minimal supervision and take ownership of projects from start to finishQuick learners who can master new technologies with minimal guidancePatient communicators with flexible, inclusive interpersonal skills who genuinely enjoy helping othersProblem-solvers who are resilient in learning from mistakes and view technical challenges as opportunitiesPeople who thrive in fast-paced environments and can adapt quickly to changing priorities

What to expect

 For more than 65 years, The State Group's 3,500+ professionals have built and maintained the infrastructure that keeps businesses and industries moving across North America.  BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US

   This position is integral to our success and offers opportunities for career advancement.

jobs.description:
#### **About the Company**

We are a renewable energy and ocean technology company committed to rapidly developing and deploying technologies that will ensure a sustainable future for Earth by unlocking the vast energy potential of its oceans. Our focus is on capturing civilizational levels of ultra-low-cost renewable energy for applications including computing and affordable renewable fuels delivered to shore.

The company is a public benefit corporation headquartered in Portland, Oregon, and backed by leading venture capitalists, philanthropic investors, university endowments, and private investment offices. We operate as an idea meritocracy in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

Our staff have worked at organizations such as SpaceX, Blue Origin, Boeing, Tesla, Apple, Virgin Orbit, Astra, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, New Relic, Bridgewater, Raytheon, Disney Imagineering, and the US Army and Air Force, as well as research universities, startups, and small companies across a range of industries.

#### **About the Job**

Our core technology is the node, a device that produces energy in the ocean’s harshest conditions for years at a time without human maintenance or intervention.

We're looking for an Endpoint Engineer to own how every laptop, phone, and piece of office technology at Panthalassa is deployed, secured, and kept healthy. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role sitting alongside our IT Support function. You'll lead the initiatives that let us scale device management without scaling headcount: zero touch deployment for Windows and macOS, BYOD support for mobile devices, endpoint security baselines, and the device compliance posture our access policies depend on. You'll also serve as an escalation point and mentor for our IT Support Specialists, and act as our subject matter expert in physical office technology, from access control to printers to patch panels.

Our IT Support team runs the day to day of the physical office: badge issuance, printer break/fix, conference room checks, and desk moves. You own the design, standards, and escalations behind all of it, and you get your hands dirty on build-outs and the hard problems. One day you're writing configuration profiles to automate workstation security, the next you're installing A/V equipment and running patch cables.

Candidates should have strong interpersonal skills and be able to thrive in a creative, scrappy, and collaborative environment in which the best ideas change the company’s direction on a regular basis.

#### **Responsibilities**

##### **Endpoint Management and Zero Touch Deployment**

- Administer our MDM platforms (Microsoft Intune, JumpCloud) for Windows and macOS devices, including enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, and application delivery.
- Architect and execute our zero touch provisioning rollout (Windows Autopilot and Apple Business Manager / Automatic Device Enrollment), eliminating manual imaging for new device deployments.
- Drive device enrollment to full coverage and keep it there through regular audit.
- Design and implement BYOD policies and enrollment workflows that enable secure access from personal devices.
- Own the device lifecycle: procurement standards, refresh cadence, repair, and secure decommissioning.

##### **Endpoint Security and Compliance**

- Build and enforce endpoint security baselines, patch management cadences, and device health policies.
- Deliver the device compliance signals our Conditional Access policies rely on, working with our IAM Engineer to keep policy and posture in sync.
- Monitor and respond to endpoint telemetry and security alerts, driving remediation with the relevant owners.
- Translate compliance framework requirements (NIST or equivalent) into concrete endpoint controls and documentation.

##### **Escalation and Mentorship**

- Serve as the primary escalation point for our IT Support Specialists on complex hardware, OS, and device issues.
- Mentor the support team and transfer knowledge deliberately so fixes land at tier 1 the next time.
- Write and maintain runbooks and knowledge base content in Confluence.

#### **Required Qualifications**

- Experience administering endpoint management including MDM, device compliance, and application deployment.
- Experience building or running zero touch deployment at scale (Autopilot, Apple Business Manager / ADE, or equivalent).
- Ability to write clear documentation and turn written policy into enforceable technical controls.
- Comfort working across abstraction layers, designing systems one day and swapping hardware the next.

#### **Desired Qualifications**

- Experience administering a modern MDM solution such as Intune, Jamf, JumpCloud, or Kandji.
- Comfort with scripting for endpoint automation (PowerShell, bash, Python).
- Familiarity with zero trust concepts and how device posture feeds access decisions.
- Experience supporting or implementing a security or compliance framework (NIST, ISO 27001, SOC 2, or equivalent).
- Experience with endpoint telemetry and security alert response, including triage, remediation, and root cause.

The above qualifications are desired, not required. We encourage you to apply if you are a strong candidate with only some of the desired skills and experience listed.

#### **Additional Requirements**

- Available for occasional evening and weekend work to support deployments, maintenance windows, and office moves.
- Travel to vendor sites and other company locations as needed.
- Intermittently able to work longer hours to support critical needs. While we expect a lot of each other, we also offer a high degree of autonomy and work-life balance, including flexible PTO and flexible working hours.

#### **Compensation and Benefits**

If hired for this full-time role, you will receive:

- Cash compensation of $120,000 - $180,000.
- Equity in the company. We’re all owners and if we’re successful, this equity should be far and away the most valuable component of your compensation.
- A benefits package that helps you take care of yourself and your family, including:
  - Flexible paid time off
  - Health insurance (the company pays 100% of gold-level PPO plan for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Dental insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Vision insurance (the company pays 100% for full-time employees, their partners, and dependents)
  - Disability insurance (the company pays 100% for a policy to provide long-term financial support if you become disabled)
  - Ability to contribute to tax-advantaged accounts, including 401(k), health FSA, and dependent care FSA
- Relocation assistance to facilitate your move to Portland (if needed).

#### **Location**

This is an on-site position. Our offices, lab, and shop are located in
Portland, Oregon.

jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3.ai http://Horizon3.ai is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find, fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZero™ platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by IT Ops/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs.

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers & operators, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools and false positives, resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox" security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn-it-alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

As a remote first company, we require minimum 25Mbps consumer grade broadband connection.

What You'll Do

You will lead Client Platform — the team responsible for the software that lives in customer environments and makes NodeZero's autonomous pentests possible. Client Platform owns two sub-teams: Image Build & Release (the factory that produces and signs the NodeZero runner container image) and OTA Services (the system that keeps runners current across thousands of customer environments). Every pentest NodeZero runs depends on this team's work being reliable, secure, and fast.

 - Team Building & Culture: Build, mentor, and grow Client Platform to ~10 engineers across Image Build & Release and OTA Services. You will directly manage the Engineering Managers of both sub-teams and set the technical and cultural direction for the full org. Establish engineering norms and a culture of ownership for a team whose software runs in environments you cannot control.

 - Image Build & Release: Lead end-to-end CI/CD workflows to create, sign, and reliably publish the NodeZero runner container image. Own software supply chain security: reproducible builds, image signing, SBOM generation, and vulnerability scanning in CI.

 - OTA Services: Architect and operate the over-the-air update delivery system that keeps NodeZero runners current across thousands of customer environments — reliably, securely, and without requiring manual customer IT intervention.

 - Security Research Partnership: Collaborate closely with Security Research to ensure the runner seamlessly executes new autonomous pentest capabilities as they ship.

 - Act as a Product Owner: Partner with product managers, security researchers, and customer success to manage the client-side roadmap.

What You'll Bring

Platform Leadership & Architecture

 - Demonstrated expertise leading teams that design, build, and operate containerized software (Docker, VM images) deployed into on-premise or customer-managed environments.

 - Experience implementing robust software supply chain practices — secure builds, image signing (cosign, Notary), reproducible builds, and vulnerability scanning in CI.

 - Experience designing and operating OTA update mechanisms for distributed agents or edge software at scale — including staged rollouts, rollback, and delivery verification.

 - Ability to reason about correctness in opaque, customer-controlled environments where you cannot observe failure modes directly.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

 - Experience building or significantly growing an engineering team — including hiring, onboarding, and establishing engineering norms tailored for shipped software.

 - Proven ability to define and instill engineering culture: rigorous code review standards, robust testing across diverse customer environments, and a strong culture of ownership.

 - Drives high-impact architecture decisions rigorously — requires design documents, runs structured reviews, builds consensus, and ensures decisions account for customer environment variables.

Technical Expertise

 - Proficient in Go (preferred), Python, or C++.

 - Strong Linux OS-level operations: container runtimes, networking in corporate environments, systemd, process isolation.

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines for building and signing container images (cosign, Notary v2, or equivalent).

 - Familiarity with OTA update protocols and frameworks: TUF (The Update Framework), Omaha, or custom mechanisms.

 - Understanding of TLS, certificate pinning, and secure software delivery in hostile network environments.

Nice to Haves

 - Exposure to cybersecurity, pentesting tools, or vulnerability remediation.

 - Experience with cross-platform agents (Windows/Linux) and endpoint

Position Overview

This is a senior, hands-on technical leadership role. We are looking for someone who can become a trusted technical owner for our MDM platform and reliably drive initiatives from design through execution.

The ideal candidate should have strong Semarchy xDM and Master Data Management expertise, combined with solid data engineering, data analysis, team leadership, and business-facing communication skills.

Key Requirements

. 10+ years of relevant engineering and data experience.

            Strong hands-on expertise with Semarchy xDM. Deep understanding of Master Data Management concepts, including match/merge, survivorship, golden records, hierarchies, data quality, stewardship, workflows, and publishing/integration patterns. Proven experience implementing enterprise MDM solutions end-to-end, from requirements and data analysis through production implementation and support. Strong SQL, data profiling, and data analysis skills, with the ability to investigate anomalies, identify patterns, and drive root-cause analysis. Strong understanding of the underlying data domain and the ability to go beyond application configuration to understand source data, business processes, and downstream consumption. Solid data engineering background with experience building and supporting production-grade data pipelines. Experience with technologies such as Snowflake, Azure, ADF, dbt, Fivetran, Python, APIs, or comparable modern data technologies. Strong understanding of data modeling, data quality, data governance, metadata, lineage, and stewardship concepts. Ability to manage multiple priorities and switch effectively between architecture, engineering, analysis, team leadership, and stakeholder engagement. Comfortable operating in a high-expectation, fast-moving environment with competing priorities and tight delivery timelines. Ability to provide hands-on technical leadership to onshore and offshore engineering teams. Experience reviewing and guiding technical designs, data models, SQL, pipelines, implementation approaches, and code. Strong ownership mindset someone who can take ambiguous problems, bring structure, make sound technical decisions, and drive them through completion. Strong curiosity about data and a genuine passion for solving difficult data problems. Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on identifying and addressing root causes rather than implementing short-term fixes. Outcome-driven, dependable, and committed to delivery. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong presentation skills and the ability to communicate effectively with Product Owners, Data Stewards, business stakeholders, architects, engineering teams, and senior technology leaders. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable and maintainable technical solutions. Forward-looking mindset with an interest in modern engineering practices and AI-native approaches to data quality, automation, engineering productivity, and problem solving. Strongly Preferred

            Financial Services, Asset Management, Wealth Management, or Capital Markets experience. Experience with Client, Customer, Organization, Contact, Account, Party, or similar master data domains. Salesforce integration experience. Experience modernizing or re-architecting an existing MDM implementation. Experience integrating MDM platforms with cloud data warehouses, operational systems, APIs, and downstream analytical platforms.

Position: End User Computing (EUC) Engineer
Location: Stevens Point, Wisconsin (Onsite)

Salary: $85,000/Annum
Employment Type: Full Time

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced End User Computing (EUC) Engineer to provide onsite IT support for the Stevens Point manufacturing facility. The role is responsible for end user support, desktop/laptop management, network troubleshooting, plant IT infrastructure support, and coordination with regional and global IT teams to ensure high availability of business-critical systems.

Key Responsibilities

Provide Level 2/Level 3 onsite IT support for end user devices, printers, scanners, and peripherals.Install, configure, and troubleshoot Windows desktops and laptops.Support Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Azure AD, and Exchange Online.Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and connectivity issues.Perform network troubleshooting involving switches, VLANs, DHCP, DNS, and Wi Fi.Support Cisco networking equipment and coordinate with network teams.Manage IT assets, device deployments, and hardware replacements.Support manufacturing shop floor systems, barcode printers, scanners, and label printers.Work with ServiceNow for incident, request, and change management.Perform root cause analysis and ensure timely resolution of incidents.Coordinate with vendors and infrastructure teams during outages and planned maintenance.Participate in on call support and emergency response when required.Maintain documentation, SOPs, and knowledge articles.

Required Skills

5+ years of End User Computing / Desktop Support experience.Strong knowledge of Windows 10/11 administration.Microsoft 365 Administration.Active Directory and Azure AD.Hardware troubleshooting (Dell/HP laptops & desktops).Printer and peripheral support.Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tools.Excellent customer service and communication skills.

Network Skills (Mandatory)

CCNA Certification (Preferred) or equivalent Cisco networking experience.Good understanding of:Cisco SwitchesVLANsTCP/IPDNSDHCPVPN
Wireless NetworkingNetwork troubleshooting
Preferred Skills

Experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment.Cisco Meraki/Catalyst administration.Intune/Autopilot device management.SCCM/MECM.PowerShell scripting.Knowledge of cybersecurity is best practice.Experience supporting shop floor IT infrastructure.

Education

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field (preferred).CCNA certification is preferred.Microsoft certifications are an added advantage.Key Competencies

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.Excellent communication and stakeholder management.Ability to prioritize multiple incidents in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.Strong documentation and knowledge transfer skills.

Priority Requirement: The resource should be available to join immediately to support knowledge transfer before the current engineer's departure and ensure continuity of operations at the Stevens Point plant.

* Automatización de tareas mediante PowerShell, Bash o APIs REST.

jobs.title: Endpoint Manager Specialist
jobs.summary: Company Description - ------------------ Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for...
jobs.description:
Company Description
- ------------------

Creating a future worth living for future generations gets us out of bed every morning. Depending on the project, we are consultants, implementers, or both for sustainable, innovative and economical solutions for real estate, industry, energy and infrastructure. Our more than 6,500 employees at over 80 locations worldwide support our customers in interdisciplinary teams. Our thinking is both visionary and realistic. We work independently and as part of a team. With passion and the latest technologies. We unite. Join us at Dreso and let's create a world we want to live in.

Job Description
- --------------

We are looking for an**Endpoint Management Specialist** profile to join our IT team. The position provides advanced technical support to internal users across different countries and global regions, while also contributing to system administration and network operations to ensure stable and secure IT services.

Join us in shaping the future of IT security, developing secure and sustainable endpoint architectures, and actively contributing to making our digital workplace resilient and compliant. With us, you'll have the freedom to contribute big ideas and take initiative. As part of an interdisciplinary and diverse team, you'll apply your expertise in endpoint management to ambitious projects, help shape standards and roadmaps, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are reliably implemented. We look forward to receiving your application for our office in Málaga.

**Due to the international scope of the role, working hours are not fixed and may include evening, night, weekend, or rotating shifts, depending on the regions being supported.**

**Key responsibilities:**

**Endpoint Operations \& Support**

* Provide Level 2/3 support for endpoint-related incidents and service requests.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and device management issues.
* Manage incidents through their full lifecycle and perform root cause analysis.
* Support user onboarding, offboarding, and device provisioning activities.

**Endpoint Management**

* Support and maintain Microsoft Intune, Entra ID, and Microsoft 365 services.
* Configure and test device policies, compliance policies, and configuration profiles.
* Monitor endpoint compliance and support remediation activities.
* Assist with device lifecycle management and deployment processes.

**Software Packaging \& Deployment**

* Package, test, and deploy software applications and updates.
* Troubleshoot application deployment issues.
* Support application lifecycle management and software maintenance.

**Testing \& Continuous Improvement**

* Validate new endpoint configurations, policies, and solutions before production rollout.
* Participate in pilot deployments and testing activities.
* Contribute to process improvements, automation, and service optimization initiatives.

**Documentation \& Knowledge Management**

* Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and knowledge articles.
* Document recurring issues and standard solutions.
* Support knowledge sharing within the Endpoint Management team.

Qualifications
- -------------

* 4 years of experience in Endpoint Management, IT Operations, or advanced IT Support
* Experience with Microsoft Intune and endpoint management solutions
* Knowledge of software packaging and application deployment
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills
* Understanding of endpoint security and compliance concepts
* Basic PowerShell knowledge is an advantage
* Strong communication and customer service skills
* Fluent **English**(C1 or C2)

Additional Information
- ---------------------

* To ensure your work-life balance, we offer the option of mobile working
* We promote your professional and personal development through individual training and further education at the Drees \& Sommer Academy
* We support your health with a bonus for sports enthusiasts. We offer the possibility of subscribing to a private health insurance policy
* Employees benefit from tax advantages related to their commuting expenses for the office
* Fiscal advantages for employees expenses in meal costs during worktime. Employee referral program with attractive bonus scheme
* Supporting career and family by receiving tax benefits for kindergarten expenses

About the position

The senior North America (NA) Digital Workplace Client Engineer is responsible for engineering, implementing, and managing the full spectrum of North America's modern workplace endpoint platforms. Primary technologies include Microsoft Intune as the cloud-native Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) solution, Windows client platforms, iOS/iPadOS mobile devices via Apple Business Manager (ABM), and next-generation virtual endpoint solutions including Windows 365 Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD). The role also encompasses Microsoft Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join strategies for identity-based endpoint access.
The senior Client Engineer serves as the North America subject matter expert (SME) and Level 4 escalation authority for client endpoint technologies, defining technical standards, multi-year roadmaps, and architecture that position NA as the global model for modern endpoint engineering. This role partners closely with Microsoft and other key vendors, participates in product roadmap planning, and drives the transition from legacy on-premises management (SCCM, Group Policy) to a fully cloud-native endpoint model.
This is a senior individual contributor role reporting to the Team Manager, NA Digital Workplace Client Engineering Services. The North America environment serves as the reference architecture and foundation for global endpoint standards adoption across the Honda enterprise.

Responsibilities

Engineer, implement, and support Microsoft Intune as the primary Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) platform for Windows, iOS/iPadOS, MacOS and virtual endpoints. Manage device enrollment, configuration, compliance, application deployment, Windows Autopilot, and Apple Business Manager integration.Define endpoint architecture, standards, and multi-year technology roadmaps for Intune, Microsoft Entra ID Join, Hybrid Entra ID Join, Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), and mobile device management solutions.Serve as the highest-level technical escalation point for complex endpoint issues, leading root cause analysis, problem management, and long-term remediation while providing technical guidance to support teams.Lead the transition from SCCM and Group Policy-based management to cloud-native endpoint management through Intune, including migration planning, deployment strategy, and adoption of zero-touch provisioning technologies.Partner with Microsoft, Apple, and other technology providers to evaluate emerging solutions, conduct proof-of-concept initiatives, influence product direction, and recommend technology investments.Collaborate with security, identity, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure endpoint services align with compliance, governance, security, and digital workplace objectives.Develop and maintain engineering standards, operational procedures, runbooks, and technical documentation.Requirements

A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science / Information Technology (IT) / Networking / Electronics or a related STEM field of study, or equivalent relevant professional experience in the industry along with industry standard certifications.At least 8 or more years of enterprise endpoint engineering, modern desktop administration, or endpoint management experience.5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Intune administration and engineering experience supporting Windows and mobile platforms.3+ years of experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), including Entra ID Join and Hybrid Entra ID Join implementations.2+ years of enterprise iOS/iPadOS device management experience using Intune and Apple Business Manager.Strong expertise in Microsoft Intune, Windows management, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application packaging and deployment, and endpoint lifecycle management.Experience migrating SCCM and Group Policy-managed environments to cloud-native Intune management.Knowledge of Apple Business Manager, Mobile Device Management (MDM), Mobile Application Management (MAM), and enterprise iOS deployment practices.Experience with Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, BitLocker, endpoint security baselines, compliance reporting, and governance requirements.Proficiency in PowerShell automation, Microsoft Graph, reporting, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.Experience with ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms, technical documentation, vendor engagement, roadmap planning, and stakeholder communication.Nice-to-haves

Experience with Windows 365 Cloud PC, Azure Virtual Desktop (AVD), Power BI, Azure Monitor, and Microsoft endpoint management certifications.Benefits

We don't simply hire employees. We invest in them. When you work at Chatham, we empower you - offering professional development opportunities to help you grow in your career, no matter if you've been here for five months or 15 years. Chatham has worked hard to create a distinct work environment that values people, teamwork, integrity, and client service. You will have immediate opportunities to partner with talented subject matter experts, work on complex projects, and contribute to the value Chatham delivers every day.

The Digital Workplace Engineer is part of the Digital Workplace Services team within Chatham's IT organization, focused on creating a modern, seamless technology experience for employees across the firm. This role on the team will focus on AI and automation, helping the firm scale intelligent, self-service solutions using AI platforms such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Codex, alongside tools like Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and PowerShell. In this role, you'll act as a modern solution evangelist within IT, working alongside a broader network of technology champions across the firm to drive adoption of AI, automation, and modern workplace capabilities.

In this role you will:

 Serve as a modern solution evangelist within IT, partnering with a firmwide network of technology champions to promote AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools-helping employees understand practical ways to apply these solutions to their work through articles, demos, webinars, and hands-on sessions.

 Partner directly with business units to consult on process challenges, identify automation opportunities, and design and build solutions using Power Automate, Power Apps, PowerShell, and Microsoft Graph.

 Actively engage with vendors and the broader AI and automation community to stay ahead of emerging tools, techniques, and best practices, bringing new capabilities back to the firm.

 Provide insightful feedback to IT leadership on AI and automation tooling to help shape strategic product and engineering decisions.

 Partner with IT to champion standards, governance, and best practices for citizen development and AI usage across the Power Platform and beyond, including automation of identity and access workflows in Microsoft Entra ID.

 Drive adoption and best practices across the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), partnering with the broader Digital Workplace Services team on the firm's core collaboration tools.

 Take ownership of key performance indicators tied to adoption, efficiency gains, and employee engagement with AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools.

 Lead engagements with the business to understand challenges and propose solutions for process improvement and business process automation.

Your impact:

 Serve as a technical leader and modern solution evangelist, advocating for the practical adoption of AI, automation, and Microsoft 365 tools across the firm, in partnership with the firm's broader network of technology champions

 Lead innovation by identifying and delivering automation solutions that eliminate manual work and unlock employee capacity

 Drive business process automation through hands-on consulting, Power Platform development, and self-service enablement

 Be a key contributor to developing IT's vision and roadmap for AI, automation, and modern workplace strategy

Contributors to your success:

 3-5+ years of experience in a similar role, with a demonstrated track record of building automation solutions and driving technology adoption.

 Exceptional communication and consulting skills, with the ability to gather requirements from non-technical stakeholders and translate them into automated solutions.

 Solid working knowledge of the Microsoft 365 suite (Teams, SharePoint, etc.), with the ability to champion adoption alongside the wider Digital Workplace Services team.

 Hands-on experience developing solutions with Microsoft Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps), PowerShell scripting, and Microsoft Graph; familiarity with Microsoft Entra ID (identity, access, and app registrations) is a plus.

 Strong emphasis on customer service and the ability to teach people of all technical abilities.

 Practical experience applying AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, GitHub Codex, Cursor) to real business problems, with enthusiasm for staying current on the fast-evolving AI landscape.

 Experience with Lean process improvement is a plus

For Denver based candidates, the compensation range for the position is expected to be between $82,000 and $100,000 annually. Total compensation, including base pay, discretionary individual bonus and company bonus, may be higher than range listed, depending on applicant's skills, qualifications, and experience. Benefits include health insurance, life and disability insurance, 401k, EAP, paid holidays and paid time off.

About Chatham Financial:

Chatham Financial is the leading independent capital markets advisor, delivering an integrated blend of expert advice and powerful technology to help you reduce risk and seize opportunity. With decades of capital markets strategy, execution, monitoring, and performance expertise, we serve as an unwavering advocate for your best interests and your innovation partner. Our technology platform unifies data across assets, debt, and derivatives, giving you unmatched agility, transparency, and insight.

It's clear ahead.

Our commitment is to carry that light forward in every partnership, every solution, and every market we serve.

We help guide the way-giving clients the insight and momentum to move forward with confidence, no matter what lies ahead.

Senior Systems Engineer (Microsoft 365 & Intune)
 Jacksonville, FL (Local Candidates Only)
$30.00 - $33.00/hour + Bonus + Benefits

 Award-Winning Culture. Rapid Growth. Exceptional Careers.
 At Scarlett Group, we're more than a technology company. We're a team of problem-solvers, innovators, and relationship builders committed to delivering exceptional experiences for our clients and our people.

 As a JBJ Best Places to Work and one of the region's fastest-growing technology companies, we invest in our employees through professional development, career advancement opportunities, challenging work, and a culture built on collaboration, accountability, and having fun while doing meaningful work.

 We're looking for a Senior Systems Engineer with deep Microsoft 365 and Intune expertise to serve as a technical leader within our Support organization.

 If you're someone who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, mentoring others, improving processes, and staying at the forefront of Microsoft technologies, we'd love to talk with you.

 What You'll Do

  Serve as the highest level of technical escalation for complex support issues across Microsoft 365, Intune, Entra ID, Azure, endpoint management, networking, and server environments.
  Lead advanced troubleshooting, root cause analysis, major incident response, and long-term remediation efforts.
  Design, implement, and support Microsoft Intune environments, including device management, Windows Autopilot, compliance policies, application deployment, and endpoint security.
  Administer and optimize Microsoft 365 environments, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Defender, and Entra ID.
  Evaluate client environments and recommend solutions that improve security, efficiency, productivity, and user experience.
  Mentor and support Help Desk and Systems Administration team members through coaching, technical guidance, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
  Lead or contribute to infrastructure, cloud, security, migration, onboarding, and modernization projects.
  Help improve service delivery by developing technical standards, documentation, automation, and operational best practices.

 What We're Looking For

  Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field preferred. Candidates with a strong combination of relevant experience, technical expertise, and industry certifications will also be considered.
  5+ years of experience in IT support, systems administration, engineering, or Managed Services (MSP) environments.
  Strong hands-on experience administering and troubleshooting Microsoft 365 environments.
  Strong expertise with Microsoft Intune, endpoint management, and modern workplace technologies.
  Experience supporting Entra ID, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, Defender, and Microsoft security solutions.
  Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, and Windows environments.
  Excellent troubleshooting, analytical, communication, and customer service skills.
  Ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-paced, client-focused environment.
  Experience with Azure, PowerShell, Security+, AZ-104, Endpoint Administrator, or other Microsoft certifications is highly valued.

 Why Scarlett

  Work for a JBJ Best Places to Work award winner.
  Join one of the fastest-growing technology companies in the region.
  Work with cutting-edge Microsoft cloud, security, and endpoint management technologies.
  Gain exposure to a wide variety of clients, environments, and technical challenges.
  Receive support for certifications, professional development, and career growth.
  Collaborate with a talented and supportive team that values continuous learning and innovation.
  Take ownership of meaningful projects and make a direct impact on client success.
  Grow your career in an organization that promotes from within whenever possible.

 Compensation
 Hourly Pay Range: $30.00 - $33.00 per hour

 Actual compensation is based on experience, technical expertise, certifications, skills, and other job-related factors.

 This position is classified as non-exempt and is eligible for overtime in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

 Benefits
 Scarlett offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional growth of our employees, including:

  Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  Life insurance
  401(k) with company match
  Paid Time Off (PTO)
  Paid company holidays
  Yearly bonus opportunity
  Monthly cell phone stipend
  Professional development and certification program
  Employee referral bonus program

  Work Location
  To support onboarding, training, team collaboration, and professional development, this position is expected to work onsite and must be local to the Jacksonville, Florida area.

  Why This Role Matters
  This position plays a critical role in ensuring Scarlett continues to deliver exceptional support and technical expertise to our clients. As a senior technical resource and subject matter expert in Microsoft 365 and Intune, you'll help solve complex challenges, strengthen client environments, mentor team members, and contribute to the continued growth of our technical organization.

  Ready to grow your career with Scarlett Group? We'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Description

Empower AI is seeking a MECM / SCCM Engineer to engineer and operate the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager infrastructure that manages thousands of endpoints for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer designs and maintains the MECM hierarchy, distribution points, boundaries, collections, client health, and reporting; engineers automated patch and software deployment, task sequences, and PXE provisioning; and validates every significant change in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment before release. As a privileged user, the engineer is a Tier III escalation resource and a primary contributor to CAT I/II/III patch compliance and RMF evidence for the endpoint environment. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:
Engineer, operate, and maintain the MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enclaves: hierarchy and site health, distribution points, boundaries and boundary groups, collections, client health remediation, role-based administration, and reporting.Design and maintain automated deployment mechanisms (software update deployments, application deployments, task sequences, PXE/OSD provisioning) and analyze deployment results to resolve failures and improve success rates.Plan and validate MECM upgrades, client updates, and configuration changes in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment, and implement them through formal Change Management with rollback plans.Produce MECM compliance and deployment reporting (patch compliance, image deployment cycle time, client health) for the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard and provide artifacts supporting the endpoint POA&M.Design, engineer, test, and implement endpoint infrastructure solutions including hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, configuration baselines, endpoint management platform enhancements, and VDI integration across multiple security enclaves.Support the evaluation and phased implementation of a Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling, including building and maintaining the pre-production replica, defining test procedures, and validating significant changes before production deployment.Develop engineering artifacts for Government approval: requirements, design documents, test plans and results, implementation and rollback plans, change packages, and as-built documentation.Engineer and integrate automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities (e.g., predictive analytics on service data, automated remediation, ServiceNow integrations) that improve support across all tiers, upon Government approval.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:
Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree).Must be a U.S. Citizen.Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start; this is a Privileged User position.Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, or CCNA-Security).Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.Minimum of 3 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or senior systems administration in an enterprise Windows environment.Hands-on experience with MECM/SCCM and/or Intune, Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), and PowerShell scripting.Experience developing engineering documentation (requirements, designs, test plans, change packages) and executing changes through formal Change Management.Experience applying DISA STIGs, working with ACAS/Nessus results, and supporting RMF control implementation and evidence collection.Understanding of IP networking, VDI, and endpoint security concepts sufficient to design and troubleshoot integrated solutions.Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills; ability to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.

DESIRED SKILLS:
CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, or CASP+ CE; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate; VMware VCP.Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.Experience building lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments for change validation and network modeling.Experience integrating AI/ML, RPA, or predictive analytics into IT operations, and familiarity with ServiceNow integrations and APIs.Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, DoDAF, and DoD ICAM Strategy.Experience with eMASS and RMF documentation.ITIL 4 Foundation certification.

Job specifications are intended to present a descriptive list of the range of duties performed by employees. Specifications are not intended to reflect all duties performed within the job.

SUMMARY:

The Systems Administrator shall demonstrate experience in systems administration in the following operating systems: UNIX, Linux, or Windows. The specialized experience includes Linux system administration of Redhat and security setup and updates (IAVA's); UNIX system administration of Solaris, UNIX scripting, Thin Client, Sudo, IDM, NTFS, CIFS, DNS, RDP Client, and security setup and updates (IAVA's); Windows system administration of WSUS and third party solutions, GPOs Windows Server and Windows Workstations, Thin Clients (hardware/software), Networking and documentation creation/updates.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  Possess the ability to install, configure and maintain Operating Systems.

   Manage the installation and integration of systems fixes, updates and enhancements Conduct testing, troubleshooting, performance optimization and maintenance of hardware and software systems.

   Provide support including end user assistance.

   Perform functions such as manage accounts, network rights, access to systems and equipment; maintain systems configuration and backups.

   Create and maintain documentation, Standard Operating Procedures (SOP).

   Create, monitor and maintain backups/restoration of systems and files.

   Conduct research of new and upcoming technologies.

   Provide input for future systems and purchases.

   Demonstrate general knowledge of enterprise frameworks and methodologies.

   Possess the ability to communicate effectively both written and verbally.

   Other duties as assigned.

  At least 1 year of system administration experience.

jobs.description:
Overview:

  Empower AI is AI for government. Empower AI gives federal agency leaders the tools to elevate the potential of their workforce with a direct path for meaningful transformation. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

   Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.
  Responsibilities:

  This position will support our newly awarded DCSA contract.

    Description

 Empower AI is seeking an Endpoint Engineer – MAC SME to engineer and sustain the MAC (macOS / iOS/ Jamf) endpoint systems and infrastructure on the NIPRNet, SIPRNet and JWICS (as available) enclaves of a Department of War agency, where the same standards of automation, hardening, and RMF compliance apply but tooling, connectivity, and handling procedures differ. The engineer operates the classified-enclave endpoint management infrastructure (e.g., Jamf), engineers and validates hardened images and Group Policy baselines, executes CAT I/II/III patching within enclave constraints, supports classified VDI and cross-domain considerations, and produces RMF evidence for the classified endpoint systems. This TS/SCI privileged-user role is the Tier III escalation point for classified endpoint incidents. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

    THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

    JOB DUTIES:

  Engineer, operate, and maintain the NIPIRNet, SIPRNet and JWICS endpoint systems and management infrastructure (macOS / iOS/ Jamf, imaging, provisioning, Group Policy) in accordance with enclave-specific security, transfer, and handling procedures.
  Plan and execute CAT I/II/III patch and software deployments on the classified enclaves within PRS timeframes, managing media transfer and disconnected/air-gapped update workflows where required.
  Engineer and validate hardened images and configuration baselines for classified endpoints against DISA STIGs and enclave authority requirements, and provide RMF control evidence and POA&M inputs in eMASS for the classified endpoint systems.
  Serve as the Tier III escalation point for classified-enclave endpoint incidents and coordinate with the enclave network, cybersecurity, and communications teams.
  Lead the engineering design, implementation, and lifecycle of the enterprise endpoint infrastructure: hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, endpoint management platform architecture (Jamf), configuration baselines, and VDI integration across all enclaves.
  Lead the evaluation, cost-benefit analysis, and phased implementation of the Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling; author the Digital Twin Evaluation and Implementation Plan; and establish the practice that every significant change is tested in the digital replica before deployment.
  Lead engineering for AI, automation, and analytics initiatives approved by the Government, including predictive analytics on service data, intelligent automation across support tiers, and integrations with the ITSM platform, and deliver Proof of Concept Reports documenting feasibility, risks, and benefits.
  Conduct market research and produce Market Research Reports and Rough Orders of Magnitude (ROMs) for emerging technologies and proposed solutions to support Government planning and IT Capability Request analysis.
  Qualifications:
  REQUIREMENTS:

  Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (a Master's degree with 8 years of related experience, or an additional 4 years of related experience in lieu of a degree, may be substituted). 7 years (education/experience) overall minimum required.
  Must be a U.S. Citizen.
  Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance with SCI eligibility (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start.
  Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.
  Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level I baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA A+ CE, Network+ CE, Security+ CE, CCNA-Security, or SSCP) prior to performing cybersecurity-related duties.

  Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.
  Minimum of 5 years of experience in systems or infrastructure engineering for enterprise MAC OS environments.
  Current Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP) Badge.
  Expert knowledge of macOS / iOS/ Jamf and/or MAC architecture, Active Directory, Group Policy, and MAC automation.
  Demonstrated experience designing and leading implementation of lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments and formal test-before-deploy practices.
  Experience leading proof-of-concept evaluations, market research, and cost-benefit/ROM development for Government or enterprise decision-makers.
  Extensive experience with DISA STIGs, ACAS/Nessus, RMF control implementation, POA&Ms, and eMASS.
  Experience leading engineering teams, establishing standards, and executing changes through formal Change Management.
  Excellent technical writing, briefing, and stakeholder communication skills; ability to participate in after-hours emergency on-call response.
  Experience working on NIPRNet, SIPRNet and/or JWICS enclaves and with classified media handling procedures.

    DESIRED SKILLS:

  CISSP, CASP+ CE, or GCED; AWS or Azure architect certification.
  Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.
  Experience applying AI/ML, RPA, or AIOps to IT service management and endpoint operations, including ServiceNow integrations.
  Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Strategy and Reference Architecture, DoDAF 2.02, DoD ICAM Strategy, and Technology Business Management (TBM).
  ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional; PMP.
  Experience supporting IT Capability Request (ITCR) analysis and governance briefings.

 About Empower AI:

It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Headquartered in Reston, Va., Empower AI leverages three decades of experience solving complex challenges in Health, Defense, and Civilian missions. Our proven Empower AI Platform® provides a practical, sustainable path for clients to achieve transformation that is true to who they are, what they do, how they work, with the resources they have. The result is a government workforce that is exponentially more creative and productive. For more information, visit www.Empower.ai.

Empower AI is proud to be recognized as a 2024 Military Friendly Employer by Viqtory, the publisher of G.I. Jobs. This designation reflects the company’s commitment to hiring and supporting active-duty and veteran employees.

Responsibilities

This position will support our newly awarded DCSA contract.

Description

Empower AI is seeking a MECM / SCCM Engineer to engineer and operate the Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager infrastructure that manages thousands of endpoints for a Department of War agency across Pre-Production, NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves. The engineer designs and maintains the MECM hierarchy, distribution points, boundaries, collections, client health, and reporting; engineers automated patch and software deployment, task sequences, and PXE provisioning; and validates every significant change in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment before release. As a privileged user, the engineer is a Tier III escalation resource and a primary contributor to CAT I/II/III patch compliance and RMF evidence for the endpoint environment. This is a salaried, FLSA-exempt position in which you will independently analyze situations, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment on matters of significance to the program and its customers.

THIS IS AN ONSITE ROLE IN QUANTICO, VA (RKB) WITH UP TO 10% OF TRAVEL INVOLVED.

JOB DUTIES:
Engineer, operate, and maintain the MECM/SCCM infrastructure across enclaves: hierarchy and site health, distribution points, boundaries and boundary groups, collections, client health remediation, role-based administration, and reporting.Design and maintain automated deployment mechanisms (software update deployments, application deployments, task sequences, PXE/OSD provisioning) and analyze deployment results to resolve failures and improve success rates.Plan and validate MECM upgrades, client updates, and configuration changes in pre-production and the Digital Twin environment, and implement them through formal Change Management with rollback plans.Produce MECM compliance and deployment reporting (patch compliance, image deployment cycle time, client health) for the Customer Support Metrics Dashboard and provide artifacts supporting the endpoint POA&M.Design, engineer, test, and implement endpoint infrastructure solutions including hardened image pipelines, automated provisioning, configuration baselines, endpoint management platform enhancements, and VDI integration across multiple security enclaves.Support the evaluation and phased implementation of a Digital Twin capability for network and system modeling, including building and maintaining the pre-production replica, defining test procedures, and validating significant changes before production deployment.Develop engineering artifacts for Government approval: requirements, design documents, test plans and results, implementation and rollback plans, change packages, and as-built documentation.Engineer and integrate automation, AI/ML, and analytics capabilities (e.g., predictive analytics on service data, automated remediation, ServiceNow integrations) that improve support across all tiers, upon Government approval.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:
Bachelor's degree and a minimum of 3 years of related experience (an additional 4 years of related experience may be substituted for the degree).Must be a U.S. Citizen.Must have an Active Top Secret Clearance (favorably adjudicated T5/T5R) to start; this is a Privileged User position.Must be willing and able to obtain TS/SCI eligibility after start, if required by mission needs.Must be within investigation scope and/or currently enrolled in Continuous Evaluation / Continuous Vetting.Must possess and maintain a current DoD 8570/8140 IAT Level II baseline certification (e.g., CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, GSEC, SSCP, or CCNA-Security).Demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems, determine the appropriate course of action, and exercise discretion and independent judgment with limited day-to-day supervision.Minimum of 3 years of experience in systems engineering, infrastructure engineering, or senior systems administration in an enterprise Windows environment.Hands-on experience with MECM/SCCM and/or Intune, Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, virtualization (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), and PowerShell scripting.Experience developing engineering documentation (requirements, designs, test plans, change packages) and executing changes through formal Change Management.Experience applying DISA STIGs, working with ACAS/Nessus results, and supporting RMF control implementation and evidence collection.Understanding of IP networking, VDI, and endpoint security concepts sufficient to design and troubleshoot integrated solutions.Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills; ability to participate in an after-hours on-call rotation.

DESIRED SKILLS:
CompTIA Security+ CE, CySA+, or CASP+ CE; Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate; VMware VCP.Experience supporting Department of War (DoW), DoD, or Intelligence Community environments across NIPRNet, SIPRNet, and JWICS enclaves.Experience building lab, pre-production, or digital twin environments for change validation and network modeling.Experience integrating AI/ML, RPA, or predictive analytics into IT operations, and familiarity with ServiceNow integrations and APIs.Familiarity with DoD Zero Trust Reference Architecture, DoDAF, and DoD ICAM Strategy.Experience with eMASS and RMF documentation.ITIL 4 Foundation certification.
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

This position requires the ability to perform the below essential functions:

Sitting for long periodsStanding for long periodsAmbulate throughout an officeAmbulate between several buildings

About Empower AI

All hiring and promotion decisions at Empower AI are based on merit to bring the best talent available to contribute to our firm’s overall success. It is the policy of Empower AI not to discriminate against any applicant for employment, or employee because of age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status. Empower AI is a VEVRAA Federal Contractor.

If hired for this position, the base salary range would be within the range provided. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary based on various factors including but not limited to work location, skills, experience, gov con contractual requirements, and performance. The range listed is just one component of Empower AI's total compensation package for employees.

jobs.description:
About the position

The Senior EndPoint Administrator supports the maintenance, enhancement, and security of enterprise systems, including infrastructure, applications, and access controls. This role is responsible for troubleshooting complex system issues, implementing technical solutions, and ensuring the integrity and security of system configurations. The Senior EndPoint Administrator collaborates with cross-functional teams to manage infrastructure, application environments, and system-level security, with availability for after-hours support and participation in on-call rotations.

Responsibilities

Administers and supports enterprise infrastructure and systems, including servers, storage, and cloud-based platforms.Diagnoses and resolves complex technical issues, including hardware failures, software problems, and access-related incidents.Maintains system documentation, configuration standards, and procedures in accordance with organizational policies.Implements system updates, patches, and enhancements to ensure optimal performance and security.Manages access controls and security roles within enterprise applications, including ERP and HCM platforms.Participates in system security design, access provisioning, and auditing efforts to maintain compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.Collaborates with IT, Cybersecurity, and Identity Access Management (IAM) teams to support user access, security testing, and incident response.Supports automation and optimization initiatives related to system performance and user provisioning.Participates in rotational on-call support and scheduled maintenance activities as required.Performs other duties as assigned.Maintains regular and reliable attendance.Complies with all policies and standards.Design, optimize, and maintain enterprise MECM infrastructure (Primary Sites, CMG, DPs, WSUS) while driving co-management strategies, workload transitions, and adoption of modern endpoint technologies.Establish endpoint security baselines, drift detection, and automated remediation aligned with CIS Benchmarks and NIST controls to lead vulnerability management and audit readiness.Develop PowerShell scripts for automated administration and build custom SQL, SSRS, and Power BI dashboards to deliver executive and compliance reporting.Serve as the primary escalation point for advanced infrastructure and deployment issues while providing technical leadership and mentorship to junior and mid-level administrators.Requirements

H.S. Diploma or GED required4-6 years of progressive experience in systems administration supporting mid-to-large enterprise environments required
Experience configuring, maintaining, and troubleshooting infrastructure components (e.g., servers, storage, virtualization, networking) and enterprise applications required
Experience administering Microsoft SCCM/MECM/InTune and in an enterprise environment.Strong experience with: Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Microsoft InTune, Windows Server, Windows 10/11 administration, Active Directory, Group Policy, PowerShell scripting, SQL Server reporting, Windows deployment services, Endpoint security technologies
Proficiency with Windows and/or Linux server administration.Strong understanding of system security, backup, and recovery procedures.Experience with virtualization technologies (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V).Familiarity with Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, and enterprise networking concepts.Ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues.Strong communication and customer service skills.Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.Strong organizational and documentation skills.Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. for any employer.Nice-to-haves

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field preferred3-5 years of experience with access and security administration in enterprise platforms (e.g., ERP, HCM, EHR) preferred
Relevant certification in systems administration, such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, CompTIA Server+, or Red Hat Certified System Administrator (RHCSA) preferred
Security or access management certifications, such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Security certification preferred
Benefits

Competitive compensation
Paid time off for vacations, holidays, and illness
Comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription)401(k) retirement savings plan
Education support and student loan assistance
Life and disability insurance
Flexible spending account

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

Since H-E-B Digital Technology's inception, we've been investing heavily in our customers' digital experience, reinventing how they find inspiration from food, how they make food decisions, and how they ultimately get food into their homes. This is an exciting time to join H-E-B Digital. We're using the best available technologies to deliver modern, engaging, reliable, and scalable experiences to meet the needs of our growing audience.

As a Staff Systems Engineer, you'll provide end-to-end support to systems design & infrastructure, identify solutions to complex problems, and effectively propose paths forward to drive outcomes. You will recommend improvements to established frameworks for designing, testing, maintaining, and implementing systems related to H-E-B infrastructure business processes, operations, and systems, and ensure the highest levels of availability, performance, and security.

Once you're eligible, you'll become an Owner in the company, so we're looking for commitment, hard work, and focus on quality and Customer service. 'Partner-owned' means our most important resources--People--drive the innovation, growth, and success that make H-E-B The Greatest Omnichannel Retailing Company.

Do you have a:

HEART FOR PEOPLE... you can serve as technical authority and coordinate work for a group of engineers?

HEAD FOR BUSINESS... you make sound, mature technical judgments that result in significant impact?

PASSION FOR RESULTS... you can deliver sweeping technical initiatives with minimal guidance?

We are looking for:

- 7+ Years of experience or relevant and transferrable skills preferred

- Established career professional that exhibits a deep understanding of functional area

- Skilled communicator who brings clarity to projects and ideas

What is the work?

Design & Development / Information Technology:

Contributes to the overall systems design strategy and architecture specifically for more complex and interconnected systems
Designs infrastructure systems supporting H-E-B business processes, operations, and network-based product systems
Evaluates operating systems, databases, utilities software, or system management tools the perspective of best practices and on an ongoing basis to ensure business needs are met
Provides guidance on analyzing, testing and debugging to junior engineers as required
Evaluates / tests / debugs / implements applications programs supporting H-E-B infrastructure business processes, operations, and network-based product systems
Guides the team with analyzing, installing, configuring, and maintaining operating systems, databases, utilities software, or system management tools for large-scale changes to technologies/ infrastructure
Writes custom code/scripts
Contributes to the development of technology roadmaps in designs and implementations
Ensures the team adheres to architected technology roadmaps in designs and implementations
Serves as technical subject matter expert (SME) for cross-functional IT Teams; assists with / troubleshoots systems-related issues and maintenance
Assists in writing and communicating common goals and direction for team
Applies experience / knowledge of available technologies to provide detailed specifications for proposed solutions; assists in creating / presenting hands-on demonstrations for proposed solutions
Assists with the selection of vendors by conducting thorough vendor comparisons
Monitors internal and vendor service level objectives (SLOs) and agreements (SLAs) for complex/ larger scale solutions; identifies / resolves SLO / SLA gaps
Monitors system performance for productivity issues; identifies potential solutions; collaborates & guides with vendors, other Digital Teams to implement them
Contributes to the development of best-in-class security, backup, and redundancy strategies
Promotes H-E-B standards and procedures
Leads and manages complex projects requiring specialized technical knowledge
Coordinates with technical / non-technical Partners and clients to determine business requirements
May lead project teams and work cross functionally with other teams to achieve success. Takes responsibility for team and project decisions. Highly visible within their organization
Works independently with general direction. Coaches and mentors' other engineers in engineering techniques, processes, and new technologies; enables others to succeed
Interviews, mentors, and provides Partner feedback to ensure the efficient operation of the team
Manages and supports a mix of COTS, SaaS, and internal software and services
Usage of cost-benefit analyses in order to develop cost-efficient systems for specific projects.Performing quality control procedures to make sure that all systems are operational and efficient
Developing system control features that set and maintain quality standards for an organization
Interacting and working with a wide range of people, like management, vendors, clients and IT staff
Extensive hands-on experience with the Jira suite
Strong understanding of APIs

What is your background?

- A related degree or comparable formal training, certification, or work experience

- 7+ years of related systems experience

Do you have what it takes to be an H-E-B Staff Systems Engineer?

Advanced/Subject Matter Expertise of Mobile Device Management (Omnissa Workspace ONE preferred)
Advanced knowledge of all things Microsoft (Microsoft 365, Security, Compliance, Entra)
Advanced scripting and automation experience (e.g., Powershell or Python for automated installation, configuration, hardening, and maintenance tasks)
Strong knowledge of networking technologies (OSI network layers, TCP/IP)
Strong knowledge of various operating systems and their impact / implications
Strong knowledge of best practices related to system security measures, and with system administration, performance tuning, and monitoring
Advanced communication skills
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills
Effective time management and prioritization skills
Project management skills are a plus
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced technical environment with increasing support demands and complexity
Ability to manage multiple priorities and assigned tasks to meet deadlines and objectives
Ability to provide guidance and coach a team of junior engineers
Ability to work on significant projects and act as a technical owner. Provides regular mentorship to teams and is seen as a trusted leader by their organization. Creates/updates standards and practices for the department
Strong knowledge of Agile process

Can you...

- Function in a fast-paced, retail, office environment

- Travel by car or plane with overnight stays

- Work extended hours; sit for extended periods

- Work rotating and on-call schedules
